domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all client and counterparty identities across retail, corporate, institutional, and government segments. Owns KYC/CDD onboarding, customer lifecycle management, beneficial ownership, relationship hierarchies, customer segmentation, NPS tracking, and CLTV scoring. Supports CRM integration and serves as the FK reference for all other domains requiring party identification.

products.name: party
products.description: Golden master record for every legal entity or natural person the bank interacts with — retail clients, corporate borrowers, institutional counterparties, government entities, and internal legal entities. Stores canonical identity attributes: full legal name, date of birth / incorporation date, entity type (individual, corporation, partnership, trust, government), domicile country, residency status, citizenship, and lifecycle status (prospect, active, dormant, deceased, closed). Also captures: universal operational preferences (preferred language, preferred branch, statement delivery method, currency preference, time zone, accessibility requirements); external and internal identifiers (TIN, EIN, SSN, LEI, SWIFT BIC, DUNS, CIF number, passport number, national ID, Bloomberg BUID, Reuters PERM ID, legacy system IDs) with identifier type, issuing authority, effective/expiry dates, and is_primary flag per type; and lifecycle event audit log (prior status, new status, event type such as onboarded/activated/dormancy-flagged/reactivated/relationship-exited/deceased/merged/deduped, event timestamp, triggering system, initiating employee_id, approval employee_id, event notes). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for party identity, party identifiers, and party lifecycle events — no separate identifier or lifecycle event tables exist. Serves as the authoritative FK anchor for all other domains requiring party identification. Sourced from Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile — Customer Master).

attributes.description: Calculated customer lifetime value score representing the predicted net profit attributed to the entire future relationship with the party. Used for relationship prioritization and resource allocation.

attributes.name: date_of_birth

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: incorporation_date

attributes.name: is_pep
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the party is classified as a Politically Exposed Person. PEPs require enhanced due diligence under AML regulations.
attributes.references: FATF (Financial Action Task Force), AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Regulations

attributes.name: is_sanctioned
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the party appears on any sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU, etc.). Sanctioned parties are prohibited from transacting.
attributes.references: OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control), UN Security Council Sanctions, EU Sanctions

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent KYC verification was completed. Used to track periodic review requirements.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, FATF (Financial Action Task Force)

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Next Review Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review. Review frequency is typically risk-based.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, FATF (Financial Action Task Force)

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the KYC (Know Your Customer) verification process. Indicates whether customer due diligence has been completed and is current.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, FATF (Financial Action Task Force), BSA (Bank Secrecy Act)

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party as registered with governing authorities. For individuals, this is the full name as it appears on official documents. For legal entities, this is the registered business name.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act)

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the party in the customer lifecycle. Tracks the operational status from initial prospect through relationship termination or merger.

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number for individuals. Format varies by country (e.g., Social Security Number in USA, National Insurance Number in UK).
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Regulations

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score for the party, ranging from -100 to +100. Measures customer loyalty and satisfaction.

attributes.name: passport_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the passport. Used to ensure identity documents remain current for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: passport_issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the authority that issued the passport.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization) Doc 9303

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: Passport number for individual parties. Used for identity verification and cross-border compliance.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Standards, ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization) Doc 9303

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the party's preferred language for communication and documentation.

attributes.name: primary_address_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the party's primary physical address.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: primary_address_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the party's primary physical address.

attributes.name: primary_address_line_1
attributes.description: First line of the party's primary physical address. Typically contains street number and street name.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: primary_address_line_2
attributes.description: Second line of the party's primary physical address. Typically contains apartment, suite, or unit number.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: primary_address_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the party's primary physical address.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: primary_address_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the party's primary physical address.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, Universal Postal Union Standards

attributes.name: primary_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for party communication. Used for statements, notifications, and digital correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the party. Used for customer service, fraud alerts, and operational communication.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was last modified. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the party's relationship with the bank was terminated. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the party first established a relationship with the bank. Represents the initial onboarding or account opening date.

attributes.name: residency_status
attributes.description: Tax residency classification of the party. Critical for regulatory reporting under FATCA and CRS.
attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), CRS (Common Reporting Standard)

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk classification of the party based on AML (Anti-Money Laundering), sanctions screening, credit risk, and operational risk assessments.
attributes.references: FATF (Financial Action Task Force), BSA (Bank Secrecy Act), AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Regulations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this party record originated (e.g., T24 for Temenos T24, FIS_PROFILE for FIS Profile).

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Primary tax identification number issued by the domicile country tax authority. For US individuals this is SSN (Social Security Number), for US entities this is EIN (Employer Identification Number).
attributes.references: IRS (Internal Revenue Service), FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), CRS (Common Reporting Standard)

products.name: individual_profile
products.description: Extended personal profile for natural-person parties (retail and private banking clients). Captures demographic and lifestyle attributes beyond core identity: gender, marital status, number of dependents, education level, employment status, employer name, annual income, net worth band, primary occupation (NAICS/SIC code), politically exposed person (PEP) flag, US person flag (FATCA), tax residency countries (CRS), preferred contact method, and digital banking enrollment status. One-to-one with party where entity_type = individual.

attributes.name: individual_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual profile record. Primary key for natural-person parties in retail and private banking segments.

attributes.name: gender_code_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_list. Business justification: Demographic standardization - gender codes must be standardized for fair lending analysis (HMDA reporting), regulatory compliance, and demographic segmentation. Regulatory reporting requirement.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent party entity where entity_type equals individual. Establishes one-to-one relationship with core party master.

attributes.name: annual_income_amount
attributes.description: Total gross annual income declared by the individual in the banks reporting currency. Core input for credit decisioning, loan-to-income ratio calculations, and wealth management suitability assessments.

attributes.name: annual_income_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the declared annual income. Required for multi-currency operations and foreign exchange risk assessment.

attributes.name: biometric_authentication_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual has enabled biometric authentication (fingerprint, face recognition) for digital banking access. Used for security posture assessment and fraud risk scoring.

attributes.name: cltv_calculation_date
attributes.description: Date when the CLTV score was last calculated or refreshed. Used for model recency validation and refresh scheduling.

attributes.name: cltv_score
attributes.description: Predicted total net revenue the bank expects to earn from this individual over the entire customer relationship lifecycle. Used for prioritization, retention investment, and portfolio optimization.

attributes.name: credit_bureau_reporting_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual has consented to the bank reporting their credit activity to credit bureaus. Required in jurisdictions with opt-in credit reporting regimes.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Strategic segmentation classification assigned to the individual based on net worth, income, product holdings, and relationship depth. Drives service model, pricing, and relationship manager assignment.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual has consented to sharing their data with third parties (affiliates, partners, credit bureaus). Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: digital_banking_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the individual first enrolled in digital banking services. Used for cohort analysis, digital maturity scoring, and customer lifecycle stage determination.

attributes.name: digital_banking_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual has completed enrollment in the banks digital banking platform (online and mobile banking). Used for channel analytics, digital adoption tracking, and omnichannel strategy.

attributes.name: education_level
attributes.description: Highest level of formal education attained by the individual. Used for customer segmentation, product targeting, and financial literacy program design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: high_school|associate|bachelor|master|doctorate|professional|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the individuals current employer or business entity if self-employed. Used for income verification, employment stability assessment, and corporate banking cross-sell opportunities.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment classification of the individual. Critical input for credit risk assessment, loan origination decisioning, and income verification workflows.
attributes.references: ILO International Classification of Status in Employment (ICSE)

attributes.name: kyc_refresh_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Refresh Due Date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for periodic KYC refresh and customer due diligence update. Frequency is risk-based per AML regulations (typically annual for high-risk, biennial for medium-risk, triennial for low-risk).

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Current marital or civil partnership status of the individual. Impacts credit assessment, joint account eligibility, and wealth planning strategies.

attributes.name: marketing_consent_date
attributes.description: Date when the individual provided or last updated their marketing consent. Used for consent lifecycle management and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: marketing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications. Required for GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM compliance.

attributes.name: mobile_app_user_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual has downloaded and activated the banks mobile banking application. Used for mobile engagement metrics and push notification eligibility.

attributes.name: net_worth_band
attributes.description: Categorized range of the individuals total net worth (assets minus liabilities). Used for private banking eligibility, wealth management segmentation, and high-net-worth individual (HNWI) identification.
attributes.references: SEC Accredited Investor Definition / MiFID II

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score provided by the individual, ranging from 0 to 10. Measures customer loyalty and likelihood to recommend the bank to others.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent NPS score was collected. Used for trend analysis and survey recency validation.

attributes.name: number_of_dependents
attributes.description: Count of financial dependents claimed by the individual. Used in credit underwriting, affordability assessments, and wealth management planning.

attributes.name: occupation_code
attributes.description: Standardized occupation classification code (NAICS or SIC) representing the individuals primary profession. Enables industry-based risk segmentation and targeted product offerings.

attributes.name: occupation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the individuals job title or professional role. Complements occupation_code with human-readable context for relationship managers and underwriters.

attributes.name: pep_classification
attributes.description: Specific category of PEP status if pep_flag is true. Determines the level of enhanced due diligence and monitoring intensity required under AML frameworks.

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual is classified as a Politically Exposed Person under AML regulations. Triggers enhanced due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and senior management approval for account opening.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Individuals stated preference for primary communication channel. Used by CRM systems to optimize customer engagement, regulatory notifications, and marketing campaign delivery.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the individuals preferred language for communications and service delivery. Ensures compliance with language access requirements and enhances customer experience.

attributes.name: profile_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the individual profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and customer tenure calculations.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the individual profile. Controls access to banking services, reporting inclusion, and regulatory treatment.

attributes.name: profile_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the individual profile record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data freshness assessment, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Composite AML and financial crime risk rating assigned to the individual based on PEP status, geographic risk, transaction patterns, and adverse media screening. Determines monitoring intensity and review frequency.

attributes.name: risk_rating_date
attributes.description: Date when the AML risk rating was last assessed or updated. Used for periodic review scheduling and regulatory examination evidence.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Primary tax identification number issued by the individuals country of tax residency. Required for FATCA, CRS, and domestic tax reporting. May be SSN, EIN, or foreign equivalent.

attributes.name: tax_residency_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing all jurisdictions where the individual is a tax resident. Required for CRS (Common Reporting Standard) compliance and automatic exchange of information.

attributes.name: us_person_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual is classified as a US person under FATCA regulations (US citizen, green card holder, or US tax resident). Triggers IRS Form W-9 collection and FATCA reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act) / IRS Publication 515

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_list. Business justification: Legal entity type validation - legal form (LLC, Corporation, Partnership, Trust) affects regulatory treatment, tax reporting, liability assessment, and credit risk evaluation. Must use standardized co

attributes.name: credit_rating_moodys

attributes.name: credit_rating_sp
attributes.description: The long-term issuer credit rating assigned by Standard & Poor's (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-, CCC). Used for credit risk assessment, capital allocation, and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: employee_count_band
attributes.description: The size band representing the approximate number of employees working for the entity. Used for segmentation, credit risk assessment, and regulatory reporting (e.g., SME classification).

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the entity was legally incorporated or registered in its jurisdiction. Used for entity age calculations and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: industry_classification_system
attributes.description: The classification system used for the industry_classification_code field (SIC, NAICS, or ISIC).

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: The bank's internal credit rating assigned to the entity based on proprietary credit risk models and assessment frameworks. Used for IRB (Internal Ratings-Based) approach under Basel III and internal risk management.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB Approach, Internal Credit Risk Policy

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent KYC/CDD (Customer Due Diligence) review was completed for this corporate entity. Used to track KYC refresh cycles and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Next Review Date

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the corporate entity as registered with the jurisdiction of incorporation. This is the official name used in all legal documents, contracts, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: operating_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the entity's primary operating or business address. This may differ from the registered address and represents where the entity conducts its day-to-day business operations.

attributes.name: operating_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the entity's primary operating address (suite, floor, building name, etc.).

attributes.name: operating_city

products.name: kyc_record
products.description: KYC/CDD (Know Your Customer / Customer Due Diligence) master record encompassing current KYC state, review event history, and consolidated AML/financial-crime risk rating for each party. Current KYC state: KYC tier (simplified, standard, enhanced EDD), onboarding date, last review date, next scheduled review date, AML risk rating (low/medium/high/very-high), risk rating rationale, CDD/EDD completion status, source of funds/wealth verification, PEP screening result, sanctions screening result, adverse media screening result, KYC analyst and approver employee_ids, and overall KYC status (pending, approved, expired, rejected). Review event history (time-series): review trigger type (periodic, risk-triggered, regulatory, client-initiated), review date, prior and new risk ratings, review outcome (no change, upgraded, downgraded, escalated to EDD, relationship exited), EDD required flag, EDD completion date, reviewer and approver employee_ids, and next review due date. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for AML/financial-crime risk rating and KYC review events — no separate review event or AML risk rating tables exist. Credit risk and operational risk ratings are owned by the risk domain. Provides the complete audit trail required for regulatory examination. Sourced from AML/Financial Crime System (NICE Actimize / Oracle Financial Crime).

products.name: customer_beneficial_owner
products.description: Registry of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) for corporate and trust parties, satisfying FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule (31 CFR 1010.230) and FATF Recommendations 24/25. products.name: party_address
products.description: Unified contact point registry for all physical addresses and electronic contact details associated with a party. For physical addresses: address type (registered, mailing, residential, business, branch, billing), address lines, city, state/province, postal code, country (ISO 3166-1), geocode, effective/expiry dates, is_primary flag, verification status. For electronic contacts: contact type (mobile, home phone, work phone, fax, primary email, secondary email, digital identifier), contact value, country code, is_verified flag, verification date, opt-in status for marketing/e-statements, do-not-call flag. attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), CRS (Common Reporting Standard)

attributes.name: usage_context
attributes.description: Business context in which this contact detail or address is used: correspondence (general communication), service (account servicing), billing (invoices and statements), legal (regulatory notices), kyc (identity verification), or emergency (urgent contact).

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the contact detail or address was last verified. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) / CDD (Customer Due Diligence) Standards

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the contact detail or address: document (utility bill, bank statement), third_party (credit bureau, data vendor), customer_declaration, site_visit, or electronic (email link, SMS OTP).
attributes.references: AML (Anti-Money Laundering) / KYC (Know Your Customer) Guidelines

products.name: party_contact
products.description: Contact details for a party across all communication channels: phone (mobile, home, work, fax), email (primary, secondary, business), and digital identifiers. Captures: contact type, contact value, country code, is_primary flag, is_verified flag, verification date, opt-in status for marketing, opt-in status for e-statements, do-not-call flag, and effective/expiry dates. Supports omnichannel CRM integration and regulatory notification obligations.

attributes.name: party_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the party contact record. Primary key for the party_contact data product.

attributes.name: contact_type_code_list_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contact Type Code List Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_list. Business justification: Contact management - contact types (Mobile, Email, Landline, Fax) must be standardized for omnichannel communication, regulatory notifications, and contact preference management.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Contact validation - phone country codes and address validation require validated country reference for contact center routing, regulatory notifications, and international dialing rules.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (customer, counterparty, or entity) to whom this contact information belongs. Links to the party master data product.

attributes.name: area_code
attributes.description: Geographic area code or regional prefix for phone numbers. Applicable to phone contact types only.

attributes.name: bounce_count
attributes.description: The number of times an email sent to this contact has bounced (failed delivery). Used to identify invalid or inactive email addresses. Applicable to email contact types only.

attributes.name: contact_preference_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the party's preference order for this contact method. Lower numbers indicate higher preference (1 = most preferred). Used for omnichannel communication routing.
attributes.references: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Contact Preference Standards

attributes.name: contact_purpose
attributes.description: The intended purpose or use case for this contact information. Personal for personal communications, business for business-related communications, emergency for urgent notifications, billing for payment-related communications, correspondence for general account communications.
attributes.references: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Contact Classification Standards

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the contact information. Active indicates the contact is valid and in use. Inactive indicates the contact is no longer in use. Bounced indicates email delivery failures. Invalid indicates the contact failed validation. Suspended indicates temporary restriction.
attributes.references: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Contact Management Standards

attributes.name: contact_value
attributes.description: The actual contact information value (phone number, email address, or digital identifier). Format varies by contact type. Classified as restricted PII (Personally Identifiable Information) for phone and email.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 4, CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contact record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the party has requested not to be contacted via phone for marketing or solicitation purposes. True if do-not-call is active, False otherwise. Required for TCPA compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), National Do Not Call Registry

attributes.name: do_not_email
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the party has requested not to be contacted via email for marketing purposes. True if do-not-email is active, False otherwise. Required for CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 21

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the party has requested not to receive physical mail for marketing purposes. True if do-not-mail is active, False otherwise.
attributes.references: DMA (Direct Marketing Association) Guidelines, GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 21

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this contact information is valid and active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Supports temporal tracking of contact information changes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this contact information is valid. Null indicates the contact is currently active with no planned end date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Supports temporal tracking of contact information changes.

attributes.name: extension
attributes.description: Internal phone extension number for work or business phone contacts. Applicable to work phone contact types only.

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary or preferred contact method for the party. True if primary, False otherwise.
attributes.references: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Contact Preference Standards

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact information has been verified through a validation process (e.g., email verification link, SMS OTP). True if verified, False otherwise.
attributes.references: KYC (Know Your Customer) Verification Standards, AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Compliance

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the preferred language for communications via this contact method (e.g., en for English, es for Spanish, fr for French).

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent email bounce. Null if no bounces have occurred. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Applicable to email contact types only.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact method was last used to communicate with the party. Null if never contacted. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) Activity Tracking Standards

attributes.name: opt_in_estatements
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the party has consented to receive account statements and regulatory notifications electronically via this contact method. True if opted in, False otherwise.
attributes.references: E-SIGN Act (Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act), UETA (Uniform Electronic Transactions Act)

attributes.name: opt_in_estatements_date
attributes.description: The date when the party provided consent for electronic statements. Null if not opted in. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: E-SIGN Act, UETA (Uniform Electronic Transactions Act)

attributes.name: opt_in_marketing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the party has consented to receive marketing communications via this contact method. True if opted in, False otherwise. Required for GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 6, CAN-SPAM Act, TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: opt_in_marketing_date
attributes.description: The date when the party provided consent for marketing communications. Null if not opted in. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Article 7, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or channel from which this contact information was originally captured (e.g., Core Banking System, CRM, Mobile App, Branch, Call Center, Online Banking).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone associated with this contact information, using IANA time zone database format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used to schedule communications at appropriate local times and comply with TCPA calling hour restrictions.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database, TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contact record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Updated on every change to support change data capture and audit trails.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact information was last verified. Null if never verified. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the contact information. Options include email verification link, SMS one-time password, voice call verification, manual verification by staff, or third-party verification service.

products.name: party_document
products.description: Identity and supporting documents collected during KYC onboarding and periodic reviews. Captures: document type (passport, national ID, driver's license, articles of incorporation, certificate of good standing, audited financials, utility bill), issuing country, document number, issue date, expiry date, verification status (unverified, verified, expired), verification method (manual, biometric, third-party bureau), document storage reference (vault URI), and collecting employee_id. Supports CDD evidence chain and regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: party_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the party document record. Primary key.

attributes.name: document_type_code_list_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Document Type Code List Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_list. Business justification: Document type validation - KYC document types (Passport, Driver's License, Utility Bill, Bank Statement) must be standardized for regulatory reporting consistency and document verification workflows.

attributes.name: issuing_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: KYC/AML compliance - passport/ID issuing country must be validated for document verification, sanctions screening, and regulatory reporting. Core identity verification process.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (customer, counterparty, or entity) to whom this document belongs. Links to the party master record.

attributes.name: primary_party_verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or compliance officer who performed or approved the document verification. Links to the employee master record for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: collection_channel
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the document was collected from the party. Examples include branch submission, online portal upload, mobile app, email attachment, postal mail, or third-party agent.

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was collected or received from the party during the KYC onboarding or periodic review process. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level indicating the sensitivity and access restrictions for the document. Aligns with the bank's data classification policy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party document record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: destruction_eligible_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document becomes eligible for secure destruction or deletion based on retention policy and regulatory requirements. Nullable if document must be retained indefinitely. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Data Retention Policy, GDPR Article 5, BSA

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: File format or MIME type of the stored document (e.g., PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, DOCX, XML). Indicates the digital format in which the document is archived.

attributes.name: document_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code indicating the primary language in which the document is written (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish, FRA for French, DEU for German, CHI for Chinese).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The unique identification number or reference code printed on the document (e.g., passport number, national ID number, driver's license number, corporate registration number).

attributes.name: document_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the stored document file in kilobytes. Used for storage management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: document_storage_uri
attributes.description: Secure storage location reference (URI, file path, or vault key) pointing to the digitized copy of the document in the bank's document management system or secure vault. Used to retrieve the document image or PDF for audit and review.
attributes.references: Data Security Standards, SOX, GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document expires and is no longer valid for identification or verification purposes. Nullable for documents without expiration (e.g., some corporate certificates). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: is_primary_identity_document
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this document is the primary identity document used for KYC verification (e.g., the main passport or national ID). True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was originally issued by the authority. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, regulatory body, or institution that issued the document (e.g., U.S. Department of State, UK Home Office, Companies House, Ministry of Finance).

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was last reviewed or re-verified by compliance or operations. Used to track periodic KYC refresh cycles. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or observations related to the document collection, verification, or review process. Used by compliance officers and relationship managers for context and audit trail.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this document is required for regulatory reporting purposes (e.g., FATCA, CRS, SAR filing). True if required for reporting, False otherwise.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or code describing why the document was rejected during verification (e.g., expired, illegible, fraudulent, does not match party details, insufficient information). Nullable if document is not rejected.

attributes.name: retention_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years the document must be retained in the bank's records to comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., 5 years for AML, 7 years for tax records). Drives document lifecycle and archival policies.
attributes.references: BSA, AML Regulations, SOX, GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the document must be reviewed or re-verified as part of periodic KYC refresh or regulatory compliance requirements. Nullable if no periodic review is required. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: KYC Standards, AML Regulations, CDD Requirements

attributes.name: translation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the document requires translation into the bank's primary operating language for compliance or operational purposes. True if translation is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: translation_status
attributes.description: Status of the document translation process. Indicates whether translation is not required, pending, completed, or certified by a professional translator.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party document record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document verification was completed and the verification status was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method or channel used to verify the authenticity of the document. Examples include manual review by compliance officer, biometric matching, third-party verification bureau (e.g., Experian, LexisNexis), automated OCR and data extraction, video KYC, or in-person verification.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification status of the document in the KYC (Know Your Customer) and CDD (Customer Due Diligence) process. Indicates whether the document has been authenticated and accepted.

products.name: relationship_hierarchy
products.description: Unified registry of all inter-party relationships including hierarchical structures (parent-subsidiary, branch, household, ownership chains) and bilateral/reciprocal associations (guarantor-borrower, co-applicant, authorized signatory, power of attorney, referral source, introducer, joint account holder). Captures: party_a_id, party_b_id, relationship type, relationship direction (hierarchical, bilateral, reciprocal), role_a, role_b, hierarchy level (for tree structures), effective date, expiry date, is_active flag, and supporting document reference. Enables corporate group structure traversal, consolidated exposure calculation (Basel III large exposure framework), group-level KYC, household-level cross-sell analytics, relationship-aware credit aggregation, and CRM relationship mapping. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all party-to-party relationships — both hierarchical and bilateral. No separate bilateral relationship table exists. Sourced from Core Banking System and CRM.

attributes.name: relationship_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the party-to-party relationship record. Primary key for the relationship hierarchy entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or relationship manager responsible for managing this party-to-party relationship. Used for accountability, CRM workflows, and performance tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this relationship record. Used for audit trails, accountability, and compliance with SOX and data governance requirements.

attributes.name: primary_relationship_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the first party in the relationship. For hierarchical relationships, this is typically the parent, controlling entity, or primary party. For bilateral relationships, this is one side of the association.

attributes.name: relationship_type_code_list_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Relationship Type Code List Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_list. Business justification: Relationship management - relationship types (Parent-Subsidiary, Guarantor-Borrower, Ultimate Parent, Affiliate) must be standardized for credit risk aggregation, related-party reporting, and exposure

attributes.name: consolidated_exposure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship should be included in consolidated exposure calculations for regulatory capital and large exposure reporting (Basel III). True for relationships that create economic dependency or control (e.g., parent-subsidiary, guarantor-borrower).
attributes.references: Basel III Large Exposure Framework, CRR Article 4

attributes.name: control_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Party A exercises control over Party B, as defined by accounting standards (IFRS 10) or regulatory frameworks (Basel III). Control may exist even without majority ownership (e.g., through voting rights, board representation, or contractual arrangements). Used for consolidated financial reporting and group-level risk aggregation.
attributes.references: IFRS 10, Basel III Large Exposure Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this relationship record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: cross_sell_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship enables cross-sell opportunities (e.g., household members, corporate group entities). Used for CRM analytics, marketing campaigns, and customer lifetime value (CLTV) scoring.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this relationship became active or legally binding. Used for temporal analysis, historical relationship tracking, and regulatory reporting (e.g., KYC refresh, group structure changes).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this relationship ends or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended or ongoing relationships. Used for relationship lifecycle management and automated alerts for relationship renewals or reviews.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth or tier of this relationship within a hierarchical tree structure. Level 1 represents the top-most parent or ultimate controlling entity. Used for corporate group structure traversal and consolidated exposure calculation. Null for non-hierarchical (bilateral or reciprocal) relationships.
attributes.references: Basel III Large Exposure Framework, IFRS 10

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship is currently active and in effect. False indicates the relationship has been terminated, suspended, or superseded. Used for filtering current relationships in exposure calculations, CRM views, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: kyc_last_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Last Review Date
attributes.description: The date on which this relationship was last reviewed or refreshed as part of KYC/CDD procedures. Used for tracking KYC refresh cycles and ensuring compliance with periodic review requirements.

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Next Review Date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next KYC/CDD review or refresh of this relationship. Used for proactive compliance management and automated workflow triggers.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates the KYC verification status of this relationship. Verified indicates the relationship has been validated through KYC/CDD procedures. Pending indicates verification is in progress. Expired indicates the relationship requires re-verification. Used for AML compliance and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, KYC/CDD Standards, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this relationship record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, comments, or special instructions related to this relationship. Used for capturing qualitative information that does not fit structured fields (e.g., special approval conditions, relationship history).

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of ownership, control, or beneficial interest that Party A holds in Party B. Applicable for ownership, parent-subsidiary, and beneficial ownership relationships. Used for consolidated exposure calculations and regulatory reporting (e.g., Basel III, IFRS 10). Null for non-ownership relationships.
attributes.references: Basel III Large Exposure Framework, IFRS 10, FATF Beneficial Ownership

attributes.name: pep_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether either party in this relationship is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or is associated with a PEP. Used for enhanced due diligence requirements and AML compliance.

attributes.name: related_party_transaction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions between these parties are classified as related party transactions under accounting standards (IAS 24) or regulatory frameworks. Used for disclosure requirements, conflict of interest management, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IAS 24, SOX Section 402, Federal Reserve Regulation O

attributes.name: relationship_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relationship is directional (hierarchical, with a clear parent-child or controlling-controlled structure), bilateral (symmetric association where both parties have equal standing), or reciprocal (mutual obligations or roles).

attributes.name: relationship_source_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this relationship in the source system. Used for traceability, reconciliation, and bi-directional synchronization with operational systems.

attributes.name: relationship_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this relationship was sourced (e.g., Core Banking System, CRM, Loan Origination System). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the relationship. Active indicates the relationship is in effect. Pending indicates the relationship is awaiting approval or documentation. Under review indicates the relationship is being validated or updated (e.g., during KYC refresh). Terminated indicates the relationship has ended.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The risk classification assigned to this relationship based on AML, credit, or operational risk assessment. Used for risk-based KYC/CDD procedures, enhanced due diligence triggers, and regulatory reporting (e.g., SAR filing thresholds).
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, Basel III, AML/CFT Standards

attributes.name: role_a
attributes.description: The role or function that Party A plays in this relationship (e.g., parent, guarantor, account holder, introducer, controlling shareholder, trustee). Provides semantic context for Party A's position.

attributes.name: role_b
attributes.description: The role or function that Party B plays in this relationship (e.g., subsidiary, borrower, co-applicant, authorized signatory, beneficial owner, beneficiary). Provides semantic context for Party B's position.

attributes.name: sanctions_last_screened_date
attributes.description: The date on which this relationship was last screened against sanctions lists (e.g., OFAC, UN, EU). Used for tracking screening frequency and ensuring compliance with continuous monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Indicates the result of sanctions screening for this relationship. Clear indicates no sanctions matches. Match indicates a potential or confirmed sanctions hit. Pending indicates screening is in progress. Used for AML compliance and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OFAC, FATF Recommendations, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the legal or supporting documentation that evidences this relationship (e.g., shareholder agreement, power of attorney document, joint account application, beneficial ownership declaration). Used for audit trails and regulatory compliance (KYC/AML).
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations, KYC/CDD Standards, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

products.name: segment
products.description: Segment definition and time-series party assignment record supporting product targeting, pricing tiers, and service-level determination. Segment definitions: segment code (mass market, mass affluent, HNW, UHNW, SME, mid-market, large corporate, institutional, government), sub-segment, LOB, and segment criteria. Party-level assignments: party_id, segment_id, effective date, expiry date, assignment method (rule-based, manual override, model-driven), model run_id, assigned_by employee_id, is_current flag, override flag with rationale. Supports CLTV cohort analysis, segment migration reporting, segment transition analysis, FTP pricing tier determination, and targeted campaign eligibility. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for both segment definitions and party-to-segment assignments — no separate assignment table exists. Sourced from CRM and segmentation engine.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the segment definition. Links to the segment master table that defines segment criteria and characteristics.

attributes.name: assigned_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who manually assigned or approved this segment assignment. Populated for MANUAL_OVERRIDE assignments or when manual approval is required.

attributes.name: lob_code_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_list. Business justification: Line of business standardization - LOB codes (Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management) must be consistent for P&L reporting, regulatory submissions, and segment perfo

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the customer or counterparty being assigned to this segment. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to assign the party to this segment. RULE_BASED: automated rule engine based on predefined criteria; MANUAL_OVERRIDE: manual assignment by relationship manager or operations; MODEL_DRIVEN: machine learning or statistical model output.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment assignment record was created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and temporal analysis.

attributes.name: aum_threshold_max
attributes.description: Maximum Assets Under Management threshold for this segment assignment. Defines the upper bound of the segment tier. Expressed in base currency.

attributes.name: aum_threshold_min
attributes.description: Minimum Assets Under Management threshold required for this segment assignment. Used for wealth management and private banking segmentation. Expressed in base currency.

attributes.name: campaign_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether customers in this segment are eligible for targeted marketing campaigns. False may indicate regulatory restrictions or opt-out status.

attributes.name: cltv_cohort
attributes.description: CLTV-based cohort classification for segment analysis and targeted campaigns. Values: HIGH (top tier value), MEDIUM (mid tier value), LOW (entry tier value).

attributes.name: cltv_score
attributes.description: Calculated Customer Lifetime Value score at the time of segment assignment. Used for cohort analysis and segment migration tracking. Higher scores indicate greater long-term value.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, context, or special instructions related to this segment assignment. Supports operational communication and exception handling.

attributes.name: criteria
attributes.description: Description of the business rules or criteria that qualified the party for this segment (e.g., AUM threshold, revenue tier, relationship tenure, product holdings). Supports transparency and audit.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this segment assignment becomes active and applicable for pricing, service levels, and targeting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this segment assignment expires or is superseded by a new assignment. Null indicates an open-ended assignment. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ftp_pricing_tier
attributes.description: Funds Transfer Pricing tier associated with this segment. Determines internal cost of funds allocation and profitability measurement. Aligns with segment-based pricing strategy.
attributes.references: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)

attributes.name: is_current
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the currently active segment assignment for the party. True for the active record, False for historical records.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this segment assignment. Supports compliance with segment review policies and ensures assignment accuracy. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: model_run_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the segmentation model execution run that produced this assignment. Enables traceability and model performance analysis. Populated only when assignment_method is MODEL_DRIVEN.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this segment assignment. Ensures timely reassessment of segment appropriateness. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score at the time of segment assignment, reflecting customer satisfaction and loyalty. Range: -100 to +100. Used for service quality tracking by segment.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this assignment was manually overridden from the system-recommended segment. True indicates a manual override occurred.

attributes.name: override_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for manual override of the system-recommended segment assignment. Required when override_flag is True. Supports audit and compliance review.

attributes.name: previous_segment_code
attributes.description: The segment code that was active immediately prior to this assignment. Enables segment migration analysis and transition tracking. Null for initial segment assignments.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of this segment assignment record in the data warehouse. ACTIVE: currently in effect; INACTIVE: expired or terminated; SUPERSEDED: replaced by a newer assignment; PENDING: awaiting approval or activation.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the segment for capital adequacy and reporting purposes under Basel III and other frameworks. Determines Risk-Weighted Asset (RWA) treatment.

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_max
attributes.description: Maximum annual revenue threshold for corporate and commercial customer segmentation. Defines the upper bound of the segment tier. Expressed in base currency.

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_min
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue threshold for corporate and commercial customer segmentation. Used to classify SME, mid-market, and large corporate segments. Expressed in base currency.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification of the segment for credit risk, operational risk, and compliance purposes. Influences credit limits, monitoring intensity, and approval authorities.

attributes.name: segment_code
