attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit is configured to support Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring and Currency Transaction Report (CTR) thresholds. True if AML-related, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN)

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold or minimum balance requirement for this limit. Expressed in the currency specified in the currency_code field.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The role, department, or individual authorized to approve this limit configuration. May reference a user ID, role code, or department name.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this limit was approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: breach_action_code
attributes.description: Action to be taken when a transaction would breach this limit. Values: BLOCK (reject transaction), WARN (alert but allow), ALLOW_WITH_FEE (permit with penalty charge), ESCALATE (require manual approval).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Transaction Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this limit record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit was requested by the customer (e.g., self-imposed spending limit) rather than being bank-mandated. True if customer-initiated, False if bank-imposed.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account limit becomes active and enforceable. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account limit ceases to be active. Nullable for limits with no predetermined end date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fraud_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit is primarily configured for fraud prevention purposes. True if the limit is part of fraud controls, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) - Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines

attributes.name: last_reset_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the utilization counters were last reset. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_utilization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent transaction that utilized this limit. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: limit_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or business rationale for this limit configuration.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Management

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account limit. Values: ACTIVE (limit is currently enforced), SUSPENDED (temporarily not enforced), EXPIRED (past expiry date), PENDING (awaiting approval or activation), CANCELLED (permanently deactivated).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Management

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this limit record. May be a user ID, employee number, or system identifier.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this limit record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for limit-related notifications. Values: EMAIL (email notification), SMS (text message), MOBILE_APP (push notification), PHONE (voice call), NONE (no notification).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Customer Communication

attributes.name: notification_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The utilization amount at which the customer or bank should be notified (e.g., alert when 80% of limit is reached). Nullable if no notification threshold is configured.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Alert Management

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit can be overridden by authorized personnel during transaction processing. True if override is permitted, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Operational Risk Management

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for allowing limit overrides. Populated when override_flag is True.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory requirement or consumer protection rule that mandates this limit (e.g., Regulation E for electronic fund transfers, Regulation D for savings account withdrawals).
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Regulation E, Federal Reserve Regulation D

attributes.name: reset_frequency_code
attributes.description: Frequency at which the utilization counters are reset to zero. Values: DAILY (reset at start of each day), WEEKLY (reset weekly), MONTHLY (reset monthly), QUARTERLY (reset quarterly), ANNUAL (reset annually), NONE (no automatic reset).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Management

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Risk classification of the account or customer for which this limit is configured. Used to determine appropriate limit thresholds. Values: LOW (minimal risk), MEDIUM (moderate risk), HIGH (elevated risk), CRITICAL (highest risk requiring strictest controls).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Risk Management Principles

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this limit record originated (e.g., T24, FIS_PROFILE, ONLINE_BANKING).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 System Integration

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the operational limit governing transaction behavior. Values: DAILY_WITHDRAWAL (daily withdrawal limit), DAILY_TRANSFER (daily transfer limit), ATM_CASH (ATM cash limit), WIRE_TRANSFER (wire transfer limit), ACH_DEBIT (Automated Clearing House debit limit), MIN_BALANCE (minimum balance requirement).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Operational Risk Management

attributes.name: utilization_amount
attributes.description: Current cumulative amount utilized against this limit within the applicable time period (e.g., daily, monthly). Reset frequency depends on limit type.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Tracking

attributes.name: utilization_count
attributes.description: Number of transactions that have been applied against this limit within the current period. Used for frequency-based limits.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Limit Tracking

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this limit record, incremented with each modification. Used for optimistic locking and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this limit record. May be a user ID, employee number, or system identifier.

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit log of all account lifecycle status transitions for deposit accounts. Captures previous status, new status, effective date and time, reason code, initiating channel, authorizing officer, and supporting documentation reference. Status transitions include: pending activation → active → dormant → reactivated → closed → written off. Required for regulatory examination, AML dormancy monitoring, and FDIC insurance claim processing.
products.reference: Account Lifecycle Audit — OCC / FDIC Examination Requirements

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each account status transition record. Primary key for the immutable audit log of account lifecycle events.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Status changes (active, dormant, closed) are tracked by accounting period for audit trails, regulatory reporting, and understanding account lifecycle metrics within fiscal periods for management repor

attributes.name: batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch process that created this status history record, if applicable. Null for real-time transactions. Used for batch reconciliation and operational monitoring.
attributes.references: ETL Operations Manual - Batch Processing Standards

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account that experienced the status transition. Links to the authoritative account registry in the core banking system.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Account Master

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the bank officer who authorized or approved the status change. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance. May be system-generated for automated transitions.

attributes.name: aml_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggers mandatory AML review procedures (e.g., dormant to active reactivation, sudden closure after large deposits). True if AML review is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - AML Program Requirements

attributes.name: authorizing_officer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the bank officer who authorized the status change. Provides human-readable audit trail for regulatory examination.

attributes.name: balance_at_transition
attributes.description: The account balance at the moment of status transition. Critical for FDIC insurance claim processing, escheatment reporting, and write-off calculations. Expressed in the account currency.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context provided by the authorizing officer or system process. Supplements structured fields with case-specific details.
attributes.references: Internal Operations Manual - Account Status Change Procedures

attributes.name: compliance_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status change was driven by a compliance or regulatory hold (e.g., OFAC match, court order, regulatory investigation). True if compliance-driven, False otherwise.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance - Account Blocking Procedures

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this status history record was created in the system. Distinct from effective_timestamp, which represents the business event time. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the balance at transition. Ensures accurate multi-currency reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder was notified of the status change via the registered communication channels. True if notification was sent, False otherwise. Required for consumer protection compliance.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: dormancy_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the account remained inactive before transitioning to dormant status. Populated only for transitions to dormant status. Used for escheatment timeline calculations and regulatory dormancy reporting.
attributes.references: State Escheatment Laws - Dormancy Period Requirements

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the new status became effective for the account. This is the business event timestamp, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Critical for regulatory timeline reconstruction and FDIC insurance claim processing.

attributes.name: hold_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or legal entity that mandated the hold or status change (e.g., OFAC, FBI, court name, state regulator). Populated only when compliance_hold_flag is True.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance - Account Blocking Procedures

attributes.name: hold_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number or case identifier from the regulatory authority or court that issued the hold. Populated only when compliance_hold_flag is True.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance - Account Blocking Procedures

attributes.name: initiating_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the status change was initiated. Distinguishes customer-initiated changes from system-automated or regulatory-driven transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: branch|online_banking|mobile_app|call_center|atm|back_office|system_automated|regulatory_authority|third_party — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent customer-initiated transaction before the status change. Used to calculate dormancy periods and support escheatment compliance. Null for newly opened accounts.
attributes.references: State Escheatment Laws - Activity Tracking Requirements

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The account lifecycle status after this transition was applied. Captures the to-state in the status change event. Required for regulatory examination and AML dormancy monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_activation|active|dormant|inactive|frozen|blocked|closed|written_off|reactivated — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Account Status Taxonomy

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The communication method used to notify the customer of the status change. Captures the channel through which disclosure was delivered. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|postal_mail|secure_message|phone_call|in_person|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when customer notification was sent regarding the status change. Null if no notification was sent or required.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) - Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The account lifecycle status immediately before this transition occurred. Captures the from-state in the status change event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_activation|active|dormant|inactive|frozen|blocked|closed|written_off — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Account Status Taxonomy

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business or regulatory reason that triggered the status transition. Used for root cause analysis, compliance reporting, and operational metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|regulatory_hold|aml_alert|fraud_suspicion|inactivity|insufficient_funds|court_order|death_notification|account_closure_request|reactivation_request|system_migration|compliance_review — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Operations Manual - Account Status Change Procedures

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context and details about the reason for the status change. Supplements the reason code with case-specific information.
attributes.references: Internal Operations Manual - Account Status Change Procedures

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition must be included in regulatory reports (e.g., dormancy reports to banking authorities, FDIC insurance claim filings, AML suspicious activity monitoring). True if reportable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was subsequently reversed or corrected by a later entry. True if reversed, False if the transition stands. Used for audit trail integrity and error correction tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards - Transaction Reversal Procedures

attributes.name: reversal_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the account_status_history_id of the reversing entry if this transition was reversed. Null if not reversed. Maintains bidirectional audit trail for corrections.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards - Transaction Reversal Procedures

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to supporting documentation that justifies the status change (e.g., court order number, customer request ticket, AML case ID, death certificate reference). Critical for regulatory examination and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: system_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or application that recorded the status transition (e.g., Temenos T24, FIS Profile, batch job name, API service). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system process that created this status history record. May differ from authorizing_officer_id for system-automated transitions. Used for audit trail and access control review.

products.name: interest_rate
products.description: Effective interest rate configuration and complete tiered rate structure applied to deposit accounts and products. Captures base rate type (fixed, variable, tiered), benchmark index (SOFR, Fed Funds, Prime), spread over benchmark in BPS, effective date, expiry date, promotional rate flag, and promotional expiry date. Includes embedded tier-level detail: tier sequence number, minimum and maximum balance thresholds, annual percentage yield (APY), annual percentage rate (APR), and product applicability per tier. Tiered structures enable the bank to offer higher rates for larger balances on savings and money market accounts. Single source of truth for ALL rate configuration including tiered breakpoints — no separate rate tier reference table exists. Supports NIM reporting, ALCO rate sensitivity analysis, Reg DD APY disclosure requirements, and product pricing governance.
products.reference: Deposit Rate Configuration — Reg DD APY / ALCO Rate Management

attributes.name: interest_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account interest rate configuration record.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Interest rate changes become effective within specific accounting periods for accurate interest calculations, financial reporting, and net interest margin analysis. This supports period-based rate cha

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Interest rate changes and exceptions require documented approval by ALCO members, pricing committee, or relationship managers per pricing governance and margin management policies. Real business proce

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account to which this interest rate configuration applies.
attributes.references: Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile)

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: The market benchmark index to which variable rates are tied. SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate), FED_FUNDS (Federal Funds Rate), PRIME (Prime Rate), LIBOR (London Interbank Offered Rate - legacy), TREASURY (US Treasury Rate), or NONE for fixed rates.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed) / SOFR Transition Guidelines

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_interest_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account_interest_rate_id that supersedes this rate configuration. Used to maintain rate change history and audit trail.
attributes.references: Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile) Rate Management

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: The day-count convention used for interest accrual calculation. Actual/360 (actual days over 360-day year), Actual/365 (actual days over 365-day year), or 30/360 (assumes 30-day months).
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Day Count Conventions

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The base annual interest rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025000 for 2.5%). For fixed rates, this is the final rate. For variable rates, this is the starting point before spread adjustment.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed) Interest Rate Standards

attributes.name: compounding_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which interest is compounded and added to the principal balance. Daily compounding is most common for deposit accounts.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD - APY Calculation

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this interest rate configuration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this interest rate configuration record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this interest rate configuration becomes active and begins accruing interest on applicable accounts.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this interest rate configuration expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended rate configuration.

attributes.name: ftp_rate
attributes.description: The internal Funds Transfer Pricing rate used to allocate funding costs or credits between business lines. Expressed as a decimal. Used for management accounting and profitability attribution.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) / Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) Framework

attributes.name: interest_payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which accrued interest is credited to the customer's account or paid out. Most deposit accounts credit interest monthly.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a promotional interest rate offered as part of a marketing campaign or customer acquisition strategy. True if promotional, False if standard rate.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: is_tax_advantaged
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to a tax-advantaged account type (e.g., IRA, HSA, 529 plan) where interest may be tax-deferred or tax-exempt. True if tax-advantaged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: maximum_balance_cap
attributes.description: The maximum account balance on which interest is paid at this rate. Balances exceeding this cap may earn a different rate or no additional interest.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: minimum_balance_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum account balance required to earn the stated interest rate. Balances below this threshold may earn a lower rate or no interest.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: nim_contribution_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Interest Margin (NIM) Contribution in Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: The estimated contribution of this rate configuration to the bank's Net Interest Margin (NIM), expressed in basis points. Used for profitability analysis and ALCO reporting.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) / Net Interest Margin (NIM) Reporting Framework

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The deposit product code (e.g., DDA, SAV, MMA, CD) to which this rate structure applies. Used for product-level rate configuration.

attributes.name: promotional_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the promotional rate expires and reverts to the standard rate. Only applicable when is_promotional is True.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: rate_approval_authority
attributes.description: The governance body or role that approved this interest rate configuration. ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee), TREASURY, PRODUCT_MANAGEMENT, BRANCH_MANAGER, or EXECUTIVE_COMMITTEE.

attributes.name: rate_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this interest rate configuration was formally approved by the designated approval authority.

attributes.name: rate_ceiling
attributes.description: The maximum interest rate that can be applied regardless of benchmark index movements. Caps the bank's interest expense exposure. Expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) Rate Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: rate_change_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which variable interest rates are reviewed and potentially adjusted based on benchmark index movements. Fixed rates use 'at_maturity' or 'as_needed'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|at_maturity|as_needed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rate_change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for this rate configuration or rate change. Examples: 'Benchmark index adjustment', 'Competitive positioning', 'Promotional campaign Q4 2024', 'ALCO directive'.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) Rate Change Documentation Policy

attributes.name: rate_floor
attributes.description: The minimum interest rate that can be applied regardless of benchmark index movements. Protects the bank from negative or excessively low rates. Expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) Rate Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this interest rate configuration. Active (currently in effect), Pending (approved but not yet effective), Expired (past expiry date), Superseded (replaced by newer rate), or Suspended (temporarily inactive).
attributes.references: Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile) Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interest rate structure: fixed (constant rate), variable (indexed to benchmark), tiered (rate varies by balance threshold), or promotional (temporary marketing rate).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Interest Rate Risk Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_text
attributes.description: The standardized disclosure text required by Regulation DD for customer communication regarding this interest rate, including APY calculation methodology and any conditions or limitations.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD - Truth in Savings Act

attributes.name: relationship_bonus_bps
attributes.description: Additional basis points added to the base rate for customers meeting relationship pricing criteria. For example, 25 BPS = 0.25% rate bonus.

attributes.name: relationship_pricing_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is eligible for relationship pricing adjustments based on the customer's total Assets Under Management (AUM) or product holdings with the bank. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this interest rate configuration originated (e.g., 'Temenos T24', 'FIS Profile', 'Treasury Management System'). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: spread_bps
attributes.description: The spread over the benchmark index expressed in basis points (BPS). One basis point equals 0.01%. For example, 50 BPS = 0.50%. Applied to variable rates only.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of interest income subject to tax withholding, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2400 for 24%). Applicable for certain account types and jurisdictions.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) / Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA)

attributes.name: tier_apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate for this balance tier, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.024693 for 2.4693% APR). APR is the simple interest rate before compounding effects.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: tier_apy
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Yield for this balance tier, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025000 for 2.5% APY). APY reflects the effect of compounding and is the rate disclosed to customers per Regulation DD.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD - APY Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: tier_maximum_balance
attributes.description: The maximum balance threshold for this rate tier. Balances above this amount move to the next tier. Null for the highest tier indicating no upper limit.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD - Tiered Rate Disclosure

attributes.name: tier_minimum_balance
attributes.description: The minimum balance threshold for this rate tier. Balances at or above this amount and below the tier maximum earn this tier's rate. Part of tiered rate structure.
attributes.references: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD - Tiered Rate Disclosure

attributes.name: tier_sequence_number
attributes.description: The ordinal position of this rate tier within a tiered rate structure. Tier 1 is the lowest balance tier, incrementing for higher balance tiers. Null for non-tiered rates.
attributes.references: Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile) Tiered Rate Configuration

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this interest rate configuration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this interest rate configuration record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: account_product
products.description: Catalog of deposit account product types, classifications, and complete regulatory taxonomy offered by the bank. Defines the terms, features, eligibility criteria, and compliance attributes for each product variant. Captures product code, product name, product category (DDA, savings, MMA, CD, custodial), account type code and classification, regulatory classification (Reg D savings, transaction account, time deposit, custodial), FDIC insurance category, GL mapping code, interest-bearing flag, reserve requirement applicability, Call Report category (FFIEC 031/041), minimum opening deposit, minimum balance requirement, fee schedule reference, interest rate schedule reference, eligible customer segments, and product lifecycle status (active, discontinued, grandfathered). Single source of truth for both account type taxonomy and product template — no separate account type reference table exists. Individual account instances are created from this catalog. Supports product governance, regulatory reporting, and analytics platform classification.
products.reference: Deposit Product Catalog — T24 Product Definition

attributes.name: account_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account product. Primary key for the account product catalog.

attributes.name: reporting_code_id
attributes.description: FFIEC Call Report schedule and line item code for regulatory reporting. Maps to specific lines in FFIEC 031/041 Consolidated Reports of Condition and Income.

attributes.name: account_type_code
attributes.description: Granular account type classification code used for operational processing and system routing within the core banking platform.
attributes.references: Core Banking System Account Type Reference

attributes.name: ach_transfer_allowed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Clearing House (ACH) Transfer Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ACH transfers (both incoming and outgoing) are permitted for accounts under this product. True = ACH allowed, False = ACH restricted.

attributes.name: age_restriction_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum age limit for opening an account under this product (e.g., student accounts). Null if no maximum age restriction applies.

attributes.name: age_restriction_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum age requirement for primary account holder to open an account under this product. Null if no age restriction applies.

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Inherent AML risk rating assigned to this product category based on regulatory risk assessment and product characteristics.

attributes.name: bic_code
attributes.description: Bank Identifier Code (also known as SWIFT code) associated with this product for international wire transfers and SWIFT messaging. Format: 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: check_writing_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether check writing privileges are permitted for accounts under this product. True = checks allowed, False = no check writing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crs_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts under this product are subject to OECD Common Reporting Standard for automatic exchange of financial account information. True = CRS reportable, False = exempt.

attributes.name: debit_card_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts under this product are eligible for debit card issuance. True = debit card can be issued, False = not eligible.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this product was discontinued and closed to new accounts. Null if product is still active or pending.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this product became or will become available for new account openings.

attributes.name: eligible_customer_segments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segments eligible to open accounts under this product (e.g., retail, small_business, corporate, private_banking, student, senior). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|small_business|corporate|private_banking|institutional|government|non_profit|student|senior — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fatca_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts under this product are subject to FATCA reporting requirements for US tax purposes. True = FATCA reportable, False = exempt.

attributes.name: fdic_insurance_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insurance Category
attributes.description: FDIC deposit insurance classification determining coverage limits and aggregation rules for deposit insurance calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|joint|retirement|trust|business|government|uninsured — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDIC Deposit Insurance Regulations (12 CFR Part 330)

attributes.name: fee_schedule_reference
attributes.description: Reference code linking to the fee schedule document or system record that defines all fees applicable to this product (monthly maintenance, overdraft, transaction fees, etc.).

attributes.name: gl_mapping_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which balances and transactions for this product are posted in the financial accounting system.

attributes.name: iban_assignment_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) Assignment Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts under this product must be assigned an IBAN for international payment processing. True = IBAN required, False = not required.

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account product accrues interest on deposited balances. True = interest-bearing, False = non-interest-bearing.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate interest accrual on account balances. Daily balance = interest on end-of-day balance, average daily balance = interest on average balance over period, minimum balance = interest on lowest balance in period, tiered = different rates for different balance tiers.

attributes.name: interest_compounding_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which accrued interest is capitalized and added to the principal balance for subsequent interest calculations.

attributes.name: interest_rate_schedule_reference
attributes.description: Reference code linking to the interest rate schedule that defines current and historical interest rates for this product, including tiered rate structures.

attributes.name: kyc_tier_required
attributes.description: Level of KYC due diligence required to open an account under this product, aligned with AML and customer identification program requirements.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account product. Active = available for new accounts, discontinued = no longer offered but existing accounts remain, grandfathered = closed to new customers but existing accounts retain terms, pending_approval = awaiting regulatory or internal approval, suspended = temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: maximum_balance_limit
attributes.description: Maximum balance allowed in accounts under this product, typically for regulatory or insurance reasons. Null if no maximum limit applies.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum balance that must be maintained to avoid fees or account closure, in the bank's functional currency. Null if no minimum balance requirement applies.

attributes.name: minimum_opening_deposit
attributes.description: Minimum initial deposit amount required to open an account under this product, in the bank's functional currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: mobile_banking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts under this product have access to mobile banking applications. True = mobile banking available, False = not available.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was last modified.

attributes.name: online_banking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts under this product have access to online banking services. True = online banking available, False = not available.

attributes.name: overdraft_protection_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether overdraft protection services are available for accounts under this product. True = overdraft protection can be enabled, False = not available.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the account product type. DDA = Demand Deposit Account (checking), savings = savings account, money_market = money market account, certificate_of_deposit = time deposit, custodial = custodial/trust account.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the account product in the core banking system. Used for product identification in Temenos T24 / FIS Profile.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the account product features, benefits, and intended use case for internal reference and customer communication.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the account product as marketed to customers and displayed in customer-facing channels.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Federal Reserve Regulation D classification determining reserve requirements and transaction limitations. Reg D savings accounts are subject to six-transaction monthly limits; transaction accounts include DDA and NOW accounts.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D (12 CFR Part 204)

attributes.name: reserve_requirement_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether deposits in this product are subject to Federal Reserve reserve requirements under Regulation D. True = subject to reserve requirements, False = exempt.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D (12 CFR Part 204)

attributes.name: reserve_requirement_ratio
attributes.description: Percentage of deposits that must be held in reserve with the Federal Reserve, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 = 10%). Null if reserve requirements do not apply.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D (12 CFR Part 204)

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which account statements are generated and delivered to customers for accounts under this product.

attributes.name: wire_transfer_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether domestic and international wire transfers are permitted for accounts under this product. True = wire transfers allowed, False = not permitted.

products.name: standing_order
products.description: Recurring payment instruction established by an account holder to make regular fixed-amount transfers from a deposit account. Captures beneficiary account details, transfer amount, currency, frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly), start date, end date, next execution date, payment reference, execution channel (ACH, internal transfer, SWIFT), and status (active, suspended, cancelled). Distinct from one-time payment instructions — represents a persistent, repeating mandate.
products.reference: Standing Order / Recurring Transfer — ACH / SWIFT Recurring Mandate

attributes.name: standing_order_id
