attributes.description: Rule for adjusting sweep execution dates that fall on non-business days. Following moves to next business day; preceding moves to prior business day; modified following moves forward unless it crosses month boundary.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sweep arrangement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer receives notifications for each sweep execution.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Directionality of the sweep arrangement. One-way sweeps only move funds from source to destination; two-way or bidirectional sweeps can return funds to source when destination balance exceeds thresholds.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the sweep arrangement becomes active and eligible for execution.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the sweep arrangement is evaluated and executed. Daily sweeps occur once per business day; end-of-day sweeps execute after final posting; intraday sweeps may execute multiple times; on-demand sweeps are manually triggered.

attributes.name: ftp_rate_code
attributes.description: Reference to the FTP rate curve or code used for internal profitability allocation of swept funds. Used for management accounting and ALCO reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for booking sweep-related fees or interest adjustments.

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_code
attributes.description: Reference to the holiday calendar used to determine business days for sweep execution scheduling (e.g., US Federal Reserve, TARGET2, local jurisdiction).

attributes.name: investment_vehicle_type
attributes.description: Type of external investment vehicle for investment sweep arrangements. None indicates internal account-to-account sweep.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sweep arrangement record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_sweep_amount
attributes.description: Amount transferred in the most recent sweep execution. Used for operational reporting and pattern analysis.

attributes.name: last_sweep_execution_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful sweep execution. Used for operational monitoring and next-execution scheduling.

attributes.name: lifetime_sweep_count
attributes.description: Total number of sweep executions since arrangement inception. Used for usage analytics and fee calculation.

attributes.name: lifetime_sweep_total_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total amount swept since arrangement inception. Used for customer reporting and funds transfer pricing (FTP) analytics.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business unit or line of business responsible for the sweep arrangement. Used for management reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: maximum_sweep_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount that can be transferred in a single sweep execution. Used for risk management and liquidity control. Nullable for unlimited sweeps.

attributes.name: minimum_sweep_amount
attributes.description: Minimum amount that must be transferred for a sweep to execute. Prevents small, uneconomical transfers.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_sweep_date
attributes.description: Date when the next sweep execution is scheduled to occur, based on frequency and business calendar.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Preferred channel for customer notifications about sweep executions.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Execution priority when multiple sweep arrangements exist on the same source account. Lower numbers execute first. Used for cash concentration hierarchies.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sweep transactions must be included in regulatory reports such as liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) or net stable funding ratio (NSFR) calculations.

attributes.name: replenishment_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Source account balance threshold below which auto-replenishment is triggered. Applicable when auto_replenishment_enabled is true.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this sweep arrangement record (e.g., Temenos T24, FIS Profile, treasury management system).

attributes.name: sweep_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the sweep arrangement. Active arrangements execute per schedule; suspended arrangements are temporarily halted; terminated arrangements are closed; pending activation awaits approval; under review indicates compliance or risk review in progress.

attributes.name: sweep_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sweep arrangement. Zero-balance sweep transfers all excess funds; target-balance sweep maintains a specified balance; threshold sweep triggers when balance exceeds a limit; investment sweep moves funds to money market or investment vehicle; hybrid combines multiple rules.

attributes.name: target_balance_amount
attributes.description: Desired balance to maintain in the source account after sweep execution. Applicable for target-balance sweep types. Nullable for zero-balance sweeps.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the sweep arrangement is terminated or expires. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum balance threshold that triggers a sweep execution. When source account balance exceeds this amount, sweep is initiated. Nullable for zero-balance sweep types.

products.name: beneficiary_designation
products.description: Record of payable-on-death (POD) and transfer-on-death (TOD) beneficiary designations on deposit accounts. Captures beneficiary name, relationship to account holder, beneficiary type (individual, trust, estate, charity), allocation percentage, designation date, revocation date, and supporting documentation reference. Legally distinct from account holder associations — beneficiaries have no access rights during the account holder's lifetime but receive proceeds upon death, governed by state law and FDIC insurance rules.
products.reference: POD / TOD Beneficiary — FDIC Insurance / Estate Law

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the beneficiary designation record. Primary key for the beneficiary designation entity.

attributes.name: beneficiary_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Estate planning and beneficiary designation require proper KYC when beneficiary is an existing customer. Links to party master for identity verification, tax reporting (estate/inheritance), and remove

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Beneficiary allocations may specify currency for international estates and cross-border wealth transfer. Supports multi-currency trust administration and estate settlement. New attribute needed as no

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the deposit account on which this beneficiary designation is established. Links to the deposit account that will transfer proceeds to the beneficiary upon account holder death.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Account Master

attributes.name: primary_beneficiary_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the bank employee or system user who created this beneficiary designation record. Required for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of account proceeds allocated to this beneficiary upon account holder death. Must sum to 100.00 across all active beneficiaries on the same account. Expressed as a decimal value between 0.00 and 100.00.
attributes.references: State Probate Law - Payable on Death (POD) Regulations

attributes.name: aml_screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary was screened against AML sanctions lists. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Regulations

attributes.name: aml_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of AML sanctions screening for the beneficiary against OFAC and other watchlists. Cleared status is required before distribution can occur.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Regulations

attributes.name: beneficiary_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the beneficiary. Required for mailing distribution checks and legal notices upon account holder death.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: beneficiary_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional field for additional address detail.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: beneficiary_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the beneficiary address. Required for legal notices and distribution processing.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: beneficiary_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the beneficiary address. Determines cross-border reporting requirements and distribution processing rules.

attributes.name: beneficiary_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the beneficiary if the beneficiary is an individual. Used for identity verification and to determine if special handling is required for minor beneficiaries.

attributes.name: beneficiary_email_address
attributes.description: Email address for the beneficiary. Used for electronic communication regarding designation status and distribution processing.

attributes.name: beneficiary_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the beneficiary. Used to notify beneficiary of account holder death and coordinate distribution.

attributes.name: beneficiary_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the beneficiary address. Required for mailing and address validation.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: beneficiary_priority
attributes.description: Priority tier of the beneficiary designation. Primary beneficiaries receive proceeds first; contingent beneficiaries receive proceeds only if all primary beneficiaries predecease the account holder.
attributes.references: Uniform Transfer on Death Act - Model Statute

attributes.name: beneficiary_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the beneficiary address. Determines applicable state probate law and escheatment jurisdiction.

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary entity type. Determines legal treatment, documentation requirements, and distribution rules under state law and FDIC insurance regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was first created in the core banking system. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: designation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary designation became legally effective. Establishes the temporal priority of competing designations and determines which designation controls in case of dispute.
attributes.references: State Probate Law - Transfer on Death (TOD) Statutes

attributes.name: designation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this beneficiary designation. Used for customer communication and legal documentation reference.
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Temenos T24 Beneficiary Module

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the beneficiary designation. Active designations are legally binding; revoked or superseded designations have no legal effect.
attributes.references: State Probate Law - Uniform Transfer on Death Act

attributes.name: fdic_insurance_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insurance Category
attributes.description: FDIC insurance ownership category applicable to this beneficiary designation. Determines insurance coverage limits and aggregation rules. Common categories include revocable trust accounts and payable-on-death accounts.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary identity was successfully verified. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of identity verification for the beneficiary under KYC and AML regulations. Verified status is required before distribution can occur.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) - Customer Identification Program

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: minor_custodian_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the custodian designated to manage proceeds on behalf of a minor beneficiary under the Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA). Required when beneficiary is under age of majority.

attributes.name: notarization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary designation form was notarized. Required when notarization_required_flag is true.

attributes.name: notarization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether state law or bank policy requires notarization of the beneficiary designation form. Varies by jurisdiction and account type.

attributes.name: per_stirpes_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary designation includes per stirpes distribution. If true and the beneficiary predeceases the account holder, the beneficiary's share passes to their descendants rather than to other named beneficiaries.
attributes.references: State Probate Law - Per Stirpes Distribution Rules

attributes.name: relationship_to_account_holder
attributes.description: Nature of the personal or business relationship between the beneficiary and the account holder. Used for compliance review and fraud detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|other_relative|friend|business_partner|unrelated — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary designation was revoked by the account holder. Nullable for active designations. Once revoked, the designation has no legal effect.
attributes.references: State Probate Law - Revocation of POD/TOD Designations

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the beneficiary designation was revoked. Common reasons include divorce, death of beneficiary, change in estate planning strategy, or account holder request.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated this beneficiary designation record. Common values include T24 for Temenos core banking, FIS_PROFILE for FIS systems, MANUAL for branch-entered designations, and ONLINE_BANKING for customer self-service.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the signed beneficiary designation form, trust instrument, or other legal documentation supporting this designation. Required for audit and legal compliance.

attributes.name: trust_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trust was legally established. Used to verify trust validity and identify the correct trust instrument when multiple trusts exist with similar names.

attributes.name: trust_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the trust if the beneficiary type is trust. Must match the trust instrument exactly for legal distribution.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the trustee authorized to receive and manage proceeds on behalf of the trust. Required for trust beneficiary designations.

attributes.name: witness_count
attributes.description: Number of witnesses who signed the beneficiary designation form. Some jurisdictions require one or more witnesses for legal validity.

products.name: rate_tier
products.description: Reference table defining the tiered interest rate structure for deposit products. Captures tier sequence number, minimum balance threshold, maximum balance threshold, annual percentage yield (APY), annual percentage rate (APR), effective date, expiry date, product applicability, and regulatory APY disclosure format per Reg DD. Enables the bank to offer higher rates for larger balances on savings and money market accounts. Shared across multiple account products.
products.reference: Deposit Rate Tier — Reg DD APY Disclosure

attributes.name: rate_tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rate tier record. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the balance thresholds and rate calculations (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: annual_percentage_rate
attributes.description: The nominal annual interest rate for this tier, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.02500 for 2.5%). Used for interest accrual calculations.

attributes.name: annual_percentage_yield
attributes.description: The effective annual rate of return taking into account compounding, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.02531 for 2.531% APY). Required for Regulation DD disclosure.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual or committee that approved this rate tier (e.g., Asset-Liability Committee, Chief Financial Officer, Treasury Department).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rate tier was formally approved by the designated authority. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: compounding_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which interest is compounded for APY calculation: daily, monthly, quarterly, annually, or continuous compounding.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rate tier record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment for which this rate tier is available. Enables segment-specific pricing strategies (e.g., preferential rates for private banking clients or employees). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retail|private_banking|business|institutional|employee|student|senior — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this rate tier becomes active and applicable to qualifying accounts. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this rate tier ceases to be active. NULL indicates the tier is currently active with no planned expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fdic_insurance_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insurance Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether deposits in accounts using this rate tier are eligible for FDIC insurance coverage (True for most deposit products, False for certain investment or sweep accounts).

attributes.name: ftp_rate
attributes.description: Internal transfer pricing rate assigned to deposits in this tier for profitability allocation and performance measurement. Represents the cost or benefit of funds to the business unit.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic limitation for rate tier availability, specified as comma-separated list of state/province codes or country codes. NULL indicates no geographic restriction.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate interest for this tier: daily balance (interest on end-of-day balance), average daily balance (interest on average balance over period), minimum balance (interest on lowest balance in period), or collected balance (interest on available funds only).
attributes.references: Core Banking System - Interest Accrual Engine

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this rate tier record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this rate tier record was most recently updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: maximum_balance_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum account balance for which this tier's interest rate applies. Inclusive upper bound of the tier range. NULL indicates no upper limit for the highest tier.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum account balance required to qualify for this tier's interest rate. Inclusive lower bound of the tier range.

attributes.name: minimum_opening_deposit
attributes.description: Minimum initial deposit required to open an account eligible for this rate tier. May differ from the ongoing minimum balance threshold.

attributes.name: nim_impact_basis_points
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Interest Margin (NIM) Impact Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: Estimated impact of this rate tier on the bank's Net Interest Margin, expressed in basis points. Used for profitability analysis and Asset-Liability Management (ALM). Negative values indicate margin compression.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the deposit product to which this rate tier applies (e.g., savings account, money market account, certificate of deposit). Links to the bank's product catalog.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the deposit product associated with this rate tier.

attributes.name: promotional_description
attributes.description: Marketing description of the promotional rate offer, including any special terms or conditions. NULL for non-promotional tiers.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate tier is part of a promotional offering (True) or standard product pricing (False). Promotional rates typically have limited duration.

attributes.name: rate_change_frequency
attributes.description: Indicates how often the rate for this tier may change: fixed (rate guaranteed for term), variable with daily/monthly/quarterly review, or index-linked (tied to external benchmark such as SOFR or Fed Funds rate).

attributes.name: rate_index_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the external rate index to which this tier is linked (e.g., SOFR, EFFR, LIBOR). NULL for fixed or non-indexed rates.

attributes.name: rate_margin_basis_points
attributes.description: Margin in basis points added to or subtracted from the rate index to determine the tier's APR. One basis point equals 0.01%. NULL for non-indexed rates.

attributes.name: rate_tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate tier: active (currently in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending (scheduled for future activation), expired (past expiry date), or superseded (replaced by newer tier structure).

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_text
attributes.description: Standardized disclosure language required by Regulation DD for Truth in Savings compliance. Includes APY, minimum balance requirements, and any limitations or fees that may reduce earnings.
attributes.references: Regulation DD - Truth in Savings (12 CFR 1030)

attributes.name: relationship_criteria_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the relationship requirements needed to qualify for this rate tier (e.g., maintain $25,000 combined balance across all accounts, or set up recurring direct deposit of $1,000+). NULL if relationship_pricing_flag is False.

attributes.name: relationship_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate tier requires the customer to maintain additional qualifying relationships with the bank (True), such as direct deposit, minimum combined balances, or linked loan products. False for standalone pricing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this rate tier data originated (e.g., T24, FIS_PROFILE, RATE_MGMT_SYS).

attributes.name: tier_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of the tier within the rate structure. Lower numbers represent lower balance tiers. Used to determine tier precedence when calculating interest.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this rate tier record, incremented with each modification. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this rate tier record.

products.name: type
products.description: Reference classification of deposit account types recognized by the bank and regulatory bodies. Captures account type code, account type name, regulatory classification (Reg D savings, transaction account, time deposit, custodial), FDIC insurance category, GL mapping code, interest-bearing flag, reserve requirement applicability, and reporting category for Call Report (FFIEC 031/041). Provides standardized taxonomy used across T24, regulatory reporting, and analytics platforms.
products.reference: Account Type Classification — FFIEC Call Report / Reg D

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account type. Primary key for the account type reference table.

attributes.name: reporting_code_id
attributes.description: Specific line item reference within the Call Report schedule where balances for this account type are aggregated and reported (e.g., Schedule RC-E, Line 1 for noninterest-bearing deposits).

attributes.name: account_type_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the account type (e.g., DDA, SAV, MMA, CD, CUST). Used as a business key across core banking systems and regulatory reporting platforms.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Account Type Classification; FFIEC Call Report Instructions

attributes.name: account_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the account type, including its purpose, features, and typical use cases. Provides context for product management, compliance, and customer service teams.

attributes.name: account_type_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the account type (e.g., Demand Deposit Account, Savings Account, Money Market Account, Certificate of Deposit, Custodial Account). Human-readable label used in customer-facing applications and internal reporting.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Product Catalog; FIS Profile Account Master

attributes.name: ach_transfer_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Clearing House (ACH) Transfer Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ACH debits and credits are permitted for this account type. Determines eligibility for direct deposit, bill payment, and electronic funds transfer services.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Inherent money laundering and terrorist financing risk level associated with this account type. Determines transaction monitoring thresholds, enhanced due diligence requirements, and Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing protocols.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); FinCEN AML Program Requirements; NICE Actimize Risk Scoring

attributes.name: atm_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts of this type support ATM withdrawals and balance inquiries. Affects card issuance and channel access controls.

attributes.name: call_report_schedule
attributes.description: FFIEC Call Report schedule code (e.g., RC-E for deposit liabilities) where this account type must be reported. Ensures accurate quarterly regulatory filings to the Federal Reserve, FDIC, and OCC.

attributes.name: check_writing_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can write checks against this account type. Determines check order eligibility and payment processing rules.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Payment Configuration; Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Article 4

attributes.name: cip_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account type qualifies for an exemption from standard Customer Identification Program requirements under USA PATRIOT Act Section 326. Typically false for most retail and commercial accounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account type record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: crs_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account type is subject to OECD Common Reporting Standard automatic exchange of financial account information. Applies to accounts held by tax residents of participating jurisdictions.
attributes.references: OECD Common Reporting Standard (CRS); IRS Publication 5124

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment for this account type. Supports marketing strategy, pricing decisions, and customer relationship management (CRM) analytics.

attributes.name: debit_card_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a debit card can be issued and linked to this account type. Determines card product offerings and payment channel availability.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Card Management; Payment Card Industry (PCI) Standards

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this account type was discontinued and closed to new business. Null for active account types. Used in product sunset analysis and legacy system migration planning.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this account type became available for new account openings. Supports product launch tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: escheatment_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years of account dormancy after which funds must be escheated (transferred) to the state unclaimed property authority. Varies by state jurisdiction and account type.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws; Uniform Unclaimed Property Act

attributes.name: fatca_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account type is subject to FATCA reporting requirements for U.S. persons holding foreign financial accounts or foreign entities with U.S. ownership. Affects IRS Form 8938 and FBAR filing obligations.
attributes.references: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA); IRS Publication 5124

attributes.name: fdic_insurance_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insurance Category
attributes.description: FDIC insurance ownership category that determines coverage limits and aggregation rules. Critical for deposit insurance calculations and customer disclosures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_account|joint_account|revocable_trust|irrevocable_trust|employee_benefit_plan|corporation_partnership|government_account|uninsured — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDIC 12 CFR Part 330 - Deposit Insurance Coverage

attributes.name: fdic_insured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Insured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether deposits in this account type are eligible for FDIC insurance coverage. True for most deposit accounts; false for non-deposit products or uninsured investment accounts.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which balances and transactions for this account type are posted. Links deposit operations to financial accounting and enables balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Chart of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA GL Master Data

attributes.name: gl_liability_category
attributes.description: Balance sheet liability classification for this account type. Used in financial statement preparation, liquidity reporting, and Asset-Liability Management (ALM) analysis.
attributes.references: FASB Accounting Standards Codification Topic 942 - Financial Services - Depository and Lending

attributes.name: interest_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account type accrues interest on deposited balances. True for savings, money market, and time deposit accounts; false for non-interest-bearing checking accounts.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Interest Configuration; Federal Reserve Regulation Q

attributes.name: kyc_verification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Verification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enhanced Know Your Customer due diligence is required at account opening for this account type. Affects onboarding workflows and compliance checks.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); USA PATRIOT Act Section 326; FATCA

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this account type record. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: liquidity_coverage_ratio_category
attributes.description: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio classification that determines the assumed outflow rate for this account type during a 30-day stress scenario. Critical for liquidity risk management and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Basel III LCR Framework; Federal Reserve 12 CFR Part 249

attributes.name: minimum_balance_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum balance that must be maintained to avoid monthly service fees or account closure. Used in fee assessment logic and customer notifications.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Product Conditions; CFPB Regulation DD

attributes.name: minimum_opening_balance
attributes.description: Minimum initial deposit required to open an account of this type. Enforced during account origination and disclosed in product terms and conditions.
attributes.references: Temenos T24 Product Conditions; Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Regulation DD

attributes.name: monthly_service_fee
attributes.description: Standard monthly maintenance fee charged for this account type if balance or activity requirements are not met. Subject to fee waiver rules and regulatory disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: CFPB Regulation DD - Truth in Savings

attributes.name: nsfr_category
attributes.description: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio classification that determines the required stable funding factor for this account type. Used in long-term liquidity planning and regulatory capital calculations.
attributes.references: Basel III NSFR Framework; Federal Reserve 12 CFR Part 249

attributes.name: online_banking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account type is accessible through online banking and mobile banking channels. Affects digital channel entitlements and customer self-service capabilities.

attributes.name: overdraft_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether overdraft protection or overdraft privilege is available for this account type. Determines eligibility for overdraft facilities and fee structures.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation E - Overdraft Opt-In Requirements

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Business line or division that offers this account type. Enables product profitability analysis, customer segmentation, and line-of-business reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory category of the account type as defined by Federal Reserve Regulation D and FDIC guidelines. Determines reserve requirements, transaction limits, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D; FDIC Insurance Coverage Rules

attributes.name: reserve_requirement_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account type is subject to Federal Reserve reserve requirements under Regulation D. Affects bank liquidity management and Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) calculations.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve Regulation D - Reserve Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this account type definition originated (e.g., T24, FIS_PROFILE, INTERNAL_PRODUCT_CATALOG). Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation across platforms.

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: Standard frequency at which account statements are generated and delivered for this account type. Affects statement generation batch jobs and customer communication schedules.
attributes.references: CFPB Regulation DD; Temenos T24 Statement Configuration

attributes.name: tax_reporting_form

attributes.name: transaction_limit_applicable_flag

attributes.name: type_status

products.name: account_position
products.description: This association product represents the holding relationship between a custodial account and a financial instrument. It captures the position-level details required for fiduciary reporting, tax compliance (1099-B), performance measurement, and corporate action entitlements. Each record links one custodial account to one instrument with attributes that exist only in the context of this holding relationship, including quantity held, cost basis, acquisition details, and tax lot information.. Existence Justification: Custodial accounts hold portfolios consisting of multiple financial instruments simultaneously, and each instrument is held across many different custodial accounts. Banks actively manage these positions as operational business entities, tracking quantity, cost basis, acquisition dates, tax lots, and unrealized gains for each account-instrument combination. Position data is essential for fiduciary reporting, tax compliance (1099-B), performance measurement, and corporate action processing.

attributes.name: account_position_id
attributes.description: Primary key for account_position

attributes.name: custodial_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the custodial account that holds this position

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the financial instrument held in this position

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific tax lot within the position. Multiple lots may exist for the same account-instrument combination with different acquisition dates and cost bases.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this custodial account position. Primary key.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when this position or tax lot was acquired by the custodial account. Used for holding period calculations and tax reporting.

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: Total cost basis of the position in the account's base currency. Used for gain/loss calculations and tax reporting (Form 1099-B).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this position record was created.

attributes.name: income_earned_ytd
attributes.description: Total income (dividends, interest, distributions) earned from this position in the current calendar year. Used for tax reporting (Form 1099-DIV, 1099-INT).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this position record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_valuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this position was last marked-to-market and valued. Typically aligns with the account's last valuation date but may differ for illiquid securities.

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: Current market value of the position calculated as quantity multiplied by current market price. Updated with each valuation cycle.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the position. Active positions are held and valued. Closed positions have zero quantity. Pending settlement positions await trade settlement. Restricted or pledged positions have encumbrances.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units or shares of the instrument held in this position. Supports fractional shares for certain asset types.

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any investment restrictions applicable to this specific position based on the governing instrument or fiduciary guidelines. May restrict sale, pledge, or transfer.

attributes.name: tax_lot_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine which tax lots are relieved when shares are sold. FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), Specific Identification, Average Cost, or HIFO (Highest In First Out).

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Unrealized gain or loss on the position calculated as market value minus cost basis. Used for performance reporting and fiduciary compliance.

products.name: account_collateral_pledge
products.description: This association product represents the pledge or lien relationship between a deposit account and a collateral asset. It captures the specific terms under which a collateral asset secures a deposit account or related credit obligation. Each record links one deposit account to one collateral asset with pledge-specific attributes including pledge amount, lien priority, haircut percentage, coverage ratio, and lifecycle dates that exist only in the context of this specific pledge arrangement.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, a single deposit account can be pledged as collateral for multiple credit facilities or obligations (e.g., a large CD securing both a mortgage and a business line of credit), and a single collateral asset can secure multiple deposit accounts or related obligations across different customers or product lines. Banks actively manage pledge arrangements as operational business entities, tracking pledge-specific data including pledge amount, lien priority, haircut percentage, coverage ratio, and lifecycle dates for each distinct pledge relationship.

attributes.name: account_collateral_pledge_id
attributes.description: Primary key for account_collateral_pledge

attributes.name: asset_collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the collateral asset that is pledged to secure the deposit account or related obligation

attributes.name: collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the collateral asset pledged in this arrangement

attributes.name: collateral_pledge_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this specific pledge arrangement. Primary key.

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the deposit account that is secured by or associated with the pledged collateral asset

attributes.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of collateral value to the secured obligation amount for this pledge. Monitored for covenant compliance and margin call triggers. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this pledge record was created

attributes.name: haircut_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the collateral asset market value for this specific pledge arrangement. May differ from the asset-level haircut based on pledge-specific terms. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this pledge record was last modified

attributes.name: lien_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this specific pledge relative to other liens on the same collateral asset (first, second, third, subordinate, pari passu). Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: pledge_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the legal agreement or document governing this pledge arrangement

attributes.name: pledge_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the collateral value pledged in this specific arrangement. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: pledge_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collateral asset was pledged to secure the deposit account or related obligation. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: pledge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this pledge arrangement (active, released, substituted, defaulted, under_review)

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collateral asset was released from this pledge arrangement. Null for active pledges. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

products.name: account_portfolio_holding
products.description: This association product represents the holding relationship between a certificate of deposit and a managed portfolio. It captures the investment position details including allocation percentage, acquisition cost basis, tax lot tracking, and holding classification. Each record links one certificate of deposit to one managed portfolio with attributes that exist only in the context of this investment holding relationship.. Existence Justification: In wealth management operations, a single certificate of deposit can be held across multiple managed portfolios simultaneously (e.g., family office allocating the same institutional CD across multiple family member portfolios, or a single large CD position split across multiple client portfolios for diversification). Conversely, a managed portfolio holds multiple CDs as part of its fixed-income allocation strategy, often implementing CD laddering with different maturities. The holding relationship itself carries critical portfolio management data including cost basis, allocation percentage, tax lot tracking, and holding classification that belongs to neither the CD nor the portfolio alone.

attributes.name: account_portfolio_holding_id
attributes.description: Primary key for account_portfolio_holding

attributes.name: certificate_of_deposit_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Portfolio Holding - Certificate Of Deposit Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the certificate of deposit held in this portfolio position

attributes.name: managed_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the managed portfolio that holds this CD position

attributes.name: portfolio_holding_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this portfolio holding record. Primary key.

attributes.name: tax_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax lot associated with this holding, used for tax-efficient portfolio management, capital gains tracking, and tax loss harvesting strategies. Links to tax lot accounting system.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when this CD was acquired and added to the portfolio, which may differ from the CD issue_date if purchased in secondary market or transferred from another portfolio.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total portfolio AUM represented by this CD holding, used for asset allocation monitoring and rebalancing decisions. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50%).

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost of this CD position in the portfolio base currency, used for performance calculation, tax reporting, and gain/loss determination. May differ from face_value_amount if acquired at premium or discount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this holding record was created in the portfolio management system.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when this holding was sold, matured, or transferred out of the portfolio. Null for active holdings.

attributes.name: holding_classification
attributes.description: Portfolio management classification of this CD holding within the investment strategy. Core: long-term strategic allocation; Satellite: tactical positioning; Cash_equivalent: liquidity management component.

attributes.name: holding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this holding within the portfolio. Active: currently held; Pending_sale: marked for liquidation; Sold: position closed; Matured: CD reached maturity; Transferred_out: moved to another portfolio.

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Realized gain or loss amount upon disposition of this holding, calculated as proceeds minus cost basis. Used for performance attribution and tax reporting. Null for active holdings.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this holding record was last modified.

products.name: custody_mandate
products.description: This association product represents the custody arrangement between a custodial account and an investment banking mandate. It captures the specific custodial services, asset segregation, and reporting obligations that exist when a custodial account is designated to support a specific mandate engagement. Each record links one custodial account to one mandate with attributes that define the custody relationship terms.. Existence Justification: In investment banking operations, a single custodial account can support multiple concurrent mandates (e.g., a multi-client custody platform or a trust account serving multiple deal structures), and a complex mandate (especially for structured products, IPOs with lock-up arrangements, or multi-tranche financings) can require multiple custodial accounts segregated by asset class, jurisdiction, or regulatory regime. The custody arrangement itself is an operational business entity with specific terms: custody role, asset types held, valuation frequency, reporting obligations, and fee arrangements that are negotiated per mandate and managed actively by custody operations teams.

attributes.name: custody_mandate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this custody mandate arrangement. Primary key.

attributes.name: custodial_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the custodial account providing custody services for this mandate

attributes.name: investment_mandate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the investment banking mandate being supported by this custody arrangement

attributes.name: arrangement_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this custody arrangement was terminated or the mandate was completed. Null for active arrangements.

attributes.name: arrangement_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this custodial account was designated to support this mandate and custody services commenced.

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this custody mandate arrangement.

attributes.name: asset_types_held
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured description of asset types held in this custodial account for this specific mandate (e.g., 'Equity Securities', 'Fixed Income', 'Cash Collateral', 'Derivatives'). Asset segregation by mandate is critical for regulatory compliance and client reporting.

attributes.name: authorized_signatories
attributes.description: List of individuals authorized to give instructions on this custody arrangement for this specific mandate (may be a subset of general account signatories).

attributes.name: custody_role
attributes.description: The specific custodial role this account plays in supporting the mandate. Defines the nature of custody services provided (e.g., Primary Custodian for all deal assets, Escrow Agent for IPO proceeds, Collateral Agent for secured lending).

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which custody fees are calculated for this specific mandate arrangement. May differ from the custodial account's standard fee schedule based on negotiated mandate terms.

attributes.name: reporting_obligation
attributes.description: Description of specific reporting obligations tied to this custody arrangement, including report types, frequency, recipients, and regulatory requirements (e.g., 'Daily position reports to deal team and client CFO; quarterly regulatory filings under SEC Rule 17f-5').

attributes.name: segregation_requirement
attributes.description: Level of asset segregation required for this mandate, driven by regulatory requirements, client preferences, or deal structure.

attributes.name: valuation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which assets held under this custody arrangement must be valued and marked-to-market for mandate reporting purposes. May differ from the custodial account's standard valuation cycle based on mandate requirements.

products.name: account_pledge
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of a specific custodial account's assets to a specific pledge agreement. It captures the per-account-per-pledge collateral allocation details that exist only in the context of this relationship. Each record links one custodial account to one pledge with attributes tracking the quantity pledged from that account, valuation at pledge time, substitution rights specific to that account-pledge combination, and release conditions.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, a single custodial account can hold multiple types of securities and cash that may be pledged under different pledge agreements to secure various credit exposures, derivatives, or repo transactions. Conversely, a single pledge agreement can be secured by assets drawn from multiple custodial accounts, particularly in consolidated collateral pool arrangements where the bank aggregates assets across accounts to meet collateral requirements. The bank actively manages per-account-per-pledge data including the specific quantity pledged from each account, valuation at pledge time, substitution rights constrained by each account's governing instrument, and release triggers.

attributes.name: account_pledge_id
attributes.description: Primary key for account_pledge

attributes.name: collateral_pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the pledge agreement being secured by this account's assets

attributes.name: custodial_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the custodial account providing assets for this pledge

attributes.name: account_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total pledge amount that is contributed by this specific custodial account. Used when multiple accounts collectively secure a single pledge (consolidated collateral pool scenario).

attributes.name: account_pledge_status
attributes.description: Current status of this specific account-pledge assignment: active (currently pledged), released (returned to account), substituted (replaced with other collateral), partial_release (some quantity released), defaulted (pledge enforced).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this specific account's assets became pledged under this pledge agreement. Tracks when this account-pledge relationship became active.

attributes.name: pledged_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity or number of units from this custodial account that are pledged under this specific pledge agreement. For securities, this is the number of shares or bonds; for cash, this is the monetary amount.

attributes.name: release_conditions
attributes.description: Specific conditions under which the assets from this custodial account can be released from this pledge. May vary by account due to different governing instruments or beneficiary restrictions.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the assets from this custodial account were released from this pledge agreement. Null for active pledges.

attributes.name: substitution_date
attributes.description: The date on which collateral from this account was substituted with alternative collateral within this pledge. Null if no substitution has occurred.

attributes.name: substitution_rights
attributes.description: Describes the rights and restrictions for substituting collateral from this specific custodial account within this pledge. May be constrained by the account's governing instrument or investment restrictions.

attributes.name: valuation_at_pledge
attributes.description: The market value of the pledged assets from this account at the time of pledge inception. Used for historical LTV tracking and collateral coverage calculations specific to this account-pledge combination.

products.name: channel_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between deposit accounts and banking channels. It captures which channels a customer has activated for each account, tracking enrollment lifecycle, usage patterns, and channel preferences. Each record links one deposit account to one channel with enrollment status, dates, usage metrics, and preference indicators used for channel analytics, fraud detection (unusual channel usage patterns), and customer experience optimization.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, customers actively enroll individual deposit accounts in multiple channels (mobile app, web banking, ATM network, branch access) to enable multi-channel access, and each channel serves thousands of accounts. Banks manage these enrollments as operational records with lifecycle status (active, suspended, revoked), track usage patterns per account-channel pair for fraud detection (e.g., sudden ATM usage after months of mobile-only activity), and maintain channel preferences and authentication methods specific to each account-channel combination.

attributes.name: channel_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the account-channel enrollment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: banking_channel_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Account Channel Enrollment - Banking Channel Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the banking channel in which the account is enrolled

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Account Channel Enrollment - Deposit Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the deposit account enrolled in the channel

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (customer or bank staff) who initiated the enrollment. Used for audit trail and fraud investigation.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Specific authentication method configured for this account-channel combination (e.g., biometric, hardware_token, sms_otp, app_push). May differ from channel default based on customer preference or risk profile.

attributes.name: channel_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account-channel enrollment. Active = channel is available for use; Suspended = temporarily disabled (e.g., fraud alert); Inactive = customer deactivated; Pending_activation = awaiting verification; Revoked = permanently disabled by bank.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was deactivated, suspended, or revoked. Null for active enrollments. Used for audit trail and reactivation workflows.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for enrollment deactivation (e.g., customer_request, fraud_alert, account_closure, security_breach). Null for active enrollments.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the enrollment was initiated (e.g., branch, mobile_app, web_banking, contact_center). Used to track enrollment source and self-service adoption.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was enrolled or activated for use through this specific channel. Captured during channel onboarding or self-service activation.

attributes.name: last_usage_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent transaction or interaction with this account through this specific channel. Used for dormancy detection, fraud pattern analysis (sudden channel usage after long inactivity), and channel engagement metrics.

attributes.name: preferred_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the customer's preferred channel for interacting with this specific account. Used for routing notifications, optimizing customer experience, and channel recommendation engines.

attributes.name: transaction_limit_override
attributes.description: Account-specific transaction limit override for this channel, if different from the channel's default limit. Null indicates channel default applies. Used for high-value customers or risk-based controls.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of transactions or interactions performed on this account through this channel since enrollment. Used for channel adoption analytics and customer behavior profiling.

products.name: rm_account_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between deposit_account and relationship_manager. It captures the operational coverage model where relationship managers are assigned to serve specific deposit accounts with defined roles, coverage responsibilities, and revenue attribution. Each record links one deposit_account to one relationship_manager with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, including assignment type (primary, secondary, specialist), coverage percentage, service model, revenue attribution, and assignment lifecycle dates. This is the account-level RM assignment, distinct from party-level client assignments.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, high-value deposit accounts are routinely served by multiple relationship managers simultaneously with different roles (primary RM, secondary RM, product specialists for treasury/FX services, geographic coverage RMs). Each RM manages a portfolio of multiple accounts. Banks actively manage these assignments as operational records, tracking assignment type, coverage percentage, service model, and revenue attribution per RM-account pair for performance management, succession planning, portfolio transfers, and client service coordination.

attributes.name: rm_account_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this relationship manager account assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: channel_relationship_manager_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rm Account Assignment - Channel Relationship Manager Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the relationship manager assigned to serve the account

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rm Account Assignment - Deposit Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the deposit account being served by the relationship manager

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date the relationship manager was assigned to serve this deposit account. Used for coverage continuity tracking, performance period attribution, and handoff analysis. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date the relationship manager's assignment to this account ended or is scheduled to end. Null for active assignments. Used for portfolio transfer tracking, succession planning, and historical coverage analysis.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or trigger for this RM account assignment. Examples: new_account_opening, portfolio_transfer, rm_departure, client_request, geographic_realignment, product_specialization, escalation. Used for assignment pattern analysis and coverage optimization.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the relationship manager's role in serving this account. Primary = main point of contact and accountability; Secondary = backup or co-coverage; Specialist = product-specific or technical coverage (e.g., treasury management, FX); Coverage = geographic or portfolio coverage without primary responsibility. Determines escalation paths and performance attribution rules.

attributes.name: aum_at_assignment
attributes.description: Assets under management (account balance) at the time of assignment. Provides baseline for measuring account growth under this RM's coverage. Used for performance attribution and portfolio composition analysis.

attributes.name: coverage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of coverage responsibility allocated to this relationship manager for this account, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 100.00 for sole coverage, 50.00 for split coverage). Used in matrix coverage models where multiple RMs share responsibility. Sum of coverage_percentage across all active assignments for an account may equal 100% or exceed it in overlapping coverage models. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was created. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: handoff_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting context for this assignment, particularly for portfolio transfers or reassignments. May include client preferences, service history, relationship nuances, or special handling instructions. Used for coverage continuity and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: lob_context
attributes.description: Line of business context for this specific assignment, which may differ from the RM's primary LOB assignment if the RM provides cross-LOB coverage. Examples: commercial_banking, wealth_management, private_banking, treasury_services. Used for LOB-specific performance reporting and coverage analysis.

attributes.name: revenue_attributed
attributes.description: Total revenue attributed to this relationship manager from this account assignment, measured in the bank's reporting currency. Calculated based on fees, interest income, cross-sell revenue, and attribution rules (may be split across multiple RMs based on coverage_percentage or assignment_type). Used for RM performance evaluation, compensation calculation, and portfolio profitability analysis. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: rm_account_assignment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this RM account assignment. Active = currently serving; Inactive = assignment ended; Pending = scheduled future assignment; Suspended = temporarily paused (e.g., RM on leave). Determines whether this assignment is included in active portfolio counts and service routing.

attributes.name: service_model
attributes.description: Service delivery model applied to this RM-account assignment. Dedicated = RM provides personalized service; Shared = RM is part of a team serving the account; Pooled = account served by RM pool without dedicated assignment; Virtual = remote or digital-first service model. Determines service level expectations and client communication protocols. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last updated this assignment record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
