attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: Repayment structure of the facility principal. 'Bullet' requires full repayment at maturity; 'amortizing' schedules periodic principal reductions; 'interest_only' defers principal; 'balloon' combines periodic payments with a large final payment; 'revolving' allows repeated drawdown and repayment.
attributes.references: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ Amortization Schedule; FASB ASC 310; OCC Loan Documentation

attributes.name: bank_hold_amount
attributes.description: The bank's retained share of the facility commitment in a syndicated loan, representing the portion not sold down to participant lenders. Determines the bank's net credit exposure and regulatory capital requirement for the facility.
attributes.references: OCC Shared National Credit (SNC); Basel III — CRR Article 166; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total committed credit limit approved for the facility, representing the maximum exposure the bank has contractually agreed to extend. Used in RWA (Risk-Weighted Assets) calculation and EAD (Exposure at Default) estimation under Basel IRB/SA approaches.
attributes.references: Basel III — CRR Article 166 EAD; BCBS 239; OCC Lending Limits

attributes.name: covenant_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the borrower is currently in breach of one or more financial or non-financial covenants attached to the facility. A covenant breach may constitute an event of default or trigger accelerated repayment provisions.
attributes.references: OCC Leveraged Lending Guidance; LMA Covenant Documentation; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ Covenant Tracking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the facility record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Provides audit trail for data lineage, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance, and ETL (Extract Transform Load) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; BCBS 239 Data Lineage; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the facility is past its scheduled payment due date. Key delinquency metric used for NPL classification (90+ DPD threshold), IFRS 9 staging triggers, and CECL loss estimation.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — 90 DPD Backstop; EBA NPL Guidelines; FFIEC Call Report; OCC Loan Classification

attributes.name: drawn_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding principal balance currently drawn and outstanding under the facility. Represents the bank's actual on-balance-sheet credit exposure. Key input for ECL (Expected Credit Loss) provisioning under IFRS 9 and CECL.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — ECL Measurement; CECL (ASC 326); Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Ratio of the borrower's net operating income to total debt service obligations (principal and interest). A DSCR below 1.0 indicates insufficient cash flow to service debt. Core covenant metric for commercial real estate and leveraged lending.
attributes.references: OCC Leveraged Lending Guidance (2013); FDIC Commercial Lending Standards; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the credit facility as recorded in the Loan Origination System, typically reflecting the borrower name and facility type (e.g., 'Acme Corp — 5-Year Revolving Credit Facility').
attributes.references: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Facility Master

attributes.name: facility_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the credit facility by the Loan Origination System (e.g., Finastra Fusion Loan IQ). Used in borrower communications, regulatory filings, and inter-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Facility Master; OCC Loan Classification Guidelines

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit facility. Drives downstream processing, provisioning, and regulatory classification. 'defaulted' triggers NPL (Non-Performing Loan) reporting; 'written_off' indicates full credit loss recognition under CECL/IFRS 9.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — Stage Classification; CECL (ASC 326); OCC Loan Classification; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit facility by product structure. Determines amortization schedule, drawdown mechanics, and regulatory capital treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revolving_credit|term_loan|mortgage|consumer_loan|syndicated_loan|letter_of_credit|overdraft|trade_finance|guarantee|bridge_loan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OCC Loan Classification Guidelines; Basel III — CRR Article 147; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: first_drawdown_date
attributes.description: Date of the first utilization or drawdown under the facility. Marks the transition from commitment to active exposure and is used for interest accrual commencement and IFRS 9 initial recognition of financial asset.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — Initial Recognition; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: ifrs9_stage
attributes.description: IFRS 9 impairment staging classification: Stage 1 (performing, 12-month ECL), Stage 2 (significant increase in credit risk, lifetime ECL), Stage 3 (credit-impaired, lifetime ECL). Drives ECL provisioning and income recognition methodology.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — Section 5.5 Impairment; IASB IFRS 9 (2014); EBA Guidelines on Credit Risk Management

attributes.name: interest_rate_basis
attributes.description: Reference rate benchmark underpinning the facility's floating interest rate (e.g., SOFR — Secured Overnight Financing Rate, EURIBOR). Reflects LIBOR transition requirements per ARRC/ISDA fallback protocols. Fixed-rate facilities carry 'fixed' designation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SOFR|LIBOR|EURIBOR|SONIA|fixed|prime|CDOR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ARRC SOFR Transition; ISDA 2020 IBOR Fallbacks; FASB ASU 2020-04 Reference Rate Reform

attributes.name: interest_rate_spread_bps
attributes.description: Credit spread above the reference rate benchmark expressed in BPS (Basis Points), representing the bank's risk-adjusted margin on the facility. Key input for NIM (Net Interest Margin) and NII (Net Interest Income) reporting and FTP (Funds Transfer Pricing).
attributes.references: ALCO NIM/NII Framework; FTP Policy; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: loan_purpose_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the intended use of proceeds for the credit facility (e.g., working capital, capital expenditure, acquisition finance, real estate purchase). Required for HMDA, CRA, and Call Report regulatory filings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: working_capital|capex|acquisition|real_estate|trade_finance|refinancing|general_corporate|consumer_personal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FFIEC Call Report Instructions; HMDA Regulation C; CRA Regulation BB; OCC Loan Classification

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the outstanding drawn amount to the appraised value of pledged collateral, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 = 75% LTV). Key underwriting metric for mortgage and secured commercial lending; used in LGD estimation and collateral adequacy monitoring.
attributes.references: OCC Real Estate Lending Standards (12 CFR 34); BCBS Mortgage Risk Weights; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual date on which the facility expires and all outstanding principal and accrued interest become due. Used for liquidity gap analysis, NSFR (Net Stable Funding Ratio) bucketing, and ALM (Asset-Liability Management) cash flow projections.
attributes.references: Basel III NSFR — BCBS 295; ALM Framework; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: npl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is classified as a Non-Performing Loan (NPL) per regulatory definition (typically 90+ days past due or unlikely-to-pay). Triggers specific provisioning, income recognition suspension, and regulatory NPL ratio reporting.
attributes.references: EBA NPL Guidelines (EBA/GL/2018/06); OCC Loan Classification; IFRS 9 Stage 3; FDIC Call Report

attributes.name: originating_branch_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the bank branch or business unit that originated the credit facility. Used for geographic concentration analysis, CRA (Community Reinvestment Act) reporting, and LOB (Line of Business) profitability attribution.
attributes.references: CRA Regulation BB; FFIEC Call Report; OCC Geographic Concentration Guidelines

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit facility was formally originated and booked in the Loan Origination System. Marks the start of the facility lifecycle and is used for vintage analysis, seasoning calculations, and CECL/IFRS 9 staging.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — Initial Recognition; CECL (ASC 326); Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: regulatory_segment
attributes.description: Basel III regulatory exposure class assigned to the facility for RWA (Risk-Weighted Assets) calculation under the Standardized Approach (SA) or Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) approach. Determines applicable risk weight and capital treatment.
attributes.references: Basel III — CRR Article 112 Exposure Classes; BCBS 128 IRB; OCC Capital Rules (12 CFR 3)

attributes.name: repayment_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency of principal and/or interest repayment installments under the facility. Drives cash flow projection for ALM (Asset-Liability Management), liquidity gap analysis, and NSFR (Net Stable Funding Ratio) bucketing.
attributes.references: Basel III NSFR — BCBS 295; ALM Framework; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next annual or periodic credit review of the facility. Triggers credit underwriting reassessment, covenant compliance review, and internal risk rating refresh.
attributes.references: OCC Loan Review Guidelines; SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ

attributes.name: syndicated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is part of a syndicated loan arrangement involving multiple lender participants. Syndicated facilities require agent bank coordination, participation tracking, and specific regulatory reporting under OCC Shared National Credit (SNC) program.
attributes.references: OCC Shared National Credit (SNC) Program; Finastra Fusion Loan IQ Syndication Module

attributes.name: undrawn_amount
attributes.description: Available but unutilized portion of the committed facility (committed_amount minus drawn_amount). Attracts a credit conversion factor (CCF) for off-balance-sheet RWA calculation under Basel III standardized and IRB approaches.
attributes.references: Basel III — CRR Article 166 CCF; BCBS 239; OCC Lending Limits

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the facility record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental ETL (Extract Transform Load) processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; BCBS 239 Data Lineage; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: credit_application

Captures applicant reference, requested facility amount and type, purpose of borrowing, collateral offered, financial statement submission dates, credit analyst assigned, credit scoring model output, underwriting decision (approved, declined, referred, withdrawn), approved terms and conditions, conditions precedent checklist, credit committee approval timestamps, and pipeline stage tracking. Supports regulatory reporting (HMDA, CRA) and origination funnel analytics.

attributes.name: credit_score

attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Basel III IRB Approach

attributes.name: decline_reason

attributes.description: Date of the most recent financial statements submitted by the applicant as part of the credit application package.

attributes.name: kyc_completed

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: loan_account
products.description: Operational loan account record representing the active borrower position for a booked facility. Tracks outstanding principal balance, accrued interest, fees payable, payment schedule, day-count convention, current interest rate, rate reset date, loan status (current, delinquent, NPL, charged-off), delinquency bucket (DPD), NPL classification (substandard, doubtful, loss), classification trigger events, regulatory classification basis (OCC, Basel), watch-list flag, cure dates, and interest accrual calculations. Distinct from the account domain's deposit accounts; this is the SSOT for loan balance positions, credit quality classification, and NPL lifecycle management including regulatory NPL reporting.

attributes.description: Actual principal reduction amount applied from the received payment. May differ from scheduled principal due to payment allocation rules, prepayments, or shortfalls.

attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: Type of amortization method used for this schedule. Level payment maintains constant total payments; level principal maintains constant principal payments; bullet has principal due at maturity; balloon has a large final payment; custom follows a non-standard pattern.

attributes.name: beginning_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding principal balance at the start of this payment period, before the current installment is applied. Represents the loan balance carried forward from the previous period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amortization schedule entry was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail for schedule generation.

attributes.name: day_count_convention
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the number of days in the accrual period and the year basis for interest calculations. Standard conventions include 30/360, Actual/365, Actual/360, and Actual/Actual.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days this payment is overdue, calculated as the difference between current date (or actual payment date) and the due date. Zero or null if payment is current or paid on time. Critical metric for delinquency tracking and credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which this installment payment is contractually due. Used for payment processing, delinquency tracking, and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: ending_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding principal balance remaining after this scheduled payment is applied. Calculated as beginning balance minus scheduled principal amount. Becomes the beginning balance for the next period.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this payment installment within the loan's repayment schedule. Starts at 1 for the first payment and increments for each subsequent scheduled payment.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate in effect for this payment period, expressed as a decimal. May vary across installments for variable-rate loans or after rate resets. Used to calculate the scheduled interest amount.

attributes.name: is_final_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final scheduled payment for the loan. True for the last installment that brings the ending balance to zero. Used to identify loan maturity and schedule completion.

attributes.name: is_restructured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this installment is part of a restructured payment schedule. True if the loan has been modified after origination due to borrower hardship, forbearance, or other restructuring events. Critical for regulatory reporting and credit risk classification.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late payment fee assessed for this installment if payment was received after the due date. Calculated according to the loan agreement's late fee provisions. Null if payment was on time or no late fee was assessed.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which payments are scheduled for this loan. Determines the interval between installments and affects the amortization calculation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the actual payment was received for this installment. Includes ACH (Automated Clearing House), wire transfer, check, cash, card payment, or internal account transfer. Null if payment has not been received.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this scheduled installment payment. Tracks whether the payment is still scheduled, has been paid in full, partially paid, is overdue, has been waived, or has been deferred to a future date.

attributes.name: prepayment_amount
attributes.description: Additional principal amount paid beyond the scheduled principal for this installment. Represents voluntary prepayments that reduce the outstanding balance faster than scheduled. Null if no prepayment occurred.

attributes.name: restructure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loan restructuring became effective, if applicable. Null for non-restructured installments. Used to track troubled debt restructuring (TDR) events and assess credit quality.

attributes.name: schedule_generation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the amortization schedule was generated or regenerated. Updated whenever the schedule is recalculated due to loan modifications or rate changes.

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number of this amortization schedule. Increments each time the schedule is regenerated due to loan modifications, restructuring, rate resets, or payment plan changes. Version 1 is the original schedule at loan origination.

attributes.name: scheduled_fee_amount
attributes.description: Any contractually scheduled fees or charges included in this installment, such as servicing fees, insurance premiums, or other recurring charges.

attributes.name: scheduled_interest_amount
attributes.description: Contractually scheduled interest charge for this payment period. Calculated based on the beginning balance, interest rate, and accrual period. Represents the cost of borrowing for this period.

attributes.name: scheduled_principal_amount
attributes.description: Contractually scheduled principal reduction amount for this installment. This portion of the payment reduces the outstanding loan balance.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount due for this installment, calculated as the sum of scheduled principal, interest, and fees. This is the amount the borrower is contractually obligated to pay on the due date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this amortization schedule entry was last modified. Updated whenever payment status changes, actual payment information is recorded, or schedule adjustments are made.

attributes.name: waived_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of scheduled payment that was waived or forgiven for this installment. May include waived principal, interest, or fees due to loan modifications, hardship programs, or settlement agreements.

products.name: drawdown
products.description: Records each individual drawdown (disbursement) event against a committed credit facility, capturing drawdown date, drawdown amount, currency, applicable interest rate at drawdown, drawdown purpose, funding account, value date, and settlement reference. attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the committed credit facility or loan agreement against which this drawdown is made. Links to the parent facility contract.

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id

attributes.name: party_id

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id

attributes.name: aml_screening_status
attributes.description: Status of AML and sanctions screening for this drawdown transaction: pending (awaiting review), cleared (passed), flagged (potential match), or escalated (under investigation).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The principal amount drawn down by the borrower in this transaction, denominated in the drawdown currency. This amount reduces available facility headroom.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drawdown request was approved by the credit officer or automated system. Required for audit trail and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: available_commitment_amount
attributes.description: The remaining undrawn commitment amount available under the facility after this drawdown. Calculated as facility limit minus total outstanding drawdowns.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate
attributes.description: The reference benchmark rate used for floating-rate drawdowns: SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate), LIBOR (legacy), EURIBOR, SONIA, ESTR, PRIME, or BASE rate.

attributes.name: beneficiary_account_number
attributes.description: The borrowers account number or IBAN to which the drawdown funds were credited. May be an internal DDA or an external account at another institution.

attributes.name: commitment_utilization_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total facility commitment utilized after this drawdown, calculated as (total outstanding + this drawdown) / facility limit * 100. Used for covenant monitoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drawdown record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the drawdown amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Multi-currency facilities may allow drawdowns in different currencies.

attributes.name: disbursement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the drawdown funds were released from the funding account. Critical for interest accrual calculation and operational reporting.

attributes.name: drawdown_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the borrower requested or executed the drawdown. This is the transaction date for accounting and interest accrual purposes.

attributes.name: drawdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the drawdown transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized), disbursed (funds sent), settled (funds received), failed (payment failed), cancelled (voided), or reversed (unwound). attributes.name: drawdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the drawdown event: scheduled (pre-agreed), unscheduled (ad-hoc), revolving (under revolving facility), term (under term loan), swing_line (short-term bridge), or overdraft (emergency).

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Any upfront or transaction fee charged to the borrower for this drawdown event. May include commitment fees, utilization fees, or processing fees.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fee amount. May differ from drawdown currency in multi-currency facilities.

attributes.name: funding_account_number

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this drawdown transaction was posted to the general ledger. Used for financial reporting and period-end close processes.

attributes.name: interest_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days in the interest period for this drawdown (e.g., 30, 90, 180). Determines the frequency of interest rate resets for floating-rate drawdowns.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The all-in interest rate applicable to this drawdown at the time of execution, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%). For floating rates, this is the initial rate.

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Type of interest rate applicable to this drawdown: fixed (locked rate), floating (benchmark + spread), variable (adjustable), or zero (non-interest bearing).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drawdown record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, amounts, or other mutable fields for audit purposes.

attributes.name: loan_to_value_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the total outstanding loan amount (including this drawdown) to the appraised value of the collateral, expressed as a percentage. Key covenant metric for secured facilities.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which this drawdown principal is due for repayment. For revolving facilities, this may be the next scheduled repayment date or facility maturity.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment rail or mechanism used to disburse the drawdown funds: wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement), SWIFT, internal book transfer, or check.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose or use of funds for this drawdown as declared by the borrower. May be required for covenant compliance, regulatory reporting, or trade finance documentation.
attributes.references: UCP 600 (Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number for this drawdown event, used in customer communications, SWIFT messages, and settlement instructions.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drawdown must be included in regulatory reports such as CCAR, DFAST, or Basel III capital adequacy filings. True if reportable, false otherwise.

attributes.name: repayment_type
attributes.description: The repayment structure for this drawdown: bullet (single payment at maturity), amortizing (scheduled installments), revolving (flexible repayment and re-draw), or on_demand (callable).

attributes.name: risk_weight_pct
attributes.description: The Basel III risk weight percentage applied to this drawdown exposure for Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation. Varies by borrower credit rating and collateral.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drawdown funds were actually transferred to the borrowers account. Reflects T+0, T+1, or T+2 settlement depending on payment rail.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the drawdown funds were confirmed as received in the beneficiary account. Used for reconciliation and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: spread_bps
attributes.description: The credit spread over the benchmark rate, expressed in basis points (e.g., 150.00 for 1.50%). This spread reflects the borrowers credit risk premium.

attributes.name: swift_message_reference
attributes.description: The SWIFT MT103 or MT202 message reference number for cross-border or interbank drawdown settlements. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: syndication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drawdown is part of a syndicated loan facility with multiple lender participants. True if syndicated, false if bilateral.

attributes.name: trade_finance_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying trade finance instrument if this drawdown is linked to a letter of credit, documentary collection, or bill of lading. Used for UCP 600 compliance.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which funds are made available to the borrower and interest accrual begins. May differ from drawdown_date due to settlement cycles.

products.name: repayment
products.description: Records each principal and interest repayment transaction against a loan account, including payment date, payment amount, principal component, interest component, fee component, penalty interest (if any), payment method (ACH, wire, RTGS), payment source account, outstanding balance post-payment, and whether the payment was on-time, early, or late. Feeds NPL classification and delinquency tracking.

Regulatory reporting (FFIEC 031/041) requires trac

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the repayment transaction was approved for processing. Null for automated payments that do not require manual approval.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or system user who approved the repayment transaction, particularly for manual or exception-based payments. Used for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this repayment record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days between the scheduled_payment_date and the actual payment_date. Positive values indicate late payment; negative values indicate early payment. Zero indicates on-time payment.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign Exchange (FX) rate applied if the repayment currency differs from the loan currency. Null if no currency conversion occurred.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to fees such as servicing fees, processing fees, or prepayment fees. Excludes penalty interest.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to accrued interest charges on the loan. Contributes to Net Interest Income (NII) calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments or context about the repayment transaction. Used for customer service, dispute resolution, and audit purposes.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_after_payment
attributes.description: Remaining principal balance on the loan immediately after this repayment is applied. Critical for Exposure at Default (EAD) and credit risk calculations.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount received in this repayment transaction, including principal, interest, fees, and penalties. Gross payment amount before allocation.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The customer-facing channel through which the repayment was initiated. Distinct from payment_method; tracks the interface used by the customer.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repayment was received and applied to the loan account. This is the business event date for the repayment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used to make the repayment. Includes Automated Clearing House (ACH), wire transfer, Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS), check, cash, or direct debit.

attributes.name: payment_processor_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment processing system or hub that handled this transaction. References systems such as ACI Worldwide or Volante payment platforms.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number or transaction identifier provided by the payment system or customer. Used for reconciliation and customer inquiries.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the repayment transaction. Tracks lifecycle from receipt through application to the loan account.

attributes.name: payment_timeliness
attributes.description: Classification of whether the payment was received on-time, early, or late relative to the scheduled_payment_date. Critical for Non-Performing Loan (NPL) classification and delinquency tracking.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the repayment transaction type. Scheduled indicates a regular installment; prepayment indicates early principal reduction; partial indicates less than scheduled amount; balloon indicates large lump-sum; final indicates loan payoff.

attributes.name: penalty_interest_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to penalty interest charges for late payment or covenant breach. Tracked separately for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repayment was posted to the General Ledger (GL) for accounting purposes. May differ from payment_date due to batch processing.

attributes.name: prepayment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this repayment includes a prepayment component (principal paid ahead of schedule). True if prepayment occurred; false otherwise.

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment allocated to reduce the outstanding principal balance of the loan. Core component for amortization tracking.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repayment transaction was reversed, if applicable. Null if the transaction has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this repayment transaction has been reversed due to insufficient funds, dispute, or error. True if reversed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the repayment was reversed, if applicable. Includes reasons such as insufficient funds, customer dispute, or processing error. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: scheduled_payment_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled due date for this repayment installment per the loan amortization schedule. Used to determine if payment is on-time, early, or late.

attributes.name: source_bank_bic
attributes.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) or SWIFT code of the financial institution from which the payment originated. Required for cross-border payments.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the repayment transaction was processed by the payment system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this repayment record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes and ensuring data integrity.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date from which the repayment amount is considered for interest calculation purposes. May differ from payment_date due to settlement timing.

attributes.name: waiver_amount
attributes.description: Amount of fees or penalties waived by the bank as part of this repayment transaction. Used for customer relationship management and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for waiving fees or penalties, if applicable. Includes reasons such as customer goodwill, hardship, or error correction. Null if no waiver applied.
