products.description: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) impairment provisioning records under CECL (ASC 326) and IFRS 9 frameworks. Captures staging classification (Stage 1, 2, 3 under IFRS 9 or lifetime/12-month under CECL), provision amount, ECL model used, PD, LGD, EAD inputs, discount rate, forward-looking macroeconomic overlays, provision movement (new, release, increase), and reporting period. SSOT for loan loss reserve calculations.

attributes.name: loan_ecl_provision_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loan Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Provision ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the expected credit loss provision record.

attributes.name: capital_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.capital_plan. Business justification: ECL provisions directly impact projected capital ratios in forward-looking capital plans under CCAR/ICAAP frameworks. Essential for stress testing and capital adequacy planning.

attributes.name: collateral_valuation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_valuation. Business justification: ECL provision calculations under IFRS9/CECL require current collateral valuations to estimate LGD and recovery amounts. Finance teams must link each provision calculation to the specific valuation use

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: ECL provisions calculated in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for consolidation (group reporting currency translation), regulatory reporting (IFRS 9 disclosures), and GL pos

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: ECL provision movements generate journal entries for credit loss expense and allowance adjustments. Mandatory for IFRS 9/CECL compliance and regulatory reporting (CCAR, stress testing).

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan for which this ECL provision is calculated.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: IFRS 9 ECL calculations require forward-looking macroeconomic scenarios for probability-weighted provisioning. Macroeconomic_scenario is a denormalized scenario name that should reference the full str

attributes.name: accounting_framework
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which this provision is calculated (IFRS 9, CECL/ASC 326, or Local GAAP).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this provision calculation was approved for financial reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the credit risk officer or committee that approved this provision calculation.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ECL provision calculation was performed.

attributes.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of collateral value to exposure at default (collateral_value / EAD), expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: collateral_value
attributes.description: The current fair value of collateral securing the loan, used in LGD calculation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, assumptions, or qualitative factors considered in the provision calculation.

attributes.name: credit_impaired_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the loan is credit-impaired (Stage 3 under IFRS 9 or NPL status).

attributes.name: cumulative_provision_amount
attributes.description: The total accumulated provision balance for this loan as of the reporting date.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days the loan payment is overdue at the reporting date, a key input for stage classification.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The effective interest rate used to discount expected credit losses to present value, typically the loan's original effective interest rate.

attributes.name: ead
attributes.description: The total value of the loan exposure at the time of default, including drawn and undrawn committed amounts.

attributes.name: ecl_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the ECL calculation model or methodology used (e.g., PD/LGD/EAD model, vintage analysis, roll-rate model).

attributes.name: forbearance_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the loan is under forbearance or modification due to borrower financial difficulty.

attributes.name: lgd
attributes.description: The estimated percentage of exposure that will be lost if the borrower defaults, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%).

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the ECL model used for this calculation, supporting model governance and audit trails.

attributes.name: override_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the provision amount was manually overridden by credit risk management.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual override of the model-calculated provision amount.

attributes.name: pd
attributes.description: The probability that the borrower will default over the relevant time horizon (12-month or lifetime), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025 = 2.5%).

attributes.name: previous_stage_classification
attributes.description: The credit risk stage classification in the prior reporting period, used to track stage migrations.

attributes.name: provision_amount
attributes.description: The calculated expected credit loss provision amount for this loan at the reporting date.

attributes.name: provision_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the provision amount.

attributes.name: provision_movement_amount
attributes.description: The net change in provision amount for this period (positive for increases, negative for releases).

attributes.name: provision_movement_type
attributes.description: The type of movement in the provision balance: New (initial provision), Increase (additional provision), Decrease (partial release), Release (full release), Write-Off (charge-off against provision), Transfer (stage migration).

attributes.name: provision_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the provision record, used for external reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: recovery_rate
attributes.description: The expected recovery rate in the event of default, expressed as a decimal (1 - LGD).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this provision record is included in regulatory capital and stress testing reports (Basel III, CCAR, DFAST).

attributes.name: reporting_period_date
attributes.description: The financial reporting period end date for which this ECL provision is calculated (e.g., quarter-end, year-end).

attributes.name: scenario_weight
attributes.description: The probability weight assigned to this macroeconomic scenario in the weighted-average ECL calculation, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.60 = 60%).

attributes.name: significant_increase_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Significant Increase in Credit Risk Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether there has been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition (triggers Stage 2 under IFRS 9).

attributes.name: stage_classification
attributes.description: Credit risk staging under IFRS 9 (Stage 1, 2, 3) or CECL classification (12-Month ECL, Lifetime ECL, Credit-Impaired). Stage 1: performing loans with no significant increase in credit risk. Stage 2: significant increase in credit risk since origination. Stage 3: credit-impaired/non-performing.

attributes.name: stage_migration_date
attributes.description: The date when the loan migrated to the current stage classification, if applicable.

attributes.name: time_to_default_months
attributes.description: The estimated time horizon in months over which the default probability is measured (12 for Stage 1, lifetime for Stage 2/3).

products.name: loan_syndication
products.description: Master record for syndicated loan arrangements, capturing the syndication structure including lead arranger, agent bank, total syndicated amount, syndication close date, number of lenders, syndication type (club deal, broadly syndicated), market flex terms, and regulatory hold limits. Links to individual lender participations via the participation entity. Supports Investment Banking syndicated lending advisory.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Syndicated Loan / Agency

attributes.name: loan_syndication_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the syndicated loan arrangement. Primary key for the loan syndication entity.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Syndications structured in currencies require currency metadata (convertibility, settlement lag) for lender allocation, commitment tracking, settlement instructions, and regulatory reporting (large ex

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person or service account that last modified this syndication record. Supports audit trail and accountability for data changes.

attributes.name: kyc_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.kyc_review. Business justification: Syndicated loans require KYC on all participant lenders for AML purposes, especially when participants are foreign banks. Agent banks must verify participant identities and assess AML risk before synd

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying loan facility that is being syndicated. Links to the master loan record in the core banking system.

attributes.name: primary_loan_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial institution serving as lead arranger responsible for structuring the syndication, marketing to potential lenders, and coordinating the syndicate formation.

attributes.name: allocation_methodology
attributes.description: Method used by lead arrangers to allocate participations when syndication is oversubscribed. First come first served honors commitment timing; relationship based favors key bank relationships; pro rata scale reduces all commitments proportionally; tiered priority uses commitment size tiers.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: arranger_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee paid to lead arranger(s) for structuring and syndicating the loan. Separate from upfront fees paid to all lenders. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: borrower_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether borrower consent is required for lender assignments or participations. True means borrower has approval rights over syndicate composition changes; false allows free transferability subject only to credit criteria.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date when the syndication process was completed, all lender commitments finalized, and participation allocations confirmed. After this date, the syndicate structure is locked unless secondary market transfers occur.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: commitment_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which prospective lenders must submit binding commitments to participate in the syndication. After this date, allocations are finalized and late commitments are not accepted.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: confidentiality_tier
attributes.description: Level of confidentiality assigned to syndication information. Public allows broad distribution; private restricts to committed lenders; highly confidential limits to lead arrangers and named parties only.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this syndication record was first created in the loan origination or syndication management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: documentation_type
attributes.description: Standard documentation framework used for the syndication. LMA (Loan Market Association) standard for European markets; LSTA (Loan Syndications and Trading Association) standard for US markets; custom for bespoke terms; bilateral form adapted for syndication.
attributes.references: Loan Market Association (LMA) / Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: final_pricing_spread_bps
attributes.description: Final agreed pricing spread over the reference rate in basis points at syndication close. May differ from original spread if market flex was exercised. Represents the actual pricing achieved in the market.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: flex_exercised_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead arrangers exercised market flex provisions to modify loan terms during syndication. True indicates terms were adjusted from initial launch parameters to achieve full placement.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: green_loan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the syndicated loan qualifies as a green loan under Loan Market Association Green Loan Principles, with proceeds dedicated to environmentally beneficial projects and subject to sustainability reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Loan Market Association (LMA) Green Loan Principles

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the syndication was formally launched to the market and potential lenders were invited to participate. Marks the beginning of the marketing period.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: lender_meeting_date
attributes.description: Date of the formal lender presentation or bank meeting where the borrower and lead arrangers presented the credit opportunity to prospective syndicate participants. Key milestone in the marketing process.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: mandate_date
attributes.description: Date when the borrower formally awarded the syndication mandate to the lead arranger(s). Marks the official start of the syndication process.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: market_flex_provision
attributes.description: Type of flexibility granted to lead arrangers to adjust loan terms if market conditions require changes to achieve successful syndication. Pricing flex allows rate adjustments; structure flex allows covenant or maturity changes; full flex allows both; none means terms are locked.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: minimum_hold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum commitment amount that the lead arranger has contractually agreed to retain. Demonstrates skin in the game and alignment with syndicate lenders.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this syndication record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record for audit and change management purposes.

attributes.name: number_of_lenders
attributes.description: Total count of financial institutions participating in the syndicate as lenders. Includes lead arrangers, co-arrangers, and participating lenders at all commitment tiers.

attributes.name: original_pricing_spread_bps
attributes.description: Initial pricing spread over the reference rate (SOFR, LIBOR, etc.) in basis points at syndication launch. Used to track pricing flex if terms were adjusted during marketing.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: oversubscription_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of lender commitments received in excess of the target syndicated amount. Null if syndication was not oversubscribed. Used to calculate allocation scaling factors.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: oversubscription_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the syndication received commitments exceeding the target amount, requiring allocation scaling. True indicates strong market demand and potential for improved pricing terms.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: pro_rata_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all syndicate lenders share pro rata in payments, collateral, and recoveries based on their commitment percentages. True enforces equal treatment; false allows priority structures.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Business rationale for syndicating the loan. Common purposes include risk distribution, regulatory capital relief, relationship capacity management, fee generation, or market-making activity.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated this syndication record (e.g., Finastra Fusion Loan IQ, Murex, custom syndication platform). Used for data lineage and reconciliation across enterprise systems.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the syndication arrangement used in communications with participating lenders and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount that the lead arranger is permitted to retain on its own balance sheet under regulatory large exposure limits. Drives minimum syndication distribution requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this syndication requires specific regulatory reporting to supervisory authorities under large exposure rules, concentration risk frameworks, or syndicated lending disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: sustainability_linked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan includes sustainability-linked pricing mechanisms where the interest margin adjusts based on the borrower's achievement of predefined Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance targets.
attributes.references: Loan Market Association (LMA) Sustainability Linked Loan Principles

attributes.name: syndication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the syndication process. Mandate awarded indicates lead arranger selected; structuring involves term sheet development; marketing is active lender solicitation; allocation is commitment distribution; closed is final participation confirmed; cancelled indicates syndication abandoned.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: syndication_type
attributes.description: Classification of the syndication structure. Club deal involves a small group of relationship lenders; broadly syndicated involves wider institutional distribution; best efforts means no underwriting commitment; underwritten means lead arrangers guarantee full placement; sub-participation involves risk transfer without borrower notification.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: total_syndicated_amount
attributes.description: Total facility amount being syndicated across all participating lenders. Represents the aggregate commitment that will be distributed among syndicate members.

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_type
attributes.description: Classification of restrictions on secondary market transfers of syndicate participations. Freely transferable allows unrestricted assignment; consent required needs borrower or agent approval; restricted list limits transfers to approved institutions; prohibited blocks all transfers.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: upfront_fee_bps
attributes.description: One-time upfront fee paid to syndicate lenders at closing, expressed in basis points of their commitment amount. Compensates lenders for underwriting and structuring work.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

attributes.name: voting_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of syndicate lender commitments required to approve material amendments or waivers to the loan agreement. Typically 50%, 66.67%, or 100% depending on the action type.
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standards

products.name: lender_participation
products.description: Records each lender's participation share in a syndicated loan facility, capturing lender institution, commitment amount, funded amount, unfunded commitment, pro-rata share percentage, participation type (primary, sub-participation), assignment date, and settlement status. Enables agent bank position management and lender fee distribution calculations in Loan IQ's agency module.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Lender Participation / Commitment

attributes.name: lender_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lender participation record in the syndicated loan facility.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.credit_exposure. Business justification: Syndication participations create credit exposures requiring regulatory capital measurement and credit risk monitoring. Ead/lgd/pd/ecl/rwa are denormalized exposure metrics that should be sourced from

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Lender participations denominated in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for commitment tracking, risk weighting (RWA calculation), ECL provisioning, and regulatory reporting (

attributes.name: loan_syndication_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent syndicated loan facility in which this lender participates.

attributes.name: primary_lender_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial institution participating as a lender in the syndicated facility.

attributes.name: syndication_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.syndication_allocation. Business justification: Lender participations in loan syndications correspond to investment banking syndication allocations—parallel views of same economic participation. Investment banking allocates; lending books. Essentia

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest income accrued but not yet paid on the lender's funded participation balance, calculated from last payment date to current date.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender's participation was assigned, transferred, or novated from another lender or originated in primary syndication.

attributes.name: collateral_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Lender's pro-rata share of collateral securing the syndicated facility, expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.1250 for 12.50%), used for recovery calculations in default scenarios.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information related to the lender participation that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: Total committed capital amount that the lender has agreed to provide to the syndicated facility, representing the maximum exposure.

attributes.name: commitment_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual fee rate charged on the unfunded commitment portion, expressed as decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0050 for 0.50% or 50 basis points).

attributes.name: confidential_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender's identity and participation details are confidential and not disclosed to the borrower. True if confidential, false if disclosed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the lender participation record was first created in the loan origination system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the lender's participation becomes legally binding and operational, marking the start of commitment period.

attributes.name: funded_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount of capital that the lender has disbursed or drawn down from their commitment to date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the lender participation record was most recently updated, capturing any changes to commitment, funding, or status.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent principal or interest payment received by the lender on this participation.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lender's participation commitment expires and all outstanding funded amounts must be repaid.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the system user who last modified the participation record, supporting audit and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: next_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled principal or interest payment is due to the lender.

attributes.name: participation_fee_amount
attributes.description: Upfront or recurring fee paid to the lender for participating in the syndicated facility, separate from interest income.

attributes.name: participation_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the lender in the syndicate structure: lead arranger (organizes syndicate), bookrunner (manages allocation), agent (administrative duties), co-agent (supporting agent), participant (passive lender), or underwriter (guarantees placement).

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lender participation: active (operational), pending (awaiting settlement), settled (funds transferred), terminated (participation ended), defaulted (borrower default), or transferred (sold to another lender).

attributes.name: participation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lender's participation structure: primary syndication member, sub-participation (unfunded risk transfer), assignment (funded transfer with borrower consent), novation (full replacement), risk participation (credit risk transfer only), or funded participation (capital commitment).
attributes.references: Loan Syndications and Trading Association (LSTA) Standard Terms

attributes.name: pro_rata_share_percentage
attributes.description: Lender's proportional ownership percentage of the total syndicated facility, used for fee distribution and payment allocation calculations. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.1250 for 12.50%).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation must be included in regulatory capital and liquidity reporting (e.g., CCAR, DFAST, Basel III). True if reportable, false if exempt.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 12-17 / Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR)

attributes.name: risk_weight_percentage
attributes.description: Basel III risk weighting applied to the participation exposure for regulatory capital calculation purposes, expressed as percentage (e.g., 100.00 for 100%).
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cash settlement for the participation was completed and funds were transferred between parties.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current state of cash settlement for the participation: pending (awaiting funds transfer), settled (funds received), failed (settlement unsuccessful), reversed (settlement unwound), or reconciled (confirmed and matched).

attributes.name: stage_classification
attributes.description: IFRS 9 impairment stage classification: stage_1 (performing, 12-month ECL), stage_2 (significant increase in credit risk, lifetime ECL), or stage_3 (credit-impaired, lifetime ECL with interest suspension).

attributes.name: syndication_tier
attributes.description: Seniority tier of the lender's participation in the capital structure: senior (first lien priority), mezzanine (second lien), subordinated (unsecured), or junior (lowest priority).

attributes.name: transfer_premium_discount
attributes.description: Difference between transfer price and par value of the participation, representing premium (positive) or discount (negative) paid in secondary market transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_price
attributes.description: Purchase price paid by the lender when acquiring the participation through secondary market assignment or sub-participation, may differ from par value.

attributes.name: unfunded_commitment
attributes.description: Remaining undrawn portion of the lender's commitment, calculated as commitment_amount minus funded_amount, representing contingent exposure.

attributes.name: voting_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender retains voting rights on material amendments, waivers, and consents under the credit agreement. True if voting rights are held, false if waived or transferred.

products.name: loan_fee_schedule
products.description: Master definition and transactional accrual ledger for all loan-related fees including origination fees, commitment fees, agency fees, amendment fees, prepayment penalties, and late payment charges. Captures fee type, calculation basis (flat, percentage of facility, percentage of undrawn), rate or amount, accrual frequency, applicability conditions, and for each accrual period: accrual date, accrued amount, billed amount, billing date, payment status, and GL posting reference. Supports revenue recognition for loan fee income and NIM reporting.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Fee Schedule

attributes.name: loan_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fee schedule record. Primary key for the fee schedule entity.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Fee schedules accrued in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for billing, revenue recognition (IFRS 15), GL posting, and financial reporting (fee income by currency). Reuses cu

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Fee schedules require GL account assignment for accrual, billing, and revenue recognition per fee type. Essential for fee income accounting and revenue recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15).

attributes.name: instruction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_instruction. Business justification: Fee billing and collection process: commitment fees, facility fees, and other loan-related charges are collected via payment instructions (direct debit, wire transfer). Required for revenue recognitio

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan facility or credit agreement to which this fee schedule applies. Links fee schedule to the underlying loan product.

attributes.name: accrual_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which fee accrual ceases. For term loans, typically the maturity date; for revolving facilities, the commitment termination date; for one-time fees, same as accrual start date. Null for open-ended fee schedules.

attributes.name: accrual_frequency
attributes.description: Periodicity at which the fee accrues and is recognized for revenue purposes. One-time fees are charged once at a specific event; recurring fees accrue at the specified interval throughout the loan lifecycle.

attributes.name: accrual_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which fee accrual begins. For origination fees, typically the loan booking date; for commitment fees, the facility effective date; for recurring fees, the first day of the accrual period.

attributes.name: amendment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter tracking the number of amendments made to this fee schedule. Starts at zero for the original fee schedule; incremented by one for each amendment. Supports audit trail and version control for fee schedule changes.

attributes.name: applicability_condition
attributes.description: Business rule or contractual condition that must be satisfied for the fee to apply. Examples: 'Undrawn balance exceeds $1M', 'Payment overdue by more than 30 days', 'Amendment requires lender consent'. Free-text field capturing the conditional logic from the loan agreement.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Role, committee, or individual who approved this fee schedule. Examples: 'Chief Credit Officer', 'Loan Committee', 'Relationship Manager'. Supports governance and audit trail for fee schedule establishment and amendments.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy Manual - Approval Authority Matrix

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule was approved by the designated approval authority. Used for audit trail and to ensure fee schedules are properly authorized before activation.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Periodicity at which the fee is invoiced to the borrower. May differ from accrual frequency; for example, a fee may accrue daily but be billed quarterly. On-demand billing applies to event-driven fees such as amendments or prepayments.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Method used to compute the fee amount. Flat amount is a fixed dollar value; percentage of facility applies to the total committed amount; percentage of undrawn applies only to the unused portion of a revolving facility; percentage of outstanding applies to the current loan balance; tiered uses different rates for different balance ranges.
attributes.references: Loan Origination System - Fee Calculation Engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fee schedule record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field capturing the initial record creation event.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the fee payment is overdue, calculated as current date minus payment due date. Zero or null when payment status is current or paid in full. Used to trigger late payment charges and delinquency reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule becomes active and binding per the loan agreement. For origination fees, typically the loan closing date; for amendment fees, the amendment effective date; for commitment fees, the facility effective date.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount of the fee when calculation basis is flat amount. Null when calculation basis is percentage-based. Represents the contractual fee value in the loan currency.

attributes.name: fee_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied when calculation basis is percentage-based. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.015000 represents 1.5% or 150 basis points). Null when calculation basis is flat amount.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fee schedule. Externally-known unique code used for operational reference and reporting.
attributes.references: Loan Origination System - Fee Management Module

attributes.name: fee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fee schedule. Active fees are currently accruing and billable; inactive fees are defined but not currently applicable; suspended fees are temporarily paused; waived fees have been forgiven by credit decision; cancelled fees are permanently terminated.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fee based on its business purpose. Origination fees are charged at loan inception; commitment fees apply to undrawn portions of facilities; agency fees compensate the administrative agent in syndicated loans; amendment fees apply when loan terms are modified; prepayment penalties discourage early repayment; late payment charges penalize overdue payments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-20 (Loan Receivables - Nonrefundable Fees and Costs)

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this fee schedule is currently active and applicable. True indicates the fee schedule is in effect; false indicates it has been terminated, superseded, or is otherwise inactive. Used for filtering active fee schedules in operational queries.

attributes.name: last_accrual_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which fee accrual was calculated and recorded. Used to track the current position in the accrual cycle and prevent duplicate accruals. Updated by the nightly accrual batch process.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment to this fee schedule. Null if no amendments have been made. Used to track the currency of fee terms and to support audit and compliance reviews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fee schedule record was most recently updated. Updated automatically on every record modification. Supports change tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to overdue fee amounts to calculate late payment charges. Expressed as a decimal. Null if no late payment penalty applies to this fee type. Typically specified in the loan agreement default provisions.

attributes.name: next_billing_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next fee invoice to be generated and sent to the borrower. Updated after each billing cycle. Null for one-time fees that have already been billed or for inactive fee schedules.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or exceptions related to this fee schedule. Examples: 'Fee waived for first 90 days as relationship incentive', 'Custom calculation per side letter dated 2024-01-15', 'Subject to annual review per credit committee resolution'.

attributes.name: outstanding_receivable_amount
attributes.description: Current unpaid fee balance (total billed amount minus total paid amount). Represents the borrower's outstanding fee obligation. Monitored for credit risk and collections purposes.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the most recent fee invoice must be paid to avoid late payment charges. Typically set as a number of days after the billing date per the loan agreement payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current state of fee payment obligation. Current indicates payment is not yet due or was paid on time; overdue indicates payment is past due date; partially paid indicates partial payment received; paid in full indicates full payment received; waived indicates fee was forgiven.
attributes.references: Payment Processing Hub - Payment Status Tracking

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Classification of the fee for regulatory reporting purposes. Determines how the fee is reported in Call Reports (FFIEC 031/041), FR Y-9C, and other regulatory filings. Interest income includes fees that are part of the effective interest rate; non-interest income includes transactional fees; fee income is a subset of non-interest income specific to loan-related fees.
attributes.references: FFIEC Call Report Instructions, Federal Reserve FR Y-9C

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting treatment for recognizing fee income. Immediate recognition books the full fee at billing; straight-line amortizes evenly over the loan term; effective interest method aligns with interest income recognition per CECL/IFRS 9; proportional allocates based on loan utilization or time elapsed.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this fee schedule record originated. Examples: 'LOAN_IQ' for Finastra Fusion Loan IQ, 'T24' for Temenos T24, 'CUSTOM_LOS' for proprietary loan origination system. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Architecture - Source System Registry

attributes.name: syndication_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method for distributing fee revenue among syndicate members in syndicated loan facilities. Pro rata allocates based on each lender's participation percentage; lead arranger only assigns the full fee to the lead; agent only assigns to the administrative agent; custom follows a specific allocation schedule defined in the syndication agreement.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Tax classification of the fee for income tax and withholding purposes. Taxable fees are subject to standard income tax; tax exempt fees are excluded from taxable income; withholding required indicates cross-border fees subject to withholding tax per tax treaty; VAT applicable indicates fees subject to value-added tax in applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule ceases to be active. For term loans, typically the maturity date; for revolving facilities, the commitment termination date; for one-time fees, the date the fee was billed. Null for open-ended fee schedules that remain active until loan payoff.

attributes.name: total_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative fee amount accrued to date but not yet billed. Represents the unbilled revenue recognized on the balance sheet. Reset to zero after each billing cycle when accrued amounts are transferred to billed amounts.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative fee amount invoiced to the borrower since fee schedule inception. Includes both paid and unpaid invoices. Used for revenue reporting and reconciliation with accounts receivable.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative fee amount received from the borrower since fee schedule inception. Used to calculate outstanding receivables (total billed minus total paid) and to track payment compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_authority
attributes.description: Role or committee authorized to waive or reduce this fee. Examples: 'Chief Credit Officer', 'Loan Committee', 'Relationship Manager up to $5,000'. Supports governance and audit trail for fee waivers.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy Manual - Fee Waiver Authority Matrix

products.name: modification
products.description: Records all material amendments and restructurings to existing loan facilities, including modification type (maturity extension, rate reduction, principal forgiveness, payment deferral, forbearance), modification date, original terms, modified terms, TDR (Troubled Debt Restructuring) classification flag, regulatory reporting flag, approving authority, and modification rationale. Supports NPL workout management and CECL staging reassessment.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Loan Amendment / Restructuring

attributes.name: modification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for modification

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Loan modifications (forbearance, restructuring, TDR) require documented approval authority for OCC/FDIC regulatory compliance and CECL audit trail. approving_authority field exists but is text/level,

attributes.name: capital_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.capital_plan. Business justification: TDR modifications affect credit loss projections used in capital stress scenarios under DFAST/CCAR frameworks. Essential for forward-looking capital planning and stress testing.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Modifications requested/processed via channels. Essential for forbearance program tracking, channel servicing quality measurement, regulatory reporting on modification channels (CFPB, OCC requirements

attributes.name: collateral_pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.pledge. Business justification: Loan modifications (forbearance, restructuring, TDR) often require collateral pledge amendments—lien releases, substitutions, or coverage ratio waivers. Workout teams track which pledge was modified a

attributes.name: counterparty_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.counterparty_rating. Business justification: Loan modifications (especially TDRs) trigger credit rating reassessment per credit policy. The modification should reference the post-modification rating to track credit deterioration and support CECL

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Loan modifications with fee amounts in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for fee calculation, GL posting, and regulatory reporting (TDR reporting, CECL modification tracking)

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Loan modifications generate journal entries for TDR classification, modification gain/loss recognition, and principal forgiveness accounting. Required for GAAP/IFRS compliance and regulatory TDR repor

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan facility being modified. Links to the core loan master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the modification was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: The name or title of the credit authority (individual, committee, or board) that approved this modification.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Delegation of Authority Matrix

attributes.name: approving_authority_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the approving authority. Indicates the escalation tier required for this modification based on risk and materiality.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Delegation of Authority Matrix

attributes.name: cecl_stage_after
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Stage After Modification
attributes.description: The CECL impairment stage classification of the loan after the modification is applied. Used to track stage migration resulting from the modification.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 326 - Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL)

attributes.name: cecl_stage_before
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Stage Before Modification
attributes.description: The CECL impairment stage classification of the loan immediately prior to the modification (Stage 1: performing, Stage 2: underperforming, Stage 3: credit-impaired).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 326 - Current Expected Credit Losses (CECL)

attributes.name: collateral_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification involved changes to collateral requirements, pledges, or Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios. True if collateral terms were adjusted.
attributes.references: Basel III - Credit Risk Mitigation Framework

attributes.name: covenant_waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification includes a waiver of one or more financial or operational covenants. True if covenants were waived.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who created this modification record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this modification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date the modification agreement was executed and legally binding documentation was completed.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee charged to the borrower for processing and executing the modification. Zero if no fee was assessed.

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the modification fee (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: forbearance_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the forbearance period ends and normal payment obligations resume. Null if not a forbearance modification.
attributes.references: CARES Act - Forbearance and Deferral Guidance

attributes.name: gain_loss_amount
attributes.description: The accounting gain or loss recognized as a result of the modification, calculated as the difference between the present value of the original and modified cash flows. Positive for gain, negative for loss.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Confidential internal notes and commentary regarding the modification decision, borrower negotiations, and risk considerations. Not shared externally.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., OCC, Fed, FDIC) under applicable reporting frameworks.
attributes.references: FFIEC Call Report - Schedule RC-C Part II

attributes.name: is_tdr
attributes.description: Indicates whether this modification qualifies as a Troubled Debt Restructuring under CECL and regulatory guidance. True if the borrower is experiencing financial difficulty and the lender granted a concession.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-40 - Troubled Debt Restructurings by Creditors

attributes.name: legal_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the legal amendment agreement or forbearance letter executed for this modification.

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the modification terms become effective and binding. This is the principal business event timestamp for the modification.

attributes.name: modification_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to this modification for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: modification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the modification request. Tracks the approval and execution workflow.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Amendment Approval Process

attributes.name: modification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the modification action taken. Determines the nature of the amendment to the original loan terms.
attributes.references: Basel III - Credit Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: modified_interest_rate
attributes.description: The new interest rate applicable to the loan after this modification, expressed as a decimal. Null if rate was not changed.

attributes.name: modified_maturity_date
attributes.description: The new maturity date of the loan after this modification is applied. Null if maturity was not changed.

attributes.name: modified_principal_amount
attributes.description: The principal balance after applying any forgiveness, capitalization, or other principal adjustments. Null if principal was not changed.

attributes.name: npl_status_after
attributes.description: The credit quality classification of the loan after modification. Tracks whether the modification successfully cured the NPL status.
attributes.references: Basel III - Definition of Default and Credit-Impaired Assets

attributes.name: npl_status_before
attributes.description: The credit quality classification of the loan prior to modification. Used to assess whether the modification is part of NPL workout management.
attributes.references: Basel III - Definition of Default and Credit-Impaired Assets

attributes.name: original_interest_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate applicable to the loan prior to this modification, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%).

attributes.name: original_maturity_date
attributes.description: The maturity date of the loan prior to this modification. Retained for historical comparison and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: original_principal_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the loan at the time of modification request.

attributes.name: payment_deferral_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which scheduled payments are deferred. Zero if no deferral was granted.
attributes.references: CARES Act - Forbearance and Deferral Guidance

attributes.name: principal_forgiveness_amount
attributes.description: The amount of principal forgiven or written down as part of this modification. Zero if no forgiveness occurred.

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the business and credit rationale for granting the modification. Includes borrower circumstances, lender strategy, and expected outcomes.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy - Modification Documentation Standards

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date the borrower or lender initiated the modification request.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who last updated this modification record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this modification record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

products.name: collateral_link
products.description: Association entity linking loan facilities to pledged collateral assets managed in the collateral domain. Records lien position (first, second, subordinate), pledged value at origination, current collateral value, LTV ratio at origination and current, collateral coverage ratio, perfection status (UCC filing, mortgage registration), and cross-collateralization flags. This entity owns the loan-side relationship data only; the collateral master record and valuation history remain in the collateral domain.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Collateral Linkage

attributes.name: collateral_link_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collateral link record. Primary key for the association between a loan facility and pledged collateral asset.

attributes.name: collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collateral asset pledged to secure the loan. Links to the collateral master record in the collateral domain.

attributes.name: hqla_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.hqla_inventory. Business justification: Eligible loan collateral (government securities, high-grade bonds) may qualify as HQLA for LCR calculation and liquidity buffer management. Critical for liquidity coverage ratio compliance and liquidi

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.investor_account. Business justification: Wealth management collateral: fund units held in investor accounts serve as loan collateral. Banks pledge the investor's fund positions (tracked via investor_account) against credit facilities. This l

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan facility that is secured by the pledged collateral. Links to the loan master record in the loan domain.

attributes.name: managed_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to wealth.managed_portfolio. Business justification: Managed portfolios are pledged as collateral for credit facilities. Collateral perfection process requires linking investment accounts, daily mark-to-market valuation for LTV monitoring, haircut appli

attributes.name: security_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Collateral_link already has collateral_asset_id (physical/real assets). Securities pledged as collateral require separate instrument reference for market-based valuation, haircut application, and marg

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the collateral asset value allocated to this specific loan facility. Used when a single collateral asset secures multiple loans. Sum of allocation percentages across all links for a collateral asset should equal 1.0000 (100%).

attributes.name: collateral_coverage_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of current collateral value to outstanding loan balance. Inverse of LTV. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.2500 represents 125% coverage). Values above 1.0 indicate over-collateralization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this collateral link record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: cross_collateralization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this collateral secures multiple loan facilities under a cross-collateralization agreement. True means the collateral is pledged to secure more than one loan obligation.

attributes.name: cross_default_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a default on this loan triggers default provisions on other loans secured by the same collateral. True means cross-default provisions are in effect.

attributes.name: current_collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: The most recent market or appraised value of the pledged collateral. Updated periodically based on revaluation frequency requirements and market conditions.

attributes.name: current_ltv_ratio
attributes.description: The current ratio of the outstanding loan balance to the current collateral value. Expressed as a decimal. Monitored for covenant compliance and risk management. Rising LTV indicates deteriorating collateral coverage.
attributes.references: Basel III - Standardized Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: current_value_as_of_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current collateral value was determined. Indicates the valuation date for the most recent appraisal or market assessment.

attributes.name: eligible_collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: The collateral value after applying regulatory haircuts and eligibility criteria. Used for Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation and regulatory capital reporting under Basel III.

attributes.name: haircut_percentage
attributes.description: The discount applied to the collateral value for risk management and regulatory capital purposes. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 represents 20% haircut). Reflects potential loss in value during liquidation.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral insurance policy expires. Monitored to ensure continuous coverage and covenant compliance.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number for the insurance coverage on the pledged collateral. Used to verify insurance compliance and file claims in the event of loss or damage.

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement requires the borrower to maintain insurance coverage on the pledged collateral. True means insurance is mandatory to protect the lenders security interest.

attributes.name: last_revaluation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent collateral revaluation. Used to monitor compliance with revaluation frequency requirements and identify stale valuations.

attributes.name: lender_loss_payee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lender is named as loss payee on the collateral insurance policy. True means insurance proceeds will be paid to the lender to protect the security interest.

attributes.name: lien_position
attributes.description: Priority ranking of the lien on the collateral asset. Determines the order of claim in the event of default and liquidation. First lien has highest priority, subordinate has lowest.

attributes.name: link_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral was pledged to secure the loan. Marks the beginning of the collateral relationship and the start of lien priority.

attributes.name: link_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing reference number for the collateral link relationship. Used in loan documentation and collateral agreements.

attributes.name: link_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collateral link relationship. Active indicates the collateral is currently securing the loan. Released indicates the lien has been discharged. Impaired indicates collateral value has deteriorated significantly.

attributes.name: link_termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral lien was released or the collateral relationship ended. Occurs upon loan payoff, collateral substitution, or lien release.

attributes.name: ltv_ratio_at_origination
attributes.description: The ratio of the loan amount to the pledged collateral value at the time of loan origination. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 represents 80%). Key credit risk metric used in underwriting decisions.
attributes.references: Basel III - Standardized Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: margin_call_status
attributes.description: Current status of any margin call on this collateral link. None indicates no margin call. Issued indicates a margin call has been sent to the borrower. Cured indicates the borrower has satisfied the margin call.

attributes.name: margin_call_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio threshold that triggers a margin call requiring the borrower to pledge additional collateral or pay down the loan. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8500 represents 85% LTV threshold).

attributes.name: next_revaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next collateral revaluation is scheduled or required. Used for operational planning and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, or exceptions related to the collateral link relationship. Used for documentation and operational context.

attributes.name: perfection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the security interest was perfected through proper filing or registration. Establishes priority over competing claims.

attributes.name: perfection_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the jurisdiction where the security interest was perfected. Determines applicable legal framework and enforcement procedures.

attributes.name: perfection_method
attributes.description: The legal mechanism used to perfect the security interest. UCC filing for personal property, mortgage registration for real estate, control agreements for securities, possession for physical assets.

attributes.name: perfection_status
attributes.description: Legal status of the security interest in the collateral. Perfected indicates the lien has been properly filed and recorded (e.g., UCC-1 filing, mortgage registration). Unperfected liens may not be enforceable against third parties.

attributes.name: pledged_value_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the collateral pledged at the time of loan origination. Represents the initial collateral valuation used for underwriting and Loan-to-Value (LTV) calculation.

attributes.name: pledged_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pledged value amount. Indicates the currency in which the collateral was valued at origination.

attributes.name: revaluation_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for revaluing the pledged collateral. Determined by loan agreement terms, collateral type, and regulatory requirements. Event-driven revaluations occur upon material changes.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system that originated this collateral link record. Typically the Loan Origination System or Core Banking System collateral module.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan agreement permits the borrower to substitute alternative collateral for the currently pledged asset. True means substitution is permitted subject to lender approval.

attributes.name: ucc_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Filing Expiration Date
attributes.description: The date on which the UCC-1 financing statement expires. Typically five years from filing date. Requires continuation statement to maintain perfection beyond expiration.

attributes.name: ucc_filing_number
attributes.description: The official filing number assigned by the Secretary of State or other filing office for the UCC-1 financing statement. Used to search and verify the perfected security interest.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this collateral link record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

products.name: write_off
products.description: Records formal write-off, charge-off, and all subsequent post-charge-off recovery events for uncollectable loan balances. Captures write-off date, written-off principal, accrued interest and fees, write-off approval authority, regulatory classification at write-off, and for each recovery event: recovery date, amount, source (borrower payment, collateral liquidation, guarantor call, debt sale), recovery channel, cumulative recovery to date, net loss after recovery, and GL posting references. Supports CECL reserve release accounting, LGD (Loss Given Default) model calibration, and regulatory net charge-off reporting to OCC/FDIC.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the write-off event. Primary key for the write-off record.

attributes.name: capital_ratio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.capital_ratio. Business justification: Charge-offs reduce RWA and impact capital ratios in the recognition period. Critical for quarterly capital ratio calculation and regulatory reporting under Basel III.

attributes.name: collateral_pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.pledge. Business justification: Write-offs track which collateral pledge was exhausted or liquidated. Collections teams need pledge reference for recovery pursuit strategy, collateral liquidation proceeds allocation, and LGD calcula

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Write-offs recorded in currencies require currency metadata (rounding, minor unit) for GL posting (charge-off journal entries), regulatory reporting (call report Schedule RI-B), and recovery tracking.

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL journal entry that recorded the write-off transaction, enabling reconciliation between loan system and financial accounting.

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loan account that was written off.

attributes.name: loss_recovery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fraud.loss_recovery. Business justification: Write-offs due to fraud are tracked for recovery efforts (insurance claims, legal action, chargeback). Linking write-off to loss_recovery enables net loss calculation, CCAR reporting, and tracking of

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the borrower whose loan was written off.

attributes.name: primary_write_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user ID or employee ID of the individual who approved the write-off, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_exam_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_exam. Business justification: Write-offs are scrutinized during regulatory exams for asset quality assessment, loss recognition timeliness, ALLL adequacy, and charge-off policy compliance. Examiners review write-off populations to

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The governance body or individual who approved the write-off: credit committee, chief credit officer, board of directors, or delegated authority per credit policy.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, OCC Comptroller's Handbook

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: call_report_schedule
attributes.description: The specific Call Report schedule and line item where this write-off is reported (e.g., Schedule RI-B Part II, Line 6a).

attributes.name: charge_off_reason_code
attributes.description: The primary reason for the charge-off: bankruptcy filing, borrower deceased, fraud, deemed uncollectable, statute of limitations expired, or other.

attributes.name: charge_off_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context and details about the reason for the charge-off.

attributes.name: collateral_liquidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether collateral was liquidated prior to or as part of the write-off process (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, Basel III LGD Framework

attributes.name: collateral_liquidation_proceeds
attributes.description: The net proceeds received from liquidation of collateral prior to write-off, applied to reduce the write-off amount.
attributes.references: Basel III LGD Framework, FASB ASC 310-10

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this write-off record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_recovery_to_date
attributes.description: The total amount recovered from all sources (borrower payments, collateral liquidation, guarantor calls, debt sales) since the write-off date, updated with each recovery event.

attributes.name: days_past_due_at_write_off
attributes.description: The number of days the loan was past due at the time of write-off, used for delinquency analysis and LGD modeling.

attributes.name: debt_sale_date
attributes.description: The date on which the charged-off debt was sold to a third-party debt buyer, if applicable.

attributes.name: debt_sale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charged-off debt was sold to a third-party debt buyer (True) or retained for internal collection (False).

attributes.name: debt_sale_proceeds
attributes.description: The amount received from the sale of the charged-off debt to a third-party buyer, recorded as a recovery.

attributes.name: ead_at_default
attributes.description: The total exposure at the time of default, used as the denominator in LGD calculation. Typically equals the total outstanding balance at default.

attributes.name: ecl_reserve_released_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Reserve Released Amount
attributes.description: The amount of ECL (Expected Credit Loss) or ALLL (Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses) reserve released upon write-off, reducing the reserve balance.

attributes.name: fees_written_off_amount
attributes.description: The unpaid fees (late fees, penalty fees, servicing fees) that were charged off at the time of write-off.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date the write-off transaction was posted to the general ledger, which may differ from the write-off date due to batch processing.

attributes.name: guarantor_call_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a guarantor was called upon for payment prior to or as part of the write-off process (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: guarantor_recovery_amount
attributes.description: The amount recovered from guarantor(s) prior to write-off, applied to reduce the write-off amount.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy, Basel III LGD Framework

attributes.name: interest_written_off_amount
attributes.description: The accrued but unpaid interest that was charged off at the time of write-off.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this write-off record was last updated, capturing any changes to recovery amounts, status, or other fields.

attributes.name: lgd_rate
attributes.description: The calculated Loss Given Default rate for this write-off: net loss after recovery divided by exposure at default (EAD). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4500 for 45%).

attributes.name: net_charge_off_amount
attributes.description: The net loss recognized after applying reserve release: total write-off amount minus ECL reserve released. This is the P&L impact of the charge-off.

attributes.name: net_loss_after_recovery
attributes.description: The net loss remaining after all recoveries: total write-off amount minus cumulative recovery to date. Used for final LGD calculation.

attributes.name: npl_classification_date
attributes.description: The date the loan was first classified as non-performing (NPL), typically 90+ days past due, prior to write-off.

attributes.name: principal_written_off_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the loan that was charged off at the time of write-off.

attributes.name: recovery_pursuit_status
attributes.description: Current status of post-charge-off recovery efforts: active pursuit, suspended, closed with no recovery, closed with partial recovery, or closed with full recovery.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification_at_write_off
attributes.description: The regulatory asset classification of the loan at the time of write-off per OCC/FDIC guidelines: substandard, doubtful, or loss.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off must be included in regulatory net charge-off reporting to OCC, FDIC, or Federal Reserve (True) or is excluded (False).

attributes.name: total_write_off_amount
attributes.description: The total amount written off, including principal, interest, and fees. Sum of all written-off components.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loan balance was formally written off and removed from performing assets.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the write-off transaction, used for audit trails and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the write-off record: pending approval, approved by credit committee, posted to general ledger, reversed due to error or recovery, or closed after final settlement.

attributes.name: write_off_type
attributes.description: Classification of the write-off event: full charge-off (entire balance), partial charge-off (portion of balance), technical write-off (accounting treatment without legal discharge), or regulatory write-off (mandated by regulator).

products.name: credit_review
products.description: Annual and periodic credit review records for active loan facilities, capturing review date, review type (annual, interim, triggered), credit analyst, relationship manager, updated internal risk rating, updated PD/LGD estimates, financial performance assessment, covenant compliance summary, collateral revaluation flag, recommended action (maintain, upgrade, downgrade, watchlist, exit), and credit committee sign-off date. Supports ongoing portfolio credit quality management.
products.reference: Finastra Fusion Loan IQ — Annual Credit Review

attributes.name: credit_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit review record. Primary key for the credit review entity.

attributes.name: channel_relationship_manager_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the relationship manager responsible for the borrower relationship. The RM provides business context and client intelligence to support the credit review.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System - Employee Master

attributes.name: collateral_investor_account_id
