attributes.name: accrued_interest
attributes.description: Interest that has accumulated on the bond since the last coupon payment date but has not yet been paid. Added to the purchase price in bond transactions.

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: Earliest date on which the issuer may exercise the call option to redeem the bond. Null if the bond is not callable.

attributes.name: call_price
attributes.description: Price at which the issuer may redeem the bond if the call option is exercised. Often expressed as a percentage of face value plus accrued interest.

attributes.name: callable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuer has the right to redeem the bond before maturity at specified call dates and prices. Affects duration, convexity, and valuation.

attributes.name: convexity
attributes.description: Measure of the curvature in the relationship between bond prices and yields. Used to refine duration-based interest rate risk estimates for large rate movements.

attributes.name: coupon_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which coupon interest payments are made to bondholders. Determines the number of payment periods per year and cash flow timing.

attributes.name: coupon_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate paid on the bond face value, expressed as a decimal. For fixed-rate bonds this remains constant; for floating-rate bonds this is the current rate after reset.

attributes.name: coupon_type
attributes.description: Classification of the coupon payment structure. Fixed coupons pay a constant rate, floating coupons reset periodically based on a reference rate, zero coupon bonds pay no periodic interest.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed income instrument record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: credit_rating_fitch
attributes.description: Credit quality assessment assigned by Fitch Ratings. Ranges from AAA (highest quality) to D (default). Used for portfolio risk management and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: credit_rating_moodys
attributes.description: Credit quality assessment assigned by Moody's Investors Service. Ranges from Aaa (highest quality) to C (lowest quality). Used for risk-weighted asset calculations and investment policy compliance.

attributes.name: credit_rating_sp
attributes.description: Credit quality assessment assigned by Standard & Poor's. Ranges from AAA (highest quality) to D (default). Critical for regulatory capital requirements under Basel III.

attributes.name: cusip
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) Number
attributes.description: 9-character alphanumeric code identifying North American securities. Primary identifier for US and Canadian fixed income instruments.

attributes.name: day_count_convention
attributes.description: Method used to calculate accrued interest between coupon payment dates. Critical for accurate interest accrual, pricing, and settlement calculations.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Measure of the bond's price sensitivity to changes in interest rates, expressed in years. Critical for interest rate risk management and ALM gap analysis.

attributes.name: face_value
attributes.description: Par value or principal amount of the bond that will be repaid at maturity. Basis for coupon payment calculations and amortization schedules.

attributes.name: first_coupon_date
attributes.description: Date of the first scheduled coupon payment. May differ from a regular period if the bond has an odd first coupon period.

attributes.name: fixed_income_status
attributes.description: Current state of the bond in its lifecycle. Active bonds are trading normally, matured bonds have reached their maturity date, called bonds have been redeemed early, defaulted bonds have missed payments.

attributes.name: floating_rate_index
attributes.description: Reference interest rate index to which the coupon rate is linked for floating-rate bonds. Common indices include SOFR, LIBOR, EURIBOR, and Treasury rates.

attributes.name: floating_rate_spread
attributes.description: Fixed spread in basis points added to the reference index rate to determine the coupon rate for floating-rate bonds. Reflects issuer credit risk and market conditions at issuance.

attributes.name: instrument_name
attributes.description: Full legal name or description of the fixed income security as registered with the issuer and regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fixed income security by issuer type and structure. Determines regulatory treatment, risk weighting, and accounting classification.

attributes.name: isin
attributes.description: 12-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the fixed income security globally. Standard identifier for cross-border trading and settlement.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bond was originally issued and became available for purchase in the primary market.

attributes.name: issuer_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country of domicile of the bond issuer. Used for country risk assessment and regulatory capital calculations.

attributes.name: last_coupon_date
attributes.description: Date of the final scheduled coupon payment before maturity. Typically occurs on or shortly before the maturity date.

attributes.name: market_price
attributes.description: Most recent trading price or valuation of the bond in the secondary market, typically expressed as a percentage of face value. Used for mark-to-market valuation and PnL calculation.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Date on which the principal amount of the bond becomes due and payable to the bondholder. Final date in the bond lifecycle.

attributes.name: price_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current market price was observed or calculated. Critical for fair value accounting and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: put_date
attributes.description: Earliest date on which the bondholder may exercise the put option to sell the bond back to the issuer. Null if the bond is not puttable.

attributes.name: put_price
attributes.description: Price at which the bondholder may sell the bond back to the issuer if the put option is exercised. Typically at or near par value.

attributes.name: puttable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bondholder has the right to sell the bond back to the issuer before maturity at specified put dates and prices. Provides downside protection to investors.

attributes.name: rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit rating was assigned or last affirmed by the rating agency. Used to track rating changes and trigger covenant reviews.

attributes.name: reset_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the coupon rate is recalculated based on the current reference index rate for floating-rate bonds. Determines interest rate risk exposure.

attributes.name: sedol
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Exchange Daily Official List (SEDOL) Code
attributes.description: 7-character alphanumeric code used to identify securities on the London Stock Exchange and other UK markets.

attributes.name: sinking_fund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bond has a sinking fund provision requiring the issuer to retire a portion of the bond issue periodically before maturity. Reduces credit risk but may limit upside.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fixed income instrument record was last modified. Tracks data currency and supports change data capture processes.

attributes.name: yield_to_maturity
attributes.description: Total return anticipated on the bond if held until maturity, expressed as an annual rate. Incorporates coupon payments, principal repayment, and current market price.

products.name: derivative
products.description: Master data for derivative instruments including exchange-traded and OTC derivatives: interest rate swaps, FX forwards, FX options, equity options, futures, CDS, total return swaps, and swaptions. Captures derivative-specific attributes: underlying instrument, derivative type, notional amount, notional currency, strike price, barrier levels, expiry date, exercise style (European/American/Bermudan), settlement type (cash/physical), ISDA master agreement reference, CSA linkage, clearing eligibility (CCP cleared vs bilateral), and trade repository reporting obligation. Supports CVA calculation, FRTB capital, and ISDA/CSA margin management.

attributes.name: margin_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Credit Support Annex that governs collateral posting requirements and margin calculations for the derivative contract.

attributes.description: Reference to the underlying asset or instrument upon which the derivative contract is based (equity, bond, commodity, index, currency pair, or another derivative).

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Broad asset class of the underlying instrument: interest rate, foreign exchange (FX), equity, commodity, or credit. Used for FRTB capital allocation and risk segmentation.

attributes.name: barrier_level
attributes.description: Price threshold that activates (knock-in) or deactivates (knock-out) the derivative contract. Used in barrier options and structured products.

attributes.name: barrier_type
attributes.description: Classification of barrier feature: knock-in (option activates when barrier is breached), knock-out (option terminates when barrier is breached), double-barrier (both upper and lower barriers), or none for non-barrier derivatives.

attributes.name: ccp_name
attributes.description: Name of the central clearing house through which the derivative is cleared (e.g., LCH, CME, Eurex Clearing). Applicable only for cleared derivatives.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the derivative is cleared through a central counterparty (CCP) or remains bilateral between counterparties. Cleared derivatives have lower capital requirements under Basel III.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the derivative instrument record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cusip
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP)
attributes.description: 9-character alphanumeric code identifying North American securities. Used for clearing and settlement.

attributes.description: Collateral posted at trade inception to cover potential future exposure. Required for non-cleared derivatives under EMIR and Dodd-Frank margin rules.

attributes.name: mtm_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the mark-to-market value is denominated.

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: The notional or face value of the derivative contract used to calculate payment obligations. Does not represent actual cash exchanged at inception but is the basis for calculating periodic settlements.

attributes.name: reporting_obligation
attributes.description: Identifies the regulatory framework under which the derivative must be reported: EMIR (EU), Dodd-Frank (US), MiFID II (EU), SFTR (Securities Financing Transactions Regulation), or none.

attributes.name: rwa_amount
attributes.description: Capital requirement for the derivative calculated under Basel III standardized approach (SA) or internal ratings-based (IRB) approach. Used for regulatory capital adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: sedol
attributes.description: 7-character alphanumeric code identifying securities traded on the London Stock Exchange and other UK exchanges.

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: Method of settlement at maturity: cash settlement (net cash payment based on market value) or physical delivery (actual transfer of underlying asset).

attributes.name: strike_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the strike price. Relevant for FX options and cross-currency derivatives.

attributes.name: strike_price
attributes.description: The predetermined price at which the holder of an option can buy (call) or sell (put) the underlying asset. Applicable to options, swaptions, and structured derivatives with embedded optionality.

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the derivative type (e.g., interest rate swap, FX forward, equity call option, barrier option, Asian option). Provides detailed product categorization for risk and capital reporting.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the derivative contract was terminated early, either by mutual agreement or due to a credit event. Null for contracts that reach natural maturity.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the derivative contract was executed and agreed upon by counterparties. Used for T+1 settlement calculations and trade repository reporting.

attributes.name: trade_repository_reference
attributes.description: Identifier assigned by the trade repository where the derivative transaction is reported under EMIR or Dodd-Frank regulations.

attributes.name: uti

products.name: price
products.description: Immutable append-only time-series of all security price observations for all instruments, serving as the single source of truth for both current and historical pricing. Records bid, ask, mid, last trade, official closing, open, high, low, close, volume, VWAP, and adjusted close (for corporate actions). Stores price source (Bloomberg, Reuters/Refinitiv, exchange feed, broker quote, internal model), price type (market/model/indicative/official), pricing date and time, currency, price basis (clean/dirty for bonds), accrued interest, yield, spread to benchmark, price quality flag, and source system. Prices are never overwritten — corrections are appended with reason codes and supersession flags. Retains the complete historical price archive for all instruments across all time periods. Supports MTM valuation, NAV calculation, portfolio P&L attribution, IFRS 9 fair value measurement, backtesting, VaR historical simulation, performance attribution, regulatory stress testing (CCAR/DFAST), historical trend analysis, and time-series analytics.

attributes.name: price_id

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Every price quote requires currency context for valuation and P&L calculation. Essential for multi-currency portfolio valuation, FX translation, and fair value hierarchy reporting under IFRS 13.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial instrument being priced. Links to the security master for ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, and instrument classification.

attributes.name: market_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.market_center. Business justification: Links price to trading venue for best execution analysis, MiFID II transaction reporting, and market data licensing. Essential for TCA (transaction cost analysis) and systematic internalizer reporting

attributes.name: market_data_source_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the external market data vendor or provider (e.g., Bloomberg ticker, Reuters RIC, exchange MIC code).

attributes.name: market_risk_position_id

attributes.name: superseded_by_price_id
attributes.description: Reference to the price_id of the corrected observation that supersedes this record. Null if this is the current valid observation.

attributes.name: accrued_interest
attributes.description: The interest accumulated on a fixed income security since the last coupon payment date. Used to calculate dirty price from clean price.

attributes.name: adjusted_close_price
attributes.description: The closing price adjusted for corporate actions (stock splits, dividends, rights issues) to maintain historical price continuity for performance analysis.

attributes.name: ask_price
attributes.description: The lowest price a seller is willing to accept for the security at the observation time. Used for liquidity analysis and bid-ask spread calculation.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the price is clean (excluding accrued interest) or dirty (including accrued interest). Primarily applicable to fixed income securities.

attributes.name: bid_price
attributes.description: The highest price a buyer is willing to pay for the security at the observation time. Used for liquidity analysis and bid-ask spread calculation.

attributes.name: change_amount
attributes.description: The absolute change in price from the previous observation, calculated as current price minus prior price. Used for volatility analysis and market movement tracking.

attributes.name: change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in price from the previous observation, calculated as ((current price - prior price) / prior price) * 100. Used for performance attribution and trend analysis.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: A quantitative measure (0.0000 to 1.0000) representing the confidence or reliability of the price observation, derived from source quality, market liquidity, and validation checks.

attributes.name: correction_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why a price observation was corrected or superseded. Supports audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this price record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A composite score (0.0000 to 1.0000) representing the overall quality of this price record based on completeness, timeliness, consistency, and validation checks.

attributes.name: fair_value_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: IFRS 13 / FASB ASC 820 fair value hierarchy classification: Level 1 (quoted prices in active markets), Level 2 (observable inputs), Level 3 (unobservable inputs).

attributes.name: high_price
attributes.description: The highest traded price of the security during the trading session or observation period.

attributes.name: is_superseded
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this price observation has been superseded by a subsequent correction or restatement. Supports immutable append-only architecture.

attributes.name: last_trade_price
attributes.description: The price at which the most recent trade was executed for this instrument. Represents actual market transaction price.

attributes.name: low_price
attributes.description: The lowest traded price of the security during the trading session or observation period.

attributes.name: mid_price
attributes.description: The midpoint between bid and ask prices, calculated as (bid + ask) / 2. Commonly used for fair value estimation and portfolio valuation.

attributes.name: notation
attributes.description: The format in which the price is expressed: decimal (e.g., 105.50), percentage (e.g., 98.75%), yield (e.g., 3.25%), basis points, or fractional (e.g., 32nds for US Treasuries).

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this price record was captured and appended to the immutable time-series. Distinct from pricing_timestamp; supports data lineage and audit.

attributes.name: official_close_price
attributes.description: The official closing price published by the exchange or pricing authority at end of trading day. Used for Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: open_price
attributes.description: The first traded price of the security at the start of the trading session.

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The originating system or vendor that provided this price observation (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters/Refinitiv, exchange feed, broker quote, internal valuation model). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bloomberg|reuters|refinitiv|exchange_feed|broker_quote|internal_model|vendor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: The current status of pricing for this instrument: active (normal trading), suspended (temporarily halted), halted (trading stopped), delisted (removed from exchange), matured (instrument expired).

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price observation: market (actual traded price), model (derived from valuation model), indicative (non-binding quote), official (exchange-published), closing (end-of-day), opening (start-of-day).

attributes.name: pricing_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this price observation is effective. Used for end-of-day valuations and historical analysis.

attributes.name: pricing_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this price observation was recorded or became effective. Critical for intraday Mark-to-Market (MTM) and trade execution analysis.

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the reliability and timeliness of the price observation. Verified = confirmed by multiple sources; stale = outdated; estimated = model-derived; challenged = disputed or under review.

attributes.name: regulatory_price_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this price observation is used for regulatory reporting purposes (e.g., CCAR, DFAST, Basel III stress testing, IFRS 9 fair value measurement).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the upstream system that originated this price observation (e.g., Murex, Calypso, Bloomberg Terminal, internal pricing engine).

attributes.name: spread_to_benchmark_bps
attributes.description: The yield spread over a benchmark rate (e.g., LIBOR, SOFR, Treasury) expressed in basis points (BPS). Used for credit risk assessment and relative value analysis.

attributes.name: trading_session
attributes.description: Identifies the trading session during which the price observation was recorded (pre-market, regular hours, after-hours, overnight).

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to derive the price: quoted (exchange-traded), matrix (interpolated from comparable securities), model (internal valuation model), consensus (average of multiple sources), broker quote.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: The total number of units (shares, bonds, contracts) traded during the observation period. Used for liquidity assessment and market depth analysis.

attributes.name: vwap
attributes.description: The average price weighted by trading volume over the observation period. Used for execution quality assessment and algorithmic trading benchmarks.

attributes.name: yield_to_maturity
attributes.description: The total return anticipated on a bond if held until maturity, expressed as an annual percentage rate. Critical for fixed income valuation and portfolio analytics.

products.name: classification
products.description: Standardized classification and taxonomy mappings for financial instruments across multiple industry frameworks including CFI (Classification of Financial Instruments ISO 10962), ISDA product taxonomy, ESMA EMIR classification, SFDR sustainability classification, MiFID II product governance classification, and internal asset class hierarchy. Enables regulatory reporting (MiFID II, EMIR, SFDR), risk bucketing (FRTB SA sensitivities-based approach), cross-domain instrument categorization, and investment policy compliance screening.

products.name: listing
products.description: Exchange listing records for securities capturing where and how each instrument is listed and traded across global exchanges. Stores exchange MIC code (ISO 10383), listing date, delisting date, trading currency, lot size, tick size, trading hours, trading status (active/suspended/halted/delisted), primary listing flag, and exchange-specific instrument code. A single instrument may have multiple listings across different exchanges (e.g., dual-listed equities, cross-listed ADRs). Supports order routing, best execution analysis (MiFID II RTS 27/28), market data subscription management, and regulatory transaction reporting (MiFIR).

products.name: benchmark
products.description: Master data for financial benchmarks, reference rates, and market indices with embedded daily rate observations and index constituent membership records. Covers SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, Fed Funds Rate, LIBOR (legacy), Treasury yield curves, credit spread indices (CDX, iTraxx), and equity indices (S&P 500, MSCI World, Bloomberg Barclays Aggregate). Captures benchmark name, administrator, IOSCO compliance status, publication frequency, currency, tenor, fallback rate provisions (LIBOR transition), and regulatory status. Includes daily published rate observations by tenor (overnight, 1M, 3M, 6M, 12M) with compounded rates, spread adjustments (for LIBOR-SOFR transition), and publication source. For indices, records constituent instruments with inclusion/exclusion dates, weights (market cap, par), rebalancing frequency, and rebalancing events. Supports floating rate coupon resets, swap valuation, FTP curve construction, passive portfolio management, index tracking, ETF basket construction, benchmark attribution, and ALM interest rate risk modeling.

products.name: yield_curve
products.description: Constructed yield curves and their constituent tenor-rate nodes used for instrument valuation, discounting, and risk measurement. Captures curve name, curve type (government, swap, credit spread, OIS), base currency, construction date, construction methodology (bootstrapping, interpolation method), and the complete set of tenor-rate nodes defining the curve shape. Each embedded node includes tenor label (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, 30Y), tenor in days, zero rate, par rate, forward rate, discount factor, and interpolation method applied between nodes. Supports bond pricing, derivative valuation (IRS, CDS), FTP curve construction, IFRS 9 ECL discount rate determination, DV01 sensitivity by tenor bucket, key rate duration analysis, and regulatory stress scenario application across the full term structure.

products.name: yield_curve_node
products.description: Individual tenor-rate data points that constitute a yield curve. attributes.name: yield_curve_node_id

attributes.name: benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.benchmark. Business justification: Yield curve nodes often reference benchmark rates (SOFR, LIBOR, Treasury rates) for rate construction. The existing benchmark_reference (STRING) should be replaced with a proper FK to the benchmark pr

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Each curve node quote is in specific currency for interpolation and rate calculation. Required for multi-currency curve bootstrapping and cross-currency basis swap pricing in rates trading.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Optional identifier linking this node to a regulatory or internal stress testing scenario (e.g., CCAR severely adverse scenario, DFAST baseline scenario). Empty for base case curves.

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent yield curve to which this node belongs. Links to the yield curve master record that defines the curve type, currency, and observation date.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of this yield curve node. Values include draft (initial calculation), pending_review (awaiting validation), approved (ready for use), rejected (failed validation), superseded (replaced by newer version).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this yield curve node was approved for production use. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance and model governance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the market risk analyst, quant, or system that approved this yield curve node for production use. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: bid_rate
attributes.description: The bid side of the market quote for this tenor, representing the rate at which market makers are willing to buy the instrument. Expressed as a decimal. Used for bid-offer spread analysis.

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: The convention used to adjust maturity dates that fall on non-business days (e.g., following, modified following, preceding, unadjusted). Ensures consistency with market settlement practices.

attributes.name: compounding_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which interest is compounded for this rate (e.g., continuous, annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, daily). Affects the conversion between different rate quotation conventions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this yield curve node record was first created in the system. Part of the data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the quality and reliability of this node rate data. Values include verified (directly observed), estimated (model-derived), interpolated (calculated from adjacent nodes), stale (not updated), or missing (no data available).

attributes.name: day_count_convention
attributes.description: The day count convention used to calculate accrued interest and discount factors for this tenor (e.g., ACT/360, ACT/365, 30/360, ACT/ACT). Critical for accurate cash flow calculations.
attributes.references: ISDA Definitions, ICMA (International Capital Market Association) Rules

attributes.name: discount_factor
attributes.description: The present value of one unit of currency to be received at this tenor, calculated as exp(-zero_rate * tenor_years). Used for discounting future cash flows to present value.
attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, IFRS 9 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: dv01
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dollar Value of One Basis Point (DV01)
attributes.description: The sensitivity of the present value of cash flows to a one basis point (0.01%) parallel shift in the yield curve at this tenor. Expressed in base currency units. Used for interest rate risk management and hedging.
attributes.references: Basel III Market Risk Framework, FRTB Sensitivities-Based Approach (SBA)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this yield curve node rate becomes effective for pricing and valuation purposes. Typically the trade date or settlement date for the underlying instruments.

attributes.name: forward_rate
attributes.description: The implied forward interest rate starting at this tenor, derived from the zero curve. Expressed as a decimal. Used for forward rate agreement (FRA) pricing and interest rate derivative valuation.

attributes.name: interpolation_method
attributes.description: The mathematical interpolation technique applied between this node and adjacent nodes to derive rates for non-standard tenors. Common methods include linear, cubic spline, Nelson-Siegel, Svensson, and log-linear interpolation.
attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, Basel III Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this yield curve node is currently active and should be used for pricing and risk calculations. False indicates the node has been superseded or retired.

attributes.name: liquidity_score
attributes.description: A quantitative measure of market liquidity for this tenor, typically ranging from 0 (illiquid) to 100 (highly liquid). Based on factors such as bid-offer spread, trading volume, and market depth.
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), FRTB Liquidity Horizons

attributes.name: market_quote
attributes.description: The raw market-quoted rate for this tenor before any adjustments or transformations. May differ from zero_rate or par_rate depending on quotation convention. Expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, MiFID II Transparency Requirements

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The calendar date corresponding to the maturity of this tenor, calculated as effective_date plus tenor_days, adjusted for business day conventions.

attributes.name: mid_rate
attributes.description: The mid-point between the bid and offer rates, calculated as (bid_rate + offer_rate) / 2. Commonly used for fair value pricing and mark-to-market (MTM) valuation. Expressed as a decimal.
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the valuation model used to generate this node rate. Enables model change tracking and audit trail for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Model Risk Management

attributes.name: node_sequence
attributes.description: The ordinal position of this node within the yield curve, ordered by increasing tenor. Used for curve traversal and interpolation logic.

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this yield curve node rate was observed or calculated. Typically aligned with market close or a specific fixing time (e.g., 4:00 PM London time for LIBOR, SOFR fixing time).
attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, IOSCO Benchmark Principles

attributes.name: offer_rate
attributes.description: The offer (ask) side of the market quote for this tenor, representing the rate at which market makers are willing to sell the instrument. Expressed as a decimal. Used for bid-offer spread analysis.

attributes.name: par_rate
attributes.description: The coupon rate at which a bond with this maturity would trade at par (face value). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50%). Used for pricing coupon-bearing securities.
attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, FRTB (Fundamental Review of the Trading Book)

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: The market data vendor or authoritative source from which this node rate was obtained (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, ICE, CME, Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, internal model). attributes.references: IOSCO Benchmark Principles, MiFID II Market Data Standards

attributes.name: rate_type

attributes.name: shock_magnitude_bps

attributes.name: spread_adjustment
attributes.description: Any credit spread, liquidity premium, or basis adjustment applied to the base rate for this tenor. Expressed in basis points (bps). Used for credit-adjusted discounting and CVA (Credit Valuation Adjustment) calculations.
attributes.references: ISDA CSA (Credit Support Annex), Basel III CVA Framework

attributes.name: tenor_days
attributes.description: The maturity tenor expressed as the number of calendar days from the curve observation date. Used for precise interpolation and duration calculations.

attributes.name: tenor_label
attributes.description: Standard market convention label for the maturity point on the yield curve (e.g., 1M for one month, 3M for three months, 1Y for one year, 10Y for ten years, 30Y for thirty years). attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, Bloomberg Tenor Standards

attributes.name: updated_by

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this yield curve node record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: valuation_model
attributes.description: The quantitative model or methodology used to derive or validate this node rate (e.g., bootstrapping, Nelson-Siegel, cubic spline, Hull-White, Black-Karasinski). Used for model risk management and validation.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Model Risk Management, Basel III Internal Models Approach

attributes.name: zero_rate
attributes.description: The continuously compounded zero-coupon interest rate (spot rate) for this tenor, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0325 for 3.25%). Used for discounting cash flows and pricing zero-coupon instruments.
attributes.references: ISDA Market Conventions, Basel III Market Risk Framework

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system process that created this yield curve node record. Part of the audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: instrument_lifecycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the instrument lifecycle status record.

attributes.name: operational_risk_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.operational_risk_event. SMA capital calculation depends on operational loss d

attributes.name: payment_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Lifecycle event payments (redemptions, calls, defaults) involve currency-specific cash flows. Essential for maturity processing, early redemption calculations, and default recovery processing in credi

attributes.name: primary_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the financial instrument in the instrument master. Links this lifecycle event to the specific security (equity, bond, derivative, MBS, ABS, CDS, CLO, CDO, or OTC instrument).

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lifecycle change was publicly announced by the issuer, exchange, or regulatory authority. May precede the effective date for events like calls or redemptions.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lifecycle status change was approved. Part of the audit trail for regulatory compliance and internal controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the operations or middle office staff member who approved this lifecycle status change. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: Date on which the issuer exercised the call option. Applicable only for callable instruments in the called lifecycle stage.

attributes.name: call_price
attributes.description: Price at which the instrument was called by the issuer, expressed per unit in the denomination currency. Used for portfolio valuation and yield-to-call calculations.

attributes.name: collateral_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the instrument remains eligible as collateral for margin, repo, or securities lending. Typically false for defaulted, suspended, or delisted instruments.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or additional context about the lifecycle event. Used by operations teams for exception handling and audit documentation.

attributes.name: credit_rating_impact_flag

attributes.name: default_date
attributes.description: Date on which the issuer was declared in default. Triggers credit event processing for Credit Default Swaps (CDS), Expected Credit Loss (ECL) recognition, and Non-Performing Loan (NPL) classification.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this lifecycle stage became effective. Used for point-in-time valuation, regulatory reporting of instrument status, and corporate actions processing.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the lifecycle stage change occurred, including time zone. Critical for intraday trading systems, market data feeds, and regulatory trade reporting where exact timing is required.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this lifecycle stage ended and transitioned to the next stage. Null if this is the current active lifecycle stage. Enables temporal queries and historical lifecycle reconstruction.

attributes.name: exchange_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio at which the original instrument is exchanged for the successor instrument in corporate actions. For example, 1.5 means each unit of the original instrument is exchanged for 1.5 units of the successor.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the financial instrument. Pre-issuance indicates the instrument is registered but not yet trading; active indicates normal trading status; suspended indicates temporary halt; called indicates issuer has exercised call option; defaulted indicates issuer has failed to meet obligations; matured indicates instrument has reached maturity date; redeemed indicates early redemption; delisted indicates removal from exchange trading. Level 1 HQLA includes sovereign debt and central bank reserves; Level 2A includes high-quality corporate bonds and covered bonds; Level 2B includes lower-rated corporate bonds and equities; non-HQLA are liquid but not LCR-eligible; illiquid applies to defaulted, suspended, or delisted instruments.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Scheduled maturity date of the instrument. Copied from the instrument master for convenience in lifecycle reporting. Used for duration calculations, yield curve construction, and Asset-Liability Management (ALM).

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Per-unit payment amount for redemption, call, or maturity. Expressed in the instruments denomination currency. Used for portfolio cash flow projections and accrual calculations.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which final payment, redemption proceeds, or maturity value is scheduled to be paid to holders. Applicable for matured, redeemed, or called instruments.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the lifecycle stage change. Issuer call indicates issuer exercised call provision; mandatory redemption indicates contractual redemption event; maturity indicates scheduled maturity date reached; issuer default indicates payment default or covenant breach; regulatory suspension indicates regulator-imposed trading halt; exchange delisting indicates exchange-initiated removal; corporate action indicates merger, acquisition, or spin-off; voluntary redemption indicates optional early redemption; credit event indicates CDS trigger event; restructuring indicates debt restructuring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issuer_call|mandatory_redemption|maturity|issuer_default|regulatory_suspension|exchange_delisting|corporate_action|voluntary_redemption|credit_event|restructuring — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context and details about the lifecycle stage change. May include references to specific contractual provisions, regulatory orders, or corporate action announcements.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle record was first created in the data warehouse. Part of the technical audit trail for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle record was last updated in the data warehouse. Enables change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: recovery_rate
attributes.description: Expected recovery rate for defaulted instruments, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4000 for 40% recovery). Used for Loss Given Default (LGD) calculations, Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisioning under IFRS 9 and CECL, and Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) calculations.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB, IFRS 9, FASB ASC 326 CECL

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the regulatory filing associated with this lifecycle event. May be an SEC Form 8-K filing number, exchange notice number, or other regulatory submission identifier.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this lifecycle event must be reported to regulatory authorities. True for material events like defaults, suspensions, and delistings that trigger FINRA, SEC, or MiFID II reporting obligations.

attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary regulatory jurisdiction for this lifecycle event. Determines which regulatory reporting requirements apply.

attributes.name: risk_weight_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this lifecycle change requires recalculation of Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) for regulatory capital purposes under Basel III. True for defaults, rating changes, or maturity changes that affect risk weighting.
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach, CRR Article 114

attributes.name: settlement_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether existing trades in this instrument can still settle through central clearing. May be false for defaulted or delisted instruments even if trading has ceased.
attributes.references: DTCC Settlement Rules, Euroclear Operating Procedures

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that initiated or recorded this lifecycle status change. Typically the trading system, corporate actions system, or regulatory reporting platform.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this lifecycle record in the source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the originating system of record.

attributes.name: trading_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the instrument remains eligible for trading in this lifecycle stage. False for suspended, defaulted, matured, redeemed, or delisted instruments; true for active and pre-issuance stages.

attributes.name: triggering_event_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier for the event that triggered this lifecycle change. May be a corporate action ID, regulatory filing number, exchange notice number, or credit event determination committee ruling reference.

attributes.name: valuation_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this lifecycle change requires immediate portfolio revaluation. True for events like default, suspension, or delisting that materially affect fair value; false for routine transitions.

products.name: coupon_schedule
products.description: Detailed coupon payment schedule for fixed income instruments defining each periodic interest payment. Captures instrument reference, coupon period number, accrual start date, accrual end date, payment date, coupon rate (fixed or floating reset), day count fraction, projected coupon amount, actual coupon amount (post-reset), payment currency, and payment status (scheduled/paid/missed/deferred). Supports cash flow projection, NII forecasting, ALM gap analysis, and bond analytics (duration, convexity, DV01).
products.reference: Coupon Schedule / Cash Flow Schedule / Payment Schedule

attributes.name: coupon_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the coupon payment schedule entry.

attributes.name: benchmark_id

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Payment date adjustments require calendar reference for accurate settlement date calculation. Essential for cash management, liquidity forecasting, and automated payment processing in securities servi

attributes.name: payment_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Each coupon payment settles in specific currency for cash flow forecasting and FX hedging. Essential for multi-currency bond portfolio cash flow projections and liquidity risk management.

attributes.name: security_instrument_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed income security instrument for which this coupon schedule applies.

attributes.name: accrual_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which interest accrual ends for this coupon period.

attributes.name: accrual_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which interest accrual begins for this coupon period.

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative interest accrued from the accrual start date to the current date or accrual end date, used for Mark-to-Market (MTM) valuation and settlement.

attributes.name: actual_coupon_amount
attributes.description: The actual coupon payment amount after rate reset (for floating rate instruments) or final calculation. Populated after payment determination.

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: The convention used to adjust payment dates that fall on non-business days.

attributes.name: calculation_agent
attributes.description: The entity responsible for calculating the coupon payment amount, typically the issuer or a designated third party.

attributes.name: coupon_period_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the coupon period within the instrument's lifecycle (e.g., 1, 2, 3...).

attributes.name: coupon_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate applicable to this coupon period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%). For floating rate instruments, this is the reset rate for the period.

attributes.name: coupon_type
attributes.description: Classification of the coupon rate structure for this period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this coupon schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: day_count_convention
attributes.description: The day count basis used to calculate the accrued interest for this coupon period.

attributes.name: day_count_fraction
attributes.description: The calculated fraction of the year represented by this coupon period based on the day count convention.

attributes.name: ex_dividend_date
attributes.description: The date on which the security begins trading without the right to receive the upcoming coupon payment.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system process that last modified this coupon schedule record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this coupon schedule record was last updated.

attributes.name: net_coupon_amount
attributes.description: The coupon payment amount after deduction of withholding taxes and any other applicable deductions.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the coupon payment is due to be paid to the security holder.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which coupon payments are made for this instrument.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the coupon payment is delivered to the security holder.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the coupon payment indicating whether it has been paid, is scheduled, or has been missed or deferred.

attributes.name: payment_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the coupon payment was executed. Null if payment has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of the security on which the coupon interest is calculated for this period.

attributes.name: projected_coupon_amount
attributes.description: The estimated coupon payment amount calculated at schedule creation time, used for cash flow projection and Net Interest Income (NII) forecasting.

attributes.name: rate_reset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the floating rate is reset based on the reference rate index. Applicable only to floating rate instruments.

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: The date on which the holder of record is entitled to receive the coupon payment.

attributes.name: reference_rate_value
attributes.description: The observed value of the reference rate index on the rate reset date, used to calculate the floating coupon rate.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which this coupon schedule record originated (e.g., Murex, Calypso, SimCorp Dimension).

attributes.name: source_system_identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this coupon schedule entry in the source system.

attributes.name: spread_bps
attributes.description: The fixed spread in basis points (BPS) added to the reference rate for floating rate instruments (e.g., SOFR + 150 bps).

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax rate applied to the coupon payment for withholding tax purposes, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15%).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system process that created this coupon schedule record.

products.name: index_constituent

Supports passive portfolio management, index tracking, benchmark attribution, and ETF creation/redemption basket construction.

attributes.name: instrument_id

attributes.name: benchmark_eligible_flag

attributes.name: capping_factor

attributes.name: constituent_status

attributes.name: country_classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: etf_creation_basket_flag

attributes.name: inclusion_date

attributes.name: index_code

attributes.name: index_divisor_impact

attributes.name: index_family

attributes.name: index_provider

attributes.name: index_type

attributes.name: index_weight

attributes.name: industry_classification

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_verified_date

attributes.name: liquidity_score

products.name: security_watchlist
products.description: Regulatory and internal investment restriction watchlists applied to securities and issuers including OFAC/SDN sanctioned securities, restricted securities lists (insider trading restrictions), investment policy exclusion lists (ESG screens, sector exclusions), and regulatory restricted lists (MiFID II product governance, SFDR Article 6/8/9 classification). Captures list type, instrument or issuer reference, restriction reason, restriction level (hard block/soft alert), effective date, expiry date, approving authority, and the regulatory or internal authority that imposed the restriction. Consumed by trade, investment, and wealth domains for pre-trade and post-trade compliance checking, best execution monitoring, and suitability assessment.

products.name: instrument_relationship
products.description: Cross-reference records defining relationships between financial instruments such as convertible bond to underlying equity, ADR/GDR to ordinary share, warrant to underlying, ETF to underlying basket, and derivative to underlier. Captures relationship type, source instrument, target instrument, conversion ratio, effective date, and expiry date. Supports corporate actions propagation, risk aggregation across related instruments, and regulatory look-through requirements (MiFID II, FRTB).

attributes.name: instrument_relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the instrument relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: source_instrument_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the source financial instrument in the relationship. For example, the convertible bond in a convertible-to-equity relationship, or the ADR in an ADR-to-ordinary-share relationship.

attributes.name: target_instrument_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the target financial instrument in the relationship. For example, the underlying equity in a convertible-to-equity relationship, or the ordinary share underlying an ADR.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, explanations, or context regarding the instrument relationship. Used to capture special conditions, exceptions, or clarifications.

attributes.name: conversion_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the conversion price is denominated.

attributes.name: conversion_price
attributes.description: Price at which the source instrument can be converted into the target instrument. Applicable for convertible bonds, warrants, and similar instruments with conversion features.

attributes.name: conversion_ratio
attributes.description: Numeric ratio defining the conversion or exchange rate between the source and target instruments. For example, the number of ordinary shares received per convertible bond, or the ratio of ADR to underlying ordinary shares. Expressed as a decimal value.

attributes.name: corporate_action_propagation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corporate actions on the target instrument should be propagated to the source instrument. True if propagation is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this instrument relationship record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the quality and completeness of the instrument relationship data, typically on a scale of 0 to 100. Higher scores indicate higher data quality and confidence.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the instrument relationship becomes effective and valid for use in corporate actions propagation, risk aggregation, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: exercise_style
attributes.description: Exercise style of the conversion or exercise right. American style allows exercise at any time before expiry, European style allows exercise only at expiry, and Bermudan style allows exercise on specific dates.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the instrument relationship expires or ceases to be valid. Nullable for relationships without a defined expiration such as perpetual ADR structures.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this instrument relationship record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this instrument relationship record was last updated or modified. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the instrument relationship data was last verified or validated by a data steward, reference data team, or automated quality process.

attributes.name: look_through_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether regulatory look-through to the underlying instrument is required for transparency and reporting purposes under MiFID II, FRTB, or other regulatory frameworks. True if look-through is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: mandatory_voluntary_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion or exercise of the relationship is mandatory (automatic) or voluntary (at the holders discretion).

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: Notional principal amount of the relationship, applicable for derivative-to-underlier relationships where the notional defines the scale of exposure to the underlying instrument.

attributes.name: notional_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the notional amount is denominated.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this instrument relationship must be reported to regulatory authorities for transparency, systemic risk monitoring, or compliance purposes. True if reporting is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: relationship_direction
attributes.description: Directionality of the instrument relationship. Source-to-target indicates a one-way relationship from source to target, target-to-source indicates the reverse, and bidirectional indicates a two-way relationship.

attributes.name: relationship_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this relationship when multiple relationships exist for the same source instrument. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to determine which relationship to apply in corporate actions and risk calculations.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the instrument relationship. Indicates whether the relationship is currently active, inactive, pending activation, expired, terminated, or temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship between the source and target instruments. attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction

attributes.name: risk_aggregation_flag

products.name: instrument_channel_availability
products.description: This association product represents the distribution configuration between financial instruments and banking channels. It captures the operational rules, limits, fees, and compliance requirements that govern how specific instruments can be traded or accessed through specific channels. Each record links one instrument to one channel with channel-specific transaction limits, fee schedules, KYC requirements, authentication methods, and customer segment restrictions that exist only in the context of this instrument-channel combination. This is essential for MiFID II distribution strategy compliance, omnichannel orchestration, and operational risk management.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, financial instruments are distributed through multiple channels (branch, digital, relationship manager, ATM) with channel-specific operational rules, and each channel offers many instruments. The bank actively manages instrument-channel availability as a distribution strategy, configuring transaction limits, fees, KYC requirements, and customer segment restrictions for each instrument-channel combination. This is an operational business process (not analytical correlation) where relationship managers, product managers, and compliance teams create, update, and monitor these availability configurations.

attributes.name: instrument_channel_availability_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Channel Availability - Instrument Channel Availability Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the instrument_channel_availability association

attributes.name: banking_channel_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Instrument Channel Availability - Banking Channel Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the banking channel through which the instrument is distributed

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the financial instrument being made available through the channel

attributes.name: authentication_method_required
attributes.description: Specific authentication method(s) required for this instrument-channel combination. May be more stringent than the channel's default authentication for high-value or high-risk instruments.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the instrument's availability through this specific channel. Controls whether new transactions can be initiated.

attributes.name: channel_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed or base fee amount charged for transacting this instrument through this channel. May be null if fee_schedule_code references a complex fee structure.

attributes.name: customer_segment_restriction

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this instrument became available through this channel. Supports temporal queries for distribution history and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the fee schedule that applies to transactions of this instrument through this channel. Different instrument-channel combinations may have different fee structures.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction
attributes.description: Geographic restrictions specific to this instrument-channel combination (e.g., country codes where this instrument cannot be distributed through this channel due to regulatory constraints).

attributes.name: kyc_requirement_level
attributes.description: Level of Know Your Customer verification required to transact this instrument through this channel. High-risk instruments may require enhanced KYC even through channels that normally support basic KYC.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this instrument was or will be removed from this channel. Null if currently active with no planned termination.

attributes.name: transaction_limit_daily
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate transaction amount allowed per customer per day for this instrument through this channel. Overrides the channel's default daily limit for this specific instrument.

attributes.name: transaction_limit_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum single transaction amount allowed for this instrument through this channel. Instrument-channel specific limit that may differ from channel default.

products.name: security_holding
products.description: This association product represents the ownership position between a financial instrument and a legal entity within the banking group. It captures the quantity, value, and regulatory treatment of each instrument held by each legal entity. Each record links one instrument to one legal entity with attributes that exist only in the context of this holding relationship, supporting Basel III consolidation, entity-level risk reporting, and regulatory capital calculations.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, a single financial instrument (e.g., US Treasury bond, Apple equity) is routinely held across multiple legal entities within the group for regulatory capital optimization, client segregation, and risk diversification. Conversely, each legal entity maintains a portfolio of many different instruments. The business actively manages these holdings as distinct positions with entity-specific attributes like holding classification (trading vs banking book), cost basis, acquisition date, and regulatory capital treatment that cannot reside on either the instrument or legal entity master records alone.

attributes.name: security_holding_id
attributes.description: Primary key for security_holding

attributes.name: holding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this instrument holding position. Primary key.

attributes.name: instrument_id

attributes.name: legal_entity_id

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal entity acquired this position in the instrument. Used for holding period calculations and tax lot tracking.

attributes.name: capital_charge

attributes.name: classification

attributes.name: cost_basis

products.name: instrument_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the eligibility relationship between financial instruments and collateral eligibility rules. It captures which instruments satisfy which eligibility criteria for use as collateral across different arrangements (CSA, repo, secured lending, CCP). Each record links one instrument to one eligibility rule with rule-specific haircuts, concentration limits, margin type eligibility, and effective/expiry dates that exist only in the context of this specific instrument-rule pairing.. Existence Justification: In banking collateral management, a single financial instrument can satisfy multiple eligibility rules simultaneously (e.g., a US Treasury bond may be HQLA Level 1 eligible, CCP-eligible, bilateral CSA-eligible, and repo-eligible), and each eligibility rule applies to many instruments that meet its criteria. The collateral optimization engine actively manages these instrument-rule pairings to determine eligible collateral pools, enforce concentration limits, and optimize collateral allocation across arrangements. This is an operational relationship that humans and systems create, evaluate, and update as part of collateral management business processes.

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_id

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the financial instrument being evaluated for collateral eligibility

attributes.name: concentration_limit_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of total collateral portfolio that can be allocated to this instrument under this rule. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this instrument becomes eligible under this specific rule. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: eligibility_status

attributes.name: eligible_for_initial_margin

attributes.name: eligible_for_variation_margin
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this instrument is eligible to satisfy variation margin requirements under this specific rule. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: haircut_percentage
attributes.description: Valuation discount percentage applied to this instrument when used as collateral under this specific rule. Can vary by instrument-rule combination. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: last_evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when this instrument was last evaluated against this eligibility rule by the collateral optimization engine.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this instrument-eligibility relationship record.

products.name: instrument_haircut_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the application of specific haircut schedules to individual financial instruments for collateral valuation and margin calculation purposes. It captures the effective haircut parameters that apply to each instrument under different regulatory frameworks, transaction types, and counterparty arrangements. Each record links one instrument to one haircut schedule with effective dates and the specific haircut percentages and methodologies that govern how that instrument's value is reduced for credit risk mitigation and regulatory capital calculations.. Existence Justification: In banking collateral operations, a single financial instrument can simultaneously be subject to multiple haircut schedules depending on the regulatory framework (Basel III supervisory vs. internal models), transaction type (bilateral CSA vs. CCP-cleared), and counterparty arrangement. Conversely, each haircut schedule applies to many instruments based on their asset class, credit quality, and maturity characteristics. The business actively manages these applicability mappings as regulatory frameworks evolve, instrument characteristics change, and new collateral agreements are negotiated.

attributes.description: Primary key for the instrument_haircut_applicability association

attributes.name: haircut_schedule_id

attributes.name: applicable_supervisory_haircut_pct

attributes.name: holding_period_days
attributes.description: The assumed liquidation period for this specific instrument under this haircut schedule. While the schedule provides default holding periods, specific instruments may have adjusted periods based on liquidity characteristics or counterparty agreements.

attributes.name: override_reason

attributes.name: volatility_adjustment_method

products.name: liquidity_holding
products.description: This association product represents the operational holding of financial instruments within liquidity positions for regulatory liquidity coverage and net stable funding calculations. It captures the specific contribution of each instrument to each liquidity position snapshot, including market value, regulatory haircuts, HQLA classification, and encumbrance status. Each record links one instrument to one liquidity position with attributes that exist only in the context of this holding relationship, supporting Basel III LCR/NSFR reporting and ALCO liquidity monitoring.. Existence Justification: In banking treasury operations, liquidity positions aggregate holdings across multiple financial instruments (government bonds, corporate bonds, equities, money market instruments) to calculate regulatory liquidity ratios (LCR/NSFR) and monitor available liquid assets. Each instrument contributes to multiple liquidity position snapshots over time (daily end-of-day positions, intraday snapshots, different scenario types, different tenor buckets, different currencies). The business actively manages these holdings with instrument-specific data including regulatory haircuts, HQLA classification, encumbrance status, and market values that exist only in the context of each position snapshot.

attributes.name: liquidity_holding_id

attributes.name: liquidity_position_id

attributes.name: custodian_account

attributes.name: encumbrance_status

attributes.name: fx_rate_to_position_currency
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate used to convert holding currency to position currency for aggregation. 1.0 if currencies match.

attributes.name: haircut_percentage
attributes.description: Regulatory haircut percentage applied to this instrument for LCR calculation based on HQLA classification. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15% haircut). Varies by asset class, credit quality, and maturity.

attributes.name: holding_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code for this holding. May differ from position currency if FX conversion applied.

attributes.name: holding_status
attributes.description: Operational status of this holding in the liquidity position: active (included in calculations), pending settlement, restricted (excluded from available liquidity), or excluded (not counted).

attributes.name: hqla_value

attributes.name: market_value

attributes.name: maturity_bucket

attributes.name: nsfr_asf_factor

attributes.name: nsfr_rsf_factor

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: valuation_source
