attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.risk_limit. Business justification: Market risk positions are monitored against VaR limits, position limits, and concentration limits. The market_risk_position table has var_1d_99, var_10d_99, and notional_amount but no reference to the

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: Market risk positions are stressed under defined scenarios for FRTB and IRRBB (Interest Rate Risk in Banking Book). The market_risk_position table has irrbb_scenario field which should be replaced by

attributes.name: trading_book_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading desk or business unit responsible for this position. Under FRTB, trading desks are the primary unit for IMA approval and P&L attribution testing.
attributes.references: FRTB BCBS d352 — Trading Desk Definition

attributes.name: valuation_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.valuation_model. Business justification: Market risk positions require valuation models to calculate mark-to-market (MTM) values. The market_risk_position table has mtm_value, which is produced by applying a valuation model to the instrument

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Broad asset class classification of the instrument (e.g., equity, interest_rate, credit, fx, commodity, securitisation). Drives risk factor assignment, sensitivity bucketing, and capital charge calculation under FRTB SA and IMA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equity|interest_rate|credit|fx|commodity|securitisation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Risk Factor Classification; ISDA taxonomy

attributes.name: book_type
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the position as either trading book (subject to market risk capital under FRTB) or banking book (subject to IRRBB framework). Determines applicable capital treatment and risk measurement methodology.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Trading/Banking Book Boundary; BCBS IRRBB d368

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk position record was first captured in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cs01
attributes.description: Credit Spread sensitivity — the change in MTM value for a 1 basis point widening in the credit spread of the underlying issuer or reference entity. Key measure for credit risk management and FRTB CSR (Credit Spread Risk) capital charge.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Credit Spread Risk (CSR); ISDA SIMM

attributes.name: cva_charge
attributes.description: Credit Valuation Adjustment representing the market value of counterparty default risk embedded in OTC derivative positions. Reflects the expected loss due to counterparty credit deterioration or default. Required under Basel III CVA framework.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III CVA Framework d325; IFRS 13; CRR2 Article 381

attributes.name: delta
attributes.description: First-order sensitivity of the position's MTM value to a unit change in the underlying risk factor price (e.g., equity price, FX spot rate, commodity price). Used for delta hedging and FRTB SA delta risk charge calculation.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Delta Risk; ISDA SIMM Methodology

attributes.name: dv01
attributes.description: Dollar Value of a 01 (one basis point) shift in interest rates — the change in MTM value for a 1 basis point (0.01%) parallel upward shift in the yield curve. Primary interest rate sensitivity measure used for hedging and risk limit monitoring.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Delta Sensitivity; ALCO Risk Reporting Standard

attributes.name: eve_sensitivity
attributes.description: Sensitivity of the Economic Value of Equity to standardised interest rate shock scenarios under IRRBB. Measures the long-term impact of rate changes on the present value of banking book assets and liabilities. Used in IRRBB supervisory outlier test.
attributes.references: BCBS IRRBB d368 — EVE; EBA IRRBB Guidelines; PRA SS31/15

attributes.name: expected_shortfall
attributes.description: Expected Shortfall (Conditional VaR) at 97.5% confidence level as required under FRTB IMA. Measures the average loss in the worst 2.5% of scenarios, replacing VaR as the primary IMA risk measure under FRTB.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — IMA Expected Shortfall; FRTB Article 325bb

attributes.name: frtb_approach
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) Approach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FRTB capital charge for this position is computed under the Internal Models Approach (IMA), Standardised Approach (SA), or IMA with SA fallback for non-modellable risk factors (NMRFs).
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — IMA vs SA Boundary

attributes.name: frtb_capital_charge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) Capital Charge
attributes.description: Total FRTB market risk capital charge for this position, representing the higher of the IMA (Internal Models Approach) or SA (Standardised Approach) capital requirement as applicable. Reported to regulators under FRTB framework.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352; CRR2 Article 325; Fed FRTB NPR

attributes.name: gamma
attributes.description: Second-order (curvature) sensitivity of the position's MTM value to changes in the underlying risk factor. Captures non-linear risk for options and structured products. Used in FRTB SA curvature risk charge calculation.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Curvature Risk; ISDA SIMM

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Accounting hedge designation for the position under IFRS 9 or ASC 815. Determines whether hedge accounting is applied and the treatment of fair value changes in OCI vs P&L. Relevant for banking book hedges of interest rate and FX risk.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Chapter 6 — Hedge Accounting; ASC 815; BCBS IRRBB d368

attributes.name: hypothetical_pnl
attributes.description: Hypothetical P&L computed by revaluing the prior day's portfolio using current day's market prices, holding positions constant. Used in VaR backtesting and FRTB IMA P&L attribution test to validate risk model accuracy.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — P&L Attribution Test (PLAT); Basel 2.5 Backtesting

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Specific instrument type classification (e.g., bond, equity, interest_rate_swap, fx_forward, credit_default_swap, option, futures, mortgage_backed_security). Used for product-level risk aggregation and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bond|equity|interest_rate_swap|fx_forward|credit_default_swap|option|futures|mortgage_backed_security|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 10962 CFI; ISDA Product Taxonomy; FRTB BCBS d352

attributes.name: irc_charge
attributes.description: Incremental Risk Charge capturing default and migration risk for credit-sensitive positions in the trading book over a one-year capital horizon at 99.9% confidence. Applicable to non-securitisation credit positions under Basel 2.5.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel 2.5 — Incremental Risk Charge; CRR Article 372

attributes.name: is_modellable_risk_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary risk factor for this position passes the FRTB Risk Factor Eligibility Test (RFET) and is classified as modellable. Non-modellable risk factors (NMRFs) attract a separate stress scenario capital add-on under FRTB IMA.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Risk Factor Eligibility Test (RFET)

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The contractual maturity or expiry date of the instrument underlying this position. Used for repricing gap bucketing, duration calculation, and IRRBB cash flow mapping.
attributes.references: BCBS IRRBB d368; FRTB BCBS d352; IFRS 9

attributes.name: mtm_value
attributes.description: Current mark-to-market fair value of the position in the reporting currency as of the position date. Represents the present value of future cash flows discounted at current market rates. Core input for P&L attribution and capital calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement; BCBS FRTB d352; ASC 820

attributes.name: nii_sensitivity
attributes.description: Sensitivity of Net Interest Income to a standardised interest rate shock scenario (e.g., +200bps parallel shift). Applicable to banking book positions under IRRBB framework. Measures short-term earnings impact of rate changes.
attributes.references: BCBS IRRBB d368; EBA IRRBB Guidelines EBA/GL/2018/02

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: The face value or contractual notional amount of the position in the instrument's native currency. For derivatives, this is the reference principal used to compute cash flows and risk sensitivities.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352; ISDA Master Agreement

attributes.name: pnl_daily
attributes.description: Daily P&L for the position representing the change in MTM value from the prior business day. Used for P&L attribution analysis, backtesting of VaR models, and FRTB IMA P&L attribution test (PLAT) compliance.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — P&L Attribution Test; IFRS 9

attributes.name: position_date
attributes.description: The business date (valuation date) for which this risk position snapshot is captured. Represents the as-of date for all MTM values, sensitivities, and risk measures on this record.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352; IRRBB BCBS d368

attributes.name: position_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the risk position as assigned by the source trading or risk system (e.g., Murex position ID or Calypso deal reference). Used for reconciliation with the system of record.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the risk position indicating whether it is actively open, closed out, suspended pending review, awaiting settlement, or cancelled.
attributes.references: FRTB (Fundamental Review of the Trading Book) — BCBS d352

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the base reporting currency (typically USD or EUR) into which all MTM values and risk measures are translated for regulatory and management reporting.

attributes.name: repricing_bucket
attributes.description: Time bucket classification for the repricing gap analysis (e.g., overnight, 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 5Y, 10Y+). Indicates when the position's interest rate resets or matures, driving IRRBB gap analysis and NII sensitivity computation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overnight|1M|3M|6M|1Y|2Y|5Y|10Y_plus — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BCBS IRRBB d368; EBA IRRBB Guidelines EBA/GL/2018/02

attributes.name: repricing_gap
attributes.description: The net difference between rate-sensitive assets and rate-sensitive liabilities repricing within a given time bucket. Used in IRRBB repricing gap analysis to identify mismatches that create NII at risk. Applicable to banking book positions.
attributes.references: BCBS IRRBB d368 — Repricing Gap Analysis; ALCO Reporting Standard

attributes.name: rwa_market_risk
attributes.description: Risk-Weighted Assets attributable to market risk for this position, computed as the capital charge multiplied by 12.5 (reciprocal of the 8% minimum capital ratio). Used in CET1 ratio and CCAR/DFAST capital adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III; CRR Article 92; CCAR/DFAST Fed Guidance

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this risk position was sourced (e.g., MUREX for trading book positions, SAS_RISK for risk aggregations, AXIOMSL for regulatory submissions). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: stressed_var
attributes.description: Stressed VaR computed using a continuous 12-month historical stress period calibrated to significant financial stress (e.g., 2008 financial crisis). Required under Basel 2.5 and used as a multiplier component in market risk capital calculation.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel 2.5 — Stressed VaR; CRR Article 365

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk position record, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: var_10d_99
attributes.description: Ten-day Value at Risk at 99% confidence level, scaled from the 1-day VaR using the square-root-of-time rule or direct simulation. Used for regulatory capital calculation under Basel 2.5 market risk framework.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel 2.5 Market Risk Amendment; CRR Article 365

attributes.name: var_1d_99
attributes.description: One-day Value at Risk at 99% confidence level computed using historical simulation methodology. Represents the maximum expected loss over a one-day horizon with 99% probability. Primary regulatory VaR metric under Basel 2.5 and FRTB IMA.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel 2.5; FRTB BCBS d352 IMA; Fed SR 11-7

attributes.name: vega
attributes.description: Sensitivity of the position's MTM value to a 1% change in implied volatility of the underlying. Applicable to options and volatility-sensitive instruments. Used in FRTB SA vega risk charge calculation.
attributes.references: BCBS FRTB d352 — Vega Risk; ISDA SIMM Methodology

products.name: risk_ecl_provision
products.description: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisioning and credit quality classification record under IFRS 9 and CECL frameworks. For ECL calculation: captures stage classification (Stage 1/2/3), 12-month ECL, lifetime ECL, PD term structure, LGD estimates, EAD, discount rate, forward-looking macroeconomic overlays, and provision movement. For NPL classification: captures NPL stage (substandard, doubtful, loss), days past due, forbearance flag, cure status, write-off amount, recovery expectation, EBA NPL definition compliance, and NPL ratio reporting. Supports regulatory reporting to FASB, IASB, OCC, EBA, and prudential regulators. Primary output for credit risk provisioning and impairment reporting.

attributes.name: risk_ecl_provision_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Provision Record ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ECL provisioning and credit quality classification record in the risk domain. Primary key for the risk_ecl_provision data product.

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_case. Business justification: AML investigations uncover fraud patterns or credit deterioration requiring ECL provision adjustments. Banks provision for losses identified through AML case investigations, supporting IFRS 9/CECL com

attributes.name: collateral_pledge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.pledge. Business justification: IFRS9/CECL ECL calculations require collateral coverage assessment. LGD estimates depend on pledged collateral value, haircuts, and enforceability. Essential for Stage 2/3 provision calculations and r

attributes.name: counterparty_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.counterparty_rating. Business justification: ECL provisions use PD/LGD estimates from counterparty ratings. The risk_ecl_provision table has internal_credit_rating, external_credit_rating, rating_agency fields which duplicate data from counterpa

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the provision amount, EAD, and ECL figures are denominated. Supports multi-currency provisioning and FX translation for consolidated reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, IFRS 9, FASB ASC 830 (Foreign Currency Matters)

attributes.name: ftp_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.ftp_allocation. Business justification: ECL provisions adjust FTP allocations for credit risk pricing in RAROC framework. Treasury FTP rates incorporate expected credit loss adjustments from risk ECL calculations to ensure risk-adjusted pro

attributes.name: irb_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.irb_model. Business justification: ECL provisions calculate PD, LGD, and EAD estimates using IRB model parameters. The risk_ecl_provision table has pd_12month, pd_lifetime, and lgd_estimate attributes that are derived from IRB model ou

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: IFRS 9/CECL ECL provisions must be posted to the general ledger via journal entries to recognize credit loss provisions in financial statements. Critical for financial reporting accuracy and audit tra

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying loan or credit facility for which the ECL provision is calculated. Links to the loan master record in the Core Banking System (Temenos T24 / FIS Profile) or Loan Origination System (Finastra Fusion Loan IQ).

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the borrower or counterparty customer record associated with this ECL provision. Enables customer-level aggregation of credit risk exposure and provision balances.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: ECL provisions are calculated under multiple macroeconomic scenarios (base, upside, downside) per IFRS 9 requirements. The risk_ecl_provision table has macro_scenario_type field which should be replac

attributes.name: cecl_pool_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) Pool Classification
attributes.description: FASB ASC 326 (CECL) pool or segment classification used for collective assessment of expected credit losses. Identifies the homogeneous risk pool to which the instrument is assigned for CECL measurement purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial_real_estate|commercial_industrial|consumer_mortgage|consumer_auto|consumer_unsecured|credit_card|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: collateral_value
attributes.description: Current market or appraised value of collateral securing the credit exposure as of the reporting date. Used in LGD estimation and LTV calculation. Relevant for secured lending provisions and NPL recovery analysis.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB paragraph 468, IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.29, OCC Comptrollers Handbook — Collateral

attributes.name: collective_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ECL provision was calculated on a collective (pooled) basis rather than an individual (specific) basis. Collective assessment is applied when individual assessment is not practicable, typically for homogeneous retail portfolios.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.1, FASB ASC 326-20-30-2, OCC Bulletin 2020-49

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ECL provision record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, BCBS BCBS239 (RDARR), GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: cure_status
attributes.description: Indicates the cure or exit status of a previously defaulted or forborne exposure. Tracks whether the borrower has exited NPL/forbearance status, is in the probation period, has been fully cured, or has re-defaulted.
attributes.references: EBA NPL Guidelines EBA/GL/2018/06, IFRS 9 paragraph 5.5.11

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the credit obligation is past its contractual due date as of the reporting date. Key trigger for stage migration (>30 DPD for Stage 2, >90 DPD for Stage 3 / NPL under EBA definition) and NPL classification.
attributes.references: EBA NPL Definition EBA/GL/2016/07, BCBS Basel III paragraph 452, OCC Loan Classification

attributes.name: default_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the obligor is in default as defined under Basel III IRB framework (>90 DPD or unlikely-to-pay criteria). Triggers Stage 3 classification under IFRS 9 and NPL status under EBA definition.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB paragraph 452, IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.37, EBA NPL Guidelines

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The effective interest rate used to discount future expected credit loss cash flows to present value as of the reporting date. Per IFRS 9, this is the original effective interest rate (or credit-adjusted EIR for POCI assets).

attributes.name: ead_amount
attributes.description: Estimated gross exposure of the credit facility at the point of default, expressed in the instrument currency. Represents the outstanding balance plus expected drawdowns on undrawn commitments used as the base for ECL calculation.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB paragraph 474, IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.29, BCBS d424

attributes.name: ecl_12month_amount
attributes.description: Calculated 12-month ECL provision amount representing the probability-weighted credit loss from default events expected within 12 months of the reporting date. Applied to Stage 1 exposures. Computed as PD_12month × LGD × EAD discounted at the effective interest rate.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph 5.5.5, FASB ASC 326-20-30, OCC Bulletin 2020-49

attributes.name: ecl_lifetime_amount
attributes.description: Calculated lifetime ECL provision amount representing the probability-weighted credit loss over the remaining life of the instrument. Applied to Stage 2 and Stage 3 exposures under IFRS 9 and all exposures under CECL.

attributes.name: forbearance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit exposure has been subject to forbearance measures (concessions granted to a borrower experiencing financial difficulty). Forbearance status affects stage classification and NPL reporting under EBA guidelines.
attributes.references: EBA Forbearance Guidelines EBA/GL/2018/06, IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.26

attributes.name: ifrs9_stage
attributes.description: IFRS 9 credit impairment stage classification: Stage 1 (performing, 12-month ECL), Stage 2 (significant increase in credit risk, lifetime ECL), Stage 3 (credit-impaired, lifetime ECL). Drives the ECL measurement horizon and provision methodology.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraphs 5.5.3–5.5.5, EBA Guidelines on credit risk management EBA/GL/2017/06

attributes.name: lgd_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated proportion of the EAD that would be lost in the event of default, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%). Reflects collateral coverage, seniority, and recovery expectations. Key input to ECL and IRB RWA calculation.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB paragraph 468, IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.29, BCBS d424

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the outstanding loan balance to the current collateral value, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 = 75% LTV). Key risk indicator for secured lending provisions, particularly mortgage portfolios. Influences LGD and stage classification.
attributes.references: Basel III CRR Article 124, OCC Comptrollers Handbook — Real Estate Lending, BCBS d424

attributes.name: macro_overlay_factor
attributes.description: Forward-looking macroeconomic adjustment factor applied to the base ECL model output to incorporate point-in-time economic conditions (e.g., GDP growth, unemployment rate, house price index scenarios). Reflects IFRS 9 requirement for unbiased, probability-weighted forward-looking information.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraphs 5.5.17, B5.5.49–B5.5.54, EBA Guidelines EBA/GL/2020/06

attributes.name: macro_scenario_weight
attributes.description: Probability weight assigned to the macroeconomic scenario (base, upside, downside) used in the probability-weighted ECL calculation. The sum of scenario weights across all scenarios for a given exposure must equal 1.0.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.41, EBA Guidelines EBA/GL/2020/06, CCAR/DFAST scenario framework

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual maturity date of the credit instrument. Determines the remaining life used in lifetime ECL calculation and the PD term structure horizon for Stage 2 and Stage 3 provisions.

attributes.name: npl_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory asset quality classification of the credit exposure per OCC and EBA NPL frameworks: performing, watch list, substandard, doubtful, or loss. Drives regulatory capital and provisioning requirements under the standardized approach.
attributes.references: OCC Comptrollers Handbook — Loan Classification, EBA NPL Guidelines EBA/GL/2018/06, Basel III SA

attributes.name: npl_entry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit exposure was first classified as non-performing under the EBA NPL definition. Used for NPL vintage analysis, cure period tracking, and EBA NPL ratio reporting.
attributes.references: EBA NPL Guidelines EBA/GL/2016/07, EBA NPL Transaction Templates

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit facility was originally originated or the financial instrument was initially recognized. Used to determine the initial recognition PD for SICR assessment and POCI identification under IFRS 9.

attributes.name: pd_12month
attributes.description: Estimated probability that the obligor will default within the next 12 months, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.00250 = 0.25%). Used for Stage 1 ECL calculation and IRB capital requirement computation.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB paragraph 461, IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.28, BCBS d424

attributes.name: pd_lifetime
attributes.description: Estimated probability that the obligor will default over the remaining contractual life of the instrument. Used for Stage 2 and Stage 3 lifetime ECL calculation under IFRS 9.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraphs 5.5.3, B5.5.28, EBA Guidelines EBA/GL/2017/06

attributes.name: poci_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the financial instrument was purchased or originated as credit-impaired (POCI). POCI assets use a credit-adjusted effective interest rate and lifetime ECL from initial recognition under IFRS 9.

attributes.name: portfolio_segment
attributes.description: High-level portfolio segment classification of the credit exposure for ECL modeling and regulatory reporting purposes. Determines the applicable IRB sub-model (retail, corporate, sovereign, etc.) and CECL pool assignment.
attributes.references: Basel III IRB paragraphs 231–234, IFRS 9, FASB ASC 326-20-30-2

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of credit product or financial instrument to which the ECL provision relates (e.g., term loan, revolving credit facility, mortgage, trade finance, overdraft, bond). Determines the applicable ECL methodology and regulatory treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_loan|revolving_credit|mortgage|trade_finance|overdraft|bond|guarantee|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 9, FASB ASC 326, Basel III CRR

attributes.name: provision_amount
attributes.description: The recognized ECL provision balance recorded on the balance sheet as of the reporting date. Equals ecl_12month_amount for Stage 1 or ecl_lifetime_amount for Stage 2/3. This is the gross provision before any write-offs.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph 5.5.1, FASB ASC 326-20-35, IASB ED/2013/3

attributes.name: provision_movement_amount
attributes.description: Net change in the provision balance during the reporting period (current period provision minus prior period provision). Positive values indicate an increase (charge to P&L); negative values indicate a release (credit to P&L). Used for income statement impairment charge reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph 5.5.8, FASB ASC 326-20-35-8, IASB ED/2013/3

attributes.name: provision_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ECL provision record, used for cross-system reconciliation and regulatory reporting. Typically sourced from the Risk Management Platform (SAS Risk Management / Moodys RiskAuthority).

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ECL provision record. Indicates whether the provision is active, has been reversed upon cure, transferred to another stage, written off, or is under review.

attributes.name: recovery_expectation_amount
attributes.description: Estimated amount expected to be recovered from a written-off or defaulted exposure through collateral realization, guarantees, or workout proceedings. Informs the net LGD estimate and provision adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph B5.5.29, Basel III IRB paragraph 468, OCC Comptrollers Handbook

attributes.name: reporting_date
attributes.description: The balance sheet or reporting reference date as of which the ECL provision is measured and staged. Represents the principal business event date for this record, used for period-end regulatory and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph 5.5.3, FASB ASC 326-20-30, OCC Bulletin 2020-49

attributes.name: sicr_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Significant Increase in Credit Risk (SICR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a significant increase in credit risk has been identified for this exposure since initial recognition, triggering migration from Stage 1 to Stage 2 under IFRS 9. Based on quantitative and qualitative SICR criteria.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraphs 5.5.3, 5.5.9–5.5.11, B5.5.1–B5.5.22, EBA Guidelines EBA/GL/2017/06

attributes.name: stage_migration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IFRS 9 stage migration occurred (e.g., Stage 1 to Stage 2, Stage 2 to Stage 3, or back-migration). Supports stage migration analysis, provision volatility monitoring, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ECL provision record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, BCBS BCBS239 (RDARR), GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of the credit exposure that has been written off against the provision balance, reducing both the gross loan balance and the provision. Triggered when there is no reasonable expectation of recovery.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 paragraph 5.4.4, FASB ASC 326-20-35-8, OCC Loan Classification

products.name: irb_model
products.description: Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) model master record and parameter repository for credit risk estimation. Captures model identifier, model type (PD/LGD/EAD/CCF), asset class, regulatory approval status, validation cycle, discriminatory power metrics (Gini, AUC), calibration metadata, and override history. For PD models, includes term structure data: point-in-time and through-the-cycle PD estimates by rating grade and time horizon, cumulative and marginal PDs, and macroeconomic conditioning variables. Supports Basel III IRB approval documentation, model governance under SR 11-7, and provides core inputs to ECL provisioning and RWA calculation.
products.reference: IRB Model / Basel III Internal Ratings-Based Approach

attributes.name: irb_model_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the IRB model record in the risk data platform. Primary key for the irb_model entity. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Basel III IRB Framework; SR 11-7 Model Risk Management

attributes.name: compliance_sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: IRB models used for allowance estimation (CECL/IFRS 9) are subject to SOX controls over model governance, change management, and access controls. Banks link models to SOX controls for audit evidence a

attributes.name: irb_developer_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the team or individual who developed the IRB model. Supports model governance documentation, audit trail, and SR 11-7 accountability requirements.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance

attributes.name: primary_irb_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the business unit or individual designated as the model owner responsible for model performance, ongoing monitoring, and remediation of findings. Aligns with SR 11-7 model ownership accountability requirements.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Regulatory asset class to which the IRB model applies, as defined under Basel III (e.g., Corporate, Retail — Residential Mortgage, Retail — Qualifying Revolving, SME, Sovereign, Bank, Specialised Lending). Determines applicable risk-weight functions and regulatory floors. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Corporate|Retail-Mortgage|Retail-QRRE|Retail-Other|SME|Sovereign|Bank|Specialised-Lending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE30); EBA IRB Guidelines; OCC Basel III Rules

attributes.name: auc_roc
attributes.description: Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC) measuring the model's discriminatory power. Ranges from 0.5 (random) to 1.0 (perfect). Complementary to the Gini coefficient (AUC = (Gini + 1) / 2). Reported in model validation and performance monitoring.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: backtesting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent backtesting exercise was completed for this IRB model. Backtesting compares predicted PD/LGD/EAD estimates against realised outcomes over the monitoring period.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36); SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: backtesting_result
attributes.description: Red-Amber-Green (RAG) status from the most recent backtesting exercise comparing model-predicted default rates against observed default rates. Green: within tolerance; Amber: minor deviation requiring monitoring; Red: material deviation requiring recalibration or override. Reported to ALCO and model risk committee.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36); SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; EBA IRB Guidelines; Federal Reserve CCAR

attributes.name: brier_score
attributes.description: Brier score measuring the mean squared error between predicted PD estimates and observed default outcomes. Lower values indicate better calibration accuracy. Used in model validation to assess PD calibration quality alongside the Hosmer-Lemeshow test.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; EBA IRB Guidelines; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the IRB model record was first created in the risk data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and model governance documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; SOX Section 404; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: default_definition
attributes.description: Description of the default definition applied in the IRB model, specifying the criteria used to classify an obligor or facility as defaulted (e.g., 90 days past due, unlikeliness to pay, distressed restructuring). Must align with Basel III Article 178 and internal credit policy.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE31.2 / Art. 178); EBA RTS on Default Definition (EBA/RTS/2016/06); OCC Basel III Rules

attributes.name: downturn_lgd
attributes.description: Downturn LGD estimate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.45 = 45%) reflecting loss rates observed during periods of economic stress or downturn, as required by Basel III for regulatory capital calculation. Applicable to LGD model types only.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36.86); EBA RTS on Downturn LGD (EBA/RTS/2018/06); OCC Basel III Rules

attributes.name: ead_ccf_estimate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exposure at Default (EAD) Credit Conversion Factor (CCF) Estimate
attributes.description: Credit Conversion Factor (CCF) estimate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.75 = 75%) used to convert off-balance-sheet commitments to credit equivalent EAD amounts. Applicable to EAD/CCF model types. Used in RWA and ECL calculation.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36.88); EBA IRB Guidelines; OCC Basel III Rules

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the IRB model version became effective for use in credit risk estimation, RWA calculation, and ECL provisioning. Marks the start of the model's active deployment period.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; IFRS 9

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB model version ceases to be effective and is superseded or retired. Null for currently active models with no scheduled end date.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: gini_coefficient
attributes.description: Gini coefficient (also known as Accuracy Ratio) measuring the discriminatory power of the IRB model — its ability to rank-order defaulters from non-defaulters. Ranges from 0 (no discrimination) to 1 (perfect discrimination). Key model performance metric reported in validation reports and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; EBA IRB Guidelines; Basel Committee Working Paper No. 14

attributes.name: last_validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent independent model validation was completed. SR 11-7 requires periodic independent validation of all models used for material risk decisions. Supports model governance tracking and regulatory examination readiness.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: lgd_in_default
attributes.description: Best estimate of LGD for exposures currently in default, used for IFRS 9 ECL Stage 3 provisioning and workout LGD calculations. Distinct from the regulatory downturn LGD used for RWA. Applicable to LGD model types.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 (IASB); BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; EBA IRB Guidelines; CECL (FASB ASC 326)

attributes.name: long_run_average_pd
attributes.description: Long-run average PD (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0025 = 0.25%) estimated for the model's portfolio segment, representing the through-the-cycle central tendency. Used as the calibration anchor for Basel III regulatory capital. Applicable to PD model types only.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36.87); EBA IRB Guidelines; Federal Reserve CCAR

attributes.name: macroeconomic_scenario
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the macroeconomic scenario used to condition PIT PD estimates (e.g., 'Base Case 2024Q4', 'Adverse Scenario DFAST 2024', 'Severely Adverse'). Relevant for IFRS 9 ECL multiple scenario weighting and CCAR/DFAST stress testing.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 (IASB); CECL (FASB ASC 326); Federal Reserve CCAR/DFAST; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: model_approach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the model operates under the Foundation Internal Ratings-Based (F-IRB) approach, where only PD is internally estimated and LGD/EAD use supervisory values, or the Advanced IRB (A-IRB) approach, where PD, LGD, and EAD are all internally estimated.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE30.1); Federal Reserve Basel III Final Rule; EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: model_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the IRB model by the model governance function (e.g., 'PD-CORP-001', 'LGD-RETAIL-003'). Used as the business identifier across risk systems, regulatory submissions, and model inventory.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; OCC Model Risk Guidance

attributes.name: model_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the statistical or econometric methodology used to develop the IRB model (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, machine learning gradient boosting, scorecard). Supports model governance documentation and SR 11-7 compliance.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the IRB model (e.g., 'Corporate PD Model — North America', 'Retail Mortgage LGD Model'). Used in model governance documentation, regulatory submissions, and reporting.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: model_risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal model risk rating assigned by the model risk management function reflecting the materiality and complexity of the model and the quality of its validation. Drives oversight intensity, validation frequency, and escalation thresholds under SR 11-7.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; Federal Reserve Model Risk Guidance

attributes.name: model_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IRB model within the model governance framework: Active (in production use for RWA/ECL), Under-Review (undergoing validation or recalibration), Deprecated (retired from use), Pending-Approval (awaiting regulatory or internal sign-off), Rejected (failed validation or regulatory review).
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IRB model by the credit risk parameter it estimates: PD (Probability of Default), LGD (Loss Given Default), EAD (Exposure at Default), or CCF (Credit Conversion Factor). Determines the model's role in RWA and ECL calculation.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE31-CRE36); IFRS 9; CECL (ASC 326); Federal Reserve CCAR

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the IRB model following semantic versioning convention (e.g., '2.1.0'). Incremented upon material recalibration, redevelopment, or methodology change. Supports model change management and audit trail.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: next_validation_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next independent model validation must be completed per the model governance calendar. Supports proactive scheduling of validation resources and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: number_of_rating_grades
attributes.description: Total number of distinct non-default rating grades in the model's rating scale. Basel III requires a minimum of 7 non-default grades for corporate/bank/sovereign exposures. Used in model governance and regulatory review.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE31.7); EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: observation_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the historical data observation window used to develop and calibrate the IRB model. Together with observation_period_start, defines the data history span used for model estimation.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36.75, CRE36.83); EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: observation_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the historical data observation window used to develop and calibrate the IRB model. Basel III requires a minimum of 5 years for PD and 7 years for LGD/EAD. Supports model documentation and regulatory review.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36.75, CRE36.83); EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: override_count
attributes.description: Number of times model outputs have been overridden by credit officers or risk managers since the model's last validation cycle. High override rates may indicate model weakness and trigger recalibration. Monitored under SR 11-7 model performance tracking.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: override_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of model outputs overridden (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.05 = 5%) during the current monitoring period. Calculated as override_count divided by total model applications. Threshold breaches trigger escalation to model risk committee.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: pd_estimation_approach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PD model produces Point-in-Time (PIT) estimates reflecting current economic conditions, Through-the-Cycle (TTC) estimates reflecting long-run average conditions, or a Hybrid blend. Applicable only to PD model types. PIT is required for IFRS 9 ECL; TTC is used for Basel III regulatory capital.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE36); IFRS 9 (IASB); CECL (FASB ASC 326); EBA IRB Guidelines

attributes.name: pd_floor
attributes.description: Minimum PD floor applied to the model's estimates as required by Basel III (e.g., 0.0003 = 0.03% for corporate exposures). Ensures that regulatory capital is not understated by overly optimistic PD estimates. Applicable to PD model types.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE31.9); EBA IRB Guidelines; Federal Reserve Basel III Final Rule

attributes.name: rating_scale_type
attributes.description: Type of rating scale used by the IRB model to assign obligor or facility grades (e.g., Numeric 1–10, Alphanumeric AAA–D, Letter-Grade A–G). Determines how model outputs are mapped to PD/LGD/EAD estimates and reported in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework (CRE31); EBA IRB Guidelines; Federal Reserve CCAR

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the prudential supervisor formally approved the IRB model for use in regulatory capital calculation. Null if approval has not yet been granted.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; Federal Reserve SR 15-18; OCC Basel III Rules

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of the model's regulatory approval from the primary prudential supervisor (e.g., Federal Reserve, OCC, PRA, ECB). Approved models may be used for regulatory capital (RWA) calculation. Conditional approval may require remediation actions.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; Federal Reserve SR 15-18; OCC Basel III Rules; EBA IRB Guidelines; PRA SS11/13

attributes.name: source_system_model_code
attributes.description: Native model identifier as recorded in the source risk management platform (e.g., SAS Risk Management or Moody's RiskAuthority model registry). Enables lineage tracing from the lakehouse silver layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the IRB model record was most recently modified in the risk data platform. Supports change management, audit trail, and model governance documentation.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; SOX Section 404; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: use_in_ecl_calculation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Used in Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Calculation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IRB model is currently used in the calculation of Expected Credit Loss (ECL) for IFRS 9 or CECL provisioning. True = in active ECL use; False = not currently used for provisioning.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 (IASB); CECL (FASB ASC 326); BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

attributes.name: use_in_rwa_calculation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Used in Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) Calculation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IRB model is currently approved and actively used in the calculation of regulatory Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) for capital adequacy reporting under Basel III. True = in active RWA use; False = not currently used for regulatory capital.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III IRB Framework; Federal Reserve Basel III Final Rule; OCC Basel III Rules; FDIC Basel III Rules

attributes.name: validation_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent independent model validation: Pass (model fit for purpose), Pass-with-Conditions (minor findings requiring remediation), Fail (material deficiencies identified), or In-Progress (validation underway). Drives model risk rating and remediation planning.
attributes.references: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance; BCBS Basel III IRB Framework

products.name: counterparty_rating
products.description: Internal and external credit rating record for counterparties, obligors, and issuers. Captures internal rating grade, external agency ratings (S&P, Moody's, Fitch), rating outlook, watch status, PD mapping, rating migration history, rating methodology, analyst override flags, and regulatory risk weight mapping under CRR/Basel III. Supports credit underwriting and RWA calculation.

attributes.name: counterparty_rating_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the counterparty credit rating record in the risk data domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) — CRR/Basel III Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) Approach

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of risk for this counterparty. Used for sovereign risk assessment, country limit management, and regulatory capital treatment under Basel III.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — Sovereign Risk; ISO 3166-1; OCC Country Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the Exposure at Default (EAD) amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; BCBS Basel III

attributes.name: deposit_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to account.deposit_account. Business justification: Counterparty credit ratings drive account opening approvals and ongoing monitoring for corporate deposit accounts. Credit risk teams assess counterparty risk for large depositors, particularly for uni

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credit analyst or rating committee member who approved or assigned this rating. Supports accountability, audit trail, and credit governance requirements.
attributes.references: OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines; Federal Reserve SR 11-7; BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach

attributes.name: industry_code_id
attributes.description: Standard industry classification code for the counterparty's primary business sector (e.g., GICS, NAICS, SIC). Used for sector concentration risk analysis, portfolio segmentation, and credit policy limits.
attributes.references: GICS — Global Industry Classification Standard; NAICS; SIC; BCBS Basel III — Concentration Risk

attributes.name: irb_model_id
attributes.description: Reference to the validated PD model used to derive the probability of default for this rating. Supports model risk management, model inventory tracking, and SR 11-7 compliance.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: kyc_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.kyc_review. Business justification: Counterparty credit ratings are informed by KYC due diligence. KYC reviews validate counterparty information (financials, ownership, sanctions status) used in rating models. Banks link ratings to KYC

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific legal entity within a counterparty group to which this rating applies, supporting group vs. entity-level rating differentiation.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Standards; FSB LEI Requirements

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty, obligor, or issuer entity for whom this credit rating record applies. Links to the counterparty master record.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; OCC Counterparty Credit Risk Guidelines

attributes.name: analyst_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit analyst has manually overridden the model-generated rating. True = override applied. Overrides must be documented and approved per credit policy. Supports model performance monitoring and governance.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Model Risk Management; OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines; BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The Basel III regulatory asset class to which this counterparty is assigned for RWA calculation purposes. Determines the applicable risk weight function and capital treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate|sovereign|bank|retail|equity|securitisation|specialised_lending|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Articles 147–152; OCC Basel III Final Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this counterparty rating record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 175 — Data Maintenance; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: default_date
attributes.description: The date on which the counterparty was classified as in default per the Basel III definition (CRR Article 178). Null if the counterparty has never defaulted. Used for LGD estimation and historical default analysis.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 178; IFRS 9 — ECL Stage 3; FASB ASC 326 — CECL

attributes.name: default_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is currently in a state of default as defined under Basel III (CRR Article 178). True = counterparty is in default. Triggers NPL classification, ECL Stage 3, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 178 — Definition of Default; IFRS 9 — Stage 3; FASB ASC 326 — CECL

attributes.name: ead
attributes.description: The estimated Exposure at Default (EAD) for this counterparty at the time of rating, expressed in the reporting currency. Represents the total value at risk if the counterparty defaults. Used in RWA and ECL calculations.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 182; IFRS 9 — ECL; Federal Reserve CCAR/DFAST

attributes.name: ecl_stage
attributes.description: The IFRS 9 / CECL impairment stage assigned to this counterparty: Stage 1 (performing, 12-month ECL), Stage 2 (significant increase in credit risk, lifetime ECL), Stage 3 (credit-impaired, lifetime ECL). Drives provisioning and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 — Financial Instruments (IASB); FASB ASC 326 — CECL; EBA Guidelines on IFRS 9

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this rating record becomes effective for credit decisions, RWA calculation, and regulatory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 175; IFRS 9 — Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Staging

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rating record expires and must be reviewed or renewed. Null for ratings with no defined expiry. Supports rating review cycle management.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 175; OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: external_rating_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent external agency rating action (S&P, Moody's, or Fitch). Used to assess the currency of external ratings for regulatory and credit purposes.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — SA External Credit Assessment; SEC NRSRO Rules

attributes.name: fitch_rating
attributes.description: The most recent long-term issuer credit rating assigned by Fitch Ratings (e.g., AAA, A+, BBB-, BB). Used for external benchmark comparison, regulatory SA risk weight mapping, and credit underwriting.
attributes.references: Fitch Ratings — Rating Definitions; BCBS Basel III — SA External Credit Assessment; SEC NRSRO Rules

attributes.name: lgd
attributes.description: The estimated Loss Given Default (LGD) for this counterparty or facility, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%). Represents the proportion of exposure expected to be lost if the counterparty defaults. Used in RWA and ECL calculations.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 181; IFRS 9 — ECL; FASB ASC 326 — CECL

attributes.name: moodys_rating
attributes.description: The most recent long-term issuer credit rating assigned by Moody's Investors Service (e.g., Aaa, Aa1, Baa2, Ba3). Used for external benchmark comparison, regulatory SA risk weight mapping, and credit underwriting.
attributes.references: Moody's Investors Service — Rating Definitions; BCBS Basel III — SA External Credit Assessment; SEC NRSRO Rules

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this counterparty's credit rating. Supports credit review cycle governance and ensures ratings remain current.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 175; Federal Reserve SR 11-7; OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: override_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the analyst override resulted in an upgrade or downgrade relative to the model-generated rating. Null if no override is in effect. Used for override tracking and model performance analysis.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Model Risk Management; OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by the credit analyst for the rating override. Required when analyst_override_flag is True. Supports audit trail and credit governance review.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Model Risk Management; OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines; BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach

attributes.name: pd
attributes.description: The estimated one-year Probability of Default (PD) associated with this internal rating grade, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.00250 = 0.25%). Core input to RWA calculation under the IRB approach and ECL computation under IFRS 9/CECL.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 180; IFRS 9 — ECL; FASB ASC 326 — CECL; Federal Reserve CCAR/DFAST

attributes.name: prior_rating_code
attributes.description: The internal rating grade code assigned to this counterparty immediately prior to the current rating. Enables rating migration analysis and transition matrix construction for credit risk modelling.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; CRR Article 175; IFRS 9 — ECL; Federal Reserve CCAR/DFAST

attributes.name: prior_rating_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prior internal rating grade was assigned. Used in conjunction with prior_rating_code to construct rating migration history and transition matrices.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; CRR Article 175; IFRS 9 — ECL

attributes.name: rating_approach
attributes.description: Regulatory capital approach under which this rating is used: Internal Ratings-Based (IRB), Standardized Approach (SA), Foundation IRB (FIRB), or Advanced IRB (AIRB). Determines RWA calculation methodology.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Articles 142–191; OCC Basel III Final Rule

attributes.name: rating_code
attributes.description: The internal credit rating grade code assigned to the counterparty under the bank's Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) model (e.g., 1A, 2B, CG3). Represents the bank's own assessment of creditworthiness.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; OCC Internal Credit Rating Guidelines; Federal Reserve SR 11-7

attributes.name: rating_committee_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rating was reviewed and approved by a formal credit rating committee (as opposed to individual analyst approval). True = committee-approved. Required for large or complex exposures per credit policy.
attributes.references: OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines; Federal Reserve SR 11-7; BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach

attributes.name: rating_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current internal credit rating was formally assigned or last affirmed by the credit analyst or rating committee. Represents the principal business event date for this rating record.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; CRR Article 175 — Data Maintenance

attributes.name: rating_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the internal rating grade (e.g., 'Investment Grade — Strong', 'Sub-Investment Grade — Speculative'). Provides qualitative context for the rating code.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Model Risk Management

attributes.name: rating_methodology
attributes.description: The name or code of the credit rating methodology applied to derive this rating (e.g., 'Corporate Scorecard v3.2', 'Financial Institution Model v2.1', 'Sovereign Rating Framework'). Supports model governance and audit trail.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Management; BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach

attributes.name: rating_model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the rating model or scorecard used to produce this rating (e.g., 'v3.2', '2024.1'). Supports model lifecycle management, backtesting, and SR 11-7 model inventory compliance.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 — Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: rating_outlook
attributes.description: The rating outlook indicating the likely direction of the credit rating over the medium term (12–24 months). Applies to both internal and external ratings. Values: positive, stable, negative, developing.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings — Outlook Definitions; Moody's — Rating Outlook; Fitch — Rating Outlook; BCBS Basel III

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rating record. 'active' indicates the rating is in force; 'under_review' indicates a rating action is pending; 'withdrawn' indicates the rating has been formally removed; 'override' indicates an analyst override is in effect.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; Federal Reserve SR 11-7; OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines

attributes.name: rating_trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event that triggered this rating action or review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual_review|financial_update|covenant_breach|market_event|acquisition|analyst_initiated|regulatory_requirement|credit_deterioration|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OCC Credit Risk Management Guidelines; BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 175; Federal Reserve SR 11-7

attributes.name: rating_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether this rating applies to the obligor/counterparty as a whole, a specific facility, an issuer, or a specific debt issue. Determines the scope of the rating assignment.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — IRB Approach; CRR Article 170 — Rating Systems

attributes.name: rwa_risk_weight
attributes.description: The regulatory risk weight percentage assigned to this counterparty under the applicable Basel III approach (IRB or SA), expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 = 75%). Directly drives Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation for capital adequacy.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III — CRR Articles 147–191; OCC Basel III Final Rule; Federal Reserve Reg Q

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this rating record originated (e.g., 'MOODYS_RISKAUTH', 'SAS_RISK', 'LIQ_IQ'). Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Section 404 — Data Lineage

attributes.name: sp_rating
attributes.description: The most recent long-term issuer credit rating assigned by S&P Global Ratings (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-, BB). Used for external benchmark comparison, regulatory SA risk weight mapping, and credit underwriting.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings — Rating Definitions; BCBS Basel III — SA External Credit Assessment; SEC NRSRO Rules

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this counterparty rating record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; BCBS Basel III — CRR Article 175 — Data Maintenance; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: watch_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty's rating is currently on a rating watch list, and the direction of the potential rating action. 'none' indicates no active watch. Signals near-term rating change risk.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings — CreditWatch; Moody's — Rating Review; Fitch — Rating Watch; BCBS Basel III

products.name: stress_scenario
products.description: Stress testing scenario master record for CCAR, DFAST, ICAAP, and internal stress programs. Captures scenario name, regulatory program (CCAR/DFAST/EBA), scenario severity (baseline, adverse, severely adverse), macroeconomic variable shocks (GDP, unemployment, HPI, interest rates), scenario vintage, approval status, and linkage to stress run results. Sourced from AxiomSL/OneSumX regulatory reporting platform.
products.reference: CCAR Scenario / DFAST Scenario / Stress Test

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the stress testing scenario record in the risk data lakehouse. Primary key for the stress_scenario entity.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Stress Testing Principles; Federal Reserve CCAR/DFAST Framework

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stress_scenario_id of the newer scenario that supersedes this record when approval_status = 'superseded'. Enables scenario lineage tracking and version chain navigation for audit and regulatory review purposes.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Stress Testing Governance Principles

attributes.name: source_scenario_stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: The native identifier of this stress scenario in the originating source system (e.g., AxiomSL scenario ID, OneSumX scenario reference). Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: AxiomSL Regulatory Reporting Platform; Wolters Kluwer OneSumX; Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: stress_scenario_cfp_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.stress_scenario_cfp. Business justification: Risk stress scenarios reference treasury contingency funding plan stress scenarios for integrated liquidity stress testing required by CCAR/DFAST. Treasury CFP scenarios define liquidity shocks that r

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the stress scenario was formally approved by the designated governance body (e.g., Risk Committee, ALCO, Board Risk Committee). Required for audit trail and model risk governance documentation.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; OCC Model Risk Guidance

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle/workflow status of the stress scenario record. 'draft' = under development; 'pending_review' = submitted for governance review; 'approved' = formally approved for use in stress runs; 'rejected' = not approved; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version; 'archived' = retired from active use.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7 Model Risk Management; BCBS Stress Testing Governance Principles

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the governance body or senior officer who formally approved the stress scenario (e.g., 'Board Risk Committee', 'ALCO', 'Chief Risk Officer'). Supports model risk governance and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 11-7; BCBS Stress Testing Governance Principles; OCC Model Risk Guidance

attributes.name: cet1_floor_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Minimum Floor Percentage
attributes.description: The minimum CET1 capital ratio floor assumed or targeted under this stress scenario, expressed as a percentage. Used to assess whether the bank maintains adequate capital buffers above regulatory minimums (4.5% CET1 minimum under Basel III) throughout the stress horizon.
attributes.references: BCBS Basel III CET1 Minimum Requirement (4.5%); Federal Reserve CCAR Capital Adequacy Standards; OCC Capital Adequacy Guidelines

attributes.name: cre_price_shock_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Price Shock Percentage
attributes.description: The peak-to-trough decline in commercial real estate prices assumed under this scenario, expressed as a percentage. Key driver for CRE loan portfolio stress testing, collateral valuation, and LTV-based ECL estimation under CECL/IFRS 9.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR CRE Variable Definition; OCC CRE Concentration Risk Guidance; FASB CECL ASC 326

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this stress scenario record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; BCBS Stress Testing Governance; Federal Reserve Data Integrity Standards

attributes.name: credit_spread_shock_bps
attributes.description: The widening of corporate/sovereign credit spreads assumed under this scenario, expressed in basis points. Drives mark-to-market losses on bond portfolios, CVA stress, and CDS pricing in trading book stress tests under FRTB.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Market Variable Definitions; FRTB Stressed VaR Requirements; ISDA CVA Framework

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this stress scenario is effective and authorized for use in stress testing runs and regulatory submissions. Aligns with the start of the scenario projection horizon.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Instructions; OCC DFAST Guidance

attributes.name: equity_price_shock_pct
attributes.description: The percentage decline in broad equity market indices (e.g., S&P 500) assumed under this scenario (e.g., -50.00 for a 50% market decline). Drives mark-to-market losses on equity portfolios, CVA stress, and trading book VaR under FRTB.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Market Variable Definitions; FRTB Stress Scenario Requirements; SEC Market Risk Guidance

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this stress scenario is no longer valid for use in new stress runs. Typically aligns with the end of the regulatory cycle or the scenario projection horizon end date. Null for open-ended internal scenarios.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Annual Cycle; BCBS Stress Testing Principles

attributes.name: fx_shock_pct
attributes.description: The percentage depreciation or appreciation of the USD (or base currency) against major foreign currencies assumed under this scenario. Drives FX translation losses, cross-currency swap valuation, and international portfolio stress.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR FX Variable Definitions; FRTB FX Risk Requirements; CFTC FX Derivatives Guidance

attributes.name: gdp_growth_shock_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) Growth Shock Percentage
attributes.description: The peak-to-trough or annualized GDP growth rate shock applied under this scenario, expressed as a percentage (e.g., -8.50 for an 8.5% contraction). A key macroeconomic variable in CCAR/DFAST scenarios used to drive credit loss and revenue projections.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Macroeconomic Variable Definitions; OCC DFAST Scenario Variables

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic coverage of the stress scenario. 'global' = worldwide macroeconomic shock; 'domestic' = US-only scenario; 'regional' = specific geographic region (e.g., Europe, Asia-Pacific); 'legal_entity_specific' = applies to a specific legal entity or subsidiary.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Geographic Scope; EBA EU-Wide Stress Test; BCBS Cross-Border Stress Testing Principles

attributes.name: hpi_shock_pct
attributes.description: The peak-to-trough decline in the House Price Index (HPI) assumed under this scenario, expressed as a percentage (e.g., -25.00 for a 25% decline). Critical for mortgage portfolio stress testing and LTV-based credit loss estimation.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR HPI Variable Definition; OCC DFAST Scenario Variables; CFPB Mortgage Risk Guidance

attributes.name: inflation_rate_shock_pct
attributes.description: The peak inflation rate (CPI/PCE) assumed under this scenario, expressed as a percentage. Used in real rate calculations, ALM stress testing, and cost-of-funds projections under CCAR/DFAST and ICAAP.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Macroeconomic Variable Definitions; BCBS ICAAP Guidance

attributes.name: is_board_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stress scenario has been formally approved by the Board of Directors or Board Risk Committee (True). Required for CCAR capital plan submission and ICAAP documentation. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Capital Plan Rule (12 CFR Part 225); BCBS Stress Testing Governance Principles; OCC Heightened Standards

attributes.name: is_regulatory_prescribed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scenario was prescribed by a regulatory authority (True) or developed internally by the bank (False). Regulatory-prescribed scenarios (e.g., Fed CCAR scenarios) have mandatory use requirements and cannot be modified by the bank.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Instructions; OCC DFAST Guidance; Dodd-Frank Act Section 165(i)

attributes.name: is_reverse_stress
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scenario is a reverse stress test (True), i.e., a scenario designed to identify conditions that would cause the bank to fail or breach critical thresholds, working backwards from the outcome. Required under PRA SS3/13 and BCBS stress testing principles.
attributes.references: PRA SS3/13 Reverse Stress Testing; BCBS Stress Testing Principles (2018); FSB Supervisory Intensity and Effectiveness

attributes.name: lcr_floor_pct
attributes.description: The minimum Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) floor assumed under this stress scenario, expressed as a percentage. Used in liquidity stress testing to assess whether the bank maintains sufficient high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) under the scenario conditions.
attributes.references: BCBS LCR Standard (Basel III); Federal Reserve LCR Rule (12 CFR Part 249); FDIC Liquidity Risk Guidance

attributes.name: legal_entity_scope
attributes.description: The legal entity or consolidated group to which this stress scenario applies (e.g., 'BHC Consolidated', 'Bank Subsidiary', 'Broker-Dealer'). Supports multi-entity stress testing and regulatory reporting at the appropriate consolidation level.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR BHC Consolidated Reporting; OCC National Bank Stress Testing; FDIC Insured Institution Requirements

attributes.name: lgd_multiplier
attributes.description: The scalar multiplier applied to baseline Loss Given Default (LGD) estimates under this scenario to derive stressed LGD inputs for ECL/CECL and RWA stress calculations. Reflects collateral value deterioration and recovery rate compression under stress.
attributes.references: BCBS IRB Approach (Basel III); FASB CECL ASC 326; IFRS 9; Federal Reserve CCAR Credit Loss Methodology

attributes.name: line_of_business_scope
attributes.description: The line of business or portfolio segment to which this scenario applies (e.g., 'All LOBs', 'Commercial Lending', 'Trading Book', 'Retail Banking'). Null or 'All LOBs' indicates enterprise-wide applicability. Supports LOB-level stress attribution.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR LOB Reporting; BCBS Stress Testing Principles

attributes.name: long_term_rate_shock_bps
attributes.description: The shock to long-term interest rates (e.g., 10-year Treasury yield) applied under this scenario, expressed in basis points (BPS). Used in bond portfolio valuation, NII stress testing, and duration/convexity analysis under CCAR/DFAST.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR Interest Rate Variable Definitions; BCBS IRRBB Standards

attributes.name: pd_multiplier
attributes.description: The scalar multiplier applied to baseline Probability of Default (PD) estimates under this scenario to derive stressed PD inputs for ECL/CECL calculations and RWA stress testing. A value of 2.50 means stressed PD = 2.5x baseline PD. Used in IRB model stress testing.
attributes.references: BCBS IRB Approach (Basel III); FASB CECL ASC 326; IFRS 9 Forward-Looking Scenarios; Federal Reserve CCAR Credit Loss Methodology

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: The regulatory or internal stress testing program under which this scenario is defined. CCAR = Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (Fed); DFAST = Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing (OCC/Fed); ICAAP = Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process; EBA = European Banking Authority stress test; ILAAP = Internal Liquidity Adequacy Assessment Process; INTERNAL = bank-defined internal stress program; CECL = Current Expected Credit Losses scenario; IFRS9 = IFRS 9 forward-looking scenario. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CCAR|DFAST|ICAAP|EBA|ILAAP|INTERNAL|CECL|IFRS9 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Federal Reserve CCAR/DFAST Framework; EBA Stress Testing Guidelines; BCBS ICAAP Guidance; FASB CECL ASC 326; IFRS 9

attributes.name: rwa_scalar
attributes.description: The scalar factor applied to baseline Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) under this scenario to project stressed RWA for capital adequacy assessment. Used in CCAR/DFAST capital ratio projections and CET1 depletion analysis.
