attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: net_collateral_value
attributes.description: The net value of collateral available after haircuts, accrued interest, fees, and any other adjustments. This is the effective collateral coverage amount.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: net_current_exposure
attributes.description: The net mark-to-market exposure after bilateral netting under a qualifying master netting agreement (e.g., ISDA Master Agreement). Calculated as max(GPE - GNE, 0). Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Master Agreement

attributes.name: net_margin_requirement
attributes.description: The net amount of additional collateral required (positive) or excess collateral available for return (negative) after considering threshold, MTA, independent amount, and collateral already posted/received. Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: position_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this collateral position snapshot is recorded. Represents the valuation date for inventory and exposure calculations.
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) Disclosure Standards

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collateral position: held (owned but not pledged), posted (delivered to counterparty), received (accepted from counterparty), pledged (committed but not yet delivered), rehypothecated (received collateral reused), or exposure (calculated margin requirement record).
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach for Counterparty Credit Risk (SA-CCR)

attributes.name: potential_future_exposure
attributes.description: An estimate of the maximum exposure that could arise in the future due to market movements, calculated using regulatory or internal models. Used for capital and margin calculations. Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach for Counterparty Credit Risk (SA-CCR)

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The number of units or nominal amount of the collateral asset in this position. For securities, this is the number of shares or bonds; for cash, this is the principal amount.
attributes.references: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) Standard ISO 6166

attributes.name: rehypothecation_allowed
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the collateral receiver is permitted to rehypothecate (reuse) the received collateral under the terms of the collateral agreement.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: risk_weighted_assets
attributes.description: The regulatory capital requirement for this collateral position, calculated by applying risk weights to the exposure amount under Basel III standardized or internal ratings-based approaches. Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: Basel III Capital Requirements for Counterparty Credit Risk

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collateral transfer was or is expected to be settled and ownership or control transferred.
attributes.references: Central Securities Depository Regulation (CSDR) Settlement Discipline

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The current settlement state of the collateral position: pending (awaiting delivery), in_transit (delivery initiated), settled (delivery confirmed), failed (settlement did not complete), recalled (collateral substitution or return in progress).
attributes.references: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) MT 54x Series

attributes.name: substitution_right_exercised
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the collateral provider has exercised their right to substitute this collateral asset with another eligible asset under the terms of the CSA.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: The minimum exposure level specified in the CSA or collateral agreement below which no collateral is required to be posted. Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: threshold_breach_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the net current exposure exceeds the threshold amount, triggering a margin call requirement. Calculated as max(NCE - threshold_amount, 0). Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Credit Support Annex (CSA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this collateral position record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: variation_margin
attributes.description: The collateral exchanged daily to reflect changes in the mark-to-market value of derivative positions. Represents the current exposure component of margin. Applicable to exposure-type positions.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) / International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO) Margin Requirements for Non-Centrally Cleared Derivatives

products.name: substitution
products.description: Transactional record of collateral substitution events where one pledged or posted asset is replaced by another under the terms of a collateral agreement, CSA, or repo arrangement. Captures substitution request date, original collateral asset, replacement collateral asset, substitution reason (cost optimization, approaching maturity, eligibility change, rating downgrade, concentration breach), counterparty consent status, effective date, approval workflow status, and settlement confirmation. Tracks the full substitution lifecycle from request through counterparty approval to settlement. Critical for collateral optimization and cheapest-to-deliver strategies.

attributes.name: substitution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collateral substitution transaction. Primary key for the collateral substitution record.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audit.engagement. Business justification: Substitution processes audited for approval workflow compliance, eligibility check effectiveness, counterparty consent requirements, and cheapest-to-deliver optimization controls. Operational risk and

attributes.name: collateral_margin_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the margin call that triggered or is associated with this collateral substitution, if applicable.

attributes.name: original_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Substitution workflows require instrument-level tracking for eligibility validation, value equivalence checks, and cheapest-to-deliver optimization. Links original security being replaced in collatera

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty with whom the collateral substitution is being executed.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: pledge_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master collateral agreement or Credit Support Annex (CSA) under which this substitution is executed.

attributes.name: primary_substitution_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the custodian or triparty agent responsible for holding and transferring the collateral assets in this substitution transaction.

attributes.name: substitution_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who initiated or created the collateral substitution request in the system.

attributes.name: substitution_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or approver who authorized the collateral substitution request.

attributes.name: substitution_original_collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original pledged or posted collateral asset being replaced in this substitution transaction.

attributes.name: substitution_replacement_collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new collateral asset being substituted in place of the original asset.

attributes.name: substitution_updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified the collateral substitution record.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_status
attributes.description: Current status of the internal approval workflow for the substitution request, tracking progression through risk review, credit approval, and operational authorization stages.

attributes.name: cheapest_to_deliver_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this substitution is part of a cheapest-to-deliver optimization strategy (True) or driven by other operational or risk factors (False).

attributes.name: collateral_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the collateral valuation amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: concentration_limit_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the substitution was triggered by a concentration limit breach in the collateral pool (True) or for other reasons (False).

attributes.name: cost_savings_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost savings achieved through the collateral substitution, typically measured as the difference in funding costs or opportunity costs between the original and replacement assets.

attributes.name: cost_savings_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost savings amount.

attributes.name: counterparty_consent_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or conditions provided by the counterparty regarding their consent decision, including any stipulations for conditional approval.

attributes.name: counterparty_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the counterparty provided their consent decision (approval or rejection) for the substitution request.

attributes.name: counterparty_consent_status
attributes.description: Current status of counterparty consent for the collateral substitution request. Tracks whether the counterparty has approved, rejected, conditionally approved, or is still reviewing the substitution request.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this collateral substitution record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collateral substitution becomes effective and the replacement collateral officially replaces the original collateral in the agreement.

attributes.name: eligibility_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the eligibility verification for the replacement collateral asset was completed.

attributes.name: eligibility_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the eligibility verification process for the replacement collateral asset, confirming it meets all criteria defined in the collateral agreement (asset class, credit rating, maturity, concentration limits).

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the counterparty or custodian for processing the collateral substitution request, if applicable per the collateral agreement terms.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the substitution fee amount.

attributes.name: internal_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which internal approval was granted for the collateral substitution request, following completion of risk and credit review processes.

attributes.name: original_collateral_adjusted_value_amount
attributes.description: Post-haircut value of the original collateral asset, representing the effective collateral coverage amount.

attributes.name: original_collateral_haircut_rate
attributes.description: Haircut percentage applied to the original collateral asset based on asset class, credit quality, and liquidity characteristics. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).

attributes.name: original_collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: Market value of the original collateral asset at the time of substitution request, before application of haircut.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the primary business reason for the collateral substitution request. Common reasons include cost optimization (cheapest-to-deliver strategy), approaching maturity of original asset, eligibility criteria change, credit rating downgrade, concentration limit breach, or liquidity management needs.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the business rationale and circumstances driving the collateral substitution request.

attributes.name: replacement_collateral_adjusted_value_amount
attributes.description: Post-haircut value of the replacement collateral asset, representing the effective collateral coverage amount after substitution.

attributes.name: replacement_collateral_haircut_rate
attributes.description: Haircut percentage applied to the replacement collateral asset based on asset class, credit quality, and liquidity characteristics. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).

attributes.name: replacement_collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: Market value of the replacement collateral asset at the time of substitution request, before application of haircut.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collateral substitution request was initiated by the requesting party.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the substitution request, used for tracking and reference in operational workflows and counterparty communications.

attributes.name: settlement_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation reference number issued by the settlement system or custodian upon successful completion of the collateral transfer.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the physical or book-entry transfer of collateral assets is completed, finalizing the substitution transaction.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Method used for settling the collateral substitution transaction. Options include Delivery versus Payment (DVP), Free of Payment (FOP), triparty arrangement, or bilateral settlement.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the settlement process for the collateral substitution, tracking the operational completion of asset transfers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this collateral substitution record was last modified in the system.

products.name: margin_exposure
products.description: Calculated exposure record representing the net mark-to-market exposure under a margin agreement or CSA, used to determine margin call obligations. Captures exposure date, gross positive exposure (GPE), gross negative exposure (GNE), net current exposure (NCE), potential future exposure (PFE), threshold breach amount, collateral already posted/received, net margin requirement, and regulatory capital impact (CVA, RWA). Feeds the margin call generation process.
products.reference: Net Current Exposure / NCE / MTM Exposure

attributes.name: margin_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the margin exposure calculation record.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audit.engagement. Business justification: Margin exposure calculations audited for CVA/DVA accuracy, PFE modeling validation, threshold breach detection, and regulatory IM model compliance. Critical for counterparty credit risk and model vali

attributes.name: margin_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the margin agreement or Credit Support Annex (CSA) under which this exposure is calculated.

attributes.name: netting_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the group of transactions that are subject to bilateral netting under the ISDA Master Agreement. All trades within a netting set are netted together for exposure calculation.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity with whom the margin exposure exists.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: Liquidity stress testing projects margin calls under adverse scenarios. Stressed margin exposure drives liquidity buffer sizing and LCR/NSFR projections. Required for regulatory liquidity stress tests

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the margin exposure and requirements. SIMM (Standard Initial Margin Model) is the industry standard for initial margin; other methods may be used for variation margin or under specific CSA terms.

attributes.name: calculation_run_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch calculation run that produced this exposure record. Used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: collateral_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the eligible collateral currency specified in the CSA. Determines the currency in which collateral must be posted.

attributes.name: collateral_posted_amount
attributes.description: The current market value of collateral that the bank has posted to the counterparty to cover exposure. Includes cash and securities adjusted for haircuts.

attributes.name: collateral_received_amount
attributes.description: The current market value of collateral that the bank has received from the counterparty to cover their exposure to the bank. Includes cash and securities adjusted for haircuts.

attributes.name: collateral_segregation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether initial margin collateral must be held in a segregated account at a third-party custodian, as required by regulatory mandates for certain counterparties and jurisdictions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this margin exposure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cva_amount
attributes.description: The adjustment to the fair value of derivative positions to account for counterparty credit risk. Represents the market value of counterparty default risk and is used for regulatory capital calculations.
attributes.references: Basel III CVA Risk Capital Charge

attributes.name: dispute_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The minimum exposure difference amount that can trigger a formal dispute resolution process under the CSA. Valuation differences below this amount are typically resolved informally.

attributes.name: dva_amount
attributes.description: The adjustment to the fair value of derivative positions to account for the bank's own credit risk. Represents the benefit the bank receives from its own default risk.

attributes.name: ead_amount
attributes.description: The estimated exposure amount at the time of counterparty default, used for regulatory capital calculations. Incorporates current exposure and potential future exposure.

attributes.name: exposure_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the exposure amounts are denominated. All monetary amounts in this record are expressed in this currency.

attributes.name: exposure_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this margin exposure was calculated, typically the valuation date for mark-to-market positions.

attributes.name: exposure_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the margin exposure calculation was performed, including time zone information.

attributes.name: gne_amount
attributes.description: The total mark-to-market value of all positions where the bank has a negative exposure to the counterparty (bank owes the counterparty). Represents the gross liability before netting and collateral.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - SA-CCR

attributes.name: gpe_amount
attributes.description: The total mark-to-market value of all positions where the bank has a positive exposure to the counterparty (counterparty owes the bank). Represents the gross amount at risk before netting and collateral.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - SA-CCR

attributes.name: independent_amount
attributes.description: Additional collateral required beyond the current exposure, often used as a buffer for potential future exposure or as initial margin. Also known as Initial Margin (IM) under regulatory frameworks.
attributes.references: Basel III Initial Margin Requirements for Non-Cleared Derivatives

attributes.name: initial_margin_amount
attributes.description: The collateral amount required to cover potential future exposure over the margin period of risk, calculated using regulatory models (SIMM) or internal models. Required for non-cleared derivatives under regulatory mandates.

attributes.name: last_margin_call_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent margin call was issued for this margin agreement and counterparty.

attributes.name: margin_call_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the margin call: whether the bank is calling for collateral from the counterparty, the counterparty is calling from the bank, or no call is required.

attributes.name: margin_call_status
attributes.description: The current status of the margin call process for this exposure calculation. Tracks whether a margin call has been issued, satisfied, or is in dispute.

attributes.name: margin_period_of_risk_days
attributes.description: The number of days between the last margin call and the closeout of positions following a counterparty default. Used in calculating initial margin requirements. Typically 10 days for standard CSAs.
attributes.references: Basel III Margin Period of Risk Definition

attributes.name: minimum_transfer_amount
attributes.description: The minimum amount of collateral that must be transferred in a single margin call. Margin calls below this amount are not executed to reduce operational burden.
attributes.references: ISDA CSA Minimum Transfer Amount Definition

attributes.name: nce_amount
attributes.description: The net mark-to-market exposure after bilateral netting of all positions under the margin agreement. Calculated as GPE minus GNE. Positive values indicate the bank is owed; negative values indicate the bank owes.

attributes.name: net_collateral_position
attributes.description: The net collateral position calculated as collateral received minus collateral posted. Positive values indicate the bank holds net collateral; negative values indicate the bank has posted net collateral.

attributes.name: net_margin_requirement
attributes.description: The net amount of additional collateral required to be posted or returned based on the current exposure, threshold, and existing collateral. Positive values indicate the bank must post more collateral; negative values indicate the bank can request collateral return.

attributes.name: next_margin_call_date
attributes.description: The next scheduled date on which a margin call may be issued based on the CSA terms. Typically daily for most CSAs but may be less frequent for certain counterparties.

attributes.name: pfe_amount
attributes.description: The estimated maximum exposure that could arise in the future due to market movements, calculated using regulatory or internal models. Used for regulatory capital calculations and risk management.
attributes.references: Basel III SA-CCR Standardized Approach for Counterparty Credit Risk

attributes.name: regulatory_im_model
attributes.description: The regulatory model used to calculate initial margin requirements. SIMM (Standard Initial Margin Model) is the industry standard; grid and schedule are simplified approaches; internal models require regulatory approval.

attributes.name: rwa_amount
attributes.description: The risk-weighted asset amount calculated for this exposure under Basel III regulatory capital requirements. Used to determine the capital charge for counterparty credit risk.
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach for Counterparty Credit Risk

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the upstream system that calculated or provided this margin exposure data (e.g., Murex, Calypso, SAS Risk Management).

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: The contractual threshold amount specified in the CSA below which no margin call is required. Exposure must exceed this amount before collateral posting obligations are triggered.

attributes.name: threshold_breach_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the net current exposure exceeds the contractual threshold. This is the exposure amount that triggers a margin call obligation. Calculated as NCE minus threshold amount (if positive).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this margin exposure record was last modified or recalculated.

attributes.name: valuation_agent
attributes.description: Identifies which party is responsible for calculating the exposure valuation under the CSA terms. May be the bank, counterparty, a third-party service, or bilateral (both parties calculate independently).

attributes.name: variation_margin_amount
attributes.description: The collateral amount required to cover the current mark-to-market exposure, calculated daily based on changes in position values. Distinct from initial margin which covers potential future exposure.
attributes.references: Basel III Margin Requirements for Non-Cleared Derivatives

products.name: repo_agreement
products.description: Master record of repurchase agreement (repo) and reverse repo transactions with embedded near-leg and far-leg settlement details. Captures repo type (classic repo, sell/buy-back, tri-party), trade date, near-leg settlement date/amount/currency/status, far-leg repurchase date/amount/currency/status, repo rate, haircut, collateral basket description, open/term flag, counterparty, coupon pass-through terms and dates, each leg's SWIFT/RTGS settlement reference, custodian instructions per leg, settlement confirmation status per leg, and failed trade status with fail reason and resolution. Supports treasury liquidity management, T+1 settlement tracking per leg, failed trade management, and LCR/NSFR regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: repo_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the repurchase agreement transaction.

attributes.name: collateral_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to collateral.collateral_asset. Business justification: Repo agreements are secured by collateral assets. repo_agreement is currently SILOED with no in-domain FKs. The table has collateral_basket_description and collateral_market_value which are redundant

attributes.name: collateral_basket_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the collateral basket pledged or received under this repo agreement.

attributes.name: counterparty_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.counterparty_rating. Business justification: Repo counterparty credit quality determines haircuts, concentration limits, and eligible counterparty lists. Rating downgrades trigger repo unwind provisions. Standard treasury and credit risk managem

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the near leg cash amount.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fund. Business justification: Repo agreements can use fund units as collateral in securities financing transactions. Business process: repo market operations with fund shares as collateral, securities lending programs using fund h

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Repo transactions require specific GL treatment for cash vs securities legs, repo interest accrual, and balance sheet classification. Essential for treasury accounting, SFTR reporting, and financial s

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Settlement date calculation for near/far legs requires holiday calendar per market convention. Creating new holiday_calendar_id FK.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Repo transactions are security-backed financing. Instrument link enables coupon pass-through calculations, corporate action handling, substitution rights validation, and settlement instruction generat

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.order. Business justification: Repo agreements are executed via trade orders on repo trading desks. Links master repo agreement terms to specific execution orders, enabling traders to verify order compliance with agreement limits a

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the counterparty institution or entity participating in the repo transaction.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: primary_repo_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the custodian bank or tri-party agent managing collateral settlement and safekeeping.

attributes.name: repo_rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.rate_benchmark. Business justification: Repo rate often references benchmark (SOFR + spread) for pricing and accrual calculations. Creating repo_rate_benchmark_id FK for benchmark-linked repos.

attributes.name: coupon_pass_through_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether coupon or dividend payments on the collateral securities are passed through to the cash lender during the repo term. True if pass-through applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: coupon_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which any coupon or dividend payment on the collateral is due to be passed through, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this repo agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: fail_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for settlement failure, such as insufficient collateral, cash shortfall, or operational error.

attributes.name: fail_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a failed trade was resolved and settlement completed.

attributes.name: failed_trade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the repo transaction has experienced a settlement failure on either leg. True if failed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: far_leg_amount
attributes.description: The total repurchase amount on the far leg, including principal and accrued repo interest.
attributes.references: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)

attributes.name: far_leg_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the far leg settlement was confirmed by the custodian or settlement system.

attributes.name: far_leg_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the far leg repurchase amount.

attributes.name: far_leg_repurchase_date
attributes.description: The scheduled maturity or repurchase date for the far leg when collateral is returned and cash plus interest is repaid. Null for open repos until termination notice is given.

attributes.name: far_leg_settlement_reference
attributes.description: SWIFT message reference or RTGS transaction identifier for the far leg repurchase settlement.

attributes.name: far_leg_settlement_status
attributes.description: Current settlement status of the far leg: pending (awaiting maturity), settled (completed), failed (settlement failure), or cancelled.

attributes.name: haircut_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the market value of collateral to determine the loan amount, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.00 for 2% haircut).

attributes.name: initial_margin_amount
attributes.description: The initial margin posted at trade inception to cover potential exposure, calculated per Basel III margin requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this repo agreement record was last updated.

attributes.name: margin_call_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum collateral value shortfall that triggers a margin call under the repo agreement.

attributes.name: near_leg_amount
attributes.description: The principal cash amount exchanged on the near leg settlement date.
attributes.references: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR)

attributes.name: near_leg_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the near leg settlement was confirmed by the custodian or settlement system.

attributes.name: near_leg_settlement_date
attributes.description: The settlement date for the initial cash and collateral exchange (near leg) of the repo transaction, typically T+1 or T+0.

attributes.name: near_leg_settlement_reference
attributes.description: SWIFT message reference or RTGS transaction identifier for the near leg cash settlement.

attributes.name: near_leg_settlement_status
attributes.description: Current settlement status of the near leg: pending (awaiting settlement), settled (completed), failed (settlement failure), or cancelled.

attributes.name: open_term_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the repo is open-ended (callable on demand) or term (fixed maturity). True for open repo, False for term repo.

attributes.name: repo_agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier or reference number for the repo transaction, used for trade confirmation and settlement messaging.

attributes.name: repo_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is borrowing cash (repo) or lending cash (reverse repo).

attributes.name: repo_rate
attributes.description: The annualized interest rate applied to the repo transaction, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%).
attributes.references: SOFR (Secured Overnight Financing Rate) / LIBOR Transition

attributes.name: repo_rate_basis
attributes.description: The day count convention used to calculate repo interest: actual/360, actual/365, or 30/360.

attributes.name: repo_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the repo agreement: active (in force), matured (far leg settled), terminated (early termination), cancelled (voided before settlement), or defaulted (counterparty default).

attributes.name: repo_type
attributes.description: Classification of the repo structure: classic repo (legal title transfer with repurchase obligation), sell/buy-back (two separate sale transactions), tri-party (custodian-managed collateral), or hold-in-custody (bilateral custody).

attributes.name: substitution_rights_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cash borrower has the right to substitute collateral during the repo term. True if substitution is permitted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repo agreement was terminated, either at maturity or through early termination.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for early termination, such as counterparty request, default event, or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the repo agreement was executed and confirmed between counterparties.

attributes.name: variation_margin_amount
attributes.description: The current variation margin amount reflecting mark-to-market changes in collateral value or exposure.

products.name: repo_leg
products.description: Individual settlement leg of a repo or reverse repo transaction, capturing the near leg (initial purchase/sale) and far leg (repurchase/resale) settlement details. Tracks leg type (near, far, coupon pass-through), settlement date, settlement amount, settlement currency, settlement status (pending, settled, failed), SWIFT/RTGS settlement reference, and custodian instruction details. Enables T+1 settlement tracking and failed trade management.

attributes.name: repo_leg_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the repo leg. Primary key.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audit.engagement. Business justification: Repo settlement legs audited for failed trade resolution, SWIFT instruction accuracy, custodian reconciliation, and SFTR UTI reporting. Operational risk and settlement process audit scope.

attributes.name: bic_directory_id
attributes.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) of the settlement agent responsible for processing this leg's settlement.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: custodian_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the custodian institution responsible for holding and settling the securities for this leg.

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Settlement date adjustment requires holiday calendar for payment system availability and business day conventions. Creating new holiday_calendar_id FK.

Captures agreement type, governing law, jurisdiction, perfection method (UCC filing, mortgage registration, charge registration), lien priority, cross-default provisions, acceleration clauses, and review/renewal dates. Distinct from CSA (derivatives) and GMRA (repo) — covers secured commercial lending collateral.

products.name: initial_margin
products.description: Record of initial margin (IM) requirements and balances for uncleared OTC derivatives under BCBS/IOSCO Uncleared Margin Rules (UMR). Captures IM calculation methodology (ISDA SIMM, schedule-based), IM requirement amount, IM posted amount, IM received amount, segregation status (segregated, commingled), custodian details, regulatory phase, and daily reconciliation status. Tracks compliance with UMR phase-in requirements and SIMM model governance.
products.reference: Initial Margin / IM / UMR / ISDA SIMM

attributes.name: primary_initial_custodian_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party custodian or triparty agent holding the segregated initial margin collateral on behalf of the posting party.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trade.trade_position. Business justification: Initial margin requirements are calculated by aggregating trade positions in the netting set. Risk and margin teams drill down from IM requirements to underlying positions for SIMM sensitivity analysi

attributes.name: aana_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate average notional amount of uncleared derivatives for the counterparty group, calculated over a specified period (typically March, April, May of the prior year). AANA determines UMR phase-in applicability.

attributes.name: aana_calculation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Aggregate Average Notional Amount (AANA) Calculation Date
attributes.description: The date on which the AANA was calculated for the counterparty group, used to determine UMR phase-in eligibility.

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the initial margin requirement was calculated. This is the valuation date for the underlying derivative portfolio used in the IM calculation.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the initial margin requirement. ISDA SIMM (Standard Initial Margin Model) is the industry-standard risk-based approach; Schedule-Based uses fixed percentages by asset class per regulatory schedules; Internal Model refers to proprietary approved models.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: The compliance status of the initial margin arrangement with respect to UMR requirements. Non-Compliant status indicates a breach requiring remediation.

attributes.name: concentration_limit_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the initial margin collateral portfolio breaches concentration limits defined in the CSA or regulatory requirements (e.g., single issuer limits, asset class limits).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this initial margin record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: custodian_account_number
attributes.description: The account number at the custodian institution where the initial margin collateral is held. This is business-confidential information.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The amount of initial margin under dispute between the entity and the counterparty due to calculation differences, valuation disagreements, or operational errors. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for the initial margin dispute, including details of the calculation or valuation disagreement.

attributes.name: eligible_collateral_types
attributes.business_glossary_term: Eligible Collateral Types for Initial Margin (IM)
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of collateral asset types eligible for posting as initial margin under the CSA agreement (e.g., Cash, Government Bonds, Corporate Bonds, Equities). Eligibility is defined by the CSA and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ISDA CSA Eligible Collateral Schedule, BCBS/IOSCO UMR

attributes.name: haircut_schedule_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Haircut Schedule Applied to Initial Margin (IM) Collateral
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the haircut schedule applied to non-cash collateral posted as initial margin. Haircuts reduce the collateral value to account for market risk and liquidity risk.

attributes.name: im_posted_amount
attributes.description: The actual initial margin amount posted by the entity to the counterparty as of the calculation date. This represents collateral delivered to meet the IM requirement.

attributes.name: im_received_amount
attributes.description: The actual initial margin amount received by the entity from the counterparty as of the calculation date. This represents collateral received to cover the counterparty's IM obligation.

attributes.name: im_requirement_amount
attributes.description: The total initial margin amount required to be posted by the entity to the counterparty, calculated based on the agreed methodology and the risk profile of the uncleared OTC derivative portfolio.

attributes.name: independent_amount
attributes.description: An additional fixed or formula-based margin amount agreed bilaterally in the CSA, independent of the mark-to-market exposure or SIMM calculation. Often used for credit risk mitigation.

attributes.name: interest_rate_on_cash_collateral
attributes.description: The interest rate applied to cash collateral posted as initial margin, as agreed in the CSA. Typically based on an overnight rate such as SOFR or ESTR.

attributes.name: last_margin_call_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent initial margin call issued to or by the counterparty due to a change in the IM requirement exceeding the minimum transfer amount.

attributes.name: minimum_transfer_amount
attributes.description: The minimum amount of initial margin change that triggers a collateral transfer. Amounts below the MTA are not called or returned to reduce operational burden.

attributes.name: model_approval_status
attributes.description: The regulatory approval status of the internal model used for initial margin calculation, if applicable. ISDA SIMM is generally pre-approved; proprietary models require explicit regulatory approval.

attributes.name: model_validation_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent independent validation of the initial margin calculation model, as required by model governance and regulatory standards.

attributes.name: net_im_exposure
attributes.description: The net initial margin exposure after netting posted and received amounts. Positive values indicate the entity has a net IM receivable; negative values indicate a net IM payable.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Initial Margin (IM) Review Date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled review of the initial margin methodology, model parameters, or CSA terms, as required by internal governance or regulatory standards.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context related to the initial margin record, including operational issues, special agreements, or audit trail information.

attributes.name: phase_in_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the counterparty relationship became subject to UMR initial margin requirements, based on the applicable regulatory phase.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent reconciliation of initial margin calculations and balances was performed with the counterparty.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The status of the daily reconciliation process between the entity and the counterparty for initial margin calculations and balances. Matched indicates agreement; Unmatched or Disputed indicates discrepancies requiring resolution.

attributes.name: regulatory_phase
attributes.description: The UMR phase-in category to which the counterparty relationship belongs, based on aggregate average notional amount (AANA) thresholds. Phase 1 applies to the largest entities; Phase 6 to smaller entities. Out of Scope indicates the relationship does not meet UMR thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase 1|Phase 2|Phase 3|Phase 4|Phase 5|Phase 6|Out of Scope — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rehypothecation_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the receiving party is permitted to rehypothecate (reuse) the initial margin collateral. UMR generally prohibits rehypothecation of IM collateral to ensure segregation and protection.

attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction(s) to which this initial margin record must be reported (e.g., US, EU, UK, Japan). Multiple jurisdictions may apply for cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: segregation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the initial margin collateral is held in a segregated account (isolated from the custodian's own assets and other clients' assets) or commingled. Segregation is a key regulatory requirement under UMR to protect against custodian insolvency.

attributes.name: simm_version
attributes.description: The version of the ISDA SIMM methodology applied for the calculation (e.g., SIMM 2.6, SIMM 2.5). Null if a non-SIMM methodology is used.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the posting party has the right to substitute initial margin collateral with other eligible assets, as defined in the CSA agreement.

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: The bilateral threshold amount agreed in the CSA below which initial margin is not required to be posted. Regulatory maximum is typically 50 million in the base currency of the CSA.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this initial margin record was last updated in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

Provides the audit trail for daily VM settlement and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: calculation_agent

attributes.name: calculation_date

attributes.name: collateral_type

attributes.name: dispute_flag

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the variation margin dispute, such as valuation disagreement, calculation error, or settlement timing issue.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date

attributes.name: fx_rate

attributes.name: independent_amount

attributes.name: interest_accrual_flag

attributes.name: minimum_transfer_amount

attributes.name: previous_vm_balance

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_regime

attributes.name: response_deadline

attributes.name: rounding_amount

attributes.name: settlement_date

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The payment mechanism used to settle the variation margin, such as wire transfer, ACH, RTGS, SWIFT, or through a central clearing house.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the variation margin settlement process. Tracks whether the margin call has been fulfilled, is pending, or encountered issues.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the variation margin settlement was completed and cash was transferred.

attributes.name: threshold_amount
attributes.description: The threshold amount specified in the CSA below which variation margin is not called. Only exposure exceeding this threshold triggers a margin call.

products.name: review
products.description: Periodic collateral review and revaluation event record for secured lending portfolios, capturing scheduled and triggered reviews of collateral adequacy. Captures review date, review type (annual, triggered, covenant breach), reviewer, LTV ratio at review, required collateral coverage, actual collateral coverage, coverage shortfall, recommended action (top-up call, substitution, release), and approval status. Supports credit risk management and covenant monitoring.

products.name: netting_set
products.description: Master record defining netting sets — groups of derivative transactions with a single counterparty subject to legally enforceable close-out netting under an ISDA Master Agreement. Captures netting set identifier, governing ISDA agreement, counterparty, netting enforceability legal opinion status, jurisdiction, product scope (rates, FX, credit, equity, commodities), and regulatory recognition status for capital purposes (Basel III SA-CCR, IMM). Fundamental to exposure calculation, CVA computation, RWA determination, and margin call netting. The netting set is the atomic unit for margin agreement exposure aggregation.

products.name: stress_valuation
products.description: This association product represents the stress-tested valuation and eligibility assessment of each collateral asset under each liquidity stress scenario. It captures scenario-specific market value shocks, haircut adjustments, eligibility changes, and monetization capacity used for LCR stress testing, CLAR reporting, and resolution planning. Each record links one collateral asset to one stress scenario with valuation parameters that exist only in the context of that specific stress test.. Existence Justification: In treasury liquidity stress testing, each collateral asset must be revalued under multiple stress scenarios (CCAR severely adverse, idiosyncratic, market-wide) with scenario-specific market value shocks, haircuts, and eligibility determinations. Conversely, each stress scenario applies different shock parameters to the entire collateral portfolio. Treasury actively manages and updates these scenario-specific valuations quarterly for LCR stress testing, CLAR reporting, and resolution planning submissions to regulators.

domains.name: treasury
domains.description: Treasury operations including liquidity management, funds transfer pricing (FTP), ALM, ALCO reporting, interest rate risk management, and balance sheet optimization. domains.references: Basel III LCR/NSFR, ALCO, FTP Standards

products.name: liquidity_position
products.description: Daily intraday and end-of-day liquidity position and forward cash flow forecast for the bank, capturing available liquid assets, cash balances across nostro accounts, central bank reserves, undrawn committed facilities, and projected inflows/outflows by currency and tenor bucket (intraday, overnight, 1W, 2W, 1M, 3M). Distinguishes contractual cash flows (loan repayments, bond maturities, coupon payments) from behavioral cash flows (deposit runoff, credit line drawdowns) under base and stress scenarios. Includes forward-looking cash flow forecast by business line for liquidity stress testing and contingency funding planning. Serves as the operational heartbeat for ALCO and treasury desk liquidity monitoring. Tracks LCR and NSFR buffer positions against regulatory minimums (Basel III / BCBS). Supports intraday liquidity monitoring per BCBS 248 and contingency funding trigger assessment. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for liquidity positions and cash flow forecasting — replaces former separate cash_flow_forecast product.

products.name: liquidity_ratio
products.description: Unified regulatory liquidity ratio record capturing both Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) calculations per legal entity and consolidated group. For LCR: captures HQLA stock, total net cash outflows over a 30-day stress horizon, and resulting LCR percentage. For NSFR: captures Available Stable Funding (ASF), Required Stable Funding (RSF) by asset/liability category, and resulting NSFR percentage. Supports daily and quarterly regulatory reporting to the Federal Reserve and OCC under Basel III. Tracks breaches, buffers, and trends against the 100% minimum thresholds for both ratios. Includes ratio type discriminator (LCR, NSFR) for unified compliance monitoring.

products.name: repo_position
products.description: Master and transactional record for repurchase agreement (repo) and reverse repo operations used for short-term secured funding and liquidity management. Master attributes: repo type (classic, sell/buy-back, tri-party), counterparty, GMRA reference, collateral ISIN, haircut, repo rate, open/term flag, start/end dates, margin call status. Transaction-level attributes: individual opening and closing leg records, settlement amounts, accrued interest, MTM valuation, margin call amounts, settlement status (T+1/T+2), and daily P&L attribution for the repo book. Feeds into treasury funding cost ledger and funding plan execution tracking. Interfaces with collateral domain for substitution and margin management. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for all repo master and transaction data — replaces former separate repo_transaction product.

products.name: ftp_rate
products.description: Comprehensive Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) product covering the full FTP lifecycle: internal transfer pricing curve construction, rate definition, and account-level allocation. Curve construction: term structure of internal transfer rates by currency, tenor, and curve type (base rate, liquidity spread, credit spread), built from market benchmarks (SOFR, OIS, swap rates) adjusted for bank-specific liquidity premiums, versioned by effective date and ALCO approval. Rate definition: FTP rates assigned to asset and liability products by tenor bucket, currency, and product type, capturing methodology (matched-maturity, pooled, hybrid), base rate index, spread components (liquidity premium, optionality charge, basis adjustment). Allocation: transactional FTP charge/credit records applied to individual loan, deposit, and investment accounts with notional balance, FTP rate, FTP amount, calculation date, and business line cost center. Enables NIM decomposition and RAROC calculation at product, segment, and LOB level. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for all FTP methodology, curves, rates, and allocations — replaces former separate transfer_pricing_curve and ftp_allocation products.
products.reference: Funds Transfer Pricing Rate — ALM/FTP Framework

attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 LEI of the legal entity booking the hedge. Required for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hedge instrument expires or settles. Defines the end of the hedge relationship.

attributes.name: mtm_valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fair value was calculated. Used for tracking valuation frequency and reporting.

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: Principal amount on which the hedge payments are calculated. Does not represent actual cash exchanged except at settlement.

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: Type of option embedded in the hedge instrument (applicable for caps, floors, and swaptions).

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which hedge payments are exchanged between counterparties.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hedge must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., Basel III, CCAR, DFAST).

attributes.name: strike_rate
attributes.description: Strike rate for cap, floor, or swaption instruments. Defines the rate at which the option becomes in-the-money.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: Date on which the hedge transaction was executed and agreed upon by both parties.

products.name: capital_ratio
products.description: Regulatory capital adequacy and planning record capturing current capital ratios (CET1, Tier 1, Total Capital), Risk-Weighted Assets by risk type (credit, market, operational), leverage ratio, and capital buffers (conservation, countercyclical, G-SIB surcharge) at legal entity and consolidated level. Includes multi-year capital planning: projected CET1 trajectories, RWA growth assumptions, dividend/buyback plans, stress scenario capital paths, and capital actions (issuance, redemption, AT1 triggers) under base and adverse scenarios. Produced for CCAR, DFAST, and Basel III Pillar 1 regulatory submissions. Tracks ALCO-approved capital targets and management buffers above regulatory minimums. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for capital ratios and capital planning — replaces former separate capital_plan product. Note: potential SSOT overlap with risk domain capital/RWA products requires global architect adjudication.
products.reference: CET1 / Basel III Capital Ratio — BCBS

attributes.name: capital_ratio_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital ratio record. Primary key for the capital ratio data product.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Capital ratio calculations require CFO/CRO approval for Basel III regulatory submissions and capital adequacy reporting. approved_by_user text field should be FK to employee_id for regulatory audit tr

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_regulatory_filing. Business justification: Capital ratios are reported in Call Reports (FFIEC 031/041), FR Y-9C, and Basel III reports. Direct linkage enables audit trail from calculated ratio to submitted filing, essential for regulatory comp

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.jurisdiction. Business justification: Capital ratios calculated per regulatory jurisdiction for Basel compliance. Link enables jurisdiction-specific capital buffers (CCyB, G-SIB), CCAR/DFAST applicability, and regulatory submission routin

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity for which capital ratios are calculated. Links to the legal entity master.

attributes.name: regulatory_taxonomy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.regulatory_taxonomy. Business justification: Capital ratio reporting follows regulatory taxonomy (Basel III/IV, FFIEC 031). Link enables taxonomy version lookup, XBRL tagging, data point mapping, and regulatory submission validation.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Capital ratios reported in regulatory currency (USD for US banks, EUR for EU banks). Link enables multi-entity consolidation, FX revaluation for group reporting, and regulatory submission validation.

attributes.name: alco_target_cet1_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset-Liability Committee (ALCO) Target Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio
attributes.description: The internal ALCO-approved target CET1 ratio, typically set above regulatory minimums to provide a management buffer for business volatility and growth.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the capital ratio calculation and capital plan within the internal governance process.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capital ratio record was approved by the authorized approver.

attributes.name: at1_trigger_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CET1 ratio has breached the contractual trigger level for AT1 instrument write-down or conversion (typically 5.125% or 7.0% depending on instrument terms).
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - AT1 Instrument Requirements

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate credit risk RWA: Standardized Approach (SA), Internal Ratings-Based Foundation (IRB-F), or Internal Ratings-Based Advanced (IRB-A).
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Credit Risk Approaches

attributes.name: capital_conservation_buffer
attributes.description: The capital conservation buffer requirement, expressed as a percentage of RWA. Standard requirement is 2.5% of RWA in CET1 capital above the minimum.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Capital Conservation Buffer

attributes.name: capital_issuance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of new capital issuance (common equity, AT1, or Tier 2 instruments) planned or executed during the reporting period.

attributes.name: capital_redemption_amount
attributes.description: The amount of capital instrument redemptions (AT1 or Tier 2 instruments) planned or executed during the reporting period.

attributes.name: cet1_buffer_amount
attributes.description: The absolute amount of CET1 capital held above the minimum regulatory requirement plus buffers, representing the management buffer or excess capital.

attributes.name: cet1_capital_amount
attributes.description: The total Common Equity Tier 1 capital amount, representing the highest quality capital consisting of common shares, retained earnings, and other comprehensive income, net of regulatory adjustments.

attributes.name: cet1_ratio
attributes.description: The CET1 capital ratio, calculated as CET1 capital divided by total RWA, expressed as a percentage. Regulatory minimum is 4.5% under Basel III.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - CET1 Ratio Requirement

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the capital ratio calculation, assumptions, or capital actions for this reporting period.

attributes.name: consolidation_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital ratio is calculated at consolidated group level, solo legal entity level, or sub-consolidated level.

attributes.name: countercyclical_buffer
attributes.description: The countercyclical capital buffer requirement, expressed as a percentage of RWA. Ranges from 0% to 2.5% and varies by jurisdiction based on credit cycle conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capital ratio record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_rwa_amount
attributes.description: Risk-weighted assets arising from credit risk exposures, calculated using either the Standardized Approach (SA) or Internal Ratings-Based (IRB) approach.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Credit Risk RWA

attributes.name: gsib_surcharge
attributes.description: The additional capital surcharge for Global Systemically Important Banks, ranging from 1.0% to 3.5% of RWA based on systemic importance score.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capital ratio record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: leverage_ratio
attributes.description: The leverage ratio, calculated as Tier 1 capital divided by total exposure measure (on- and off-balance sheet exposures), expressed as a percentage. Regulatory minimum is 3.0% under Basel III.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Leverage Ratio Requirement

attributes.name: market_rwa_amount
attributes.description: Risk-weighted assets arising from market risk exposures in the trading book, calculated under the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) or legacy market risk framework.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Market Risk RWA / FRTB

attributes.name: operational_rwa_amount
attributes.description: Risk-weighted assets arising from operational risk, calculated using the Standardized Measurement Approach (SMA) or legacy approaches.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Operational Risk RWA / SMA

attributes.name: planned_buyback_amount
attributes.description: The planned share repurchase amount for the reporting period under the capital plan.

attributes.name: planned_dividend_amount
attributes.description: The planned common stock dividend distribution amount for the reporting period under the capital plan.

attributes.name: projected_cet1_ratio_year1
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio Year 1
attributes.description: The projected CET1 ratio for the first year of the capital planning horizon under the specified scenario.
attributes.references: CCAR and DFAST Capital Planning Requirements

attributes.name: projected_cet1_ratio_year2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio Year 2
attributes.description: The projected CET1 ratio for the second year of the capital planning horizon under the specified scenario.
attributes.references: CCAR and DFAST Capital Planning Requirements

attributes.name: projected_cet1_ratio_year3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio Year 3
attributes.description: The projected CET1 ratio for the third year of the capital planning horizon under the specified scenario.
attributes.references: CCAR and DFAST Capital Planning Requirements

attributes.name: projected_rwa_growth_rate
attributes.description: The assumed annual growth rate for RWA in the capital planning scenario, expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: CCAR and DFAST Capital Planning Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_minimum_cet1_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Minimum Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio
attributes.description: The applicable regulatory minimum CET1 ratio including all buffers, representing the threshold below which capital distribution restrictions apply.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework / Federal Reserve Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital ratio record was submitted to regulatory authorities as part of formal reporting (CCAR, DFAST, Basel III Pillar 3).

attributes.name: reporting_date
attributes.description: The date for which the capital ratio is calculated and reported. Typically month-end or quarter-end for regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The reporting period identifier in format YYYY-QN for quarterly or YYYY-MNN for monthly reporting cycles.

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: The stress scenario or planning scenario under which the capital ratio is calculated. Actual represents current position, base/adverse/severely_adverse represent CCAR/DFAST stress scenarios.
attributes.references: CCAR and DFAST Stress Testing Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which the capital ratio data was extracted, typically the Risk Management Platform or Regulatory Reporting Platform.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this capital ratio was submitted to regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: tier1_capital_amount
attributes.description: The total Tier 1 capital amount, comprising CET1 capital plus Additional Tier 1 (AT1) instruments such as perpetual non-cumulative preferred stock.

attributes.name: tier1_ratio
attributes.description: The Tier 1 capital ratio, calculated as Tier 1 capital divided by total RWA, expressed as a percentage. Regulatory minimum is 6.0% under Basel III.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Tier 1 Ratio Requirement

attributes.name: tier2_capital_amount
attributes.description: The total Tier 2 capital amount, comprising subordinated debt, hybrid instruments, and loan loss reserves up to regulatory limits.

attributes.name: total_buffer_requirement
attributes.description: The sum of all capital buffer requirements (conservation, countercyclical, G-SIB surcharge), expressed as a percentage of RWA.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Combined Buffer Requirement

attributes.name: total_capital_amount
attributes.description: The sum of Tier 1 and Tier 2 capital, representing the total regulatory capital available to absorb losses.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Total Capital Definition

attributes.name: total_capital_ratio
attributes.description: The total capital ratio, calculated as total capital divided by total RWA, expressed as a percentage. Regulatory minimum is 8.0% under Basel III.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Total Capital Ratio Requirement

attributes.name: total_exposure_measure
attributes.description: The total exposure measure used in the leverage ratio calculation, comprising on-balance sheet exposures, derivative exposures, securities financing transaction exposures, and off-balance sheet items.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework - Leverage Ratio Exposure Measure

attributes.name: total_rwa_amount
attributes.description: The sum of credit, market, and operational risk-weighted assets, representing the total risk exposure for capital adequacy calculation.

products.name: capital_plan
products.description: Multi-year capital planning record capturing projected CET1 ratios, RWA growth assumptions, dividend and buyback plans, stress scenario capital trajectories, and capital actions (issuance, redemption, AT1 triggers) under base and adverse scenarios. Submitted to the Federal Reserve as part of CCAR/DFAST annual capital planning cycle. Tracks ALCO-approved capital targets and management buffers above regulatory minimums.

attributes.name: alco_meeting_id

attributes.name: consent_order_id

attributes.name: alco_approved_target_cet1_ratio

attributes.name: baseline_cet1_ratio

attributes.name: baseline_rwa_amount

attributes.name: capital_action_description

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier

attributes.name: minimum_cet1_ratio_stressed

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital plan in the regulatory submission and approval process.

attributes.name: plan_version

attributes.name: planned_capital_issuance_amount

attributes.name: planned_capital_redemption_amount

attributes.name: pre_provision_net_revenue_projection

attributes.name: projected_cet1_ratio_year_1
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio Year 1
attributes.description: Projected CET1 capital ratio at the end of year 1 under the specified scenario, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: projected_cet1_ratio_year_2

attributes.name: projected_cet1_ratio_year_3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) Ratio Year 3
attributes.description: Projected CET1 capital ratio at the end of year 3 under the specified scenario, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: projected_rwa_growth_rate_year_1
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) Growth Rate Year 1
attributes.description: Projected annual growth rate of RWA in year 1, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: projected_rwa_growth_rate_year_2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Projected Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) Growth Rate Year 2
attributes.description: Projected annual growth rate of RWA in year 2, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: projected_rwa_growth_rate_year_3
