products.name: funding_plan
products.description: Treasury funding strategy, execution, and debt issuance record capturing the banks wholesale and retail funding plan by instrument type (senior unsecured, covered bonds, FHLB advances, repo, deposits, commercial paper, CDs), target issuance volumes, maturity profile, currency mix, and cost-of-funds targets. Includes individual debt issuance execution records: ISIN/CUSIP, issuance date, maturity, coupon type/rate, currency, notional outstanding, underwriter, listing exchange, call/put features, and outstanding balance tracking. Tracks actual vs. planned funding execution, concentration limits by counterparty and instrument, and feeds into the funding maturity profile and capital structure reporting. Approved by ALCO and updated quarterly. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for funding strategy and debt issuance — replaces former separate debt_issuance product.

attributes.name: funding_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the funding plan record. Primary key for the funding plan entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Funding plans executed within specific accounting periods for budget tracking, variance analysis, and cost of funds reporting. Links funding strategy to fiscal period performance measurement.

attributes.name: alco_meeting_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to treasury.alco_meeting. Business justification: Funding plans (wholesale and retail funding strategy, debt issuance plans) are strategic treasury decisions made by ALCO. The funding_plan product has approval_date and approved_by attributes but lack

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Funding plans specify issuance currency for debt issuance strategy. Link enables multi-currency funding diversification, FX hedging decisions, and currency-specific cost of funds analysis.

attributes.name: actual_cost_of_funds_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Cost of Funds Rate (Basis Points)
attributes.description: Actual realized all-in cost of funds rate for this instrument type during the plan period, expressed as a decimal. Tracks execution vs. target pricing.

attributes.name: actual_issuance_amount
attributes.description: Actual notional amount raised through this funding instrument during the plan period, in the plan's base currency. Tracks execution vs. plan.
attributes.references: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the ALCO member or executive who approved the funding plan.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or line of business (LOB) responsible for managing this funding plan or debt issuance (e.g., Corporate Treasury, Capital Markets, Retail Banking).

attributes.name: call_date
attributes.description: Earliest date on which the issuer can exercise the call option to redeem the debt instrument. Null if not callable.

attributes.name: call_feature_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the debt instrument includes a call feature allowing the issuer to redeem the instrument before maturity. True if callable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, commentary, or context regarding the funding plan or specific issuance (e.g., market conditions, strategic rationale, execution challenges).

attributes.name: concentration_limit_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of total funding that can be sourced from this instrument type, as defined by ALCO policy. Used to enforce diversification and concentration risk limits.
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Risk Management Principles

attributes.name: counterparty_concentration_limit
attributes.description: Maximum notional amount that can be sourced from a single counterparty or investor group for this instrument type, in the plan's base currency. Enforces counterparty concentration risk limits.

attributes.name: coupon_rate
attributes.description: Annual coupon rate for the debt instrument, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0425 for 4.25%). For floating-rate instruments, this represents the spread over the reference rate.

attributes.name: coupon_type
attributes.description: Type of coupon structure for the debt instrument: fixed (constant rate), floating (variable rate linked to benchmark), zero-coupon (no periodic interest), step-up (increasing rate schedule), callable (issuer redemption option), or puttable (investor redemption option).
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding plan record was first created in the system. ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: cusip
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP)
attributes.description: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) identifier for the specific debt issuance, if applicable. 9-character alphanumeric code used in North America.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of funding instrument covered by this plan entry (e.g., senior unsecured bonds, covered bonds, Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advances, repurchase agreements (repo), retail deposits, commercial paper (CP), certificates of deposit (CDs), subordinated debt). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: senior_unsecured|covered_bonds|fhlb_advances|repo|deposits|commercial_paper|certificates_of_deposit|subordinated_debt|tier2_capital|preferred_stock — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Basel III Capital and Liquidity Framework

attributes.name: isin
attributes.description: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) for the specific debt issuance, if applicable. 12-character alphanumeric code (ISO 6166 standard).

attributes.name: issuance_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the debt instrument was issued to investors. Represents the trade date for the issuance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this funding plan record was last updated in the system. ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: lcr_treatment
attributes.description: Classification of the funding source for Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) calculation purposes: stable (retail deposits with low run-off), less-stable (higher run-off), operational (operational deposits), non-operational (wholesale funding), or excluded (not included in LCR).
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: 20-character Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) of the issuing legal entity. ISO 17442 standard identifier for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: listing_exchange
attributes.description: Name of the stock exchange or trading venue where the debt instrument is listed (e.g., New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), London Stock Exchange (LSE), Luxembourg Stock Exchange). Null if unlisted.
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Regulation S-K

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Scheduled maturity date of the debt instrument, when principal repayment is due. May be subject to call/put features.

attributes.name: notional_outstanding
attributes.description: Current outstanding notional principal amount of the debt instrument, in the instrument's currency. Tracks amortization and prepayments.

attributes.name: nsfr_treatment
attributes.description: Classification of the funding source for Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) calculation purposes: stable (high available stable funding factor), less-stable (lower factor), wholesale (institutional funding), or excluded (not included in NSFR).
attributes.references: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Business name or title of the funding plan (e.g., 'FY2024 Q2 Wholesale Funding Strategy', '2024 Annual Debt Issuance Plan').

attributes.name: plan_period_end_date
attributes.description: The effective end date of the funding plan period (e.g., end of fiscal quarter or year).

attributes.name: plan_period_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the funding plan period (e.g., beginning of fiscal quarter or year).

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the funding plan: draft (under development), approved (ALCO-approved), active (in execution), executed (fully completed), closed (archived), or cancelled (terminated before execution).

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the funding plan by strategic purpose: wholesale (institutional funding), retail (deposit-based), hybrid (mixed sources), contingency (stress scenario), or strategic (long-term capital structure).
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Risk Management Principles

attributes.name: put_date
attributes.description: Earliest date on which the investor can exercise the put option to demand redemption. Null if not puttable.

attributes.name: put_feature_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the debt instrument includes a put feature allowing the investor to demand early redemption. True if puttable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reference_rate
attributes.description: Benchmark reference rate for floating-rate instruments (e.g., Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR), London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), Euro Interbank Offered Rate (EURIBOR)). Null for fixed-rate instruments.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) IBOR Fallbacks Protocol

attributes.name: regulatory_capital_treatment
attributes.description: Classification of the funding instrument for regulatory capital purposes: Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1), Additional Tier 1 (Tier1), Tier 2 (Tier2), non-capital (does not qualify), or excluded (not applicable).

attributes.name: target_cost_of_funds_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Cost of Funds Rate (Basis Points)
attributes.description: Planned or target all-in cost of funds rate for this instrument type, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0325 for 3.25% or 325 basis points). Includes coupon, fees, and issuance costs.

products.name: nostro_account
products.description: Master record and daily reconciliation for the banks nostro accounts held at correspondent banks globally. Master attributes: account number, correspondent bank BIC/SWIFT, currency, account purpose (settlement, FX, securities), authorized signatories, overdraft limit, account status. Reconciliation attributes: daily matching of internal ledger balances against correspondent bank statements (MT940/MT950), matched/unmatched items (breaks), break aging by category, reconciliation status, resolution actions, and escalation triggers. Critical for RTGS and SWIFT payment settlement, FX position management, and intraday liquidity monitoring (BCBS 248). Regulatory requirement under OCC guidance on correspondent banking controls. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for nostro master data and reconciliation — replaces former separate nostro_reconciliation product.

products.name: balance_sheet_position
products.description: Treasury-managed balance sheet position, interest rate risk analytics, and ALM risk snapshot capturing asset and liability balances by product type, currency, legal entity, business line, repricing tenor, and maturity bucket. Includes comprehensive interest rate risk metrics: repricing gap analysis by tenor bucket, duration of equity, Economic Value of Equity (EVE) sensitivity, and Net Interest Income (NII) sensitivity across rate shock scenarios (+/-100bps, +/-200bps, +/-300bps). Tracks basis risk, yield curve risk, and optionality risk components per BCBS 368 (IRRBB). Aggregates loan book, deposit book, securities portfolio, derivatives MTM, and wholesale funding positions into a unified treasury management view. Supports NIM analysis, duration gap management, FTP profitability attribution, and FX position management for treasurys own book. Produced daily and as-of-month-end for ALCO review and regulatory reporting. Distinct from the ledger domains journal-level GL balances. Post-merge: this is the single source of truth for balance sheet positions and interest rate risk — replaces former separate interest_rate_risk_position product.

attributes.description: The contractual maturity date of the position.

attributes.name: nii_sensitivity_100bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Interest Income (NII) Sensitivity +/-100 Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: The projected change in Net Interest Income over a 12-month horizon under a parallel shift of +/-100 basis points in interest rates.

attributes.name: nii_sensitivity_200bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Interest Income (NII) Sensitivity +/-200 Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: The projected change in Net Interest Income over a 12-month horizon under a parallel shift of +/-200 basis points in interest rates.

attributes.name: nii_sensitivity_300bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Interest Income (NII) Sensitivity +/-300 Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: The projected change in Net Interest Income over a 12-month horizon under a parallel shift of +/-300 basis points in interest rates.

attributes.name: nim_contribution_bps
attributes.description: The contribution of this position to the overall Net Interest Margin, expressed in basis points.

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: The notional or principal amount of the balance sheet position in the original currency.

attributes.name: nsfr_asf_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) Available Stable Funding (ASF) Factor
attributes.description: The Available Stable Funding factor applied to this position for NSFR calculation.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Basel III NSFR

attributes.name: nsfr_rsf_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) Required Stable Funding (RSF) Factor
attributes.description: The Required Stable Funding factor applied to this position for NSFR calculation.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Basel III NSFR

attributes.name: optionality_risk_amount
attributes.description: The exposure to optionality risk, arising from embedded options in financial instruments (e.g., prepayment options, caps, floors).

attributes.name: position_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this balance sheet position is reported.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this balance sheet position.

attributes.name: position_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when this balance sheet position snapshot was captured.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is included in regulatory reporting submissions.

attributes.name: repricing_gap_amount
attributes.description: The net repricing gap (rate-sensitive assets minus rate-sensitive liabilities) for this position within its tenor bucket.

attributes.name: repricing_tenor_bucket
attributes.description: The time bucket indicating when the interest rate on this position will next reprice (e.g., overnight, 1-3 months, 3-6 months, 1-2 years).

attributes.name: risk_weight_percent
attributes.description: The risk weight percentage applied to this position for regulatory capital calculation purposes.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Basel III

attributes.name: rwa_amount
attributes.description: The risk-weighted asset amount calculated for this position under Basel III regulatory capital rules.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Basel III

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this balance sheet position data originated.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_type
attributes.description: The type of stress scenario applied to this position (e.g., baseline, adverse, severely adverse, custom).

attributes.name: yield_curve_risk_amount
attributes.description: The exposure to yield curve risk, arising from non-parallel shifts in the yield curve.

products.name: investment_portfolio
products.description: Treasury investment portfolio record for the banks own investment book (AFS, HTM, trading securities). Captures portfolio classification, accounting treatment, duration target, and yield objective.

attributes.name: investment_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the treasury investment portfolio record. Primary key for the investment portfolio entity.

attributes.name: benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.benchmark. Business justification: Investment portfolios track performance against benchmark indices (Bloomberg Barclays Aggregate, S&P 500, custom benchmarks). Portfolio performance attribution, ALCO reporting, investment mandate comp

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Investment portfolios denominated in specific currencies for valuation and FX hedging. Link enables currency validation, FX revaluation, HQLA eligibility by currency, and multi-currency portfolio repo

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.fund. Business justification: Treasury investment portfolios hold money market funds, bond funds, and ETFs as part of liquidity buffer and yield optimization strategy. ALCO reviews fund allocations, duration, credit quality, and p

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Investment portfolios are balance sheet assets requiring GL account mapping for fair value accounting, unrealized gain/loss reporting (OCI), and monthly valuation entries per ASC 320/IFRS 9.

attributes.name: investment_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to hr.employee

attributes.name: primary_investment_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the portfolio manager responsible for investment decisions and performance of this portfolio.

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: Total accrued interest receivable on fixed income securities in the portfolio from last coupon payment date to current valuation date.

attributes.name: alco_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this investment portfolio is included in regular ALCO reporting and oversight for balance sheet management and interest rate risk.

attributes.name: book_value_amount
attributes.description: Amortized cost or book value of all securities in the portfolio as recorded in the general ledger under applicable accounting standards.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Treasury business unit or desk responsible for managing this investment portfolio.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the investment portfolio.

attributes.name: convexity
attributes.description: Convexity measure of the portfolio indicating the curvature of the price-yield relationship and the rate of change of duration as interest rates change.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investment portfolio record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_rating_average
attributes.description: Weighted average credit rating of all securities in the portfolio based on ratings from major credit rating agencies (Moody's, S&P, Fitch).
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: current_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Current yield of the portfolio calculated as annual coupon income divided by current market value, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date when the investment portfolio was established and became operational for investment activity.

attributes.name: investment_objective
attributes.description: Primary investment objective of the portfolio such as capital preservation, income generation, liquidity management, or total return optimization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investment portfolio record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_rebalance_date
attributes.description: Date when the portfolio was last rebalanced to align with target allocation, duration, or risk parameters.

attributes.name: lcr_treatment
attributes.description: Classification of the portfolio for Liquidity Coverage Ratio calculation under Basel III, indicating the level of High Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA) eligibility.
attributes.references: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) Framework

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier of the bank entity that owns and manages this investment portfolio for regulatory reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: market_value_amount
attributes.description: Current market value of all securities and investments held in the portfolio based on latest mark-to-market valuation.
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: modified_duration_years
attributes.description: Modified duration of the portfolio measuring interest rate sensitivity. Indicates the approximate percentage change in portfolio value for a 1% change in interest rates.
attributes.references: Asset-Liability Management (ALM) Framework, Basel III Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of the investment portfolio strategy, performance, and compliance with investment policy.

attributes.name: nsfr_treatment
attributes.description: Required Stable Funding (RSF) factor applied to the portfolio for Net Stable Funding Ratio calculation under Basel III liquidity standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rsf_0|rsf_5|rsf_10|rsf_15|rsf_50|rsf_65|rsf_85|rsf_100 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Basel III Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR) Framework

attributes.name: portfolio_classification
attributes.description: Accounting classification of the investment portfolio under IFRS 9 or GAAP standards. Determines measurement and recognition treatment for gains and losses.

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the investment portfolio for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: portfolio_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the investment portfolio used in regulatory reporting and ALCO presentations. Unique across the organization.

attributes.name: portfolio_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the investment portfolio indicating whether it is actively managed, restricted from new investments, or closed.

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss_ytd_amount
attributes.description: Year-to-date realized gains or losses from securities sold or matured from the portfolio, recognized in profit and loss statement.

attributes.name: regulatory_capital_treatment
attributes.description: Regulatory capital treatment classification for the portfolio under Basel III framework, indicating risk weighting and capital requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this investment portfolio is subject to regulatory reporting requirements to central banks, banking supervisors, or securities regulators.
attributes.references: Basel III Regulatory Reporting Framework, SEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: risk_weight_percentage
attributes.description: Weighted average risk weight percentage applied to the portfolio for Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) calculation under Basel III standardized or internal ratings-based approach.
attributes.references: Basel III Standardized Approach for Credit Risk

attributes.name: rwa_amount
attributes.description: Total Risk-Weighted Assets amount for the investment portfolio used in regulatory capital ratio calculations under Basel III framework.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream operational system that is the system of record for this investment portfolio data, such as treasury management system or portfolio management platform.

attributes.name: target_duration_years
attributes.description: Target modified duration in years for the investment portfolio to manage interest rate risk exposure in alignment with ALM strategy.

attributes.name: target_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Target yield or return objective for the investment portfolio expressed as an annual percentage rate.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the investment portfolio was closed or terminated. Null for active portfolios.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative unrealized gain or loss on the portfolio calculated as the difference between market value and book value. Positive values indicate gains, negative values indicate losses.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent mark-to-market valuation for the investment portfolio and all its holdings.
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement, FASB ASC 820

attributes.name: weighted_average_maturity_years
attributes.description: Weighted average time to maturity of all securities in the portfolio expressed in years, weighted by market value of each holding.

attributes.name: yield_to_maturity_percentage
attributes.description: Weighted average yield to maturity of all fixed income securities in the portfolio expressed as an annual percentage rate.

attributes.name: parent_investment_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on investment_portfolio (parent_investment_portfolio_id)

domains.name: ledger
domains.description: General ledger and financial accounting system of record covering chart of accounts, journal entries, subledgers, cost centers, intercompany eliminations, AP/AR, financial close, consolidation, and trial balance. Supports SOX financial controls and IFRS/GAAP reporting. Primary system of record aligned with Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA.

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master registry of all general ledger account codes used across the enterprise, defining the financial reporting structure including account number, account name, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), normal balance direction, financial statement mapping (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow), IFRS/GAAP classification, consolidation group, and active status. Sourced from Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts module. Serves as the foundational reference for all journal entries and financial reporting.
products.reference: GL Chart of Accounts (Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account in the chart of accounts master registry.

attributes.name: account_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Chart of accounts must specify native currency for each account to support multi-currency GL operations, currency-specific reporting, and FX revaluation processes required in global banking operations

attributes.name: gaap_classification_reporting_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gaap Classification Reporting Code Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reporting_code. Business justification: Chart of accounts maps to GAAP reporting codes for regulatory filing; this link enables automated financial statement preparation and US GAAP compliance reporting.

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying the general ledger account. This is the externally-known business identifier used in all journal entries and financial reports. Typically follows a hierarchical numbering scheme (e.g., 1000-1999 for assets, 2000-2999 for liabilities).

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: A detailed description of the purpose, usage guidelines, and business rules for this account. Provides additional context beyond the account name for users posting journal entries and for auditors reviewing account activity.

attributes.name: account_level
attributes.description: The level of this account in the chart of accounts hierarchy (e.g., 1 for top-level summary accounts, 2 for sub-categories, 3 for detail accounts). Used for drill-down reporting and financial statement presentation at different levels of detail.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Hierarchy

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the general ledger account (e.g., 'Cash and Cash Equivalents', 'Accounts Receivable - Trade', 'Interest Income on Loans'). This is the human-readable label used in financial statements and reports.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the general ledger account. Active accounts accept postings; inactive accounts are closed and do not accept new postings; blocked accounts are temporarily suspended; pending closure accounts are in the process of being closed after final reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: account_subtype
attributes.description: A more granular classification within the account type (e.g., 'current asset', 'fixed asset', 'current liability', 'long-term liability', 'operating revenue', 'non-operating revenue', 'operating expense', 'non-operating expense'). Used for detailed financial statement presentation and analysis.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account determining its placement in the financial statements and its normal balance direction. Asset and expense accounts have debit normal balances; liability, equity, and revenue accounts have credit normal balances.

attributes.name: alternate_account_code
attributes.description: An alternate or legacy account code used for cross-reference purposes during system migrations, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), or for mapping to external reporting frameworks. Allows historical data to be linked to the current chart of accounts structure.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: The consolidation grouping code used for multi-entity financial consolidation and elimination of intercompany transactions. Identifies which legal entities or business units this account applies to and how it should be treated in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The default cost center or responsibility center associated with this account for management accounting and internal reporting. Used for departmental P&L, budget tracking, and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account was closed or became inactive. Null for currently active accounts. Once an account is closed, no new postings are allowed, but historical balances and transactions remain accessible for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account became active and available for posting in the general ledger. Used for historical analysis and to prevent backdated postings to accounts that did not exist in prior periods.

attributes.name: financial_statement_category
attributes.description: Identifies the primary financial statement where this account is reported (balance sheet for assets/liabilities/equity, income statement for revenue/expenses, cash flow statement for cash movements, statement of changes in equity for equity movements).

attributes.name: financial_statement_line_item
attributes.description: The specific line item or caption on the financial statement where this account balance is aggregated and presented (e.g., 'Cash and Cash Equivalents', 'Property Plant and Equipment', 'Interest Income', 'Salaries and Benefits'). Maps the detailed GL account to the published financial statement presentation.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area or business process this account supports (e.g., 'Commercial Lending', 'Investment Banking', 'Treasury', 'Risk Management', 'Operations', 'Technology'). Used for functional cost allocation and activity-based costing.

attributes.name: ifrs_classification
attributes.description: The classification of this account under IFRS accounting standards, including specific IAS/IFRS standard references where applicable (e.g., 'IAS 16 - Property Plant and Equipment', 'IFRS 9 - Financial Instruments', 'IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers'). Used for international statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions between legal entities within the consolidated group. Intercompany accounts are subject to elimination entries during financial consolidation to remove intra-group transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this account record. Used for audit trail and accountability in chart of accounts maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this account record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: legal_entity_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary to which this account belongs. Used for multi-entity accounting, statutory reporting by legal entity, and intercompany elimination processing.

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance. Asset and expense accounts have debit normal balances; liability, equity, and revenue accounts have credit normal balances. Used for validation of journal entries and trial balance preparation.

attributes.name: parent_account_code
attributes.description: The account code of the parent account in a hierarchical chart of accounts structure. Used for roll-up reporting and financial statement aggregation. Null for top-level accounts.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Hierarchy

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct manual journal entries are allowed to this account, or whether it is a control/summary account that only receives automated postings from subledgers. Control accounts typically have this flag set to false to prevent manual posting errors.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The default profit center or business unit associated with this account for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Used for line of business (LOB) reporting and RAROC calculations.

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external statements or subledger systems (e.g., bank statements, loan subledger, securities positions). Accounts flagged for reconciliation are subject to monthly close procedures and variance investigation.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: The classification of this account for banking regulatory reports such as Call Reports (FFIEC 031/041), FR Y-9C, Basel III capital adequacy reporting, and liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) calculations. Maps GL accounts to regulatory reporting line items.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve FR Y-9C, FFIEC Call Report Instructions, Basel III Framework

attributes.name: risk_weighted_asset_category
attributes.description: The Basel III risk-weighted asset category for this account, used in capital adequacy calculations (e.g., 'credit risk - corporate exposures', 'credit risk - retail exposures', 'market risk', 'operational risk'). Determines the risk weighting applied for Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio calculations.
attributes.references: Basel III Framework, Federal Reserve Regulation Q

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) internal control testing and documentation requirements. Accounts flagged as SOX-controlled require additional review, approval workflows, and audit trail documentation for all journal entries.

attributes.name: statistical_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical (non-monetary) account used to track quantities, headcount, or other non-financial metrics for management reporting and ratio analysis (e.g., number of employees, number of accounts, transaction volumes). Statistical accounts do not appear in financial statements but support KPI calculations.

attributes.name: subledger_source
attributes.description: The name of the subledger system that feeds detailed transactions into this GL account (e.g., 'Loan Origination System', 'Trading System', 'Accounts Payable', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Fixed Assets'). Used for subledger-to-GL reconciliation and drill-down analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA Integration Architecture

attributes.name: tax_line_mapping
attributes.description: The mapping of this account to specific lines on corporate tax returns (e.g., IRS Form 1120 line references, state tax return schedules). Used for tax provision calculation, deferred tax accounting, and tax compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this account in the chart of accounts master. Used for audit trail and accountability in chart of accounts maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Individual general ledger account instance within a specific ledger set and legal entity, representing the operational account used for posting. Captures account code, account description, account category, currency, ledger assignment, cost center linkage, intercompany flag, revaluation flag, reconciliation flag, budget control flag, and effective date range. Distinct from chart_of_accounts (the template) — this is the instantiated account within a specific legal entity and ledger context in Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA.
products.reference: GL Account Master (Oracle Financials COA Segment / SAP G/L Account)

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account instance within a specific ledger set and legal entity. Primary key for the GL account operational record.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL Account Structure, SAP S/4HANA GL Master Data

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chart of accounts template from which this account is instantiated. The COA defines the account structure and hierarchy.
attributes.references: FASB Accounting Standards Codification, IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center or responsibility center to which this account is assigned. Enables management accounting, budgeting, and performance analysis by organizational unit.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices, SAP Controlling (CO) Module

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: GL accounts track balances in specific currencies; this link enables currency-specific balance reporting, revaluation processing, and multi-currency consolidation required for IFRS and US GAAP complia

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity under which this GL account is instantiated. A GL account is specific to a legal entity context for regulatory and consolidation purposes.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit or line of business (LOB) to which this account belongs. Supports divisional reporting and performance measurement.

attributes.name: parent_account_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent account in the account hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical financial analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Account Hierarchy, SAP GL Account Group

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center for internal profitability analysis. Used for segment reporting and management decision-making.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments, SAP Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.reporting_code. Business justification: GL accounts are tagged with regulatory reporting codes for automated regulatory report generation; this link enables Basel III, CCAR, DFAST, and other prudential reporting.

attributes.name: set_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ledger set (primary, secondary, reporting, tax) to which this account belongs. Supports multiple accounting bases (GAAP, IFRS, tax) and parallel ledgers.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Ledger Architecture, SAP S/4HANA Ledger Concept

attributes.name: account_category
attributes.description: Sub-classification within the account type (e.g., current asset, fixed asset, operating expense, cost of goods sold). Used for financial statement line item grouping and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, Basel III Pillar 3 Disclosure

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying this account within the chart of accounts. Typically structured (e.g., segment-based) to encode account type, department, and classification.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Account Flexfield, SAP S/4HANA GL Account Number

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Extended description of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and posting rules. Provides detailed context for accounting staff and auditors.

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this account in the chart of accounts hierarchy (1=top level, increasing for detail accounts). Used for reporting aggregation and drill-down.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the GL account, providing human-readable identification of the account purpose (e.g., Cash and Cash Equivalents, Accounts Receivable - Trade).

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the GL account. Inactive or closed accounts do not accept new postings but retain historical balances.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Account Lifecycle, SAP GL Account Master

attributes.name: account_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular classification within the account category for detailed financial analysis and management reporting (e.g., trade receivables, employee receivables, intercompany receivables).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Determines financial statement presentation and normal balance (debit/credit).
attributes.references: FASB Conceptual Framework, IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: alternate_account_code
attributes.description: An alternative account code used for external reporting, regulatory filings, or legacy system integration. Supports cross-reference and mapping requirements.

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account are subject to budget availability checking. Prevents overspending and enforces fiscal discipline.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Budget Control, SAP Funds Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL account becomes inactive and no longer accepts postings. Null for accounts with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account becomes active and available for posting. Supports temporal account management and reorganizations.

attributes.name: financial_statement_line_item
attributes.description: The financial statement line item to which this account rolls up for external reporting (e.g., Cash and Cash Equivalents, Property Plant and Equipment).
attributes.references: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions requiring elimination during consolidation. Critical for group financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this GL account record. Critical for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account record was last modified. Enables change detection and audit trail reconstruction.

attributes.name: materiality_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold above which variances or adjustments to this account require additional review or approval. Used for risk-based controls and audit scoping.

attributes.name: natural_balance
attributes.description: The normal balance side for this account: debit for assets and expenses, credit for liabilities, equity, and revenue. Used for balance validation and error detection.

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct journal entries can be posted to this account. Summary or control accounts typically do not allow direct posting.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials Account Attributes, SAP GL Account Master

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for account reconciliation: daily for high-volume transaction accounts, monthly for standard accounts, quarterly for low-activity accounts.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external statements or subledger detail. Key control for SOX compliance and audit readiness.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: revaluation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to foreign exchange revaluation or fair value remeasurement at period end. Applies to foreign currency accounts and financial instruments.
attributes.references: IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates, IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to SOX internal control testing and documentation requirements. High-risk accounts require enhanced controls and audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: statistical_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical (non-monetary) account used for tracking quantities, headcount, or other non-financial metrics for allocation and analysis purposes.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices, SAP Statistical Key Figures

attributes.name: tax_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for tax-related transactions (VAT, sales tax, withholding tax). Subject to specific tax reporting and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: third_party_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is a control account for a subledger (AP, AR, fixed assets). Balance must reconcile to subledger detail.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Header record for a general ledger journal entry representing a balanced debit/credit accounting transaction posted to the GL. Captures journal number, source (manual, subledger, intercompany, accrual, revaluation, reversal, recurring, reclassification, top-side adjustment, statistical), category, accounting date, period, ledger, legal entity, currency, total debits/credits, functional currency equivalent, description, preparer, approver, approval status, posting status, reversal indicator, reversal date, batch reference, and SOX control reference. Accruals, FX revaluations, reclassifications, recurring entries, and top-side adjustments are subtypes distinguished by journal source — not separate products. Primary transactional entity of the ledger domain supporting the full GL posting lifecycle including automated posting rules, approval workflows, and audit trail for SOX Section 302/404 compliance.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational accounting unit used for cost allocation, revenue attribution, profitability measurement, and management accounting within the bank. Represents any discrete area of financial responsibility — functioning as a cost center, revenue center, or profit center (including banking segment, product line, geographic region, or shared service unit). Captures unit code, name, type (cost, revenue, profit, shared service), responsible manager/executive, legal entity, business unit, line of business (LOB), geographic region, hierarchy level, parent unit, FTP rate assignment, revenue allocation method, cost allocation method, transfer pricing method, effective date range, and active status. Supports FTP allocation, RAROC reporting, PnL attribution, IFRS 8 segment reporting, Basel III business line mapping, and management accounting across Oracle Financials / SAP S/4HANA. This product is the single source of truth for all organizational accounting units regardless of whether they are measured on cost, revenue, or profit.

products.name: subledger
products.description: Registry of subledger modules that feed into the general ledger, combined with the operational reconciliation records that verify subledger-to-GL integrity each period. Captures subledger configuration: name, type (accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, loans, securities, payroll, derivatives), source system, GL transfer method, posting frequency, and control account mapping. Also captures period-end reconciliation execution: reconciliation run ID, accounting period, GL account range, subledger aggregate balance, GL posted balance, variance amount, variance root cause, reconciliation status (reconciled, in-progress, exception, escalated), auto-reconciliation flag, preparer, reviewer, approval date, resolution actions, and SOX control evidence reference. This product is the single source of truth for both subledger configuration and subledger-to-GL reconciliation governance, supporting period-end close compliance for SOX Section 302/404 and external audit requirements.

products.name: ledger_sox_control
products.description: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) record defining a specific control activity within the ledger domain. Captures control ID, control name, description, type (preventive, detective), frequency (daily, monthly, quarterly, annual), control owner, GL process area, risk assertion (completeness, accuracy, existence, valuation, presentation, rights and obligations), testing method, last test date, test result (effective, deficiency, significant deficiency, material weakness), remediation plan, remediation status, remediation due date, and external auditor reference. Supports SOX Section 302/404 compliance, PCAOB inspection readiness, and internal audit coordination.
products.reference: SOX Internal Control (PCAOB AS 2201 / COSO Framework)

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control: active (currently in operation), inactive (temporarily suspended), retired (no longer applicable), or under review (being evaluated for changes).

attributes.description: Classification of the control based on its timing and purpose: preventive (stops errors before they occur), detective (identifies errors after occurrence), or corrective (remediates identified errors).

attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is an entity-level control (true) that operates across the organization (e.g., tone at the top, code of conduct, risk assessment), or a process-level control (false).

attributes.description: Reference number or identifier used by the external auditor (e.g., Big Four firm) to track this control in their audit workpapers and PCAOB inspection documentation.

attributes.name: gl_process_area

attributes.name: it_dependent_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this control relies on IT general controls (ITGC) or automated system controls for its effectiveness.

attributes.name: key_control_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a key control (true) that directly addresses a significant risk to financial reporting, or a supporting control (false).

attributes.name: last_test_date

attributes.name: last_test_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent control test: effective (operating as designed), deficiency (minor issue), significant deficiency (important enough to merit attention), material weakness (reasonable possibility of material misstatement), or not tested.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this control record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the remediation plan must be completed and the control deficiency resolved.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action plan to address identified control deficiencies, significant deficiencies, or material weaknesses.

attributes.name: remediation_status

attributes.name: risk_assertion
attributes.description: The financial statement assertion this control addresses: completeness (all transactions recorded), accuracy (amounts correct), existence (assets/liabilities exist), valuation (proper measurement), presentation (proper classification and disclosure), or rights and obligations (entity has legal claim).

products.name: account_testing_scope
products.description: This association product represents the audit scope relationship between gl_account and engagement. It captures the specific GL accounts selected for testing within each internal audit engagement, including the rationale for inclusion, risk assessment, sampling methodology, testing period, and materiality thresholds. Each record links one GL account to one engagement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit scope decision.. Existence Justification: In banking internal audit operations, each audit engagement tests multiple GL accounts based on risk assessment, materiality, and regulatory requirements, and each GL account may be tested across multiple engagements over time (annual audits, SOX testing, regulatory exams, targeted reviews). The audit team actively manages the scope selection for each engagement, documenting why specific accounts are included, the risk rating for each account in that engagement context, the sampling approach, testing period, and materiality thresholds. This is a recognized business process called 'audit scope definition' or 'account testing scope.'

products.name: rule_validation
products.description: This association product represents the validation testing relationship between monitoring_rule and engagement. It captures the audit testing and validation activities performed on AML/BSA monitoring rules during internal audit engagements. Each record links one monitoring rule to one audit engagement with validation results, effectiveness assessments, and tuning recommendations that exist only in the context of this specific audit test.. Existence Justification: In banking audit operations, a single AML/BSA audit engagement routinely validates multiple monitoring rules (e.g., an annual AML audit tests structuring detection, rapid movement, high-risk geography, and peer group anomaly rules). Conversely, a single monitoring rule is validated across multiple audit engagements over time (annual AML audits, model validation engagements, continuous monitoring reviews, regulatory response audits). The business actively manages rule validation testing as an operational process, tracking effectiveness ratings, false positive rates, alert volumes reviewed, and tuning recommendations for each rule-engagement combination.

attributes.name: monitoring_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the AML/BSA monitoring rule being validated in this audit engagement

attributes.name: alert_volume_reviewed
attributes.description: Number of alerts generated by this monitoring rule that were sampled and reviewed during the audit engagement. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: auditor_notes
attributes.description: Free-text observations, findings, and contextual notes recorded by the auditor during validation testing of this rule.

attributes.name: exceptions_identified
attributes.description: Number of control exceptions or deficiencies identified during testing of this monitoring rule in this engagement.

attributes.name: false_positive_rate_observed
attributes.description: Percentage of alerts generated by this rule during the audit period that were determined to be false positives, as measured during engagement testing. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: last_validation_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific rule validation testing was completed during the engagement. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: rule_effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Audit assessment of the monitoring rule's effectiveness in detecting the intended risk scenarios during the engagement testing period. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of transactions or alerts sampled for testing this rule during the engagement, supporting the statistical validity of validation results.

attributes.name: tuning_recommendations
attributes.description: Auditor recommendations for threshold adjustments, logic refinements, or parameter changes to improve rule effectiveness or reduce false positives. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: validation_methodology
attributes.description: Audit testing approach used to validate this rule during the engagement (e.g., transaction sampling, back-testing, scenario analysis, model validation). Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the validation testing for this rule within this engagement lifecycle.

products.name: coverage
products.description: This association product represents the testing relationship between a compliance obligation and an internal audit engagement. It captures the scope, timing, and approach used to test each obligation within each audit engagement. Each record links one obligation to one engagement with attributes that exist only in the context of this testing relationship, enabling the bank to track which obligations are covered by which audits, when they were tested, and what testing approach was used.. Existence Justification: In banking audit and compliance operations, a single internal audit engagement routinely tests multiple regulatory obligations (e.g., a BSA/AML engagement covers CTR filing, SAR filing, CIP, and CDD obligations simultaneously), and conversely, a single compliance obligation requires testing across multiple audit engagements throughout the year (e.g., SOX 404 control testing spans quarterly IT audits, annual financial audits, and specialized process audits). The business actively manages this coverage relationship through audit planning, tracks testing approach and timing for each obligation-engagement pair, and refers to this as the Audit Coverage Mapping or Obligation Testing Matrix.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance obligation being tested in this audit engagement

attributes.name: coverage_status
attributes.description: Current status of this coverage record: planned (scheduled but not started), in progress (testing underway), completed (testing finished), deferred (postponed to future engagement), or cancelled (removed from scope).

attributes.name: findings_count
attributes.description: Number of audit findings or exceptions identified for this obligation during this engagement. Used for risk assessment and remediation tracking.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: The date when testing of this obligation was last completed within this engagement. Used to track testing currency and plan future coverage.

attributes.name: next_test_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date when this obligation must be tested again, based on the testing frequency and risk rating. Used for audit planning and coverage gap analysis.

products.name: session
products.description: Transactional record capturing each authenticated or anonymous customer session across all channels — mobile app, web banking, branch visit, ATM interaction, and contact center call. products.name: interaction
products.description: Transactional record of each discrete customer interaction event across any channel, serving as the single source of truth for all channel-originated transaction and engagement activity. Uses a channel_type discriminator to capture channel-specific attributes: ATM transactions (withdrawal, deposit, balance inquiry, cardless cash, PIN change — with network, authorization/response codes, surcharge, cash dispensed flag), branch teller transactions (cash deposit, withdrawal, check cashing, wire initiation, cashiers checks, foreign currency exchange, safe deposit box access — with teller ID, CTR threshold flag for BSA/FinCEN $10K reporting, override approvals), digital banking actions (login, transfer, bill pay, account inquiry), contact center interactions (IVR path, agent interaction, chat, email), and API calls (endpoint, response code, payload size). Captures interaction type, channel reference, timestamp, duration, amount (where applicable), currency, outcome, associated product/service, staff member (for branch/RM), resolution status, and session reference. Enables omnichannel journey reconstruction, SLA measurement, regulatory transaction reporting (CTR/SAR), and channel performance analytics.

products.name: sla
products.description: Master record defining SLA targets and thresholds for each channel and interaction type combination, including breach event tracking. Captures SLA name, channel type, interaction category (account inquiry, loan application, wire transfer, complaint), target response time, target resolution time, escalation thresholds, measurement methodology, effective date range, and regulatory basis (CFPB complaint resolution timelines, OCC service standards). Also records each SLA breach instance: breach type (response time, resolution time, escalation), actual vs. target metric, breach severity, root cause category, responsible channel/team, remediation action taken, customer impact assessment, and breach penalty applied. Feeds SLA monitoring dashboards, regulatory reporting (CFPB complaint SLA compliance), and operational improvement programs.

products.name: journey

attributes.description: Risk score assigned by the fraud detection system indicating the likelihood of fraudulent activity, typically ranging from 0 (low risk) to 100 (high risk).

products.name: branch_audit_scope
products.description: This association product represents the audit scope relationship between branch and engagement. It captures the inclusion of a specific branch location within an internal audit engagement, including branch-specific risk assessments, sample parameters, and audit findings. Each record links one branch to one engagement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific audit coverage.. Existence Justification: In banking internal audit operations, audit engagements routinely cover multiple branch locations (regional audits, thematic compliance reviews, network-wide cash audits), and each branch is subject to multiple audit engagements over time (annual operational audits, surprise cash counts, BSA/AML reviews, SOX testing). The audit function actively manages the scope definition by assigning branches to engagements, tracking branch-specific risk ratings, sample sizes, findings counts, and audit status per branch.

products.name: audit_scope
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific banking channel within the scope of an internal audit engagement. It captures the audit scope boundaries, risk assessment, transaction sampling parameters, and audit effort allocation for each channel-engagement combination. Each record links one channel to one engagement with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit scope relationship.. Existence Justification: In banking internal audit operations, a single audit engagement routinely covers multiple channels (branch network, ATM network, digital banking, contact center) to assess omnichannel risk, customer experience, and control effectiveness across the channel ecosystem. Conversely, each banking channel is audited by multiple engagements over time—annual operational audits, regulatory examinations, SOX compliance reviews, incident-driven investigations, and thematic audits. The audit function actively manages the scope definition for each engagement, explicitly selecting which channels to include, allocating audit hours per channel, assessing channel-specific risk ratings, sampling transactions, and tracking findings at the channel level.

products.name: rule_configuration
products.description: This association product represents the configuration relationship between banking channels and fraud detection rules. It captures channel-specific rule tuning, performance metrics, and threshold adjustments that exist only in the context of a specific channel-rule pairing. Each record links one channel to one detection rule with performance data and configuration parameters that vary by channel.. Existence Justification: In banking fraud operations, detection rules are configured and tuned differently for each channel based on channel-specific fraud patterns and risk profiles. A single fraud detection rule (e.g., velocity check) applies to multiple channels (ATM, mobile, branch, wire), and each channel has multiple active rules. The bank actively manages channel-rule configurations as operational entities, tracking performance metrics (alert volume, false positive rate, effectiveness score) and tuning thresholds per channel-rule combination.

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the cost allocation relationship between cost centers and banking channels. It captures how organizational costs are distributed across customer interaction channels for activity-based costing, channel profitability analysis, and management accounting. Each record links one cost center to one channel with allocation percentages, methods, and effective date ranges that exist only in the context of this cost distribution relationship.. Existence Justification: In banking operations, cost centers (organizational units like IT Operations, Compliance, Facilities) distribute their costs across multiple channels (branch network, ATM network, digital channels, contact centers), and each channel receives cost allocations from multiple cost centers. Banks actively manage these allocation relationships through formal allocation methodologies (activity-based costing, headcount-based, transaction volume-based) with specific percentages, effective dates, and approval workflows. This is a core management accounting process for channel profitability analysis, RAROC reporting, and FTP allocation.

products.name: currency
products.description: ISO 4217 currency master — authoritative golden record for all currencies used across the enterprise. Captures currency code, numeric code, minor unit (decimal places), currency name, issuing country, active/inactive status, and effective dates. Used by payments, FX, GL, and all financial domains for currency denomination and conversion.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the currency record. Primary key.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_type
attributes.description: The primary interest rate benchmark associated with this currency (e.g., Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) for USD, Euro Short-Term Rate (ESTR) for EUR, Sterling Overnight Index Average (SONIA) for GBP). Used for pricing loans, derivatives, and other financial instruments. Reflects the transition from London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) to alternative reference rates.

attributes.name: central_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the central bank or monetary authority responsible for issuing and regulating this currency (e.g., Federal Reserve System for USD, European Central Bank for EUR, Bank of England for GBP). Used for regulatory reporting and monetary policy reference.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this currency record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro, British Pound Sterling, Japanese Yen).

attributes.name: currency_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the currency. Active currencies are currently in circulation and available for transactions. Inactive currencies are temporarily suspended. Deprecated currencies are being phased out (e.g., legacy currencies replaced by EUR). Historical currencies are no longer in use but retained for historical transaction reference. Pending currencies are approved but not yet in circulation.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the currency by its fundamental nature. Fiat currencies are government-issued legal tender. Commodity currencies are backed by physical commodities. Digital currencies include cryptocurrencies and central bank digital currencies. Fund represents investment fund units. Special Drawing Right (SDR) is the International Monetary Fund (IMF) reserve asset.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this currency record becomes effective and available for use in financial transactions. For new currencies, this is the introduction date. For currency updates, this is the date the change takes effect.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this currency record is effective. Nullable for currently active currencies with no planned end date. For deprecated or historical currencies, this represents the date the currency ceased to be legal tender or was replaced.

attributes.name: is_base_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency serves as a base currency for the enterprise's financial reporting and consolidation. Typically the functional currency of the parent company. Used for General Ledger (GL) consolidation and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: is_convertible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is freely convertible on international foreign exchange markets without significant restrictions. True for major reserve currencies and freely traded currencies. False for currencies with limited convertibility or capital controls.

attributes.name: is_crypto_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a cryptocurrency or digital asset rather than a fiat currency issued by a central bank. Used to apply different regulatory treatment, risk controls, and processing rules for digital assets.

attributes.name: is_fund_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency code represents a fund or investment vehicle unit rather than a traditional currency. Used for mutual funds, exchange-traded funds, and other investment products that have their own unit pricing.

attributes.name: is_legal_tender
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is currently recognized as legal tender in its issuing jurisdiction. True for currencies that must be accepted for payment of debts. False for commemorative, historical, or non-legal tender currencies.

attributes.name: is_precious_metal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency code represents a precious metal (e.g., XAU for gold, XAG for silver, XPT for platinum) used as a store of value or trading instrument. ISO 4217 includes codes for precious metals alongside traditional currencies.

attributes.name: is_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is subject to capital controls, exchange restrictions, or regulatory limitations that restrict its convertibility or cross-border movement. True for currencies with government-imposed restrictions. Used for compliance and risk management.

attributes.name: iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 4217 Currency Code
attributes.description: Three-letter alphabetic currency code as defined by ISO 4217 standard (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). This is the primary business identifier used across all financial systems for currency denomination.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country or jurisdiction that issues this currency (e.g., USA for USD, DEU for EUR in Germany context). For supranational currencies like EUR, this may represent the primary issuing authority or be left as a representative member state.

attributes.name: last_revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when currency balances denominated in this currency were last revalued for financial reporting purposes. Used in foreign currency revaluation processes for General Ledger (GL) and to track compliance with accounting standards requiring periodic revaluation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this currency record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: minor_unit
attributes.description: Number of decimal places used for the currency's minor unit. Indicates the relationship between the major currency unit and its minor unit (e.g., 2 for USD cents, 0 for JPY which has no minor unit, 3 for certain Middle Eastern currencies). Critical for accurate financial calculations and rounding.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special handling instructions, regulatory notes, or historical context about the currency. May include information about currency reforms, redenominations, or special processing requirements.

attributes.name: numeric_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 4217 Numeric Currency Code
attributes.description: Three-digit numeric currency code as defined by ISO 4217 standard (e.g., 840 for USD, 978 for EUR). Used in systems where alphabetic codes are not suitable.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the relative importance or usage frequency of this currency within the enterprise. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to determine default currencies, optimize system performance, and prioritize currency pair availability in FX trading systems.

attributes.name: rounding_method
attributes.description: Standard rounding method to be applied for this currency in financial calculations. Standard uses mathematical rounding (0.5 rounds up). Bankers rounding rounds 0.5 to the nearest even number. Up always rounds up. Down always rounds down. Truncate drops decimal places without rounding. Critical for ensuring consistent calculation results across systems.

attributes.name: settlement_lag_days
attributes.description: Standard number of business days required for settlement of foreign exchange (FX) transactions involving this currency. Typically 2 days (T+2) for major currencies, but can vary. Used for calculating settlement dates in FX trading and payment processing.
attributes.references: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or data provider from which this currency record originated (e.g., Core Banking System, Market Data Provider, ISO 4217 Registry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Graphical symbol used to represent the currency in financial displays and reports (e.g., $, €, £, ¥). Used for user interface presentation and customer-facing documents.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this currency record, incremented with each update. Used for optimistic locking, change tracking, and maintaining historical versions of currency attributes.

products.name: country
