Includes region, sub-region, sovereign status, FATCA jurisdiction flag, CRS jurisdiction flag, OFAC sanctions flag, and EU membership indicator. Referenced by KYC, AML, regulatory reporting, and customer onboarding.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the country record. Primary key.

attributes.name: ach_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the country's automated clearing house system for retail payments (e.g., ACH for USA, Bacs for UK, SEPA for Eurozone). Used for batch payment processing, direct debit operations, and retail payment routing.
attributes.references: BIS (Bank for International Settlements) Payment Systems Database

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this country record is currently active and should be used in operational systems. Inactive countries are retained for historical reference but excluded from customer onboarding and new transaction processing.

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall AML risk classification for the country based on regulatory framework strength, corruption indices, FATF assessments, and financial crime prevalence. Used in customer risk scoring, transaction monitoring thresholds, and enhanced due diligence triggers.
attributes.references: Basel AML Index / Transparency International Corruption Perceptions Index

attributes.name: basel_committee_member_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Member Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is represented on the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision. Signals adoption of Basel III capital and liquidity standards, relevant for counterparty risk assessment and regulatory capital calculations.
attributes.references: BCBS (Basel Committee on Banking Supervision) Member List

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: Standard business day convention code used for financial calculations in this country (e.g., Following, Modified Following, Preceding). Used in interest accrual, payment scheduling, and derivative valuation.
attributes.references: ISDA (International Swaps and Derivatives Association) Definitions

attributes.name: calling_code
attributes.description: International dialing prefix for the country (e.g., +1 for USA, +44 for UK). Used for phone number validation, customer contact data standardization, and communication routing.

attributes.name: capital_city
attributes.description: Name of the country's capital city. Used for geographic reference, branch location planning, and regulatory correspondence addressing.

attributes.name: country_name
attributes.description: Official short-form name of the country in English (e.g., United States of America, United Kingdom, Germany). Used for customer-facing displays, reports, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: crs_jurisdiction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a CRS participating jurisdiction requiring automatic exchange of financial account information. Essential for global tax compliance and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: crs_reportable_jurisdiction_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Reporting Standard (CRS) Reportable Jurisdiction Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts held by residents of this country must be reported under CRS. Used in customer classification and regulatory reporting workflows.

attributes.name: eea_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a member of the European Economic Area (EU plus Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway). Relevant for passporting rights, regulatory equivalence, and data protection frameworks.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this country record becomes effective. Used for managing country code changes, new country creation, and historical data accuracy.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this country record is effective. Null for currently active countries. Used for managing country dissolution, mergers, or code changes (e.g., Yugoslavia, Czechoslovakia).

attributes.name: eu_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a current member of the European Union. Used for regulatory compliance (GDPR, MiFID II), cross-border payment processing (SEPA), and risk classification.

attributes.name: fatca_giin_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Global Intermediary Identification Number (GIIN) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial institutions in this country must obtain a GIIN for FATCA compliance. Used in onboarding and due diligence processes for institutional counterparties.

attributes.name: fatca_jurisdiction_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Jurisdiction Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a FATCA reporting jurisdiction requiring financial institutions to report US person accounts to the IRS. Critical for compliance with US tax regulations and customer onboarding workflows.

attributes.name: fatf_high_risk_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) High-Risk Jurisdiction Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is identified by FATF as a high-risk jurisdiction with strategic AML/CFT deficiencies. Triggers enhanced due diligence requirements and elevated risk ratings in customer onboarding and transaction monitoring.
attributes.references: FATF (Financial Action Task Force) High-Risk Jurisdictions List

attributes.name: fatf_member_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a member of the Financial Action Task Force. Used for assessing AML/CFT framework strength and country risk rating in financial crime compliance.
attributes.references: FATF (Financial Action Task Force) Member List

attributes.name: iban_length
attributes.description: Standard length of IBAN for this country (e.g., 22 for Germany, 27 for France). Used for IBAN validation and account number format checking.

attributes.name: iban_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IBAN format is required for bank account numbers in this country. Used for payment validation, account number formatting, and cross-border payment processing.

attributes.name: intermediate_region
attributes.description: Intermediate-level geographic classification between region and sub-region where applicable (e.g., Caribbean, Channel Islands). Used for specialized regional analytics and compliance grouping.

attributes.name: iso_alpha_2_code
attributes.description: Two-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard (e.g., US, GB, DE). Primary business identifier for country lookup in KYC, AML, and regulatory reporting systems.

attributes.name: iso_alpha_3_code
attributes.description: Three-letter country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 standard (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used in SWIFT messaging, trade finance, and cross-border payment processing.

attributes.name: iso_numeric_code
attributes.description: Three-digit numeric country code as defined by ISO 3166-1 numeric standard (e.g., 840 for USA, 826 for GBR). Used in systems requiring language-independent country representation.

attributes.name: oecd_member_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) Member Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is a member of the OECD. Used for assessing regulatory standards, tax treaty eligibility, and country risk classification.
attributes.references: OECD (Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development) Member List

attributes.name: ofac_sanctions_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is subject to comprehensive OFAC sanctions programs. Critical for transaction screening, customer onboarding, and AML compliance.
attributes.references: OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) Sanctions Programs

attributes.name: ofac_sanctions_program
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions Program Name
attributes.description: Name of the specific OFAC sanctions program applicable to this country (e.g., Iran Sanctions, North Korea Sanctions). Used for detailed compliance screening and risk assessment.
attributes.references: OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) Sanctions Programs

attributes.name: official_name
attributes.description: Official long-form name of the country including full legal designation (e.g., United States of America, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland). Used in legal contracts, regulatory submissions, and formal documentation.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: High-level geographic region classification (e.g., Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa, Oceania). Used for regional risk aggregation, portfolio analysis, and management reporting.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Composite country risk rating incorporating political stability, economic strength, regulatory environment, and credit risk. Used for credit underwriting, exposure limits, provisioning calculations (ECL), and portfolio risk management.

attributes.name: rtgs_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the country's real-time gross settlement system for high-value payments (e.g., Fedwire for USA, CHAPS for UK, TARGET2 for Eurozone). Used for payment routing, liquidity management, and settlement risk assessment.
attributes.references: BIS (Bank for International Settlements) Payment Systems Database

attributes.name: settlement_cycle
attributes.description: Standard settlement cycle for securities transactions in this country (e.g., T+1, T+2, T+3). Used for trade settlement processing, liquidity planning, and operational risk management.
attributes.references: IOSCO (International Organization of Securities Commissions) Standards

attributes.name: sovereign_credit_rating
attributes.description: Long-term foreign currency sovereign credit rating from major rating agencies (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-, CCC). Used for risk-weighted asset (RWA) calculations, credit valuation adjustment (CVA), and investment grade classification.

attributes.name: sovereign_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the rating agency providing the sovereign credit rating (e.g., S&P, Moody's, Fitch). Used for rating source attribution and multi-agency rating reconciliation.

attributes.name: sovereign_rating_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sovereign credit rating assessment. Used for rating staleness checks and triggering rating review workflows.

attributes.name: sovereign_status
attributes.description: Indicates the political sovereignty status of the country or territory. Critical for determining applicable regulatory frameworks, tax treaties, and legal jurisdiction in cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: sub_region
attributes.description: Detailed sub-region classification within the broader region (e.g., Northern America, Western Europe, South-Eastern Asia). Used for granular geographic segmentation and risk analysis.

attributes.name: tax_haven_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the country is classified as a tax haven or low-tax jurisdiction. Used for enhanced due diligence, beneficial ownership verification, and tax evasion risk assessment.
attributes.references: OECD Tax Haven List / EU Tax Haven Blacklist

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Primary time zone identifier for the country in IANA Time Zone Database format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for trade settlement timing, payment cut-off calculations, and business day determination.

Stores benchmark name, administrator, currency, tenor conventions, publication source, IBOR transition status, fallback rate linkage, and regulatory recognition status. Critical for loan pricing, derivatives valuation, and ALM.

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id

attributes.references: ISDA IBOR Fallbacks Protocol, Financial Stability Board (FSB)

The holiday_calendar_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to holiday_calendar.holiday_calendar_id. This enab

attributes.name: administrator_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the administrators regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., USA, GBR, EUR).

attributes.name: administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization responsible for calculating and publishing the benchmark (e.g., Federal Reserve Bank of New York, ICE Benchmark Administration, European Money Markets Institute).

attributes.name: alternative_benchmark_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of alternative names or abbreviations for the benchmark (e.g., 'Fed Funds, Federal Funds Rate, Effective Federal Funds Rate').

attributes.name: benchmark_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code for the benchmark (e.g., SOFR, LIBOR_USD_3M, EURIBOR_6M, SONIA, ESTR, FED_FUNDS).

attributes.name: benchmark_family
attributes.description: Grouping of related benchmarks under a common family name (e.g., LIBOR family includes USD LIBOR, GBP LIBOR, EUR LIBOR; SOFR family includes SOFR, Term SOFR).

attributes.name: benchmark_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the interest rate benchmark (e.g., Secured Overnight Financing Rate, London Interbank Offered Rate).

attributes.name: benchmark_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the benchmark: active (currently published and usable), inactive (temporarily not published), suspended (publication halted pending review), discontinued (permanently ceased), under_review (regulatory or administrator review in progress).

attributes.name: benchmark_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benchmark by rate structure: overnight (daily), term (fixed tenor), interbank (bank-to-bank), risk-free (secured), or central bank (policy rate).
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Financial Stability Board (FSB)

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: Rule for adjusting payment dates that fall on non-business days: following (next business day), modified_following (next business day unless it crosses month-end), preceding (prior business day), modified_preceding (prior business day unless it crosses month-start), unadjusted (no adjustment).
attributes.references: ISDA, International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA)

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of how the benchmark rate is calculated (e.g., volume-weighted median of overnight repo transactions, trimmed mean of panel bank submissions).
attributes.references: IOSCO Principles for Financial Benchmarks, ISDA

attributes.name: compounding_convention
attributes.description: Method for aggregating overnight rates into term rates: simple (arithmetic average), compounded (geometric compounding), averaged (simple average), none (single rate, not compounded).
attributes.references: ISDA, International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benchmark record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the benchmark reference data. Used for data governance and quality monitoring.

attributes.name: data_source_description
attributes.description: Description of the underlying data sources used to calculate the benchmark (e.g., tri-party repo transactions cleared through FICC, panel bank submissions, central bank policy rate).

attributes.name: day_count_convention
attributes.description: Method used to calculate interest accrual periods for the benchmark (e.g., Actual/360, Actual/365, 30/360, Actual/Actual).
attributes.references: ISDA, International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA)

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the benchmark was or will be discontinued (e.g., June 30, 2023 for most USD LIBOR tenors). Null if the benchmark is still active.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the benchmark was first published or became effective for use in financial contracts.

attributes.name: fallback_spread_adjustment
attributes.description: Fixed spread (in basis points) added to the fallback rate to account for historical differences between the original benchmark and the fallback benchmark.

attributes.name: ibor_transition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the benchmark in the context of IBOR reform: active (current use), legacy (being phased out, e.g., LIBOR), discontinued (no longer published), transition_phase (migration underway), fallback_activated (fallback rate in use).
attributes.references: Financial Stability Board (FSB), ISDA IBOR Fallbacks Protocol

attributes.name: is_risk_free_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benchmark is classified as a risk-free rate (e.g., SOFR, SONIA, ESTR) as opposed to a credit-sensitive rate (e.g., LIBOR). True for RFRs, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Financial Stability Board (FSB), Alternative Reference Rates Committee (ARRC)

attributes.name: is_secured_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benchmark is based on secured transactions (e.g., repo transactions for SOFR) as opposed to unsecured lending (e.g., LIBOR). True for secured rates, False for unsecured.

attributes.name: last_publication_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which a rate was published for this benchmark. Used to track currency of data and identify stale benchmarks.

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of business days prior to the payment date used to determine the applicable rate (common in SOFR-based loans to allow operational time for rate fixing).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or historical context about the benchmark (e.g., transition milestones, regulatory announcements, usage restrictions).

attributes.name: observation_shift_days
attributes.description: Number of days the observation period is shifted backward relative to the interest period (alternative to lookback for SOFR and other overnight rates).

attributes.name: panel_bank_count
attributes.description: Number of contributing banks or institutions in the benchmark panel (for panel-based benchmarks like legacy LIBOR). Null for transaction-based benchmarks.

attributes.name: payment_delay_days
attributes.description: Standard number of business days between rate fixing and payment date (e.g., T+2 for some benchmarks).

attributes.name: publication_source
attributes.description: Official source or platform where the benchmark rate is published (e.g., Federal Reserve website, Bloomberg, Reuters, ICE portal).

attributes.name: publication_time
attributes.description: Standard time of day when the benchmark rate is published, in the administrators local timezone (e.g., 08:00 EST, 11:00 CET).

attributes.name: regulatory_recognition_status
attributes.description: Regulatory approval status of the benchmark: authorized (approved by regulator), recognized (accepted for regulatory purposes), non_recognized (not approved), under_review (pending regulatory assessment).
attributes.references: European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) Benchmark Regulation, IOSCO

attributes.name: regulatory_regime
attributes.description: Primary regulatory framework governing the benchmark (e.g., EU Benchmark Regulation, UK Benchmark Regulation, IOSCO Principles).
attributes.references: European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), IOSCO

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_code
attributes.description: Standardized code used for regulatory reporting purposes (e.g., CFTC reporting, EMIR reporting, MiFID II transaction reporting).
attributes.references: Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the upstream system or data provider from which this benchmark reference data was sourced (e.g., BLOOMBERG, REUTERS, FED_RESERVE, ICE_ADMIN).

attributes.name: tenor_convention
attributes.description: Standard maturity or term structure for the benchmark (e.g., overnight, 1-month, 3-month, 6-month, 12-month). Overnight benchmarks use 'overnight'; term benchmarks specify the period. attributes.references: ISDA, International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA)

attributes.name: transaction_volume_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum daily transaction volume (in currency units) required for the benchmark to be published. Used to assess benchmark robustness and representativeness.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benchmark record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: usage_scope
attributes.description: Description of typical use cases for the benchmark (e.g., loan pricing, derivatives valuation, asset-liability management, mortgage indexing, corporate debt).
attributes.references: ISDA, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS)

products.name: benchmark_rate_fixing
products.description: Daily published fixing values for interest rate benchmarks by tenor and fixing date. Each record links to its parent rate_benchmark (SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, etc.) and captures fixing date, tenor (O/N, 1M, 3M, 6M, 12M), published rate value, source authority, publication timestamp, revision indicator, and superseded rate (for corrections). Serves as the transactional time-series complement to the rate_benchmark master. Used for loan interest accrual, derivative settlement, mark-to-market calculations, and regulatory rate audit trails across trading, loan, and treasury domains.

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_fixing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each benchmark rate fixing record. Primary key for the benchmark_rate_fixing product.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Rate fixings are denominated in specific currencies. The currency_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to currency.currency_id. This enables JOIN to retrieve iso_code, currency_name,

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Rate fixings reference holiday calendars for business day conventions. The holiday_calendar STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to holiday_calendar.holiday_calendar_id. This enables JOIN

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent rate benchmark master record (e.g., SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, LIBOR). Links this fixing to its benchmark definition.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this rate fixing to audit logs, data lineage records, or external verification sources. Used for regulatory audit and data quality assurance.

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: The convention for adjusting dates that fall on non-business days (e.g., following, modified following). Used in derivative and loan contract calculations.

attributes.name: compounding_method
attributes.description: The calculation methodology used to derive the rate fixing when based on multiple observations (e.g., simple average, compound, weighted average). Set to 'none' for single-observation spot rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benchmark rate fixing record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality score (0-100) assessing the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of this rate fixing record. Used for data governance and reconciliation monitoring.

attributes.name: day_count_convention
attributes.description: The day count convention used for interest accrual calculations with this rate (e.g., ACT/360 for USD SOFR, ACT/365 for GBP SONIA). Critical for accurate interest computation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this rate fixing becomes effective for contractual calculations. Typically the same as fixing_date but may differ for backdated corrections.

attributes.name: fallback_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the fallback calculation methodology applied if this is a fallback rate (e.g., compounded SOFR plus spread adjustment). Null if not a fallback.

attributes.name: fallback_rate_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rate is a fallback or substitute rate used when the primary benchmark is unavailable (e.g., LIBOR transition fallbacks). True if this is a fallback rate.

attributes.name: fixing_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the benchmark rate was fixed and published by the rate authority. This is the effective date for the rate value.

attributes.name: is_business_day
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fixing date is a business day in the relevant market. False if the fixing date falls on a weekend or holiday, which may affect rate applicability.

attributes.name: is_revised
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this fixing is a revision or correction of a previously published rate. True if this record supersedes an earlier fixing for the same date and tenor.

attributes.name: number_of_transactions
attributes.description: The count of individual transactions used to calculate the benchmark rate, if published by the rate authority. Indicates market breadth. Null if not disclosed.

attributes.name: observation_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the observation period used to calculate the rate fixing. Null for spot rates.

attributes.name: observation_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the observation period used to calculate the rate fixing, applicable for compounded or averaged rates (e.g., SOFR averages). Null for spot rates.

attributes.name: publication_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the rate fixing was officially published by the rate authority. Used for audit trails and to determine which rate applies for time-sensitive calculations.

attributes.name: rate_basis_points
attributes.description: The rate value expressed in basis points for convenience (e.g., 525.00 BPS for 5.25%). One basis point equals 0.01%. Commonly used in trading and risk reporting.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the rate fixing. Published is the standard state; preliminary indicates subject to revision; final indicates no further changes expected; corrected indicates a revision; withdrawn indicates the rate was retracted.

attributes.name: rate_value
attributes.description: The published benchmark interest rate value expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05250000 for 5.25%). This is the official fixing rate used for loan accrual, derivative settlement, and mark-to-market calculations.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the reconciliation process comparing this rate fixing against multiple source feeds or vendor data. Matched indicates agreement across sources; exception indicates discrepancies requiring investigation.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this rate fixing must be included in regulatory reports (e.g., CCAR, DFAST, Basel III). True if required for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Federal Reserve CCAR Guidelines

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the rate authority for why the rate was revised or corrected. Null if not a revision.

attributes.name: revision_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the revision iteration for this fixing date and tenor. Initial publication is 1, first revision is 2, etc. Null if never revised.

attributes.name: source_authority
attributes.description: The official organization or entity that published the benchmark rate fixing (e.g., Federal Reserve Bank of New York for SOFR, European Money Markets Institute for EURIBOR, Bank of England for SONIA).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system or data feed from which the rate fixing was ingested (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, direct API feed from rate authority). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: spread_adjustment
attributes.description: The spread adjustment (in decimal form) added to the fallback rate to align it with the discontinued benchmark. Used in LIBOR transition scenarios. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: ISDA IBOR Fallbacks Protocol, Bloomberg IBOR Fallback Rate Adjustments

attributes.name: superseded_rate_value
attributes.description: The previous rate value that this fixing replaces, if this is a revision. Null for initial publications. Used for audit trails and impact analysis of rate corrections.

attributes.name: tenor_code
attributes.description: The maturity period for which the rate applies. Standard tenors include overnight (O/N), tomorrow-next (T/N), spot-next (S/N), and term periods (1W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 12M). attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this benchmark rate fixing record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.description: The total transaction volume (in currency units) underlying the rate calculation, if published by the rate authority. Provides transparency on market depth. Null if not disclosed.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_id

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate is an official benchmark rate used for regulatory reporting, financial statement revaluation, or contractual reference (e.g., WM/Reuters 4pm London Fix). Benchmark rates have heightened governance and audit requirements.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, notes, or explanations about this exchange rate. May include information about market conditions, data quality issues, manual adjustments, or special circumstances affecting the rate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Distinct from publication_timestamp and effective_timestamp.

attributes.name: cross_rate_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate is a cross rate (derived from two other currency pairs) rather than a directly traded pair. For example, EUR/GBP may be derived from EUR/USD and GBP/USD. Cross rates may have wider spreads.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) representing the assessed quality and reliability of this rate record based on source reputation, timeliness, completeness, and validation checks. Scores below threshold may trigger alerts or prevent automated use.

attributes.name: ecb_published_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate was published by the European Central Bank as an official ECB reference rate. ECB rates are used for regulatory reporting and accounting revaluations in the Eurozone.
attributes.references: European Central Bank (ECB) Reference Rate Standards

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate becomes effective and valid for use in transactions, valuations, and revaluations. This is the business event timestamp representing when the rate was published or became active in the market.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate expires and is no longer valid for use. For spot rates this may be end-of-day, for forward rates this is the forward settlement date. Null indicates an open-ended rate.

attributes.name: fed_published_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate was published by the U.S. Federal Reserve as an official Fed reference rate. Fed rates are used for regulatory reporting and accounting revaluations in the United States.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed) Reference Rate Standards

attributes.name: gl_revaluation_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate is approved for use in general ledger foreign currency revaluation processes. GL revaluation rates must meet accounting policy standards and audit requirements.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) ASC 830, International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) IAS 21

attributes.name: holiday_adjusted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate has been adjusted for banking holidays in either the base or quote currency jurisdiction. Holiday adjustments affect settlement dates and may impact rate calculations.

attributes.name: inverse_rate_value
attributes.description: The inverse of the rate_value, representing the exchange rate when the base and quote currencies are swapped. Calculated as 1 / rate_value. Stored for performance optimization in bidirectional FX calculations.

attributes.name: publication_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the rate was officially published or released by the source provider. May differ from effective_timestamp in cases where rates are published in advance of their effective date.

attributes.name: quote_currency_code
attributes.description: The quote currency (counter currency) in the exchange rate pair, represented as a three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. This is the currency in which the base currency is priced.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exchange rate record. Active rates are currently valid for use, superseded rates have been replaced by newer rates, preliminary rates are initial publications subject to revision, final rates are confirmed and will not change, and cancelled rates were published in error.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange rate type. Spot rates are for immediate settlement (T+2), forward rates are for future settlement dates, mid rates are the average of bid and ask, bid rates are the price at which the market maker will buy the base currency, ask rates are the price at which the market maker will sell the base currency, and fixing rates are official daily reference rates published by central banks.

attributes.name: rate_value
attributes.description: The numerical exchange rate value representing how many units of the quote currency are needed to purchase one unit of the base currency. Precision of 8 decimal places supports accurate FX calculations for large transactions.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this rate is approved for use in regulatory reporting submissions (e.g., Basel III, CCAR, DFAST, IFRS 9, CECL). Only rates from approved sources and meeting regulatory standards are eligible.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB), International Accounting Standards Board (IASB)

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The value date when the FX transaction using this rate would settle. For spot rates this is typically T+2 (trade date plus two business days), for forward rates this is the forward maturity date. Used by treasury and payment processing systems.

attributes.name: source_provider
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the market data provider or central bank that published this exchange rate (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, ECB, Federal Reserve, WM/Reuters Closing Spot Rates). Critical for audit trail and rate validation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier or reference code for this rate in the source provider's system. Enables traceability back to the original market data feed or central bank publication.

attributes.name: spread_bps
attributes.description: The bid-ask spread expressed in basis points (1 BPS = 0.01%). Represents the difference between the bid and ask rates as a percentage of the mid rate. Used for liquidity analysis and transaction cost assessment.

attributes.name: tenor
attributes.description: The time period for forward exchange rates, expressed in standard market conventions. ON=Overnight, TN=Tom-Next, SN=Spot-Next, W=Weeks, M=Months, Y=Years. SPOT indicates a spot rate with no forward tenor. Used primarily for forward rates and FX swaps.

attributes.name: trading_session
attributes.description: The global FX trading session during which this rate was captured or published. FX markets operate 24 hours across major financial centers. Continuous indicates a real-time streaming rate not tied to a specific session. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: london_open|london_close|ny_open|ny_close|tokyo_open|tokyo_close|sydney_open|sydney_close|continuous — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: triangulation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate this rate if it is a cross rate. Via_usd indicates the rate was triangulated through USD as the vehicle currency. Not_applicable indicates a directly traded pair. Triangulation method affects precision and spread.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this exchange rate record was last modified in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Updated whenever any attribute value changes.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this exchange rate record. Incremented each time the record is updated. Supports historical tracking and audit requirements. Version 1 is the initial publication.

attributes.name: volatility_indicator
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the market volatility level at the time this rate was published. High or extreme volatility may trigger additional risk management controls or require manual review before use in automated systems.

attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is eligible for credit risk mitigation under Basel III standardized or internal ratings-based approaches. Affects risk-weighted asset calculation.

attributes.name: derivative_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is a derivative contract. Used for derivative-specific regulatory reporting, margin requirements, and central clearing obligations.

attributes.name: exchange_traded_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is traded on a regulated exchange or multilateral trading facility. Affects transparency requirements and best execution obligations.

attributes.name: fair_value_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: IFRS 13 / ASC 820 fair value hierarchy level indicating the observability of valuation inputs. Level 1 uses quoted prices, Level 2 uses observable inputs, Level 3 uses unobservable inputs.

attributes.name: frtb_book_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) Book Classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification determining whether the instrument belongs to the trading book or banking book under FRTB rules. Critical for capital calculation and risk-weighted asset determination.

attributes.name: ifrs9_measurement_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9) Measurement Category
attributes.description: IFRS 9 accounting measurement category determining how the instrument is valued and how gains/losses are recognized. Drives financial statement presentation and expected credit loss calculation.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Specific instrument type descriptor providing business-friendly categorization (e.g., equity option, convertible bond, credit default swap). Used by trading desks and product teams.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the classification record. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of the classification. Used to ensure classifications remain current with regulatory changes and business practices.

attributes.name: liquidity_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the instrument for liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) and net stable funding ratio (NSFR) calculations. Determines eligibility as high-quality liquid asset and applicable haircuts.

attributes.name: market_risk_category
attributes.description: Market risk classification for VaR, stressed VaR, and incremental risk charge calculations. Used by market risk management and trading desk risk limits.

attributes.name: mifid2_instrument_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II (MiFID II) Instrument Category
attributes.description: MiFID II regulatory categorization for European market transparency and reporting requirements. Determines transaction reporting obligations and best execution rules.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the classification. Supports proactive governance and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: otc_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is traded over-the-counter rather than on an exchange. Impacts clearing requirements, margin rules, and trade reporting obligations.

attributes.name: product_control_category
attributes.description: Internal product control classification used by finance and product management teams for P&L attribution, valuation hierarchy, and product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: regulatory_capital_treatment
attributes.description: Description of how the instrument is treated for regulatory capital purposes under Basel III, including risk-weighting approach and capital charge methodology.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Standardized category code used for regulatory reporting submissions (e.g., FINREP, COREP, CCAR, DFAST). Maps to specific reporting taxonomy line items.
attributes.references: EBA ITS, Federal Reserve FR Y-14, FINREP

attributes.name: risk_weight_percentage
attributes.description: Standard risk weight percentage applied to the instrument under the Basel III standardized approach for credit risk. Used to calculate risk-weighted assets (RWA).

attributes.name: securitization_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is a securitization (e.g., MBS, ABS, CDO, CLO). Triggers specific capital treatment and risk retention requirements.
attributes.references: Basel III Securitization Framework (BCBS 303), Dodd-Frank Section 941

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream system or data provider that supplied the classification data (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv, internal product control system).

attributes.name: stress_testing_category
attributes.description: Classification used for CCAR, DFAST, and internal stress testing scenarios. Determines which stress factors and shocks are applied to the instrument.

attributes.name: structured_product_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is a structured product combining multiple underlying instruments or derivatives. Used for risk decomposition and valuation.

attributes.name: sub_asset_class
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the asset class (e.g., common stock, corporate bond, interest rate swap, FX forward). Used for detailed risk segmentation and product management.

attributes.name: valuation_methodology
attributes.description: Primary valuation approach used for the instrument class. Determines fair value hierarchy level and valuation control requirements.

attributes.name: volcker_rule_covered
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the instrument is subject to Volcker Rule proprietary trading restrictions. Used for compliance monitoring and permitted market-making activities.

products.name: bic_directory
products.description: SWIFT BIC (Bank Identifier Code) directory — golden source for all BIC codes used in SWIFT messaging and correspondent banking. Captures BIC8/BIC11, institution name, branch name, city, country, address, connectivity status (live/test), and SWIFT service profile. Used by payment processing, correspondent banking, and trade finance domains.

attributes.name: bic_directory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BIC directory record. Primary key for the BIC directory golden source.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: BIC codes are assigned to financial institutions in specific countries. The country_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to country.country_id. This enables JOIN to retrieve country_

attributes.name: lei_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.lei_registry. Business justification: BIC directory cross-references LEI codes for legal entity identification. The lei_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to lei_registry.lei_registry_id. This enables JOIN to retrieve

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the institution or branch. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Additional address information such as building name, floor, or suite number. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: bic11
attributes.description: The 11-character BIC code including the 3-character branch code suffix. Used for branch-level identification in SWIFT messaging.

attributes.name: bic8
attributes.description: The 8-character BIC code identifying the institution, comprising institution code (4 chars), country code (2 chars), and location code (2 chars). Used for head office identification.

attributes.name: bic_code
attributes.description: The SWIFT BIC code (8 or 11 characters). BIC8 format identifies the institution and country; BIC11 includes branch code. Also known as SWIFT code.

attributes.name: branch_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific branch or office identified by the BIC11 code. Null for head office BIC8 entries.

attributes.name: business_day_convention
attributes.description: The convention used for adjusting payment dates that fall on non-business days. Following moves to next business day; modified_following moves to next unless it crosses month-end; preceding moves to prior business day.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Definitions

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city where the institution or branch is located. Used for correspondent banking and payment routing.

attributes.name: connectivity_status
attributes.description: The current operational status of the BIC code in the SWIFT network. Live indicates active production use; test indicates sandbox environment; inactive indicates decommissioned; suspended indicates temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: correspondent_banking_role
attributes.description: The role this institution plays in correspondent banking relationships. Nostro indicates the institution holds accounts at other banks; vostro indicates other banks hold accounts here; both indicates bidirectional relationships; none indicates no correspondent banking.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Correspondent Banking Guidelines

attributes.name: cut_off_time_local
attributes.description: The local time (HH:MM format) by which payment instructions must be received for same-day value. Used by payment processing hubs for scheduling.
attributes.references: SWIFT Payment Market Practice Group Guidelines

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated score (0.00 to 100.00) representing the completeness and accuracy of this BIC record. Based on presence of optional fields, validation against SWIFT directory, and recency of updates.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BIC code became active in the SWIFT directory. Used for historical payment routing validation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this BIC code was or will be deactivated. Null for currently active BIC codes. Used for payment routing validation and historical analysis.

attributes.name: iban_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution supports IBAN format for account identification. Mandatory in SEPA countries; optional elsewhere.

attributes.name: institution_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the financial institution associated with this BIC code. Used for correspondent banking identification and payment processing.

attributes.name: institution_type
attributes.description: The classification of the institution holding this BIC code. Determines the types of SWIFT services and message types available.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC code is currently active and should be used for payment routing. Derived from connectivity_status and expiry_date. False indicates the BIC should not be used for new transactions.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BIC directory record was last modified. Used for change data capture and synchronization with upstream SWIFT directory feeds.

attributes.name: national_identifier_code
attributes.description: The national registration or license number assigned by the domestic banking regulator. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., FDIC Certificate Number in USA, Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) number in UK).

attributes.name: payment_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC is enabled for payment processing services including wire transfers, Automated Clearing House (ACH), and Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS).

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code for the institution address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: The regulatory standing of the institution for cross-border transactions. Sanctioned indicates Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) or other sanctions apply; restricted indicates regulatory limitations; under_review indicates pending regulatory action.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions List, Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Guidelines

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The domestic routing or sort code used for local payment clearing. Examples include American Bankers Association (ABA) routing number (USA), sort code (UK), Bankleitzahl (Germany). Null for institutions without domestic clearing participation.

attributes.name: securities_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC is enabled for securities settlement, custody, and clearing services. Relevant for broker-dealers and custodian banks.

attributes.name: sepa_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution is a participant in the Single Euro Payments Area for euro-denominated payments. Applicable to European Economic Area (EEA) institutions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the system or feed that provided this BIC record. Typically SWIFT BIC Directory feed, but may include manual entries or third-party data providers.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region where the institution is located. Applicable for countries with sub-national divisions.

attributes.name: swift_service_profile
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Service Profile
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SWIFT service types supported by this BIC. Examples include FIN (financial messaging), FileAct (file transfer), InterAct (real-time messaging), and Browse (information retrieval).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The IANA time zone identifier for the institution location. Used for cut-off time calculations and same-day value dating in payment processing.

attributes.name: trade_finance_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BIC is enabled for trade finance services including letters of credit, guarantees, and documentary collections.

products.name: lei_registry
products.description: Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) registry — authoritative source for LEI codes assigned to legal entities under the GLEIF framework. Captures LEI code, legal entity name, legal address, headquarters country, registration authority, LEI status, renewal date, and ultimate parent LEI. Required for MiFID II, EMIR, and Dodd-Frank regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: lei_registry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the LEI registry record. Primary key for the LEI registry data product.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id

attributes.name: legal_address_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: LEI entities have legal addresses in specific countries. The legal_address_country_code STRING column should be replaced with a proper FK to country.country_id. This is the first of two FKs from lei_r

attributes.name: bic_code
attributes.description: The ISO 9362 Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT code, assigned to the entity if it is a financial institution participating in the SWIFT network. Used for international payment routing and messaging.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or data provider from which this LEI registry record was obtained or synchronized (e.g., GLEIF API, LOU direct feed, regulatory reporting platform).

attributes.name: entity_category
attributes.description: The category classification of the entity as defined by GLEIF, indicating the type of legal entity (e.g., BRANCH for branch offices, FUND for investment funds, GENERAL for standard legal entities). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BRANCH|FUND|SOLE_PROPRIETOR|RESIDENT_GOVERNMENT_ENTITY|NON_RESIDENT_GOVERNMENT_ENTITY|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION|GENERAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entity_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the legal entity is scheduled to expire, dissolve, or terminate, if applicable. This is relevant for entities with a defined lifespan such as special purpose vehicles, project companies, or entities in liquidation.

attributes.name: entity_expiration_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the entitys expiration or termination, if applicable. Indicates the business or legal event that led to the entitys cessation.

attributes.name: entity_registration_number
attributes.description: The unique registration number or identifier assigned to the entity by the registration authority in its jurisdiction of incorporation or registration.

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: The operational status of the legal entity as reported by the registration authority. ACTIVE indicates the entity is currently operating; INACTIVE indicates the entity has ceased operations, been dissolved, or is otherwise non-operational.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality component of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code representing the country of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the headquarters address where the entity conducts its primary business operations, which may differ from the legal address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the headquarters address, containing additional address details.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_region
attributes.description: The region, state, province, or administrative subdivision component of the headquarters address.

attributes.name: initial_registration_date
attributes.description: The date when the LEI was first issued to the entity by a Local Operating Unit (LOU). This represents the original registration date in the GLEIF system.

attributes.name: last_update_date
attributes.description: The date when the LEI record was last updated in the GLEIF system, reflecting changes to entity information, status, or other attributes.

attributes.name: legal_address_city
attributes.description: The city or municipality component of the legal address.

attributes.name: legal_address_line_1
attributes.description: The first line of the legal address of the entity as registered with the relevant registration authority. This is the official address for legal and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: legal_address_line_2
attributes.description: The second line of the legal address, typically containing additional address details such as suite, floor, or building information.

attributes.name: legal_address_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the legal address.

attributes.name: legal_address_region
attributes.description: The region, state, province, or administrative subdivision component of the legal address.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The official legal name of the entity as registered with the relevant registration authority. This is the primary legal name under which the entity operates and is recognized in legal and regulatory contexts.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name_local
attributes.description: The legal name of the entity in the local language and script of the jurisdiction of registration, if different from the transliterated or English version.

attributes.name: legal_form_code
attributes.description: The code representing the legal form of the entity (e.g., corporation, partnership, trust) as defined by the Entity Legal Forms (ELF) code list maintained by GLEIF.
attributes.references: GLEIF Entity Legal Forms (ELF) Code List

attributes.name: legal_form_name
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the legal form corresponding to the legal form code (e.g., Public Limited Company, Limited Liability Company).
attributes.references: GLEIF Entity Legal Forms (ELF) Code List

attributes.name: lei_code
attributes.description: The 20-character alphanumeric ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier code assigned to the legal entity by a Local Operating Unit (LOU) under the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) framework. Required for MiFID II, EMIR, and Dodd-Frank regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 17442, GLEIF, MiFID II, EMIR, Dodd-Frank

attributes.name: lei_status
attributes.description: The current status of the LEI code itself within the GLEIF system. ISSUED indicates an active LEI; LAPSED indicates the LEI has not been renewed; MERGED, RETIRED, ANNULLED, CANCELLED indicate various termination states; TRANSFERRED and PENDING_TRANSFER indicate LEI management changes between LOUs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ISSUED|LAPSED|MERGED|RETIRED|ANNULLED|CANCELLED|TRANSFERRED|PENDING_TRANSFER|PENDING_ARCHIVAL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: managing_lou_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the Local Operating Unit (LOU) that currently manages and maintains the LEI record. LOUs are accredited organizations authorized by GLEIF to issue and manage LEIs.

attributes.name: managing_lou_name
attributes.description: The name of the Local Operating Unit (LOU) that currently manages the LEI record (e.g., London Stock Exchange, Bloomberg Finance L.P., DTCC).

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the LEI must be renewed to maintain its ISSUED status. LEIs must be renewed annually; failure to renew results in a LAPSED status.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this LEI registry record was first created in the enterprise data lakehouse. Represents the initial load or ingestion time.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this LEI registry record was last updated in the enterprise data lakehouse. Reflects the most recent synchronization or modification.

attributes.name: registration_authority_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the registration authority (business registry) where the entity is officially registered. This is typically a code from the Registration Authorities Code List (RAL) maintained by GLEIF.

attributes.name: registration_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the registration authority or business registry where the entity is officially registered (e.g., Companies House UK, Delaware Division of Corporations).

attributes.name: relationship_last_update_date
attributes.description: The date when the parent-child relationship information (direct parent and ultimate parent LEIs) was last updated or validated in the GLEIF system.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: The status of the parent-child relationship data reported to GLEIF. ACTIVE indicates current, valid relationship information; INACTIVE indicates the relationship data is no longer current or has been superseded.

attributes.name: successor_lei
attributes.description: The LEI code of the successor entity, if this entity has been merged, acquired, or otherwise succeeded by another legal entity. Used to maintain continuity in regulatory reporting and relationship tracking.

attributes.name: ultimate_parent_lei
attributes.description: The LEI code of the ultimate parent entity at the top of the corporate ownership hierarchy. This represents the highest-level parent entity that is not itself owned or controlled by another entity, as reported under GLEIF Level 2 relationship data. Required for consolidated regulatory reporting and risk assessment.

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: The level of validation and corroboration applied to the relationship data. FULLY_CORROBORATED indicates both parent and child have confirmed the relationship; PARTIALLY_CORROBORATED indicates one party has confirmed; ENTITY_SUPPLIED_ONLY indicates self-reported data without external validation; PENDING indicates validation is in progress.

products.name: market_data_source
products.description: Master registry of external market data providers, pricing sources, and data feeds used across the enterprise — including Bloomberg, Refinitiv, ICE, IHS Markit, SIX Financial, and internal pricing desks. Captures provider name, feed type, asset class coverage, data frequency, licensing terms, SLA commitments, connectivity method (API, FTP, real-time), data quality tier, pricing methodology (e.g., BGN composite, exchange last trade, evaluated/model-based), primary/fallback source designation per instrument type and market, and override governance rules. Governs which source is authoritative for each data type, valuation use case, and regulatory context. Used by MTM, NAV calculation, risk valuation, and all downstream market data consumers.

attributes.name: market_data_source_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the market data source provider or feed. Primary key.

attributes.name: fallback_source_market_data_source_id
attributes.description: Reference to the alternative market data source to be used if this source becomes unavailable or fails quality checks. Self-referential foreign key to another market_data_source record.

attributes.name: annual_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total annual subscription or licensing cost for this market data source in USD. Used for vendor cost management and budgeting.

attributes.name: asset_class_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset classes covered by this source (e.g., equities, fixed income, FX, commodities, derivatives, credit, structured products). Indicates scope of market data provided.

attributes.name: business_owner_lob
attributes.description: Primary line of business or division that owns and funds this market data source (e.g., Trading, Asset Management, Risk, Treasury). Used for cost allocation and accountability.

attributes.name: connectivity_method
attributes.description: Technical delivery mechanism for the data feed: API (REST/SOAP), FTP/SFTP batch transfer, real-time streaming protocol, message queue (e.g., Kafka, MQ), direct market feed, or web service. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: API|FTP|SFTP|real-time-stream|message-queue|direct-feed|web-service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate the cost of this data source across business units or cost centers: direct charge, allocated by usage, shared equally, or via Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this market data source record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_frequency
attributes.description: Granularity or update frequency of the market data feed: tick-by-tick, per-second, per-minute, hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tick|second|minute|hourly|daily|weekly|monthly — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: data_quality_tier
attributes.description: Enterprise classification of the source's data quality and reliability: tier-1 (highest quality, regulatory-grade), tier-2 (standard quality), tier-3 (lower quality or unverified), or internal (proprietary pricing desk).

attributes.name: data_retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days historical data from this source is retained in the enterprise data lake or warehouse. Driven by regulatory requirements, storage costs, and business needs.

attributes.name: data_steward_email
attributes.description: Email address of the data steward responsible for this market data source.

attributes.name: data_steward_name
attributes.description: Name of the enterprise data steward or data owner responsible for governance, quality monitoring, and vendor relationship management for this source.

attributes.name: feed_type
attributes.description: Classification of the data feed delivery frequency and latency: real-time streaming, delayed quotes, end-of-day batch, intraday snapshots, evaluated pricing, or composite aggregated feeds.

attributes.name: instrument_type_coverage
attributes.description: Specific instrument types or security classifications covered by this source (e.g., listed equities, corporate bonds, government securities, interest rate swaps, FX forwards, commodity futures). Complements asset_class_coverage with granular detail.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent governance or vendor review for this data source. Used to track periodic assessments of data quality, cost-effectiveness, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: license_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration or renewal date of the current license agreement. Null if perpetual or rolling subscription.

attributes.name: license_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current license agreement or subscription term with this provider.

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Licensing model governing usage rights: enterprise-wide, per-user subscription, per-device, display-only (for human viewing), non-display (for automated systems), or internal-use only.

attributes.name: market_coverage
attributes.description: Geographic markets or exchanges covered by this source (e.g., NYSE, LSE, XETRA, TSE, global OTC). Comma-separated list of market identifiers or regions.

attributes.name: market_data_source_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the market data source: active (in production use), inactive (temporarily disabled), suspended (service issue), decommissioned (retired), pilot (testing phase), or pending-approval (awaiting governance approval).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next governance or vendor review. Ensures periodic reassessment of source performance and alignment with enterprise needs.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, known issues, or historical context about this market data source.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when this market data source was first onboarded and integrated into the enterprise data infrastructure.

attributes.name: override_governance_rule
attributes.description: Description of the governance process and approval requirements for overriding prices from this source. Defines who can override, under what conditions, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: pricing_methodology
attributes.description: Description of how prices are determined by this source: exchange last trade, composite average (e.g., BGN composite), evaluated/model-based pricing, broker quotes, internal desk pricing, or consensus pricing.

attributes.name: provider_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code or ticker symbol uniquely identifying the provider within the enterprise (e.g., BBG, RFTV, ICE, MKIT).

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the market data provider (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv, ICE Data Services, IHS Markit, SIX Financial Information).

attributes.name: regulatory_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this source is approved for use in regulatory reporting, capital calculations, or official valuations (e.g., CCAR, DFAST, Basel III, IFRS 9). True if approved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: sla_data_accuracy_pct

attributes.description: Contractually committed data accuracy rate (e.g., 99.99%). Measures correctness of prices, reference data, and corporate actions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: data_privacy_regime

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: fatca_status

attributes.name: high_risk_jurisdiction_flag

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the holiday calendar used for determining non-business days in this jurisdiction (e.g., NYSE, TARGET, JIBOR). Links to the holiday calendar reference data.
attributes.references: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA), Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT)

attributes.name: iban_supported_flag

attributes.name: insolvency_regime_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insolvency and bankruptcy framework in this jurisdiction (e.g., debtor-friendly, creditor-friendly, administrative, judicial). Impacts Loss Given Default (LGD) and recovery rate assumptions.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the jurisdiction. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 for national jurisdictions, with optional subdivision codes (e.g., US-NY for New York State, EU for European Union).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name

attributes.name: jurisdiction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the jurisdiction record: active (currently in use), inactive (no longer used for new transactions), historical (archived), or pending (under review for activation).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: legal_system_type
attributes.description: The foundational legal system governing the jurisdiction: common law (precedent-based), civil law (code-based), Sharia law (Islamic principles), mixed (combination), customary law, or other.

attributes.name: netting_enforceability_flag

attributes.name: netting_opinion_date

attributes.name: primary_regulator
attributes.description: Name of the primary banking regulatory authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., Federal Reserve System, Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, European Central Bank, Prudential Regulation Authority).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), European Banking Authority (EBA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA)

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary banking and financial regulatory frameworks applicable in this jurisdiction (e.g., Basel III, Basel IV, Dodd-Frank Act, MiFID II, MAS Notice 637). Multiple frameworks separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: rtgs_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) payment system operated in this jurisdiction (e.g., Fedwire, CHAPS, TARGET2). Null if no RTGS system exists.
attributes.references: Real-Time Gross Settlement (RTGS), Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

attributes.name: sanctions_regime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction is subject to international economic sanctions or embargoes that restrict banking and financial transactions.
attributes.references: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), United Nations Security Council, European Union Sanctions

attributes.name: securities_regulator
attributes.description: Name of the primary securities and capital markets regulatory authority in this jurisdiction (e.g., Securities and Exchange Commission, Financial Conduct Authority, European Securities and Markets Authority).
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO)

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the jurisdiction (e.g., USA, New York, EU).

attributes.name: sovereign_credit_rating

attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO)

attributes.name: sovereign_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the rating agency that issued the sovereign credit rating (e.g., Standard & Poor's, Moody's, Fitch Ratings).

attributes.name: sovereign_rating_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sovereign credit rating assessment.

attributes.name: stress_testing_requirement
attributes.description: Mandatory stress testing framework applicable in this jurisdiction: Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR), Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing (DFAST), European Banking Authority (EBA) stress test, local framework, or none.
attributes.references: Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR), Dodd-Frank Act Stress Testing (DFAST), European Banking Authority (EBA), Federal Reserve System (Fed)

attributes.name: tax_haven_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the jurisdiction's tax regime: tax haven (minimal or no taxation), low-tax (preferential tax rates), standard (typical tax rates), or not classified.
attributes.references: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), Financial Stability Board (FSB)

attributes.name: tax_treaty_network_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this jurisdiction participates in international tax treaty networks for withholding tax relief and double taxation avoidance.
attributes.references: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), Common Reporting Standard (CRS), Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Primary time zone for this jurisdiction in IANA Time Zone Database format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Used for trade settlement and market hours.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database, Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT)

products.name: code_list
products.description: Enterprise-wide generic reference code list master — a flexible, extensible registry for all standardized lookup values that do not warrant their own first-class entity. Consolidates thin type tables including day count conventions (ACT/360, ACT/365, 30/360), settlement instruction types, counterparty types, NACE/SIC sector codes, credit rating scales (S&P, Moody's, Fitch mappings), GL account types, and other banking-specific enumerations. Each entry captures code list type, code value, code label, description, sort order, parent code (for hierarchies), effective/expiry dates, regulatory framework reference, source authority, and active flag. Maintains full auditability and versioning while reducing proliferation of single-purpose lookup tables.

attributes.name: code_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the code list entry. Primary key. [ROLE: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — _canonical_skip_reason: This is a reference/lookup entity serving as a flexible registry for standardized enumeration values; minimum field categories do not apply to REFERENCE_LOOKUP role per canonical-attrs-enforced v0.8.5.]

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.references: Change Management Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.references: Change Management Standards, Data Governance Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.references: Change Management Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: business_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business unit, line of business (LOB), or functional area responsible for defining and maintaining this code value. Establishes accountability for code list governance.

attributes.name: code_description
attributes.description: Detailed business definition and explanation of the code value, including usage context, calculation rules, and business implications. Provides comprehensive documentation for business users and analysts.

attributes.name: code_label
