attributes.name: code_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level or depth of the code within its taxonomy (e.g., 1 for top-level, 2 for sub-category, 3 for detail). Used for hierarchical navigation and aggregation logic.

attributes.name: code_list_type
attributes.description: The category or domain of the code list (e.g., day_count_convention, settlement_instruction_type, counterparty_type, credit_rating_scale, gl_account_type, nace_sector_code, sic_sector_code). Serves as the primary discriminator for grouping related code values.

attributes.name: code_value

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_classification

attributes.references: Enterprise Information Security Policy, Data Classification Framework

attributes.name: data_steward
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or team responsible for the operational maintenance, quality assurance, and lifecycle management of this code value.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework, Data Stewardship Charter

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this code value becomes valid and available for use in operational systems and reporting. Supports temporal validity and regulatory transition management (e.g., LIBOR to SOFR transition).
attributes.references: Temporal Data Management Standards, ISDA IBOR Fallbacks Protocol

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this code value is no longer valid for new transactions or bookings. Null indicates no planned expiration. Supports regulatory phase-outs and product lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Temporal Data Management Standards, Regulatory Transition Guidelines

attributes.name: is_system_generated

domains.name: fraud
domains.description: Operational fraud case management covering fraud detection alerts, investigation workflows, case disposition, chargeback management, loss recovery, and SAR escalation. Manages fraud typologies, rule configurations, and case outcomes for retail, card, and wire fraud. Distinct from compliance AML monitoring.
domains.references: FinCEN SAR, FDIC Fraud Guidance, PCI DSS, AML/BSA

products.name: case
products.description: Core master entity representing an operational fraud case opened against a customer, account, or transaction. Captures the full lifecycle from initial alert escalation through investigation, disposition, and closure. Key attributes include case type (card fraud, wire fraud, identity theft, account takeover, check fraud), case status and status history, assigned investigator, priority/severity, channel of occurrence, estimated and confirmed loss amounts, recovery amount, disposition outcome, and regulatory escalation flags. Serves as the central hub linking alerts, incidents, investigations, chargebacks, claims, SARs, evidence, and loss records. Managed within NICE Actimize or Oracle Financial Crime case management platforms.
products.reference: Fraud Case Management — NICE Actimize / Oracle Financial Crime

products.name: chargeback
products.description: Master entity managing the full lifecycle of payment card chargebacks initiated in response to disputed or fraudulent transactions. Captures chargeback reason code (per Visa/Mastercard/Amex network rules), dispute amount, original transaction reference, chargeback stage (first chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, arbitration), network case number, merchant ID, acquirer BIN, response deadlines, and final resolution outcome. Includes the complete audit trail of lifecycle events: network messages, representment filings, arbitration submissions, and resolution events with timestamps and responsible parties. Supports merchant fraud risk assessment including chargeback ratios and network monitoring program enrollment. Linked to fraud cases where chargebacks arise from confirmed fraud.

products.name: network_link
products.description: Association entity capturing identified relationships between fraud subjects, accounts, devices, and entities that indicate coordinated or organized fraud activity. Tracks link type (shared device fingerprint, shared IP address, shared physical address, shared phone number, common beneficiary account, mule account network, shared employer, velocity pattern match), link strength score, discovery method (automated graph analysis, manual investigation, tip/referral), discovery date, confirming analyst, and linkage to the fraud cases and subjects involved. products.name: subject_account_link
products.description: This association product represents the investigative link between fraud subjects and investor accounts under investigation. It captures the nature of the relationship (beneficial owner, authorized signer, mule account holder, identity theft victim), the strength of evidence connecting the subject to the account, and the investigation lifecycle status. Each record links one fraud subject to one investor account with attributes that exist only in the context of this fraud investigation relationship.. Existence Justification: In fraud investigation operations, a single fraud subject (individual or entity) can be linked to multiple investor accounts (e.g., organized fraud rings operating across multiple accounts, beneficial ownership structures, mule account networks). Conversely, a single investor account can be associated with multiple fraud subjects (e.g., multiple accomplices using the same account, identity theft with multiple perpetrators, complex fraud schemes with multiple actors). The fraud investigation team actively manages these links as investigative records, tracking evidence strength, roles, and investigation status for each subject-account pair.

attributes.name: budget_amount

attributes.name: budget_currency_code

attributes.name: closure_date

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: establishment_date

attributes.name: gl_cost_center_code

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code

attributes.name: lei

attributes.name: lob

attributes.name: org_unit_description

attributes.name: physical_address

attributes.name: region

attributes.name: regulatory_segment

attributes.name: sox_scope

attributes.name: unit_code

attributes.name: unit_name

attributes.name: unit_short_name

attributes.name: unit_status

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit within the hierarchy structure. Determines reporting and governance requirements.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this organizational unit record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: payroll_record
products.description: Payroll processing record capturing the periodic gross-to-net pay calculation for each employee. Includes pay period, gross pay, base salary, overtime, allowances, pre-tax deductions (401k, HSA, FSA), tax withholdings (federal, state, FICA), net pay, payment method, bank account details for direct deposit, and payroll run identifier. Supports SOX payroll controls, IRS Form W-2 preparation, and GL payroll journal entry generation.
products.reference: Payroll Processing (Workday Payroll / SAP SuccessFactors Payroll)

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee for whom this payroll record was generated. Links to the employee master data in the HR system.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: gl_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL journal entry generated from this payroll record for financial accounting integration.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll batch run that generated this record. Used for grouping all payroll records processed in the same cycle.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total allowances paid during this pay period, such as housing, transportation, or meal allowances.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Employee bank account number for direct deposit. Encrypted and restricted access for payroll processing only.

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account for direct deposit (checking or savings).

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Routing Number (American Bankers Association - ABA)
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number identifying the financial institution for direct deposit.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The base salary or regular wages earned during the pay period, excluding overtime, bonuses, and other supplemental pay.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus paid during this pay period.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Sales commission or incentive compensation earned during this pay period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payroll record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Currency Code (International Organization for Standardization - ISO 4217)
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dental_insurance_premium
attributes.description: Employee portion of dental insurance premium deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from gross pay based on employee W-4 elections.

attributes.name: fsa_contribution
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contribution to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare or dependent care expenses.

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Court-ordered wage garnishment deducted from net pay for child support, tax levies, or other legal obligations.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payroll record was posted to the General Ledger for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total gross pay before any deductions, including base salary, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and allowances.

attributes.name: health_insurance_premium
attributes.description: Employee portion of health insurance premium deducted from gross pay, typically pre-tax under Section 125 cafeteria plan.

attributes.name: hsa_contribution
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contribution to Health Savings Account (HSA) deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: loan_repayment_amount
attributes.description: Employee loan repayment deducted from net pay for company-issued loans or advances.

attributes.name: local_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of local or municipal income tax withheld from gross pay, if applicable.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medicare Tax Withheld (Federal Insurance Contributions Act - FICA)
attributes.description: Amount of Medicare tax (FICA) withheld from gross pay, calculated as 1.45% of all wages, plus additional 0.9% for high earners.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Final take-home pay after all pre-tax deductions, tax withholdings, and post-tax deductions. This is the amount disbursed to the employee.

attributes.name: other_posttax_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all other post-tax deductions not otherwise categorized, such as union dues, charitable contributions, or Roth 401k.

attributes.name: other_pretax_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all other pre-tax deductions not otherwise categorized, such as commuter benefits or supplemental insurance.

attributes.name: overtime_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime pay earned during the pay period, typically calculated at 1.5x or 2x the regular hourly rate.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the pay period.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly).

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net pay was or will be disbursed to the employee.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee (direct deposit, physical check, cash, or payroll card).

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this payroll record in the payroll lifecycle.

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_pretax
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax contribution to retirement plan (401k, 403b) deducted from gross pay before tax calculation.

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Security Tax Withheld (Federal Insurance Contributions Act - FICA)
attributes.description: Amount of Social Security tax (FICA) withheld from gross pay, calculated as 6.2% of wages up to the annual wage base limit.

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from gross pay based on state tax regulations and employee elections.

attributes.name: total_posttax_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all post-tax deductions including garnishments, loan repayments, and other voluntary deductions.

attributes.name: total_pretax_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all pre-tax deductions including retirement, health insurance, HSA, FSA, and other pre-tax benefits.

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Sum of all tax withholdings including federal, state, local, Social Security, and Medicare taxes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payroll record was last modified.

attributes.name: vision_insurance_premium
attributes.description: Employee portion of vision insurance premium deducted from gross pay.

products.name: compensation_event
products.description: Compensation management master and transactional record serving as the SSOT for all compensation data. On the master side, captures plan-level structures including salary grade bands, pay ranges, incentive plan frameworks, plan types (base salary, short-term incentive, long-term incentive, deferred compensation), eligibility criteria, currency, and effective dates. On the transactional side, captures individual compensation change events including merit increases, promotions, equity adjustments, off-cycle adjustments, bonus awards, stock option grants, prior/new compensation values, effective dates, change reasons, and approvers. Supports annual compensation review cycles, EBA Material Risk Taker remuneration policy compliance, RAROC-linked incentive design, SOX compensation controls, audit trail, and regulatory remuneration disclosure (EBA/PRA Material Risk Taker reporting, CRD IV remuneration disclosure).

attributes.name: compensation_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation event record.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this compensation event.

attributes.name: equity_instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Stock-based compensation (options, RSUs, performance shares) is core to banking compensation, especially for material risk takers. Links compensation events to specific equity instruments (typically b

attributes.name: primary_compensation_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee receiving the compensation change.

attributes.name: annual_review_cycle_year
attributes.description: The calendar year of the annual compensation review cycle to which this event belongs.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational level required to approve this compensation event based on materiality and policy thresholds.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: bonus_award_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of a discretionary or performance-based bonus awarded in this event, in the specified currency.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the compensation change (e.g., annual review, market adjustment, role change).

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the business rationale for the compensation change.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, context, or special instructions related to the compensation event.

attributes.name: compa_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the employee's new base salary to the pay range midpoint, expressed as a percentage, indicating position within the salary band.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the compensation expense for this event is allocated.
attributes.references: Internal General Ledger (GL) Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compensation event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this compensation event.

attributes.name: deferred_compensation_amount
attributes.description: The amount of compensation deferred to future periods as part of this event, in the specified currency.
attributes.references: EBA Material Risk Taker Remuneration Policy

attributes.name: event_effective_date

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the compensation event, used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compensation event in the approval and processing workflow.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the compensation event was initiated or recorded in the system.

attributes.name: event_type

attributes.references: EBA Material Risk Taker Remuneration Policy

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the compensation expense is posted.
attributes.references: Internal General Ledger (GL) Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The business unit or line of business to which the employee belongs at the time of this compensation event.

attributes.name: material_risk_taker_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is classified as a Material Risk Taker under EBA/PRA remuneration regulations, requiring enhanced disclosure and deferral rules.

attributes.name: performance_rating

attributes.name: prior_base_salary

attributes.name: prior_lti_value

attributes.name: prior_target_bonus_pct

attributes.name: processed_timestamp

attributes.name: raroc_linked_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation event must be included in regulatory remuneration disclosures (EBA/PRA Material Risk Taker reporting, CRD IV).

attributes.name: salary_grade_code

attributes.name: sox_control_flag

attributes.name: stock_option_grant_quantity
attributes.description: The number of stock options granted to the employee in this compensation event.

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Benefits plan master defining the bank's employee benefit offerings including health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, retirement plans (401k, pension), employee assistance programs, and flexible spending accounts. Captures plan name, plan type, carrier, coverage tiers, employee/employer contribution rates, eligibility rules, open enrollment windows, and regulatory plan identifiers (ERISA plan number).

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Benefit plan costs and contributions tracked in currencies. Needed for benefit expense accounting, multi-currency benefit administration, financial reporting, and expatriate benefit management in glob

attributes.name: annual_contribution_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount an employee can contribute to this plan in a calendar year. Applicable to FSA, HSA, 401k, and other contribution-based plans.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969 (HSA), IRS Publication 15-B (FSA), IRC Section 402(g) (401k)

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or third-party administrator providing the benefit plan (e.g., 'Aetna', 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'Fidelity').

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or contract number assigned by the carrier to this benefit plan. Used for claims processing and carrier communication.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of covered service costs the employee pays after meeting the deductible (e.g., 20.00 for 20% coinsurance). Null if plan uses copays.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted and paid: weekly, biweekly (every two weeks), semimonthly (twice per month), monthly, or annual.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the employee pays for covered services (e.g., doctor visit, prescription). Null if plan uses coinsurance instead.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Benefit coverage amount for life insurance or disability plans (e.g., $50,000 life insurance, 60% salary replacement for disability). Null for non-insurance plans.

attributes.name: coverage_multiple_of_salary
attributes.description: Coverage amount expressed as a multiple of employee annual salary (e.g., 2.00 for 2x salary life insurance). Null if coverage is fixed amount.

attributes.name: coverage_tier_structure
attributes.description: Defines how coverage levels are structured: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, employee plus family, tiered (multiple levels), or composite (single rate for all).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount the employee must pay before insurance coverage begins for applicable plan types (health, dental, vision). Null for non-insurance plans.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302, Internal Benefits Administration Standard

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit plan is no longer available for new enrollments or coverage ends. Null for ongoing plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this benefit plan becomes available for employee enrollment and coverage begins. Plan activation date.

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_description
attributes.description: Textual description of eligibility criteria for this plan (e.g., 'Full-time employees with 90 days of service', 'All regular employees', 'Executive level and above').

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the employee contributes per pay period for this benefit plan. Null if contribution is percentage-based or varies by tier.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total premium cost the employee contributes (e.g., 20.00 for 20%). Null if contribution is fixed dollar amount.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the employer contributes per pay period for this benefit plan. Null if contribution is percentage-based or varies by tier.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total premium cost the employer contributes (e.g., 80.00 for 80%). Null if contribution is fixed dollar amount.

attributes.name: employer_match_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount or percentage of salary the employer will match for retirement plan contributions. Null if no match or non-retirement plan.

attributes.name: employer_match_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of employee contributions the employer matches for retirement plans (e.g., 50.00 for 50% match up to a limit). Null for non-retirement plans.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Number
attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned for ERISA reporting purposes. Required for Form 5500 filing for qualifying benefit plans.

attributes.name: is_aca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this health plan meets Affordable Care Act (ACA) minimum essential coverage and affordability requirements.

attributes.name: is_cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage after employment termination. True for most health, dental, and vision plans.
attributes.references: COBRA (Title X of the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985)

attributes.name: open_enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the annual open enrollment period ends for this benefit plan. Last day employees can make benefit elections for the upcoming plan year.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the annual open enrollment period begins for this benefit plan. Employees can enroll, change, or cancel coverage during this window.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount an employee pays in a plan year for covered services before insurance pays 100%. Applicable to health insurance plans.

attributes.name: plan_administrator_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (email or phone) for the plan administrator. Used for employee inquiries and regulatory communication.

attributes.name: plan_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or department responsible for administering this benefit plan within the organization.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the benefit plan in external systems and communications. Used for plan enrollment and payroll integration.

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official plan document, summary plan description (SPD), or benefits guide for employee reference.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the benefit plan as presented to employees (e.g., 'Comprehensive Health Plan - PPO Gold', 'Basic Dental Coverage').

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit plan: active (available for enrollment), inactive (not currently offered), pending (awaiting approval or activation), suspended (temporarily unavailable), or terminated (permanently closed).

attributes.name: plan_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the plan type (e.g., for health: PPO, HMO, EPO, HDHP; for retirement: 401k Traditional, 401k Roth, Defined Benefit Pension).

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan: health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term or long-term disability, retirement (401k, pension), flexible spending account (FSA), health reimbursement arrangement (HRA), health savings account (HSA), or employee assistance program (EAP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health|dental|vision|life|disability|retirement|fsa|hra|hsa|eap — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_year_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the plan year for this benefit. After this date, a new plan year begins with reset deductibles and limits.

attributes.name: plan_year_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the plan year for this benefit. Defines the 12-month period for coverage, deductibles, and out-of-pocket maximums.

attributes.name: summary_plan_description_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Summary Plan Description (SPD) Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the Summary Plan Description (SPD) document required by ERISA for employee benefit plans.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium cost per pay period for the base coverage tier (typically employee-only). Combined employee and employer contributions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vesting_schedule_description
attributes.description: Description of the vesting schedule for employer contributions to retirement plans (e.g., 'Immediate', '3-year cliff', '5-year graded'). Null for non-retirement plans.

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days an employee must wait after hire date before becoming eligible for this benefit plan. Zero indicates immediate eligibility.

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Employee benefit enrollment record capturing an employee's active elections across benefit plans. Includes enrollment effective date, coverage tier selected, dependent coverage, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, waiver status, and enrollment source (open enrollment, life event, new hire). Supports ERISA compliance, ACA reporting (Form 1095-C), and benefits cost allocation to GL cost centers.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the benefit plan in which the employee is enrolled. Links to the benefit plan master record.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Individual enrollment premiums may be currency-specific. Supports expatriate benefit management, multi-currency payroll deduction processing, and benefit cost tracking for employees in different juris

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee who enrolled in the benefit plan. Links to the employee master record in the Human Capital Management (HCM) system.

attributes.name: aca_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment must be included in ACA Form 1095-C reporting. True if the enrollment is subject to ACA reporting requirements (e.g., health insurance coverage), False otherwise.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment has been approved by the benefits administrator or HR. Some enrollments (e.g., life events) require manual approval before becoming effective.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the enrollment was approved. Null if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the benefits administrator or HR representative who approved the enrollment, if approval was required. Null if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has designated beneficiaries for this benefit enrollment (applicable for life insurance, retirement plans, etc.). True if beneficiaries have been designated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: carrier_member_number
attributes.description: The unique member identifier assigned by the insurance carrier to the employee for this benefit enrollment. Used for claims processing and coordination with the carrier.

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance carrier's policy or contract number under which this enrollment is covered. Used for coordination with external insurance carriers and claims processing.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_sent_date

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date

attributes.name: enrollment_method

attributes.name: enrollment_status

products.name: candidate
products.description: Talent acquisition master and transactional record representing the full recruiting lifecycle from headcount demand through candidate hire. On the demand side, captures requisition details including requisition number, linked position, hiring manager, recruiter assigned, requisition type (backfill, new headcount, replacement), target start date, approved salary range, sourcing channels, requisition status (open, on-hold, filled, cancelled), and time-to-fill tracking. On the candidate side, captures candidate name, contact information, source channel, application date, current employer, education, experience, application status and stage progression (screening, interview, offer, hire, reject), disposition reason, offer details, and regulatory background check status including OFAC/sanctions screening. Serves as the SSOT for all recruiting activity including requisition management, pipeline tracking, EEO/OFCCP compliance, adverse impact analysis, diversity hiring tracking, and headcount budget control.

products.name: workforce_plan
products.description: Strategic workforce and succession planning record capturing forward-looking headcount demand/supply projections and leadership continuity plans by business unit. On the workforce planning side, captures planning horizon, scenario type (base, stress, growth), org unit, job family, projected headcount demand, current supply, gap analysis, planned hiring actions, planned attrition assumptions, and budget envelope. attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: ethics_hotline_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this case was reported through the corporate ethics hotline or anonymous reporting channel.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation was completed and findings were documented, prior to resolution action implementation.

attributes.name: investigation_findings
attributes.description: Comprehensive summary of the investigation findings, conclusions, and determinations made by the investigator based on evidence gathered and interviews conducted.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal investigation activities commenced following case intake and assignment.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the legal jurisdiction governing employment law compliance for this case.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee relations case record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether case documentation and related records are subject to legal hold for preservation due to pending or anticipated litigation.

attributes.name: litigation_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this case presents potential employment litigation risk requiring legal department involvement and special handling.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) designation for the organizational unit where the case originated, used for segment reporting and risk aggregation.

attributes.name: material_risk_taker_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the employee subject to this case is classified as a material risk taker under regulatory capital and compensation rules, requiring enhanced oversight and reporting.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), European Banking Authority (EBA)

attributes.name: pip_initiated_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan was initiated as part of the case resolution.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this case must be reported to regulatory authorities such as Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), or Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) due to the nature of the violation or employee role.
attributes.references: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Type of disciplinary or corrective action taken as a result of the investigation findings, ranging from no action to termination for cause. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_action|verbal_warning|written_warning|pip|suspension|termination|training|mediation|policy_change — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the resolution action was formally communicated to the employee and implemented.

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the resolution actions taken, including specific terms of warnings, Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) requirements, suspension duration, or termination rationale.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: retaliation_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the case involves allegations of retaliation against an employee for protected activity such as whistleblowing or filing a complaint.
attributes.references: Dodd-Frank Act, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)

attributes.name: senior_manager_regime_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this case involves a senior manager subject to Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR) fitness and propriety requirements.
attributes.references: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA)

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this case is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) internal control requirements, particularly for whistleblower protections and financial reporting integrity.

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: Date when employee suspension concluded and the employee was eligible to return to work.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Date when employee suspension commenced as a disciplinary action resulting from the case investigation.

attributes.name: termination_for_cause_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the case resulted in termination of employment for cause, which has implications for severance, unemployment benefits, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: whistleblower_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this case originated from a whistleblower complaint, requiring special protections under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Act and Dodd-Frank whistleblower provisions.

products.name: onboarding_event
products.description: Employee onboarding and offboarding lifecycle event record tracking the end-to-end process of integrating new hires and separating departing employees. Captures event type (new hire onboarding, transfer onboarding, offboarding/separation), milestone checklist (background check completion, I-9 verification, system access provisioning, compliance training completion, equipment issuance/return, exit interview, access revocation), milestone status, target date, actual completion date, responsible party, and regulatory clearance flags. Supports banking-specific requirements including FINRA registration initiation, entitlement access reviews, SOX Day-1 controls, and OCC fitness and propriety onboarding checks.

attributes.name: onboarding_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding or offboarding event record. Primary key for the onboarding event entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system account that last modified the onboarding or offboarding event record. Used for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: hr_position_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the HR position being filled (for onboarding) or vacated (for offboarding). Links to the HR position master record for workforce planning and headcount tracking.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.jurisdiction. Business justification: Onboarding compliance requirements vary by jurisdiction (I-9 verification, FINRA registration, fitness & propriety reviews). Required for regulatory clearance tracking, compliance workflow management,

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the organizational unit (department, division, business unit) to which the employee is being onboarded or from which they are offboarding. Links to the organizational unit master record.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: primary_onboarding_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee undergoing onboarding or offboarding. Links to the employee master record.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: access_revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when all system access and entitlements were revoked for the departing employee. Must occur on or before separation date per SOX controls. Null for onboarding events.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: access_revocation_status
attributes.description: Status of access revocation milestone (offboarding only): not applicable (onboarding event), in progress (revocation underway), revoked (access removed), or verified (revocation confirmed by security team). Critical for SOX ITGC and information security compliance.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when all onboarding or offboarding milestones were completed and the event was closed. Null if event is still in progress.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: background_check_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the background check was completed and results were received. Required for regulatory audit trails and Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Day-1 controls.
attributes.references: OCC Fitness and Propriety Standards, SOX HR Controls

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the background check milestone: not started, in progress, cleared (passed), flagged (requires review), or failed (disqualifying findings). Critical for banking regulatory compliance and Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) fitness and propriety requirements.
attributes.references: OCC Fitness and Propriety Standards, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or context related to the onboarding or offboarding event. May include escalation notes, exception approvals, or coordination details.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: compliance_training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all mandatory compliance training courses were completed. Required for regulatory reporting and audit evidence.
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), FINRA, OCC Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_training_status
attributes.description: Status of mandatory compliance training completion milestone: not started, in progress, completed (all required courses finished), or overdue (past due date). Includes Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), and ethics training required for banking employees.
attributes.references: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), FINRA, OCC Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding or offboarding event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: employee_start_date
attributes.description: Official start date or hire date for the employee (for onboarding events) or the effective date of transfer (for transfer onboarding). Represents the date the employee begins their role.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: entitlement_access_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the entitlement access review was completed and documented. Required for SOX audit evidence and quarterly access certification.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: entitlement_access_review_status
attributes.description: Status of entitlement access review milestone: not started, in progress, completed (access validated and approved), or failed (access violations identified). Required for SOX user access reviews and segregation of duties testing.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: equipment_issuance_date
attributes.description: Date when equipment was issued to the employee (for onboarding) or returned by the employee (for offboarding). Used for asset tracking and inventory management.

attributes.name: equipment_issuance_status
attributes.description: Status of equipment issuance or return milestone: not started, in progress, issued (equipment provided to employee), or returned (equipment collected during offboarding). Includes laptops, mobile devices, access badges, and other company property.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or case number for the onboarding or offboarding event, used for tracking and reference in HR systems and communications.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: event_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the onboarding or offboarding event was initiated or formally commenced. Represents the beginning of the lifecycle process.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the onboarding or offboarding event: initiated (event created), in progress (tasks underway), completed (all milestones finished), cancelled (event aborted), or on hold (temporarily paused).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of lifecycle event: new hire onboarding (external hire), transfer onboarding (internal move requiring new access/setup), offboarding (voluntary or involuntary separation), or separation (termination).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: exit_interview_date
attributes.description: Date when the exit interview was conducted. Null for onboarding events or if exit interview was not completed.

attributes.name: exit_interview_status
attributes.description: Status of exit interview milestone (offboarding only): not applicable (onboarding event), scheduled, completed, declined (employee refused), or waived (not required). Used for retention analytics and organizational feedback.

attributes.name: finra_registration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration Date
attributes.description: Date when FINRA registration was approved or submitted. Null if not applicable to the employee role.

attributes.name: finra_registration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration Status
attributes.description: Status of FINRA registration initiation milestone (for registered representatives and broker-dealer employees): not applicable (non-registered role), initiated, submitted (application filed), approved (registration granted), or rejected. Required for investment banking and securities trading roles.

attributes.name: i9_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the I-9 employment eligibility verification was completed. Must be within three business days of hire date per USCIS regulations.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) I-9 Requirements

attributes.name: i9_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the I-9 employment eligibility verification milestone (U.S. only): not started, in progress, verified (compliant), expired (requires reverification), or failed (ineligible). Required for U.S. labor law compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) I-9 Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding or offboarding event record was last updated. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: material_risk_taker_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is classified as a material risk taker under Basel III and Dodd-Frank compensation rules. Material risk takers are subject to enhanced compensation controls, deferral requirements, and regulatory reporting. True if material risk taker, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Dodd-Frank Act Section 956

attributes.name: occ_fitness_propriety_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) Fitness and Propriety Review Date
attributes.description: Date when the OCC fitness and propriety review was completed. Null if not applicable to the employee role.
attributes.references: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) 12 CFR Part 5

attributes.name: occ_fitness_propriety_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) Fitness and Propriety Status
attributes.description: Status of OCC fitness and propriety onboarding check (for senior management and material risk taker roles): not applicable (non-covered role), in progress, cleared (approved), or flagged (requires additional review). Required for executive officers, directors, and key control function roles in federally chartered banks.
attributes.references: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) 12 CFR Part 5

attributes.name: regulatory_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the role requires regulatory clearance or approval before the employee can begin work (e.g., FINRA registration, OCC fitness and propriety approval, Federal Reserve Board approval for bank holding company officers). True if regulatory clearance required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: separation_date
attributes.description: Official last working day or termination date for the employee (for offboarding events). Null for onboarding events.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this onboarding or offboarding event is subject to SOX internal control testing and documentation requirements. True if SOX controls apply (e.g., roles with financial reporting access, IT privileged access, or segregation of duties requirements), false otherwise.

attributes.name: sox_day1_control_status
attributes.description: Status of SOX Day-1 control testing for new hire onboarding: not applicable (offboarding or non-SOX role), passed (controls effective), failed (control deficiency identified), or pending (testing in progress). Validates that access provisioning, segregation of duties, and background checks were completed before system access was granted.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: sox_day1_control_test_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Day-1 Control Test Date
attributes.description: Date when SOX Day-1 control testing was performed and documented. Required for SOX compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: system_access_provisioning_date
attributes.description: Date when system access and entitlements were provisioned or revoked. Used for SOX Day-1 control testing and access review audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: system_access_provisioning_status
attributes.description: Status of system access and entitlement provisioning milestone: not started, in progress, provisioned (access granted), or revoked (access removed for offboarding). Critical for SOX IT General Controls (ITGC) and segregation of duties.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date by which all onboarding or offboarding milestones should be completed. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: previous_onboarding_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on onboarding_event (previous_onboarding_event_id)

products.name: time_attendance
products.description: Employee time and attendance record capturing work hours, overtime, leave balances, and absence tracking. Includes time entry, approval workflow, and integration with payroll processing.

attributes.name: time_attendance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time and attendance record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved this time entry, establishing accountability in the approval workflow.

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll run in which this time entry was processed and paid, linking time data to compensation.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee to whom this time and attendance record belongs. Links to the employee master data.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: absence_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours recorded as absence or leave for this time entry, deducted from available leave balances.

attributes.name: absence_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of absence when the time entry represents leave or absence (e.g., sick leave, vacation, personal leave, FMLA).

attributes.name: activity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific activity or task performed during the work period, used for detailed labor analytics and productivity tracking.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry was approved by the authorized approver (typically manager or supervisor).

attributes.name: break_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of breaks taken during the work period, which may be paid or unpaid depending on policy and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the employee clocked in or started their work period, captured from time clock or system entry.

attributes.name: clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the employee clocked out or ended their work period, captured from time clock or system entry.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes provided by the employee, manager, or timekeeper regarding this time entry.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the time and associated labor costs should be allocated for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.
attributes.references: General Ledger and Financial Accounting System (Oracle Financials / SAP S4HANA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time and attendance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked that qualify for double-time premium pay, typically for work on holidays or beyond a certain overtime threshold.

attributes.name: early_departure_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the employee departed early relative to their scheduled end time, used for attendance policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any time and attendance exception or policy violation associated with this entry (e.g., missing punch, excessive overtime).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: flsa_overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Overtime Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the employee is eligible for FLSA overtime premium pay for hours worked beyond the standard threshold.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time and attendance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the employee arrived late relative to their scheduled start time, used for attendance policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: no_show_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the employee failed to report for a scheduled shift without prior notification or approved absence.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked beyond regular hours, typically subject to premium pay rates as defined by labor regulations and employment contracts.

attributes.name: paid_time_off_hours
attributes.description: Number of paid time off hours used for this time entry, drawn from the employee's PTO balance.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: payroll_processing_date
attributes.description: Date when this time entry was processed through payroll and included in employee compensation calculations.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Project or work order code to which the time should be charged, enabling project-based time tracking and cost allocation.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular work hours recorded for this time entry, typically within standard contracted hours and not subject to overtime premium.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code provided when a time entry is rejected by the approver, requiring correction and resubmission.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Planned or scheduled end time for the work period based on the employee's work schedule or shift assignment.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned or scheduled start time for the work period based on the employee's work schedule or shift assignment.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the scheduled shift or work schedule pattern for this time entry (e.g., day shift, night shift, rotating schedule).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this time entry is subject to SOX internal controls for financial reporting accuracy and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee or timekeeper submitted the time entry for approval.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: time_entry_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the time entry record, typically system-generated or user-assigned for tracking and reference purposes.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: time_entry_source
attributes.description: Source system or method through which the time entry was captured (time clock, manual entry, mobile app, etc.).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: time_entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the time entry record indicating its position in the approval and processing workflow.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: time_entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the time entry indicating the nature of hours worked or absence recorded (regular hours, overtime, leave, etc.).

attributes.name: total_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked for this time entry, calculated as the sum of regular, overtime, and double-time hours.

attributes.name: unpaid_leave_hours
attributes.description: Number of unpaid leave hours recorded for this time entry, not compensated and not deducted from paid leave balances.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work hours or attendance event occurred. Primary business event date for time tracking.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical or virtual location where the work was performed (office, branch, remote, client site).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: parent_time_attendance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on time_attendance (parent_time_attendance_id)

products.name: succession_plan
products.description: Succession planning record for critical roles and key positions. Captures target position, identified successors, readiness assessment, development actions, and timeline.

attributes.name: succession_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the succession planning record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the executive or board member who approved the succession plan.

attributes.name: hr_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the critical role or key position being planned for succession.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit or business division where the succession plan applies.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior leader or HR business partner responsible for overseeing and maintaining the succession plan.

attributes.name: primary_succession_successor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary identified successor employee for the target position.

attributes.name: quaternary_succession_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or HR professional who originally created the succession plan record.

attributes.name: quinary_succession_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who most recently modified the succession plan record.

attributes.name: tertiary_succession_incumbent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the current employee occupying the target position for which succession is being planned.

attributes.name: alco_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this succession plan is reported to the Asset-Liability Committee due to the positions impact on balance sheet management or liquidity risk.
attributes.references: Basel Committee Principles for Sound Liquidity Risk Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan received formal approval from the designated authority.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the succession plan within the governance workflow, indicating whether it has received required management or board endorsement.

attributes.name: board_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this succession plan is subject to board-level reporting and oversight, typically for executive or critical roles.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 08-8 Guidance on Risk Management

attributes.name: ccar_stress_scenario_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) Stress Scenario Flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the succession plan is considered in CCAR stress testing scenarios, particularly for roles critical to capital planning and risk management.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context regarding the succession plan, development progress, or special considerations.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting cost center code associated with the target position, used for budgeting and expense allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when the succession plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_position_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the target position is classified as business-critical, requiring heightened succession planning rigor and board oversight.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve SR 13-1 Guidance on Managing Outsourcing Risk

attributes.name: development_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the development actions, training programs, stretch assignments, and experiences required to prepare the successor for the target role.

attributes.name: development_plan_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the development plan activities for the identified successor.

attributes.name: incumbent_expected_departure_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the current incumbent is expected to vacate the position due to retirement, promotion, or other transition.

attributes.name: key_person_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the position represents a key person risk where departure or unavailability would materially impact business operations or strategic objectives.
attributes.references: Basel Committee Principles for Sound Management of Operational Risk

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when the succession plan record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan was most recently reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and progress against development milestones.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Business line or segment to which the target position and succession plan are aligned, such as Retail Banking, Investment Banking, or Wealth Management.

attributes.name: material_risk_taker_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the target position is designated as a Material Risk Taker role under regulatory frameworks such as CRD IV, requiring enhanced governance and compensation controls.
attributes.references: EBA Guidelines on Material Risk Takers

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory review of the succession plan, ensuring ongoing alignment with business needs and talent availability.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or reference code for the succession plan, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: plan_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan becomes active and enters into force for governance and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the succession plan is scheduled to conclude or be superseded, typically aligned with the transition completion or plan refresh cycle.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the succession plan indicating its stage in the planning and approval workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|under_review|approved|on_hold|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the succession plan based on urgency, horizon, and strategic importance.

attributes.name: readiness_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the successor readiness level was last assessed or reviewed by management.

attributes.name: readiness_level
attributes.description: Assessment of how soon the identified successor will be ready to assume the target role, based on skills, experience, and development progress.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the succession plan must be disclosed to regulatory authorities such as the Federal Reserve, OCC, or EBA under governance or risk management reporting requirements.

attributes.name: retention_risk_rating

A fund may have multiple classes with different fee structures and currencies targeting different investor segments.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund share class or unit class. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Share class currency denomination (USD, EUR, GBP hedged classes) drives pricing, FX hedging strategy, and investor suitability. Essential for multi-currency fund structures and currency overlay manage

attributes.name: domicile_country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Share class domicile may differ from umbrella fund (e.g., Irish umbrella with Luxembourg share class). Determines tax treatment, withholding obligations, and regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.description: Reference to the parent fund to which this share class belongs. A fund may have multiple classes with different fee structures and currencies targeting different investor segments.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Share classes may be domiciled in different legal entities for tax optimization (e.g., offshore vs onshore classes). Required for entity-level financial reporting and tax provision calculations.

attributes.name: benchmark_index
attributes.description: Name of the market index or composite benchmark against which the fund class performance is measured (e.g., S&P 500, MSCI World, Bloomberg Barclays Aggregate). Used for performance attribution and investor reporting.

attributes.name: bloomberg_ticker
attributes.description: Bloomberg-assigned ticker symbol for the fund class. Used for market data retrieval, pricing, and analytics on Bloomberg Terminal.

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the share class within the fund (e.g., A, B, I, R, Institutional). Used for internal classification and operational processing.

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the share class (e.g., Institutional Class, Retail Class A, Hedged EUR Class). Human-readable identifier used in client reporting and marketing materials.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund class record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cusip
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) Number
attributes.description: 9-character alphanumeric code identifying the fund class in North American markets. Used for trade settlement and regulatory reporting in the United States and Canada.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the upstream operational system from which this fund class record originated (e.g., SimCorp Dimension, BlackRock Aladdin, proprietary fund accounting system). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: dealing_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Time of day (HH:MM format) by which subscription and redemption orders must be received to be processed at the next available NAV. Orders received after this time are processed at the subsequent NAV.

attributes.name: dealing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which investors can subscribe to or redeem from the fund class. Must align with or be less frequent than NAV calculation frequency.

attributes.name: distribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which income distributions are paid to investors for distributing share classes. Accumulating classes have value 'none'.

attributes.name: distribution_policy
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund class distributes income to investors (distributing) or reinvests it (accumulating). Flexible classes may switch based on fund manager discretion.

attributes.name: entry_load_rate
attributes.description: Front-end sales charge or entry fee applied when an investor subscribes to the fund class, expressed as a decimal percentage of the subscription amount. May be waived for institutional investors.

attributes.name: exit_load_rate
attributes.description: Back-end sales charge or exit fee applied when an investor redeems shares from the fund class, expressed as a decimal percentage of the redemption amount. Often used to discourage short-term trading.

attributes.name: hedged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund class employs currency hedging to mitigate foreign exchange risk for investors. True if hedged, False if unhedged.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund class was launched and became available for investor subscriptions. Used to calculate performance track record and regulatory reporting periods.

attributes.name: investor_eligibility
attributes.description: Classification of investor types eligible to invest in this share class. Determines minimum investment thresholds, fee structures, and regulatory treatment.

attributes.name: isin
attributes.description: 12-character alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the fund class globally. Required for regulatory reporting and cross-border distribution.

attributes.name: kiid_url
attributes.description: Web address (URL) where the Key Investor Information Document (KIID) or Key Information Document (KID) can be accessed. Mandatory pre-contractual disclosure document for UCITS and PRIIPs.

attributes.name: lei_code

attributes.name: management_fee_rate

attributes.name: minimum_initial_investment
attributes.description: Minimum amount required for an investor to make an initial subscription into the fund class, expressed in the class currency. Used to enforce eligibility and operational thresholds.

attributes.name: minimum_subsequent_investment
attributes.description: Minimum amount required for additional subscriptions after the initial investment. May be lower than the initial minimum to encourage ongoing contributions.

attributes.name: nav_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the Net Asset Value (NAV) is calculated and published for the fund class. Daily is most common for liquid funds; less frequent for alternative or illiquid strategies.

attributes.name: ongoing_charges_figure
attributes.description: Annual charges taken from the fund class excluding transaction costs and performance fees, expressed as a decimal percentage of AUM. Required disclosure metric under UCITS regulations.

attributes.name: performance_fee_rate
attributes.description: Performance-based fee charged when the fund class exceeds a specified benchmark or hurdle rate, expressed as a decimal percentage of outperformance. Common in hedge funds and alternative investment funds.

attributes.name: prospectus_url
attributes.description: Web address (URL) where the current prospectus or offering document for the fund class can be accessed. Required for investor disclosure and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
