products.name: fund_performance
products.description: Periodic fund performance record capturing time-weighted returns (TWR) and money-weighted returns (MWR/IRR) for each fund class over standard reporting periods (1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, since inception). Captures gross and net returns, benchmark return, active return (alpha), tracking error, Sharpe ratio, information ratio, maximum drawdown, volatility, and GIPS compliance flag. Used for investor reporting, fund factsheets, and regulatory disclosures.
products.reference: Fund Performance Record / GIPS Composite Return

attributes.name: fund_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund performance record.

attributes.name: benchmark_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the benchmark index used for performance comparison (e.g., S&P 500, MSCI World, Bloomberg Barclays Aggregate).

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific fund share class (e.g., Class A, Class I, Institutional) for which performance is calculated.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fund for which performance is being measured.

attributes.name: nav_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Performance metrics currency denomination for return calculation and peer comparison. Essential for GIPS compliance and performance attribution.

attributes.name: primary_fund_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that performed the performance calculation.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.stress_scenario. Business justification: Performance attribution under stress scenarios measures risk-adjusted returns and worst-case performance. Required for AIFMD stress testing disclosure and investor reporting. Real process: stressed pe

attributes.name: yield_curve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.yield_curve. Business justification: Performance attribution for fixed income funds requires yield curve data for return decomposition (carry, rolldown, spread, curve shift). Essential for explaining bond portfolio returns to investors.

attributes.name: active_return_pct
attributes.description: Excess return of the fund relative to the benchmark (fund return minus benchmark return), also known as alpha. Measures the value added by active management.

attributes.name: average_aum
attributes.description: Average total net assets of the fund during the performance period, used for expense ratio and turnover calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, GIPS Standards

attributes.name: beginning_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per share at the start of the performance period.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: benchmark_return_pct
attributes.description: Return of the benchmark index over the same performance period, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: beta
attributes.description: Measure of the fund's sensitivity to benchmark movements. Beta of 1.0 indicates the fund moves in line with the benchmark; >1.0 indicates higher volatility; <1.0 indicates lower volatility.
attributes.references: CFA Institute, Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM)

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance metrics were calculated.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Specific mathematical method used to calculate the performance return: Modified Dietz (approximation), True TWR (daily valuation), Simple TWR (periodic valuation), IRR (money-weighted).

attributes.name: capital_appreciation_pct
attributes.description: Portion of total return attributable to capital gains (price appreciation), expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ending_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per share at the end of the performance period.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, FASB ASC 946

attributes.name: expense_ratio_pct
attributes.description: Total annual operating expenses as a percentage of average net assets during the performance period. Includes management fees, administrative costs, and other fund expenses.

attributes.name: gips_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the performance calculation and presentation comply with Global Investment Performance Standards established by CFA Institute.

attributes.name: income_return_pct
attributes.description: Portion of total return attributable to income (dividends, interest, distributions), expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: information_ratio
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted active return metric calculated as active return / tracking error. Measures excess return per unit of active risk.

attributes.name: maximum_drawdown_pct
attributes.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline in fund value during the performance period, expressed as a percentage. Measures downside risk and worst-case loss scenario.

attributes.name: mwr_return_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Money-Weighted Return (MWR) / Internal Rate of Return (IRR) Percentage
attributes.description: Money-weighted return (also known as Internal Rate of Return or IRR) that accounts for the timing and magnitude of cash flows. Reflects the actual investor experience including contribution and withdrawal timing effects.

attributes.name: number_of_holdings
attributes.description: Total count of distinct securities held in the fund portfolio at the end of the performance period.

attributes.name: performance_attribution_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed performance attribution analysis (sector allocation, security selection effects) is available for this performance record.

attributes.name: performance_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period.

attributes.name: performance_period_type
attributes.description: Standard reporting period for the performance calculation. ITD = Inception-to-Date (since inception). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1M|3M|6M|YTD|1Y|3Y|5Y|ITD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: performance_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period.

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the performance record in its lifecycle: preliminary (initial calculation), final (confirmed), restated (corrected after finalization), audited (verified by external auditor).

attributes.name: r_squared
attributes.description: Statistical measure (0 to 1) indicating how much of the fund's movements can be explained by benchmark movements. Higher values indicate greater correlation with the benchmark.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance record is used for regulatory reporting purposes (SEC filings, prospectus updates, factsheet disclosures).

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which performance metrics are reported to investors. May differ from base fund currency for multi-currency share classes.

attributes.name: risk_free_rate_pct
attributes.description: Risk-free rate of return used in risk-adjusted performance calculations (Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio). Typically based on government treasury securities of comparable duration.

attributes.name: sharpe_ratio
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted return metric calculated as (fund return - risk-free rate) / standard deviation of returns. Measures excess return per unit of total risk.

attributes.name: sortino_ratio
attributes.description: Risk-adjusted return metric similar to Sharpe ratio but using downside deviation instead of total standard deviation. Focuses on downside risk only.

attributes.name: total_return_amount
attributes.description: Absolute dollar amount of return generated during the performance period, calculated as ending NAV minus beginning NAV plus distributions.

attributes.name: tracking_error_pct
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the difference between fund returns and benchmark returns, expressed as a percentage. Measures the consistency of active return.

attributes.name: turnover_ratio_pct
attributes.description: Measure of how frequently assets within the fund are bought and sold, expressed as a percentage of average net assets. Higher turnover may indicate more active trading.

attributes.name: twr_gross_return_pct
attributes.description: Time-weighted return before deduction of fees, expressed as a percentage. TWR eliminates the effect of cash flows and measures the compound growth rate of the portfolio.

attributes.name: twr_net_return_pct
attributes.description: Time-weighted return after deduction of all fees and expenses, expressed as a percentage. This is the return actually realized by investors.
attributes.references: GIPS Standards, SEC Investment Company Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was last modified.

attributes.name: volatility_pct
attributes.description: Annualized standard deviation of fund returns over the performance period, expressed as a percentage. Measures total risk and return variability.

attributes.name: previous_fund_performance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_performance (previous_fund_performance_id)

attributes.description: Reference to the fund to which this benchmark is assigned.

attributes.name: rate_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.rate_benchmark. Business justification: Performance benchmark (SOFR, SONIA, MSCI World) for relative return calculation, tracking error monitoring, and investment mandate compliance. Core requirement for performance attribution.

attributes.name: superseded_by_benchmark_fund_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund_benchmark_id that replaces this benchmark assignment. Populated when benchmark_status is superseded. Enables tracking of benchmark change history.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benchmark assignment was formally approved by the governing authority.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, Fund Governance Best Practices

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or committee that approved this benchmark assignment (e.g., Investment Committee, Board of Directors, Chief Investment Officer).
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, Fund Governance Best Practices

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale for assigning this benchmark to the fund or fund class (e.g., investment strategy alignment, investor request, regulatory requirement, board decision, benchmark change due to index discontinuation).
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards

attributes.name: benchmark_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the benchmark is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: benchmark_methodology_description
attributes.description: Brief description of the benchmark construction methodology, including weighting scheme (market-cap weighted, equal-weighted, factor-based), rebalancing frequency, and constituent selection criteria.
attributes.references: CFA Institute GIPS, IOSMA Principles for Financial Benchmarks

attributes.name: benchmark_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization that publishes and maintains the benchmark index (e.g., S&P Dow Jones Indices, MSCI Inc., FTSE Russell, Bloomberg).

attributes.name: benchmark_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benchmark assignment: active (currently in use), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (approved but not yet effective), superseded (replaced by a newer benchmark), or discontinued (permanently retired).
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards

attributes.name: benchmark_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benchmark role: primary (main performance comparison), secondary (supplemental comparison), absolute return hurdle (minimum return threshold for performance fees), composite (blended benchmark), custom (client-specific), or peer group (universe comparison).
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benchmark assignment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: System or vendor from which benchmark return data is sourced (e.g., Bloomberg, FactSet, MSCI Direct, internal calculation). Critical for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this benchmark assignment becomes effective for performance measurement and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards

attributes.name: high_water_mark_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance fees are subject to a high water mark provision, meaning fees are only charged on net new profits above the highest previous Net Asset Value (NAV). Applicable when performance_fee_applicable_flag is true.
attributes.references: Hedge Fund Standards Board (HFSB), Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive (AIFMD)

attributes.name: hurdle_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum return threshold (expressed as annualized percentage) that the fund must exceed before performance fees are charged. Applicable only when benchmark_type is absolute_return_hurdle. Null for market index benchmarks.
attributes.references: Investment Advisers Act of 1940, Hedge Fund Best Practices

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of the benchmark appropriateness by the investment committee or board. Regulatory best practice requires annual benchmark reviews.
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards, AIFMD

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benchmark assignment record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of benchmark appropriateness. Typically annual or as specified in fund governance policies.
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards, AIFMD

attributes.name: performance_fee_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benchmark is used to calculate performance-based fees (incentive fees, carried interest). True if the fund charges performance fees based on outperformance versus this benchmark.
attributes.references: Investment Advisers Act of 1940, SEC Rule 205-3

attributes.name: prospectus_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benchmark is disclosed in the fund prospectus or offering documents as the primary or supplemental performance comparison index.

attributes.name: rebalancing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the benchmark index is reconstituted or rebalanced (e.g., quarterly for most equity indices, monthly for some bond indices).
attributes.references: MSCI Index Methodology, S&P Index Methodology

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance relative to this benchmark must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., SEC Form N-PORT, UCITS KIID).

attributes.name: return_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method by which benchmark returns are calculated: total return (includes dividends reinvested), price return (capital appreciation only), net return (after withholding taxes), or gross return (before taxes).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this benchmark assignment ceases to be effective. Null if the benchmark is currently active.
attributes.references: Investment Company Institute (ICI) Fund Governance Standards

attributes.name: tracking_error_tolerance_bps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tracking Error Tolerance in Basis Points (BPS)
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable tracking error (standard deviation of the difference between fund returns and benchmark returns) expressed in basis points. Used for index funds and passive strategies to monitor replication quality.

attributes.name: usage_context
attributes.description: Primary purpose for which this benchmark is used: performance fee calculation (determines incentive fees), IPS mandate (Investment Policy Statement compliance), investor reporting (client communications), regulatory filing (Form N-1A, UCITS KIID), marketing material (prospectus, factsheets), or risk attribution (portfolio analytics).
attributes.references: SEC Form N-1A, UCITS Directive, CFA Institute GIPS

attributes.name: weighting_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage weight of this benchmark in a composite or blended benchmark structure. For single benchmarks, this is 100.00. For composite benchmarks, the sum of all benchmark weights for a given fund/class should equal 100.00.
attributes.references: CFA Institute Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS)

attributes.name: previous_fund_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_benchmark (previous_fund_benchmark_id)

products.name: transfer_agency_event
products.description: Operational event log for all transfer agency processing activities including order receipt, AML clearance, NAV application, unit allotment/cancellation, settlement confirmation, register update, and investor statement generation. Captures event type, event timestamp, investor account, fund class, processing status, exception flag, exception reason, STP indicator, and operator ID. Provides the complete audit trail for investor servicing operations.

attributes.name: transfer_agency_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transfer agency event record. Primary key for the transfer agency event log.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the financial intermediary or distributor through which the transfer agency event was submitted.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transfer agency operator or system user who processed or initiated the event.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific fund share class involved in the transfer agency event.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fund for which the transfer agency event was processed.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investor account for which the transfer agency event was executed.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investor order that triggered this transfer agency event, if applicable.

attributes.name: parent_event_transfer_agency_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent transfer agency event if this event is part of a multi-step process.

attributes.name: primary_original_event_transfer_agency_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original transfer agency event that is being reversed or corrected by this event.

attributes.name: aml_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of the AML screening and clearance process for this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: aml_clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when AML clearance was completed for this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number issued to the investor for this transfer agency transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer agency event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by transfer agency operators regarding this event.

attributes.name: event_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique business reference number assigned to the transfer agency event for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of this event within a related series of transfer agency events.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the transfer agency event occurred in the processing workflow.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of transfer agency processing activity captured in this event log entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: order_receipt|aml_clearance|nav_application|unit_allotment|unit_cancellation|settlement_confirmation|register_update|statement_generation|redemption_processing|exchange_processing|dividend_reinvestment|systematic_withdrawal — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of exception encountered during processing.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether an exception occurred during the processing of this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exception or error that occurred during transfer agency event processing.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the KYC verification for the investor account at the time of the transfer agency event.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transfer agency event record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nav_date
attributes.description: Date of the NAV used for pricing the transaction in this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: nav_per_unit
attributes.description: Net asset value per unit applied to the transaction in this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Type of investor order being processed in this transfer agency event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: subscription|redemption|exchange|transfer|dividend_reinvestment|systematic_investment|systematic_withdrawal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used for payment or settlement of funds in this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: processing_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the transfer agency event was processed, used for NAV application and accounting purposes.

attributes.name: processing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this transfer agency event for processing queue management.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the transfer agency event in the processing lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|pending|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled|suspended|rejected — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: register_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fund register was updated as a result of this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transfer agency event represents a reversal or correction of a previous event.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the transfer agency transaction is scheduled to settle or has settled.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Status of the settlement process for the transfer agency event.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system that originated or recorded this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: statement_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether an investor statement was generated as a result of this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: statement_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the investor statement was generated for this transfer agency event.

attributes.name: stp_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transfer agency event was processed automatically without manual intervention.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the transaction being processed in the transfer agency event.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the transaction amount.

attributes.name: unit_quantity
attributes.description: Number of fund units or shares involved in the transfer agency event.

attributes.name: previous_transfer_agency_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on transfer_agency_event (previous_transfer_agency_event_id)

products.name: fund_fee_schedule
products.description: Reference master defining the fee structure and calculation methodology for each fund class. Captures management fee rate, performance fee rate, hurdle rate, high-water mark flag, crystallization frequency, entry load schedule, exit load schedule (with holding period tiers), redemption fee, switching fee, TER cap, and fee currency. Serves as the authoritative reference for fee accrual calculations in NAV computation and investor billing.

attributes.name: fund_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund fee schedule record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: fee_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Fee calculation currency for management fees, performance fees, and expense accruals. Required for multi-currency fee billing and TER calculation.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fund class (share class) to which this fee schedule applies. Different share classes within the same fund may have different fee structures.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund to which this fee schedule applies.

attributes.name: superseded_by_schedule_fund_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule that supersedes this one. Null if this is the current active schedule.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule was approved by the fund board or authorized committee.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or committee that approved this fee schedule.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crystallization_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which performance fees are calculated and locked in (crystallized). Determines when performance fee liability becomes payable.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this fee schedule becomes applicable for fee calculations and investor billing.

attributes.name: entry_load_rate
attributes.description: Front-end load fee charged when an investor subscribes to the fund, expressed as a percentage of the subscription amount. Also known as initial charge or sales load.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, UCITS Directive

attributes.name: entry_load_type
attributes.description: Structure of the entry load fee. Flat: single rate for all subscriptions. Tiered: rate varies by subscription amount. Waived: no entry load charged.

attributes.name: exit_load_holding_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days an investor must hold the investment before the exit load is reduced or waived. Used to determine applicable exit load tier.

attributes.name: exit_load_rate
attributes.description: Back-end load fee charged when an investor redeems from the fund, expressed as a percentage of the redemption amount. May vary based on holding period.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, UCITS Directive

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this fee schedule ceases to be applicable. Null indicates an open-ended schedule.

attributes.name: fee_calculation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate and accrue fees. Defines the frequency and timing of fee calculations for Net Asset Value (NAV) computation.

attributes.name: fee_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which accrued fees are paid to the fund manager or service provider.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for this fee schedule, used for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the fee schedule, typically indicating the share class and fee structure type.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fee schedule indicating whether it is currently in use, pending activation, or has been superseded.

attributes.name: high_water_mark_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a high water mark provision applies. When true, performance fees are only charged on net new profits above the highest previous Net Asset Value (NAV) level.

attributes.name: hurdle_rate
attributes.description: Minimum rate of return that must be achieved before performance fees are charged. Expressed as an annual percentage rate.

attributes.name: hurdle_type
attributes.description: Type of hurdle rate application. Hard hurdle: performance fee applies only to returns above the hurdle. Soft hurdle: performance fee applies to all returns once hurdle is exceeded.

attributes.name: management_fee_basis
attributes.description: The base amount on which the management fee is calculated, such as total Assets Under Management (AUM), Net Asset Value (NAV), committed capital, or invested capital.

attributes.name: management_fee_rate
attributes.description: Annual management fee rate expressed as a decimal percentage of Assets Under Management (AUM). Used in Net Asset Value (NAV) calculation and fee accrual.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, SEC Form N-1A

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or explanations related to this fee schedule.

attributes.name: performance_fee_rate
attributes.description: Performance fee rate (also known as incentive fee or carried interest) expressed as a decimal percentage of profits above the hurdle rate. Typically applies to hedge funds and private equity funds.

attributes.name: prospectus_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the section or page in the fund prospectus where this fee schedule is disclosed to investors.

attributes.name: recoupment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether waived fees are eligible for recoupment (recovery) by the fund manager in future periods when expenses fall below the cap.

attributes.name: recoupment_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which waived fees remain eligible for recoupment by the fund manager.

attributes.name: redemption_fee_rate
attributes.description: Fee charged on redemptions to discourage short-term trading and protect long-term investors. Typically retained by the fund rather than paid to the manager. Expressed as a percentage of redemption amount.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, SEC Rule 22c-2

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the fee schedule for compliance and reporting purposes, such as UCITS-compliant, 40 Act compliant, or AIFMD-compliant.
attributes.references: Investment Company Act of 1940, UCITS Directive, AIFMD

attributes.name: switching_fee_rate
attributes.description: Fee charged when an investor switches between different funds or share classes within the same fund family. Expressed as a percentage of the switched amount.

attributes.name: ter_cap
attributes.description: Maximum Total Expense Ratio (TER) that can be charged to investors, expressed as an annual percentage. Any expenses above this cap are absorbed by the fund manager.
attributes.references: UCITS Directive, Investment Company Act of 1940

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this fee schedule, incremented when the schedule is amended. Supports fee schedule change history and audit trail.

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee waiver expires and full fees resume. Null if no waiver is in effect or waiver is indefinite.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fund manager has voluntarily waived or reduced fees for this schedule. Common during fund launch periods or for strategic investor classes.

attributes.name: previous_fund_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_fee_schedule (previous_fund_fee_schedule_id)

products.name: fund_distribution_channel
products.description: Master record for fund distribution channel relationships and agreements. Captures distributor name, distributor type (IFA, bank, platform, insurance wrapper, direct), distribution agreement reference, trailer fee rate, retrocession arrangement, geographic scope, investor segment served, platform codes, and distribution status. Tracks the network of intermediaries through which fund units are sold to end investors.

attributes.name: fund_distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund distribution channel relationship record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Distributor compensation currency for commission payments, trailer fees, and retrocession. Required for multi-currency distribution agreements and payment processing.

attributes.name: distributor_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Distributors are legal entities (parties) requiring KYC/AML screening, regulatory approval tracking, commission payment processing, and relationship management. Links distribution agreements to corpor

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund being distributed through this channel. Links to the fund master record.

attributes.name: relationship_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Distribution channels require dedicated relationship managers (bank employees) for sales target monitoring, commission reconciliation, regulatory compliance oversight, and distributor performance mana

attributes.name: agreement_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the distribution agreement becomes legally effective and the distributor is authorized to sell fund units.

attributes.name: agreement_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the distribution agreement expires or terminates. Null for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: aml_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates which party is responsible for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring and compliance for transactions through this channel.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this distribution channel record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: distribution_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the legal distribution agreement governing this channel relationship.

attributes.name: distribution_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the distribution channel relationship. Indicates whether the distributor is actively authorized to sell fund units.

attributes.name: distributor_identifier
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the distributor, such as Legal Entity Identifier (LEI), FINRA CRD number, or internal distributor code.

attributes.name: distributor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distributor channel type. IFA = Independent Financial Advisor, RIA = Registered Investment Advisor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IFA|bank|platform|insurance_wrapper|direct|broker_dealer|RIA — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distributor has exclusive distribution rights for the fund in the specified geographic scope or investor segment.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic regions or countries where this distributor is authorized to sell the fund. Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional descriptors.

attributes.name: investor_segment_served
attributes.description: The target investor segment that this distribution channel serves. HNWI = High Net Worth Individual.

attributes.name: kyc_responsibility
attributes.description: Indicates which party is responsible for conducting Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence on end investors in this distribution channel.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date when this distribution channel relationship was last reviewed for compliance, performance, and ongoing suitability.

attributes.name: marketing_support_provided
attributes.description: The level of marketing and promotional support provided by the fund manager to this distribution channel.

attributes.name: minimum_investment_amount
attributes.description: The minimum initial investment amount required for subscriptions through this distribution channel, in the fund base currency.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this distribution channel record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this distribution channel record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the next periodic review of this distribution channel relationship is scheduled.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional details, special arrangements, or historical context for this distribution channel relationship.

attributes.name: omnibus_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distributor uses an omnibus account structure where the distributor holds fund units on behalf of multiple underlying investors.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which trailer fees and commissions are paid to the distributor.

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: The platform or system code used by the distributor for fund identification and transaction processing. May include multiple codes separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when regulatory approval was granted for this distribution channel arrangement, if applicable.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory approval is required for this distribution arrangement in the applicable jurisdiction.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The regulatory framework or jurisdiction governing this distribution arrangement, such as SEC, FCA, ESMA, or specific country regulators.

attributes.name: retrocession_arrangement
attributes.description: The type of retrocession or fee-sharing arrangement in place. Describes how distribution fees are paid back to the intermediary.

attributes.name: sales_volume_target
attributes.description: The target sales volume or Assets Under Management (AUM) goal for this distribution channel, in the fund base currency.

attributes.name: sub_accounting_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a sub-accounting agreement is in place where the distributor maintains detailed investor records on behalf of the fund.

attributes.name: termination_notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the distribution agreement.

attributes.name: trailer_fee_rate
attributes.description: The ongoing annual trailer fee or commission rate paid to the distributor, expressed as a percentage of Assets Under Management (AUM). Also known as 12b-1 fee in US context.

attributes.name: upfront_commission_rate
attributes.description: The initial sales commission rate paid to the distributor at the point of sale, expressed as a percentage of the subscription amount.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this distribution channel record.

attributes.name: previous_fund_distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_distribution_channel (previous_fund_distribution_channel_id)

products.name: fund_audit
products.description: Annual and interim fund audit record capturing the external audit engagement for each fund. Captures audit firm, audit type (annual statutory, interim, special purpose), audit period, engagement partner, audit opinion type (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer), audit report date, key audit matters identified, management letter points, and regulatory submission date. Supports fund governance, investor disclosure, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: fund_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund audit engagement record. Primary key for the fund audit entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Fund audits cover fiscal year-end periods aligned with accounting period structure. Required for audit planning, scope definition, and linking audit findings to specific reporting periods.

attributes.name: audit_fee_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Audit fee currency for expense accounting, vendor payment, and TER calculation. Required for multi-currency audit engagement management.

attributes.name: audit_liaison_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Fund audits require internal bank employee coordination for audit committee reporting, regulatory filing oversight, management letter response, and remediation tracking. Controllers or compliance offi

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund being audited. Links to the fund master record.

attributes.name: audit_committee_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund's audit committee reviewed and approved the audit report and financial statements.

attributes.name: audit_documentation_retention_date
attributes.description: Date through which audit documentation and working papers must be retained per regulatory requirements (typically 7 years from report date).

attributes.name: audit_engagement_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the audit firm to this engagement. Used for tracking and correspondence with the auditor.

attributes.name: audit_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee charged by the audit firm for the engagement, including all professional services rendered.
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Regulation S-X

attributes.name: audit_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm conducting the fund audit. Must be a registered public accounting firm.

attributes.name: audit_firm_registration_number
attributes.description: Registration or license number of the audit firm with the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., PCAOB registration number).

attributes.name: audit_opinion_type
attributes.description: The type of opinion issued by the auditor. Unqualified (clean) opinion indicates financial statements are fairly presented; qualified opinion indicates exceptions; adverse opinion indicates material misstatements; disclaimer indicates inability to form an opinion.

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the period covered by this audit engagement.

attributes.name: audit_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the period covered by this audit engagement.

attributes.name: audit_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the auditor's report was signed and issued. This is the date through which the auditor has responsibility for subsequent events.

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Description of the scope and boundaries of the audit engagement, including what financial statements, periods, and areas are covered.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of the audit engagement in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from planning through final filing.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit engagement. Annual statutory audits are required by regulation; interim reviews provide limited assurance; special purpose audits address specific matters; agreed-upon procedures perform specific tests; compliance audits verify regulatory adherence.

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the fund's board of directors formally approved the audited financial statements for publication and filing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund audit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: engagement_partner_license_number
attributes.description: Professional license or certification number of the engagement partner (e.g., CPA license number).
attributes.references: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)

attributes.name: engagement_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead audit partner responsible for the engagement. The partner signs the audit opinion.

attributes.name: fieldwork_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit fieldwork and testing procedures were completed.

attributes.name: fieldwork_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit fieldwork and testing procedures commenced.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_end_date
attributes.description: The fiscal year end date for which this audit is being conducted. Typically aligns with the fund's fiscal year end.

attributes.name: going_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor identified substantial doubt about the fund's ability to continue as a going concern.

attributes.name: key_audit_matters
attributes.description: Description of the key audit matters identified during the engagement. These are matters that required significant auditor attention and judgment.

attributes.name: management_letter_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor issued a management letter with recommendations for operational improvements or control enhancements.

attributes.name: management_letter_points
attributes.description: Summary of key points and recommendations included in the management letter, covering operational improvements, control enhancements, and best practice suggestions.

attributes.name: material_weakness_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any material weaknesses identified in internal controls, including the nature and potential impact.

attributes.name: material_weakness_identified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor identified any material weaknesses in internal controls over financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fund audit record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: opinion_basis
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the basis for the auditor's opinion, including any qualifications, limitations, or emphasis of matter paragraphs.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the audited financial statements and audit report were filed with the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_deadline_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the audited financial statements must be filed to maintain compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_form_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory form used for filing the audit report (e.g., Form N-CSR for certified shareholder reports, Form 10-K for annual reports).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference or accession number assigned by the regulatory authority upon successful filing (e.g., SEC accession number).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit report must be filed with regulatory authorities such as the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

attributes.name: restatement_description
attributes.description: Description of the nature and impact of any financial statement restatements required as a result of the audit findings.

attributes.name: restatement_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit identified errors requiring restatement of previously issued financial statements.

attributes.name: significant_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of significant deficiencies in internal controls identified during the audit that are less severe than material weaknesses but still warrant attention.

attributes.name: subsequent_events_review_date
attributes.description: Date through which the auditor reviewed subsequent events that may require adjustment or disclosure in the financial statements.

attributes.name: previous_fund_audit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_audit (previous_fund_audit_id)

products.name: investor_statement
products.description: Periodic investor account statement record generated by the transfer agency for each investor account. Captures statement period, statement date, opening unit balance, closing unit balance, opening value, closing value, transactions during period (subscriptions, redemptions, distributions), income received, fees deducted, unrealized gain/loss, and delivery method (email, post, portal). Serves as the formal investor communication and tax document.

attributes.name: investor_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the investor statement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Investor statements issued for specific accounting periods (quarterly/annual) must reconcile to NAV and financial statements. Required for investor reporting and regulatory disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Statement values in investor's preferred currency for client servicing and reporting. Required for multi-currency investor communication and regulatory disclosure.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fund class or share class for this statement.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund associated with this investor statement.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investor account for which this statement was generated.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer agent responsible for generating and issuing this statement.

attributes.name: capital_gains_long_term
attributes.description: Long-term capital gains distributed to the investor during the statement period.

attributes.name: capital_gains_short_term
attributes.description: Short-term capital gains distributed to the investor during the statement period.

attributes.name: closing_nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Closing Net Asset Value (NAV) Per Unit
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per unit at the end of the statement period.

attributes.name: closing_unit_balance
attributes.description: Number of fund units or shares held by the investor at the end of the statement period.

attributes.name: closing_value
attributes.description: Total market value of the investor's holdings at the end of the statement period (closing units × closing NAV).

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation or tracking number for statement delivery and audit purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Email address or postal address to which the statement was delivered.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the statement was delivered to the investor.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the statement was successfully delivered to the investor.

attributes.name: fees_deducted
attributes.description: Total fees charged to the investor account during the statement period, including management fees, performance fees, and administrative charges.

attributes.name: generated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the statement record was created in the system.

attributes.name: income_received
attributes.description: Total income allocated to the investor account during the statement period, including dividends and interest.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the statement record was last updated or reissued.

attributes.name: opening_nav_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Opening Net Asset Value (NAV) Per Unit
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per unit at the beginning of the statement period.

attributes.name: opening_unit_balance
attributes.description: Number of fund units or shares held by the investor at the beginning of the statement period.

attributes.name: opening_value
attributes.description: Total market value of the investor's holdings at the beginning of the statement period (opening units × opening NAV).

attributes.name: ordinary_dividend_amount
attributes.description: Portion of distributions classified as ordinary dividends for tax reporting purposes.

attributes.name: qualified_dividend_amount
attributes.description: Portion of distributions that qualify for preferential tax treatment as qualified dividends.

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Actual gains or losses realized from redemption transactions during the statement period.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statement is subject to regulatory reporting requirements such as FATCA or CRS.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the statement was generated and issued to the investor.

attributes.name: statement_format
attributes.description: File format in which the statement was generated and delivered.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the statement, typically sequential or formatted per transfer agent conventions.

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the reporting period covered by this statement.

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the reporting period covered by this statement.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the investor statement.

attributes.name: tax_form_reference
attributes.description: Reference to associated tax forms such as Form 1099-DIV, 1099-B, or equivalent international tax documents.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Tax year to which this statement applies for regulatory and tax reporting purposes.

attributes.name: total_distributions_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all distributions paid or reinvested during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_distributions_units
attributes.description: Total number of fund units issued as distributions (reinvestments) during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_redemptions_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all redemption transactions during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_redemptions_units
attributes.description: Total number of fund units redeemed by the investor during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_subscriptions_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all subscription transactions during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_subscriptions_units
attributes.description: Total number of fund units purchased by the investor during the statement period.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Change in market value of holdings during the statement period, excluding transactions (closing value - opening value - net transactions).

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax withheld from distributions during the statement period for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: previous_investor_statement_id
