products.name: fund_valuation_adjustment
products.description: Record of fair value adjustments, swing pricing adjustments, and anti-dilution levies applied to fund NAV calculations. Captures adjustment type (swing pricing, dilution levy, fair value adjustment, side pocket), adjustment date, adjustment basis, adjustment amount or percentage, triggering condition (net flow threshold, illiquid asset event), approval authority, and impact on dealing NAV. Protects existing investors from dilution caused by large subscriptions or redemptions.
products.reference: Swing Pricing / Anti-Dilution Levy / Fair Value Adjustment

attributes.name: fund_valuation_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund valuation adjustment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.accounting_period. Business justification: Swing pricing and dilution adjustments recorded in specific accounting periods for NAV impact and financial reporting. Required for period-end close and fair value accounting under IFRS 13.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Swing pricing/dilution adjustment currency for fair value adjustment and investor protection. Required for anti-dilution mechanism and NAV adjustment calculation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this adjustment. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance. Null for automated system approvals within pre-approved parameters.

attributes.name: fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fund share class affected by this adjustment. Different share classes may have different adjustment treatments.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund to which this valuation adjustment applies. Links to the fund master record.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Swing pricing and dilution adjustments are triggered by specific illiquid holdings. Direct instrument link enables adjustment calculation based on position size, liquidity, and estimated trading costs

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Valuation adjustments generate journal entries to record NAV impact in general ledger. Required for audit trail, SOX controls, and reconciliation between fund accounting and GL.

attributes.name: nav_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the NAV calculation record to which this adjustment was applied. Links to the specific NAV calculation event.

attributes.name: original_adjustment_fund_valuation_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original adjustment record that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag is true. Maintains audit trail for adjustment corrections.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary amount of the adjustment applied to the NAV calculation. Positive values increase NAV; negative values decrease NAV. Expressed in the fund base currency.

attributes.name: adjustment_basis
attributes.description: The calculation basis or methodology used to determine the adjustment amount. Net flow threshold triggers adjustment when net flows exceed a percentage of AUM; gross subscription/redemption bases adjustment on absolute flow amounts; asset illiquidity bases adjustment on portfolio liquidity profile; market volatility uses market conditions; trading cost estimate uses expected transaction costs.
attributes.references: ESMA Guidelines on Swing Pricing, IOSCO Valuation Principles

attributes.name: adjustment_category
attributes.description: Business category indicating the trigger or reason for the adjustment. Subscription-driven adjustments protect against inflows; redemption-driven protect against outflows; market event adjustments respond to extraordinary market conditions; illiquid asset adjustments address valuation uncertainty; regulatory required adjustments comply with mandates; discretionary adjustments are management decisions.
attributes.references: IOSCO Principles for the Valuation of Collective Investment Schemes

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The valuation date on which this adjustment was applied to the fund NAV calculation. This is the business event date for the adjustment.

attributes.name: adjustment_per_unit
attributes.description: The adjustment amount expressed per fund unit or share. This is the impact on the dealing NAV per unit for investors transacting on this valuation date.

attributes.name: adjustment_percentage
attributes.description: The adjustment expressed as a percentage of NAV or transaction value. Used for swing pricing and dilution levy calculations. Positive percentages increase dealing NAV for subscriptions or decrease for redemptions.

attributes.name: adjustment_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique reference number for this valuation adjustment. Used for audit trail and external reporting.

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the adjustment. Pending adjustments await approval; approved adjustments are authorized but not yet applied; applied adjustments are reflected in NAV; reversed adjustments have been unwound; rejected adjustments were not approved.

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the adjustment calculation was executed and applied to the NAV. Used for audit trail and sequencing of adjustments.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the valuation adjustment mechanism applied. Swing pricing adjusts NAV based on net flows; dilution levy charges incoming/outgoing investors; fair value adjustment corrects stale prices; side pocket segregates illiquid assets; liquidity adjustment reflects market liquidity conditions; anti-dilution levy protects existing investors from trading costs.
attributes.references: ESMA Guidelines on Swing Pricing, SEC Rule 22e-4 Liquidity Risk Management

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The role or authority level that approved this valuation adjustment. Automated system approvals occur when adjustments fall within pre-approved parameters; manual approvals required for discretionary or material adjustments.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the adjustment was formally approved. Required for audit trail and to establish the sequence of NAV calculation events.

attributes.name: calculation_methodology
attributes.description: Detailed description of the mathematical formula or methodology used to calculate the adjustment amount. Includes references to swing pricing models, dilution levy schedules, or fair value adjustment techniques.
attributes.references: IOSCO Principles for the Valuation of Collective Investment Schemes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this adjustment record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dealing_nav_impact
attributes.description: The impact of this adjustment on the dealing NAV per unit used for investor subscriptions and redemptions. This is the NAV that transacting investors receive after adjustment application.

attributes.name: disclosure_text
attributes.description: Standardized disclosure text describing the adjustment for inclusion in investor communications, fund fact sheets, and regulatory filings. Explains the adjustment mechanism and investor impact in plain language.

attributes.name: estimated_trading_cost_bps
attributes.description: Estimated trading costs in basis points used to calculate the adjustment amount. Represents expected bid-ask spreads, market impact, and transaction fees for portfolio rebalancing.
attributes.references: IOSCO Principles for the Valuation of Collective Investment Schemes

attributes.name: gross_redemption_amount
attributes.description: Total gross redemption amount on the adjustment date. Used to calculate dilution impact and determine adjustment magnitude for redemption-driven adjustments.

attributes.name: gross_subscription_amount
attributes.description: Total gross subscription amount on the adjustment date. Used to calculate dilution impact and determine adjustment magnitude for subscription-driven adjustments.

attributes.name: illiquid_asset_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of fund portfolio classified as illiquid assets at the time of adjustment. Used to determine fair value adjustment magnitude and side pocket requirements.

attributes.name: investor_protection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment was applied specifically to protect existing investors from dilution caused by large subscriptions or redemptions. True for anti-dilution mechanisms; false for other adjustment types.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this adjustment record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_flow_amount
attributes.description: The actual net flow amount (subscriptions minus redemptions) on the adjustment date that contributed to triggering the adjustment. Expressed in fund base currency.

attributes.name: net_flow_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The net flow threshold percentage of Assets Under Management (AUM) that triggered the adjustment. Used in swing pricing mechanisms where adjustments activate when net flows exceed a defined percentage.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, explanations, or special circumstances related to this adjustment. Used for audit trail and internal documentation.

attributes.name: published_nav_impact
attributes.description: The impact of this adjustment on the published NAV per unit used for performance reporting and regulatory filings. May differ from dealing NAV if swing pricing is applied asymmetrically.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The regulatory framework or rule under which this adjustment was made. Examples: SEC Rule 22e-4, ESMA Swing Pricing Guidelines, UCITS Directive, AIFMD.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act, ESMA UCITS Directive

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment must be disclosed in regulatory filings or investor reports. Material adjustments typically require disclosure under SEC or ESMA rules.
attributes.references: SEC Form N-PORT, ESMA AIFMD Reporting

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment record represents a reversal of a previously applied adjustment. True for reversal entries; false for original adjustments.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the original adjustment was reversed. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance when adjustments are unwound.

attributes.name: triggering_condition
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific condition or threshold that triggered this adjustment. Examples: net redemptions exceeded 2% of AUM; illiquid asset position exceeded 15% of portfolio; market bid-ask spreads widened beyond 50 basis points.

attributes.name: previous_fund_valuation_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_valuation_adjustment (previous_fund_valuation_adjustment_id)

products.name: fund_switch
products.description: Transactional record of investor fund switch (exchange) transactions where units in one fund class are redeemed and proceeds are simultaneously reinvested into another fund class. Captures source fund class, target fund class, switch date, units redeemed, redemption NAV, switch proceeds, units subscribed, subscription NAV, switching fee, tax event flag, and settlement status. Distinct from standalone subscriptions and redemptions as the switch is a single atomic investor instruction.

attributes.name: fund_switch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fund switch transaction. Primary key for the fund switch record.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Fund switches originate from specific channels (digital platform, relationship manager, contact center). Required for channel performance measurement, cross-sell tracking, and investor behavior analys

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.currency. Business justification: Switch transaction currency for processing, FX conversion, and settlement. Required for multi-currency fund switching and transfer agency operations.

attributes.name: investor_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investor account initiating the fund switch transaction.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.journal_entry. Business justification: Fund switches generate journal entries for simultaneous redemption and subscription accounting across funds. Required for inter-fund transfer accounting, realized gain/loss recognition, and audit trai

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial intermediary or distributor through which the fund switch order was placed.

attributes.name: settlement_holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.holiday_calendar. Business justification: Switch settlement on valid business days per fund calendar. Critical for dealing deadline enforcement and transfer agency SLA compliance.

attributes.name: source_fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fund class from which units are being redeemed in the switch transaction.

attributes.name: source_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund from which units are being redeemed as part of the switch transaction.

attributes.name: target_fund_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fund class into which proceeds are being reinvested in the switch transaction.

attributes.name: target_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund into which proceeds are being reinvested as part of the switch transaction.

attributes.name: transfer_agent_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transfer agent responsible for processing the fund switch transaction.

attributes.name: aml_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the Anti-Money Laundering compliance check performed on the fund switch transaction.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation reference number issued to the investor upon successful processing of the fund switch transaction.

attributes.name: confirmation_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fund switch confirmation was sent to the investor.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fund switch transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: entry_load_amount
attributes.description: Entry load or subscription fee charged on the target fund class as part of the switch transaction.

attributes.name: entry_load_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to calculate the entry load on the subscription amount in the target fund class.

attributes.name: exit_load_amount
attributes.description: Exit load or redemption fee charged on the source fund class if the switch occurs before the lock-in period expires.

attributes.name: exit_load_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to calculate the exit load on the redemption proceeds from the source fund class.

attributes.name: gross_redemption_proceeds
attributes.description: Total proceeds from the redemption of units from the source fund class before deducting any fees or charges.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the Know Your Customer verification check performed on the investor account for the fund switch transaction.

attributes.name: lock_in_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the fund switch transaction complies with any lock-in period restrictions on the source fund class.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fund switch transaction record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_switch_proceeds
attributes.description: Net proceeds available for reinvestment into the target fund class after deducting switching fees, exit loads, and any applicable taxes.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investor submitted the fund switch order instruction.

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the fund switch order was received and recorded by the transfer agent or fund administrator.

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: Realized capital gain or loss resulting from the redemption leg of the fund switch transaction, calculated as the difference between redemption proceeds and cost basis.

attributes.name: redemption_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per unit of the source fund class applied to calculate the redemption proceeds.

attributes.name: redemption_units
attributes.description: Number of units redeemed from the source fund class as part of the switch transaction.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the fund switch transaction requires reporting to regulatory authorities under applicable financial regulations.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for rejection if the fund switch order was not accepted for processing.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the fund switch order was rejected.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund switch transaction is fully settled and the investor's holdings are updated in both source and target fund classes.

attributes.name: subscription_nav
attributes.description: Net Asset Value per unit of the target fund class applied to calculate the number of units subscribed.

attributes.name: subscription_units
attributes.description: Number of units subscribed in the target fund class using the net switch proceeds.

attributes.name: switch_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the fund switch order for tracking and confirmation purposes.

attributes.name: switch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fund switch transaction indicating its processing stage.

attributes.name: switch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the switch transaction indicating whether it is a full redemption and reinvestment, partial switch, or part of a systematic switch plan.

attributes.name: switching_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the fund administrator or transfer agent for processing the fund switch transaction.

attributes.name: switching_fee_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to calculate the switching fee based on the redemption proceeds or subscription amount.

attributes.name: tax_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the fund switch transaction triggers a taxable event for the investor under applicable tax regulations.

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount withheld from the redemption proceeds as required by applicable tax regulations.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fund switch transaction is executed and the Net Asset Value (NAV) is applied for both redemption and subscription legs.

attributes.name: previous_fund_switch_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on fund_switch (previous_fund_switch_id)

products.name: fund_management_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between employees and investment funds they manage or support. It captures the operational reality of team-based fund management where multiple portfolio managers, analysts, and traders are assigned to a single fund, and individual employees manage portfolios of multiple funds simultaneously. Each record links one employee to one fund with attributes that exist only in the context of this management assignment, including role type, time period, responsibility allocation, and primary manager designation.. Existence Justification: In institutional asset management, investment funds are managed by teams rather than individual managers. A single fund typically has multiple employees assigned in different roles (lead portfolio manager, analysts, traders, risk managers), and individual employees simultaneously manage portfolios of multiple funds. The bank actively manages these assignments as operational records, tracking role types, time periods, responsibility percentages, and primary manager designations for regulatory disclosure, performance attribution, and workload management.

attributes.name: fund_management_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the fund management assignment record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee assigned to manage or support the fund. References the employee master record in the HR domain.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the investment fund being managed. References the fund master record in the asset domain.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee's management or support role for this fund ended. Null for active assignments. Used to track historical management teams and support regulatory disclosures of manager tenure.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee began their management or support role for this fund. Used for regulatory reporting of fund manager changes, performance attribution analysis, and audit trail of management responsibility.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the management assignment. Active indicates the employee is currently performing the role. On_leave indicates temporary absence (sabbatical, parental leave). Transitioning indicates handover period. Terminated indicates assignment has ended.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the assignment record was created. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: primary_manager_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this employee is the primary or lead manager for the fund (true) or a supporting team member (false). Used for regulatory disclosures, investor communications, and escalation paths. Only one employee per fund should have this flag set to true at any given time for active assignments.

attributes.name: responsibility_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of management responsibility or time allocation the employee dedicates to this fund, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.00 for 25%). Used in matrix organizations where employees manage multiple funds simultaneously. Supports workload balancing, capacity planning, and proportional compensation allocation.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The specific role the employee performs for this fund assignment. Distinguishes between lead portfolio managers (primary decision authority), supporting portfolio managers, research analysts, traders executing fund strategies, risk managers, and compliance officers. Critical for regulatory disclosures and operational accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the assignment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: fund_risk_exposure
products.description: This association product represents the quantitative exposure relationship between a fund and a risk factor. It captures the sensitivity, exposure amount, and risk contribution of each risk factor to each fund's portfolio. Each record links one fund to one risk factor with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, supporting FRTB risk decomposition, VaR attribution, and regulatory stress testing.. Existence Justification: In investment fund risk management, each fund has exposure to multiple risk factors (interest rate curves, equity indices, FX rates, credit spreads), and each risk factor affects multiple funds across the portfolio. The business actively manages and monitors these exposures through daily risk calculations, VaR decomposition, and regulatory reporting under FRTB and Basel III. Risk teams create, update, and analyze these exposure records as part of operational risk management processes.

attributes.name: fund_risk_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fund-risk factor exposure record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: factor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fund Risk Exposure - Risk Factor Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific risk factor (interest rate curve, equity index, FX rate, credit spread) to which the fund has exposure

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the investment fund whose risk exposure is being measured

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this exposure record was calculated and persisted. Used for audit trail and to distinguish between intraday recalculations.

attributes.name: contribution_to_var
attributes.description: The marginal contribution of this specific risk factor to the fund's total Value at Risk (VaR). Calculated using partial derivatives and correlation structure. Expressed in base currency units.

attributes.name: exposure_status
attributes.description: Current status of this risk factor exposure: active (within limits), breached (exceeds risk limits), monitored (approaching limits), hedged (actively hedged position), closed (position no longer exists).

attributes.name: factor_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Absolute exposure amount of the fund to this risk factor, expressed in the fund's base currency. Represents the notional or market value of positions driven by this risk factor.

attributes.name: factor_sensitivity
attributes.description: Quantitative sensitivity of the fund's portfolio value to a unit change in the risk factor. For interest rate risk this is DV01 (dollar value of 1 basis point), for equity risk this is delta, for FX risk this is FX delta. Expressed in base currency units per unit change in the risk factor.

attributes.name: hedge_ratio
attributes.description: The proportion of the risk factor exposure that is hedged through derivatives or offsetting positions. Expressed as a decimal (0.0 = unhedged, 1.0 = fully hedged). Used for net exposure calculation and hedge effectiveness monitoring.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The business date (T) on which this risk factor exposure was measured and calculated. Risk exposures are typically calculated daily for active funds and may be calculated less frequently for closed-end or illiquid funds.

attributes.name: stress_scenario_impact
attributes.description: The estimated profit or loss impact on the fund if the risk factor experiences the regulatory stress scenario shock defined in the risk_factor master. Expressed in base currency units. Used for FRTB stressed VaR and scenario analysis.

domains.name: audit
domains.description: Internal audit management covering audit planning, audit engagements, audit findings, remediation tracking, continuous monitoring, and regulatory audit coordination. Manages the three lines of defense model and audit committee reporting.

products.name: plan
products.description: Annual and multi-year internal audit plan defining the universe of auditable entities, risk-based prioritization, resource allocation, and coverage strategy approved by the Audit Committee. Captures plan year, planning methodology (risk-based, cyclical, regulatory-driven), total planned audit hours, coverage percentage of audit universe, board/committee approval date, and plan version history. Serves as the master governance document for the internal audit function's annual work program.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit plan. Primary key for the audit plan entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Chief Audit Executive responsible for this audit plan. The CAE has ultimate accountability for plan development and execution.

attributes.name: prior_plan_id

attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the engagement record was first created in the audit management system.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: data_analytics_used_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advanced data analytics, machine learning, or automated testing tools were employed during the engagement (True) or traditional manual audit procedures were used (False).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: engagement_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the audit engagement, used in audit committee reporting and external communication.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit engagement: planning (scoping and preparation), fieldwork (evidence gathering and testing), reporting (draft and final report preparation), management response (awaiting or reviewing management action plans), closed (engagement complete), or cancelled (engagement terminated before completion).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit engagement by its primary purpose: assurance (independent evaluation), advisory (consulting), regulatory (mandated review), SOX compliance (Sarbanes-Oxley Act internal controls), IT audit (technology systems and controls), or AML/BSA review (Anti-Money Laundering/Bank Secrecy Act compliance).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: external_auditor_coordination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the engagement was coordinated with or relied upon by external auditors for financial statement audit purposes (True) or was independent of external audit (False).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing; Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Standards

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up audit procedures to verify implementation of management action plans and closure of findings.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the engagement requires formal follow-up audit procedures to validate that management has implemented agreed-upon action plans (True) or no follow-up is needed (False).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: inherent_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating of the auditable entity or process before considering the effectiveness of controls, based on factors such as financial materiality, regulatory exposure, complexity, and change activity.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing; Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: management_response_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which management is required to provide formal responses and action plans to address audit findings.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: management_response_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date when management submitted their formal responses and remediation action plans to the audit findings.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: overall_risk_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate risk rating assigned to the engagement based on the severity and number of findings, the inherent risk of the audited area, and the residual risk after considering management action plans.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing; Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled completion date for the audit engagement execution as defined in the audit plan or engagement letter.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: planned_hours
attributes.description: Total number of audit hours budgeted for the engagement, used for resource planning and capacity management.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled start date for the audit engagement execution as defined in the audit plan or engagement letter.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the engagement based on risk assessment, regulatory requirements, and strategic importance, used for resource allocation and scheduling decisions.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or governing body that mandated or oversees the engagement, if applicable (e.g., Federal Reserve, OCC, SEC, FINRA).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed); Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC); Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC); Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the engagement is mandated by a regulatory requirement, consent order, or supervisory agreement (True) or is discretionary based on risk assessment (False).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed); Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC); Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC)

attributes.name: report_distribution_list
attributes.description: List of stakeholders, executives, and audit committee members to whom the audit report was distributed, typically stored as a delimited list or reference to a distribution group.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: report_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the final audit report was formally issued to management and the audit committee.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating after considering the design and operating effectiveness of controls and management action plans to remediate identified findings.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing; Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: scope_statement
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit scope, including the processes, controls, systems, locations, and time periods covered by the engagement. Defines boundaries and exclusions.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: sox_section
attributes.description: Specific section of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act that this engagement addresses, if the engagement is SOX-related (e.g., Section 302, Section 404, Section 906).

attributes.name: three_lines_of_defense_line
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement within the three lines of defense model: first line (operational management and controls), second line (risk management and compliance oversight), or third line (internal audit providing independent assurance).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Three Lines of Defense Model

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the audit engagement that clearly identifies the subject matter and scope of the audit project.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the engagement record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: previous_audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on engagement (previous_audit_engagement_id)

products.name: engagement_scope
products.description: Detailed scope definition record for an audit engagement, capturing the specific processes, systems, legal entities, geographies, and time periods included in or excluded from the audit. Captures scope item type (process, system, geography, product), inclusion/exclusion flag, scope rationale, risk justification, regulatory driver, and scope change history. Enables precise documentation of what was and was not examined during an engagement, supporting audit quality and regulatory examination responses.

attributes.name: engagement_scope_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit engagement scope record.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent audit engagement for which this scope is defined.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.cost_center. Business justification: Cost center audits assess operational efficiency, budget compliance, and control effectiveness. Cost center scoping enables targeted audit procedures for organizational units.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.country. Business justification: Scope items specify country coverage determining regulatory requirements, audit procedures, and local compliance. Fundamental geographic dimension for banking audits. Replaces text country_code.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the materiality threshold (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: geographic_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.geographic_region. Business justification: Scope items specify geographic coverage for audit testing. Standard audit scoping practice in banking. Replaces text geographic_region field with proper reference.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.gl_account. Business justification: Auditors scope specific GL accounts for substantive testing, control testing, and account reconciliation validation. Account-level scoping is standard audit practice in financial statement audits.

attributes.name: instrument_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.instrument. Business justification: Audit scope definitions include specific instruments or instrument portfolios for targeted testing (e.g., high-risk derivatives, illiquid securities, new product types). Enables precise scope document

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Engagement scope items target specific legal entities for audit coverage tracking, regulatory coordination, and entity-level risk assessment. Replaces denormalized legal_entity_name with proper FK.

attributes.name: reference_product_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.product_type. Business justification: Engagement scope specifies which banking products are covered (retail lending, investment banking, treasury). Standard audit scoping dimension. Replaces denormalized product_name with proper reference

attributes.name: audit_committee_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scope item was specifically reported to the Audit Committee as part of engagement planning or scope changes (True if reported, False otherwise).

attributes.name: continuous_monitoring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scope item is subject to continuous monitoring controls in addition to periodic audit testing (True if continuously monitored, False otherwise).

attributes.name: control_framework
attributes.description: The control framework or standard against which this scope item will be audited (e.g., COSO, SOX, Basel III, GDPR).
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework, SOX, Basel III

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this engagement scope record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scope item is included (True) or explicitly excluded (False) from the audit engagement.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business to which this scope item belongs (e.g., Retail Banking, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Treasury).

attributes.name: materiality_threshold
attributes.description: The monetary materiality threshold applied to this scope item for determining audit significance and testing depth.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The identifier or name of the user who last modified this engagement scope record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this engagement scope record was last modified.

attributes.name: process_name
attributes.description: The name of the business process included in or excluded from the audit scope (e.g., Loan Origination, Trade Settlement, AML Transaction Monitoring).

attributes.name: regulatory_driver
attributes.description: The specific regulatory requirement, examination request, or compliance mandate that necessitated inclusion of this scope item (e.g., Federal Reserve, OCC, SEC, FINRA requirement).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System, OCC, SEC, FINRA

attributes.name: regulatory_examination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scope item was included in response to a regulatory examination request or finding (True if regulatory-driven, False otherwise).

attributes.name: risk_justification
attributes.description: Risk-based rationale for the scope decision, linking to the risk assessment that drove inclusion or exclusion of this item.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The assessed risk level of the scope item that influenced its inclusion or exclusion from the audit.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: The planned number of items or transactions to be tested for this scope item during the audit engagement.

attributes.name: sampling_approach
attributes.description: The sampling methodology to be applied to this scope item during audit testing (statistical, judgmental, full population review, or risk-based).

attributes.name: scope_change_approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who approved the scope change (e.g., Chief Audit Executive, Audit Committee Chair).

attributes.name: scope_change_date
attributes.description: The date on which this scope item was added, modified, or removed from the engagement scope.

attributes.name: scope_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scope item was added, modified, or removed after the initial scope definition (True if changed, False if original).

attributes.name: scope_change_reason
attributes.description: The business or regulatory reason for changing the scope after initial definition (e.g., new risk identified, regulatory request, resource constraint).

attributes.name: scope_item_code
attributes.description: The standardized code or identifier for the scope item as used in operational systems (e.g., GL account code, system ID, country code).

attributes.name: scope_item_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the specific process, system, geography, product, legal entity, or business unit included in or excluded from the audit scope.

attributes.name: scope_item_type
attributes.description: The category of scope item being defined (process, system, geography, product, legal entity, or business unit).

attributes.name: scope_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or context regarding this scope item that support audit quality and regulatory examination responses.

attributes.name: scope_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the time period covered by this scope item for the audit engagement.

attributes.name: scope_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the time period covered by this scope item for the audit engagement.

attributes.name: scope_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for including or excluding this item from the audit scope, documenting the decision-making process.

attributes.name: scope_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this scope item within the audit engagement (draft, approved, in progress, completed, or superseded).

attributes.name: system_name
attributes.description: The name of the operational system or application included in or excluded from the audit scope (e.g., Temenos T24, Murex, SAS Risk Management).

attributes.name: three_lines_of_defense_level
attributes.description: The line of defense level to which this scope item belongs in the three lines of defense model (first line operations, second line risk/compliance, third line internal audit).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The identifier or name of the user who created this engagement scope record.

attributes.name: previous_engagement_scope_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on engagement_scope (previous_engagement_scope_id)

products.name: program
products.description: Detailed audit test program and work plan for an engagement, defining the specific audit procedures, test steps, control objectives, and testing methodologies to be executed. Captures program step sequence, control objective, test procedure description, test type (walkthrough, substantive, controls testing, data analytics), expected evidence, assigned auditor, estimated hours, and completion status. Serves as the operational blueprint for fieldwork execution and quality assurance review.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit program. Primary key for the audit program entity.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent audit engagement that this program supports. Links the detailed test program to the broader audit engagement scope.

attributes.name: compliance_sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: Audit programs test specific SOX controls for design and operating effectiveness. This is the fundamental link between control documentation (compliance) and control testing (audit), required for SOX

attributes.name: program_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit manager or director who approved this audit program for execution. Establishes accountability for program design.

attributes.name: program_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member assigned as lead auditor responsible for executing this audit program and coordinating fieldwork.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior auditor or manager assigned to review the work performed under this audit program for quality assurance.

attributes.name: actual_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of audit hours spent executing this program. Compared against estimated hours for variance analysis and future planning.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit program was formally approved by the audit manager or director for execution. Marks transition from planning to fieldwork phase.

attributes.name: audit_committee_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this audit program will be reported to the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors. True for high-risk or material programs.

attributes.name: automated_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit program tests automated controls (system-enforced controls). True if program includes testing of IT general controls or application controls.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all testing procedures in this audit program were completed and documented. Marks the end of fieldwork phase.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of audit program steps completed (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated as (completed steps / total steps) * 100. Used for progress tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: High-level control objective that the audit program is designed to test (e.g., Ensure all loan disbursements are properly authorized and recorded). Aligns with COSO framework control objectives.

attributes.name: coso_component
attributes.description: COSO Internal Control Framework component addressed by this program: control_environment (tone at the top), risk_assessment (risk identification), control_activities (policies and procedures), information_communication (data flow), or monitoring (ongoing evaluation).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit program record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_analytics_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit program employs data analytics techniques (e.g., full population testing, trend analysis, anomaly detection). True if program uses advanced analytical methods.

attributes.name: estimated_hours
attributes.description: Planned number of audit hours required to complete this program. Used for resource planning and budget tracking.

attributes.name: expected_evidence_type
attributes.description: Description of the evidence expected to be collected during program execution (e.g., signed approval forms, system reports, reconciliation worksheets, email confirmations). Guides auditor documentation requirements.

attributes.name: external_auditor_reliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external auditors plan to rely on the work performed under this audit program for their financial statement audit. True if program meets external audit standards.

attributes.name: findings_count
attributes.description: Number of audit findings (control deficiencies, exceptions, observations) identified during execution of this audit program. Updated as testing progresses.

attributes.name: high_risk_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of high-risk or material findings identified during execution of this audit program. Subset of total findings requiring immediate management attention.

attributes.name: key_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit program tests key controls (controls that are critical to mitigating significant risks). True if program focuses on key controls per risk assessment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit program record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for auditor notes, observations, or special instructions related to this audit program. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Total number of items or transactions in the population from which the sample is drawn. Used to calculate sampling risk and extrapolate findings.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the audit program following organizational taxonomy (e.g., CR-2024, TRS-1001). Used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the audit program identifying the area or process being tested (e.g., Loan Origination Controls Testing, Treasury Operations Review).

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit program: draft (under development), approved (ready for execution), in_progress (fieldwork underway), completed (testing finished), on_hold (temporarily suspended), or cancelled (discontinued).

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit program by focus area: operational (process efficiency), financial (accounting controls), compliance (regulatory adherence), IT (technology controls), fraud (investigative), or regulatory (external examination support).

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Applicable regulatory framework or standard that this audit program addresses (e.g., SOX Section 404, Basel III Pillar 1, CCAR, DFAST, CECL, IFRS 9). Multiple frameworks may be listed comma-separated.

attributes.name: risk_area
attributes.description: Primary risk category addressed by this audit program per Basel III risk taxonomy: credit risk, market risk, operational risk, liquidity risk, compliance risk, or reputational risk.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of items or transactions selected for testing in this audit program. Determined based on risk assessment, population size, and desired confidence level.

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: Sampling approach used for test selection: judgmental (risk-based selection), statistical (probability-based), random (unbiased selection), stratified (segmented population), monetary_unit (dollar-weighted), or full_population (100% testing).

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit program scope including processes, systems, business units, and time periods covered. Defines boundaries of the testing effort.

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit program supports SOX Section 404 internal control testing over financial reporting. True if program tests key controls for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when fieldwork execution of this audit program began. Marks the commencement of testing activities.

attributes.name: test_approach
attributes.description: Primary testing methodology employed in this program: walkthrough (process understanding), substantive (transaction testing), controls_testing (design and operating effectiveness), data_analytics (population analysis), inquiry (interviews), observation (process witnessing), inspection (document review), or reperformance (independent execution). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: walkthrough|substantive|controls_testing|data_analytics|inquiry|observation|inspection|reperformance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: test_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the period covered by this audit program testing (e.g., 2024-12-31). Defines the temporal scope of audit procedures.

attributes.name: test_period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the period covered by this audit program testing (e.g., 2024-01-01). Defines the temporal scope of audit procedures.

attributes.name: three_lines_model_line
attributes.description: Identifies which line of defense this audit program evaluates per the IIA Three Lines Model: first_line (operational management), second_line (risk and compliance oversight), or third_line (internal audit).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the audit program template or instance (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Tracks revisions and updates to the program over time.

attributes.name: workpaper_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or identifier linking this audit program to the corresponding audit workpapers and documentation repository (e.g., WP-CR-2024-001). Supports audit trail and evidence management.

attributes.name: previous_audit_program_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on program (previous_audit_program_id)

Constitutes the evidentiary record supporting audit findings and opinions, subject to quality assurance review and regulatory inspection.
