attributes.references: IIA Standards - International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when internal audit completed validation testing and confirmed effective implementation of the recommendation.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Detailed findings from internal audit validation testing, including evidence reviewed, testing procedures performed, and assessment of control effectiveness post-implementation.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of internal audit validation testing to confirm effective implementation of the recommendation. Validated status is required before recommendation can be closed.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: superseded_recommendation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on recommendation (superseded_recommendation_id)

products.name: management_action
products.description: Management action plan (MAP) record capturing the business unit's formal response and committed remediation actions in response to an audit recommendation. Captures action description, action owner name and title, target completion date, revised target date (if extended), completion evidence description, action status (open, in progress, completed, overdue, closed), closure date, and internal audit validation status. Tracks the full remediation lifecycle from management commitment through audit validation of closure.

attributes.name: management_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the management action plan record. Primary key for the management action entity.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards - IIA International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing

attributes.name: action_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the action owner, linking to the human capital management system for accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System - Employee Master Data

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent audit engagement that generated the finding requiring this management action.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - Engagement Planning and Execution

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific audit finding or recommendation that this management action addresses.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.cost_center. Business justification: Management actions are owned and executed by cost centers. Cost center linkage provides precise accountability, budget tracking, and organizational performance assessment. Replaces denormalized respon

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost amount, supporting multi-currency operations and consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Management actions are executed within specific legal entities for regulatory compliance, board reporting, and entity-level remediation tracking. Legal entity attribution is required for audit committ

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the remediation action that management commits to implement in response to the audit finding or recommendation.

attributes.name: action_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding the management action plan, supporting communication between management and internal audit.
attributes.references: Audit Management System - Collaboration and Communication

attributes.name: action_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual accountable for executing and completing the management action plan.

attributes.name: action_owner_title
attributes.description: Job title or position of the action owner, establishing their authority and accountability level within the organization.

attributes.name: action_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the management action based on the severity and risk rating of the underlying audit finding.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the management action plan tracking progress from commitment through validation and closure.
attributes.references: Audit Management System - Action Status Workflow

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of remediation action being implemented, supporting analysis of remediation patterns and resource planning.
attributes.references: Audit Management System - Action Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when management reported that the remediation action was fully implemented and ready for internal audit validation.

attributes.name: audit_committee_report_date
attributes.description: Date when this management action was most recently reported to the audit committee, supporting governance oversight and escalation tracking.
attributes.references: Audit Committee Meeting Minutes and Reporting Calendar

attributes.name: audit_committee_reported_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this management action has been reported to the audit committee due to its significance, risk rating, or aging status.
attributes.references: Corporate Governance - Audit Committee Charter and Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the management action plan was formally closed after successful validation by internal audit, marking the end of the remediation lifecycle.

attributes.name: completion_evidence_description
attributes.description: Description of the evidence provided by management to demonstrate that the remediation action has been completed as committed.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - Evidence and Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: control_framework
attributes.description: Identification of the internal control framework or standard that the management action supports, such as COSO, SOX, Basel III operational risk, or bank-specific control library.
attributes.references: Enterprise Control Framework - COSO, SOX Section 404, Basel III

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the management action plan record was first created in the audit management system, marking the start of the remediation lifecycle.

attributes.name: days_open
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the management action has been open, calculated from the action creation date to closure date or current date if still open.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated financial cost to implement the management action, including labor, technology, and other resource costs, used for budgeting and prioritization.
attributes.references: Financial Planning and Analysis - Remediation Budget Tracking

attributes.name: extension_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the extension to the target completion date was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: extension_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authority who approved the extension request, typically senior management or audit committee.

attributes.name: extension_count
attributes.description: Number of times the target completion date has been extended, used to track management action aging and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: extension_reason
attributes.description: Business justification provided by management for requesting an extension to the original target completion date.
attributes.references: Audit Management System - Extension Approval Process

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business classification for the management action, aligning with the banks organizational and reporting structure.

attributes.name: map_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or reference number for the management action plan, used in audit committee reporting and tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who most recently modified the management action plan record, supporting accountability and change management.
attributes.references: Data Governance - Data Lineage and Accountability

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the management action plan record, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: original_target_completion_date
attributes.description: Initial target date committed by management for completing the remediation action, established at the time of management response.

attributes.name: overdue_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the management action is past its target completion date without being closed, triggering escalation and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_driver
attributes.description: Identification of the specific regulatory requirement, examination finding, or compliance framework that drives this management action if applicable.
attributes.references: Regulatory Compliance Framework - Basel III, Dodd-Frank, SOX, BSA/AML

attributes.name: regulatory_examination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this management action originated from or is related to a regulatory examination finding requiring formal response to regulators.
attributes.references: Regulatory Reporting Requirements - Fed, OCC, FDIC, SEC

attributes.name: revised_target_completion_date
attributes.description: Updated target completion date if the original deadline was extended due to legitimate business reasons, requiring approval and justification.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk severity rating of the underlying audit finding that this management action addresses, inherited from the audit finding risk assessment.
attributes.references: Enterprise Risk Management - Risk Rating Methodology

attributes.name: three_lines_of_defense_level
attributes.description: Classification of which defense line owns the remediation action: first line (business operations), second line (risk and compliance), or third line (internal audit).
attributes.references: IIA Three Lines Model - Governance Framework

attributes.name: validated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal auditor who performed the validation testing and confirmed action closure.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - Auditor Independence and Objectivity

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when internal audit completed the validation testing and confirmed the effectiveness of the implemented management action.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Internal audit observations and comments from the validation testing, documenting the basis for the validation conclusion.
attributes.references: Audit Documentation Standards - Working Paper Requirements

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of internal audits independent validation of whether the management action was implemented effectively and addresses the original finding.
attributes.references: IIA Standards - Follow-up and Validation Process

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created the management action plan record, typically an internal auditor or audit management system administrator.
attributes.references: Data Governance - Data Lineage and Accountability

attributes.name: related_management_action_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on management_action (related_management_action_id)

products.name: issue_validation
products.description: Internal audit validation record documenting the testing and evidence review performed to confirm that a management action has been effectively implemented and the underlying finding has been remediated. Captures validation date, validation method (document review, re-testing, walkthrough, data analysis), evidence reviewed, validation conclusion (validated closed, partially remediated, not remediated), validator name, and any residual risk assessment. Provides the formal audit sign-off on finding closure and supports regulatory examination responses.

attributes.name: issue_validation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the issue validation record.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit finding that is being validated for closure.

attributes.name: management_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the management action plan that was implemented to remediate the finding.

attributes.name: validator_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the auditor who performed the validation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation conclusion was formally approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the audit manager or Chief Audit Executive (CAE) who approved the validation conclusion.

attributes.name: audit_committee_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation result was reported to the Audit Committee.

attributes.name: audit_committee_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this validation result has been reported to the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.

attributes.name: control_effectiveness_rating
attributes.description: Rating of the effectiveness of the remediated control based on validation testing results.
attributes.references: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the validation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: evidence_location
attributes.description: File path, document repository location, or system reference where validation evidence is stored.

attributes.name: evidence_reviewed
attributes.description: Description of the evidence and documentation reviewed during the validation process to confirm remediation.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of exceptions identified during the validation testing.

attributes.name: exceptions_identified
attributes.description: Description of any exceptions or deficiencies identified during validation testing that indicate incomplete remediation.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date for completing any required follow-up validation or remediation activities.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional follow-up validation or management action is required.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified the validation record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the validation record was last modified.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or examiner requesting validation evidence, if applicable.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC)

attributes.name: regulatory_examination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this validation supports a regulatory examination response or inquiry.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: Date when the finding was reopened based on validation results.

attributes.name: reopen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finding was reopened due to validation testing revealing incomplete or ineffective remediation.

attributes.name: reopen_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the finding was reopened after validation testing.

attributes.name: residual_risk_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether management has formally accepted the residual risk.

attributes.name: residual_risk_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of any remaining risk after the management action has been implemented, including likelihood and impact.
attributes.references: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Categorical rating of the residual risk remaining after remediation.
attributes.references: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: sample_population
attributes.description: Total population size from which the validation sample was drawn.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of items or transactions tested during the validation process.

attributes.name: testing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by the validation testing.

attributes.name: testing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by the validation testing.

attributes.name: three_lines_of_defense_level
attributes.description: Identifies which line of defense performed the validation within the three lines of defense governance model.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Three Lines Model

attributes.name: validation_conclusion
attributes.description: Final conclusion of the validation testing indicating whether the finding has been effectively remediated.
attributes.value_regex: validated closed|partially remediated|not remediated|pending additional evidence|deferred|superseded

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the validation testing and evidence review was performed.

attributes.name: validation_method
attributes.description: Method used to validate the effectiveness of the management action implementation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: document review|re-testing|walkthrough|data analysis|observation|inquiry|inspection|recalculation — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes and observations from the validation testing, including any exceptions or concerns identified.

attributes.name: validation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the validation record, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the validation record in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: validation_team
attributes.description: Name of the audit team or unit responsible for performing the validation.

attributes.name: validator_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal auditor or audit team member who performed the validation testing.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created the validation record.

attributes.name: previous_issue_validation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on issue_validation (previous_issue_validation_id)

products.name: audit_report
products.description: Formal audit report record representing the official communication of engagement results to management and the Audit Committee. Captures report title, report type (draft, final, management letter, advisory memo, regulatory response), issuance date, distribution list, overall audit opinion, executive summary, number of findings by rating, management response summary, and report version. The primary deliverable of each engagement and the basis for Audit Committee reporting and regulatory examination responses.

attributes.name: audit_report_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit report record. Primary key for the audit report entity.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent audit engagement that this report documents. Links the report to the underlying audit work performed.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Audit reports are issued for specific legal entities for board reporting, regulatory filing, and entity-level audit opinion. Legal entity linkage is fundamental for audit reporting structure.

attributes.name: audit_committee_presentation_date
attributes.description: Date the audit report was formally presented to the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors. Critical for governance oversight and regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: audit_director_name
attributes.description: Name of the audit director or Chief Audit Executive (CAE) who reviewed and approved the audit report. Accountable for audit quality and independence.

attributes.name: audit_objective
attributes.description: Statement of the specific goals and intended outcomes of the audit engagement. Defines what the audit was designed to accomplish and the questions it sought to answer.

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the time period covered by the audit examination. Defines the cutoff for transactions and activities included in the audit scope.

attributes.name: audit_period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the time period covered by the audit examination. Defines the temporal scope of transactions and activities reviewed.

attributes.name: background_context
attributes.description: Descriptive information about the audited area including business processes, organizational structure, regulatory environment, and prior audit history. Provides context for understanding the audit scope and findings.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level governing distribution and handling of the audit report. Restricted reports contain sensitive findings requiring limited distribution, confidential reports are for management only, internal reports are for employee access, and public reports may be disclosed externally.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the audit report record was first created in the audit management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical-severity findings identified in the audit. Critical findings represent significant control deficiencies with high likelihood and impact that require immediate management attention and Board notification.

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: List of individuals and roles who received the audit report including business unit management, executive leadership, Audit Committee members, and regulatory examiners. Documents report dissemination for governance and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: executive_summary
attributes.description: High-level overview of the audit objectives, scope, key findings, and conclusions. Provides senior management and the Audit Committee with a concise understanding of the engagement results without requiring detailed review.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date for conducting follow-up audit procedures to verify remediation of findings. Typically set based on management's committed action plan completion dates.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this audit report requires formal follow-up audit work to validate implementation of management action plans. True indicates follow-up audit is scheduled.

attributes.name: high_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of high-severity findings identified in the audit. High findings represent material control weaknesses that could result in significant financial, operational, or reputational impact.

attributes.name: issuance_date
attributes.description: Official date the audit report was formally issued to management and the Audit Committee. Marks the beginning of management response and remediation tracking timelines.

attributes.name: lead_auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the senior auditor who led the engagement and is responsible for the report content and conclusions. Primary point of contact for questions and follow-up.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Business segment or division that was the subject of the audit (e.g., Commercial Lending, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Retail Banking). Used for risk-based audit planning and reporting.

attributes.name: low_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of low-severity findings identified in the audit. Low findings represent minor control weaknesses or opportunities for process improvement.

attributes.name: management_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether management agrees with the audit findings and conclusions. True indicates full agreement, false indicates disagreement requiring escalation and documentation of differing views.

attributes.name: management_response_summary
attributes.description: Consolidated summary of management's formal responses to audit findings including agreement or disagreement with findings, planned corrective actions, responsible parties, and target completion dates.

attributes.name: medium_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of medium-severity findings identified in the audit. Medium findings represent control weaknesses that should be addressed but do not pose immediate significant risk.

attributes.name: methodology_description
attributes.description: Explanation of the audit approach, techniques, and procedures employed including interviews, walkthroughs, testing, data analytics, and sampling methods. Documents how the audit work was performed.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the individual who last modified the audit report record. Used for accountability and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the audit report record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record for version control and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, context, or supplementary information about the audit report that does not fit in other structured fields. May include special circumstances, scope limitations, or coordination notes.

attributes.name: overall_audit_opinion
attributes.description: Summary assessment of the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, and control processes within the audited area. Satisfactory indicates effective controls, needs improvement indicates control weaknesses requiring attention, unsatisfactory indicates significant deficiencies, and no opinion indicates scope limitations prevented a conclusion.

attributes.name: positive_observations
attributes.description: Documentation of effective controls, best practices, and areas of strong performance identified during the audit. Provides balanced reporting and recognizes effective risk management.

attributes.name: quality_assurance_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this audit report underwent independent quality assurance review by a senior auditor not involved in the engagement. True indicates QA review was performed per IIA standards.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Quality Assurance and Improvement Program

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority that requested or coordinated with this audit (e.g., Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, SEC, FINRA). Applicable when regulatory_examination_flag is true.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)

attributes.name: regulatory_examination_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this audit report was prepared in response to or coordination with a regulatory examination by Federal Reserve, OCC, FDIC, SEC, or other banking supervisory authority.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC)

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the audit report, typically following organizational numbering conventions (e.g., IA-2024-001). Used for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audit report. In progress indicates drafting, under review indicates management or quality assurance review, issued indicates formal distribution, and archived indicates retention for historical reference.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the report format and purpose. Draft reports are preliminary versions for management review, final reports are official deliverables, management letters communicate control weaknesses, advisory memos provide consulting guidance, regulatory responses address examiner findings, and follow-up reports track remediation progress.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment of the audited area based on inherent risk, control effectiveness, and residual risk. Used for prioritizing audit resources and management attention.
attributes.references: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations (COSO) Enterprise Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the boundaries of the audit including processes, systems, locations, time periods, and organizational units examined. Also documents any scope limitations or exclusions.

attributes.name: sox_scope_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this audit report covers controls within the scope of Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404 internal control over financial reporting requirements. True indicates SOX-relevant controls were examined.

attributes.name: three_lines_of_defense_level
attributes.description: Classification of which defense line the audited area belongs to in the three lines of defense model. First line is operational management, second line is risk and compliance oversight, third line is internal audit.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Three Lines Model

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Formal title of the audit report that describes the subject matter and scope of the engagement (e.g., 'Commercial Lending Credit Underwriting Process Audit').

attributes.name: total_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of audit findings across all severity levels. Provides an aggregate measure of control deficiencies identified during the engagement.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking iterations of the report through draft, review, and final stages. Increments with each substantive revision.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the individual who created the audit report record in the system. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: superseded_audit_report_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on audit_report (superseded_audit_report_id)

products.name: resource
products.description: Internal audit staff and resource master record capturing the human capital available to the audit function. Captures auditor name, employee ID (FK to hr domain), job title, audit grade/level, professional certifications (CIA, CPA, CISA, CFE, FRM), areas of expertise (credit risk, AML, IT, trading, regulatory), language capabilities, years of experience, current engagement assignments, and availability status. Supports resource planning, skills-based assignment, and capacity management for the audit function.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit resource record. Primary key for the audit resource master data.

attributes.name: current_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the current active audit engagement the resource is assigned to. Null if the resource is currently unassigned or on administrative leave.

attributes.name: resource_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee master record in the Human Resources (HR) domain. Links the audit resource to their core HR profile for payroll, benefits, and organizational hierarchy.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: resource_reporting_line_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee ID of the auditors direct line manager within the internal audit function. Used for performance management and organizational hierarchy reporting.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: audit_grade
attributes.description: Hierarchical grade or level of the auditor within the internal audit organization. Used for resource planning, assignment complexity matching, and career progression tracking.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Competency Framework

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the internal auditor. Used for audit report attribution, engagement assignment, and audit committee reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current availability status of the audit resource for new engagement assignments. Critical for real-time resource planning and audit plan execution.

attributes.name: available_capacity_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the auditors time currently available for new audit assignments (0-100). Calculated based on current engagement workload, administrative duties, and planned time off.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Resource Planning Guidelines

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent background check performed on the auditor. Required for regulatory compliance and audit committee reporting. Typically refreshed every 3-5 years.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) Guidelines

attributes.name: cfe_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor holds the Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) professional certification from the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE). Critical for fraud investigation, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) audit, and forensic audit assignments.

attributes.name: cia_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor holds the Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) professional certification from the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Critical for regulatory audit assignments and audit committee credibility.

attributes.name: cisa_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor holds the Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) professional certification from ISACA. Essential for IT audit, cybersecurity audit, and technology risk assessment engagements.

attributes.name: continuous_professional_education_hours
attributes.description: Total number of Continuous Professional Education (CPE) hours completed by the auditor in the current reporting period. Required for maintaining professional certifications (CIA, CPA, CISA) and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards, AICPA, ISACA

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) cost center code to which the auditors salary and expenses are allocated. Used for internal audit budget tracking and financial reporting.
attributes.references: General Ledger and Financial Accounting System (Oracle Financials / SAP S4HANA)

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the auditors home office location. Used for regulatory reporting, cross-border audit coordination, and jurisdictional compliance tracking.

attributes.name: cpa_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor holds the Certified Public Accountant (CPA) professional certification. Relevant for financial statement audits, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) compliance, and General Ledger (GL) audits.
attributes.references: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit resource record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: current_engagement_role
attributes.description: Role the auditor is performing on their current engagement (e.g., Lead Auditor, Team Member, Subject Matter Expert). Used for workload balancing and engagement oversight.

attributes.name: frm_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the auditor holds the Financial Risk Manager (FRM) professional certification from the Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP). Relevant for market risk, credit risk, operational risk, and Basel III compliance audit engagements.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the auditor was hired into the internal audit function at the institution. Used for tenure calculations, anniversary recognition, and retention analytics.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: home_office_location
attributes.description: Primary office location or city where the auditor is based. Used for travel planning, regional audit coverage, and cost center allocation.
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: independence_attestation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent independence attestation signed by the auditor. Required annually per Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards to confirm the auditor has no conflicts of interest with audit subjects.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standard 1100 - Independence and Objectivity

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the audit resource within the internal audit function (e.g., Senior Auditor, Audit Manager, Chief Audit Executive, IT Audit Specialist).
attributes.references: Human Capital Management System (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors)

attributes.name: language_capabilities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages the auditor is proficient in (e.g., English, Spanish, Mandarin, French). Critical for international audit assignments and cross-border regulatory examinations.

products.name: quality_assurance_review
products.description: Internal audit quality assurance and improvement program (QAIP) review record capturing both internal ongoing assessments and periodic external quality assessments. Captures review type (internal self-assessment, external assessment, regulatory peer review), review period, reviewer identity (internal QA team or external assessor), conformance rating (generally conforms, partially conforms, does not conform) against IIA Standards, key observations, improvement recommendations, and CAE response. Required by IIA Standards 1300 and increasingly scrutinized by bank regulators.
products.reference: IIA Standards 1300 – Quality Assurance and Improvement Program

attributes.name: quality_assurance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality assurance review record. Primary key for the quality assurance review entity.

attributes.name: prior_review_quality_assurance_review_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous quality assurance review record, enabling tracking of improvement trends and follow-up on prior recommendations.

attributes.name: action_plan_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Improvement Action Plan Due Date

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology and approach used to conduct the quality assurance review, including sampling techniques, interview protocols, workpaper reviews, and benchmarking frameworks applied.

attributes.name: audit_committee_approval_flag

attributes.references: IIA Standards 1320 - Reporting on the Quality Assurance and Improvement Program

attributes.name: audit_committee_presentation_date

attributes.name: cae_response

attributes.name: conformance_rating
attributes.description: Overall assessment rating indicating the degree to which the internal audit activity conforms with the IIA Standards and Code of Ethics. Generally Conforms is the top rating indicating the internal audit activity is judged to achieve the fundamental requirements; Partially Conforms indicates deficiencies in practice; Does Not Conform indicates the internal audit activity has not achieved many or all of the fundamental requirements.
attributes.references: IIA Standards 1320 - Reporting on the Quality Assurance and Improvement Program

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: follow_up_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up quality assurance review is required to validate implementation of corrective actions and improvements, typically triggered by partially conforms or does not conform ratings.

products.name: issue_tracker
products.description: Consolidated issue tracking register providing a real-time inventory of all open audit findings, regulatory findings, and management actions across the enterprise. Captures issue source (internal audit, regulatory exam, external audit, self-identified), issue reference, business unit owner, risk rating, original due date, current due date, number of extensions granted, days overdue, escalation status, and aging bucket. Serves as the single operational dashboard for audit management, business line accountability, and Audit Committee reporting on remediation progress.
products.reference: IIA Standards 2500 – Monitoring Progress; OCC Heightened Standards

attributes.name: issue_tracker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit issue tracking record. Primary key for the audit issue tracker.

attributes.name: audit_engagement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit engagement that identified this issue. Applicable when issue_source_type is internal_audit. Links to the engagement table for full audit context.

attributes.name: finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the detailed audit finding record that describes the control deficiency or observation. Provides linkage to the full finding documentation including root cause analysis and detailed testing results.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.legal_entity. Business justification: Issues are tracked by legal entity for entity-level issue management, board reporting, and regulatory coordination. Legal entity linkage enables entity-specific issue aging, escalation, and remediatio

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loan.loan_account. Business justification: Issue tracker consolidates findings from audits, regulatory exams, and continuous monitoring; issues often relate to specific loan accounts (e.g., ECL error on loan #12345). Linking issues to loan acc

attributes.name: operational_risk_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.operational_risk_event. Business justification: Issue tracker consolidates audit findings and operational risk events for integrated remediation tracking. Links issue to event, supporting root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and regulat

attributes.name: primary_issue_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual assigned day-to-day responsibility for coordinating remediation activities and providing status updates. Typically a manager or director within the business unit.

attributes.name: prior_issue_issue_tracker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous audit issue tracker record if this is a repeat finding. Enables tracking of recurring issues and remediation effectiveness over time.

attributes.name: responsible_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to ledger.cost_center. Business justification: Issues are assigned to cost centers for remediation accountability, budget allocation, and organizational performance tracking. Cost center linkage replaces denormalized business_unit_owner with prope

attributes.name: tertiary_issue_validated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the auditor who performed the validation testing. Links to employee or auditor table for contact information and credentials.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Categorization of issue age based on days since identification. Used for aging analysis and audit committee reporting. Buckets typically align with escalation thresholds.

attributes.name: audit_committee_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the issue was presented to the Audit Committee. Null if not yet reported or if audit_committee_reported_flag is false.

attributes.name: audit_committee_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this issue has been reported to the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors. True for high-risk issues, material weaknesses, significant deficiencies, and regulatory findings that require board-level awareness.
attributes.references: Corporate Governance Standards, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 301

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the issue was officially closed after successful validation. Used to calculate time-to-remediate metrics and track closure rates.

attributes.name: control_framework
attributes.description: The control or regulatory framework that the issue relates to. Examples include COSO Internal Control, SOX Section 404, Basel III, AML/BSA, CCAR, DFAST, IFRS 9, CECL.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX), Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), Bank Secrecy Act (BSA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit issue tracker record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: current_due_date
attributes.description: Current target date for completing remediation after any approved extensions. This is the active due date used for overdue calculations and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the issue is past the current due date. Calculated as current date minus current_due_date when status is overdue. Zero or null when not overdue.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the issue was escalated to a higher level of management or governance. Null if no escalation has occurred.

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Current escalation level based on overdue status, risk rating, and extension count. None indicates no escalation. Higher levels indicate increasing senior management and governance body involvement.
attributes.references: Corporate Governance Standards, Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards

attributes.name: extension_count
attributes.description: Number of times the due date has been extended since the issue was opened. High extension counts trigger escalation and audit committee attention.

attributes.name: external_auditor_coordination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue has been shared with or identified by the external auditor. True for SOX-relevant issues and material weaknesses that impact the financial statement audit.
attributes.references: Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Standards

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: Date when the issue was first identified or reported. Used to calculate aging metrics and track time from identification to closure.

attributes.name: issue_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit issue, control deficiency, or regulatory finding. Includes the condition observed, the criteria or standard that was not met, and the context of the deficiency.
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: issue_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to the issue for tracking and communication purposes. Used in audit committee reports and management communications.

attributes.name: issue_source_type
attributes.description: The origin or source that identified the issue. Distinguishes between internal audit findings, regulatory examination findings, external audit observations, self-identified issues by business units, management reviews, and continuous monitoring alerts.
attributes.references: Three Lines of Defense Model, Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards

attributes.name: issue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the issue. Open indicates newly identified and not yet started. In_progress indicates remediation activities underway. Pending_validation indicates remediation complete and awaiting audit validation. Closed indicates validated and closed. Overdue indicates past due date.

attributes.name: issue_title
attributes.description: Concise title or summary of the audit issue or finding. Used in executive dashboards and audit committee reporting for quick identification.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Specific Line of Business (LOB) code or name where the issue was identified. Examples include Commercial Lending, Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Retail Banking, Treasury, Risk Management.
attributes.references: Internal Organizational Structure, Basel III Pillar 3 Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: management_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions management has committed to implement to remediate the issue. Includes specific steps, milestones, and resource commitments.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: material_weakness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue constitutes a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting as defined by SOX and PCAOB standards. Material weaknesses must be disclosed in the annual 10-K filing.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) AS5

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified this audit issue tracker record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit issue tracker record was last updated. Used for audit trail and tracking changes to issue status, due dates, and remediation progress.

attributes.name: original_due_date
attributes.description: Initial target date agreed upon for completing remediation when the issue was first opened. Serves as baseline for tracking extensions and delays.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority that issued the finding when issue_source_type is regulatory_exam. Examples include Federal Reserve (Fed), Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB).
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System, OCC, FDIC, SEC, FINRA, CFPB

attributes.name: regulatory_exam_reference
attributes.description: Official examination reference number or Matter Requiring Attention (MRA) number assigned by the regulatory body. Used for tracking and correspondence with regulators.
attributes.references: Federal Reserve System, OCC, FDIC Examination Standards

attributes.name: remediation_approach
attributes.description: High-level category describing the primary remediation strategy. Process redesign for fundamental process changes, control enhancement for strengthening existing controls, system implementation for technology solutions, policy update for governance changes, training for capability building, resource addition for staffing or budget increases.

attributes.name: remediation_progress_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage completion of the management action plan. Ranges from 0.00 to 100.00. Used for tracking progress and identifying stalled remediation efforts.

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this issue is a repeat of a previously identified and closed finding. Repeat findings indicate ineffective remediation or control sustainability issues and trigger heightened scrutiny.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary risk category that the issue impacts. Aligns with the enterprise risk taxonomy and Basel III risk classifications for banking institutions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_risk|market_risk|operational_risk|liquidity_risk|compliance_risk|strategic_risk|reputational_risk — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), COSO ERM Framework

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Severity rating of the issue based on potential impact to the organization. Critical issues pose immediate threat to safety, soundness, or regulatory compliance. High issues represent significant control deficiencies. Medium and low represent lesser degrees of risk.
attributes.references: COSO Enterprise Risk Management Framework, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) Risk Management Principles

attributes.name: significant_deficiency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue constitutes a significant deficiency in internal control over financial reporting. Less severe than a material weakness but important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) AS5

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issue impacts a SOX-relevant control over financial reporting. True if the issue affects a key control supporting financial statement assertions under SOX Section 404.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) AS5

attributes.name: three_lines_position
attributes.description: Indicates which line of defense in the Three Lines Model is responsible for remediation. First line (business operations), second line (risk and compliance oversight), or third line (internal audit).
attributes.references: Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Three Lines Model

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when audit validation testing was completed. Null if validation has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of audit validation testing to confirm remediation effectiveness. Not_started indicates remediation not yet complete. In_progress indicates validation testing underway. Passed indicates successful validation. Failed indicates remediation did not address the issue. Deferred indicates validation postponed.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created this audit issue tracker record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: related_issue_tracker_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on issue_tracker (related_issue_tracker_id)

products.name: cae_charter
products.description: Chief Audit Executive (CAE) charter and mandate record defining the purpose, authority, independence, and responsibility of the internal audit function as approved by the Audit Committee and Board. Captures charter version, effective date, approval date, approving body, scope of internal audit authority, reporting lines (functional to Audit Committee, administrative to CEO/CFO), independence provisions, access rights to records and personnel, and budget authority. attributes.name: approving_body

attributes.name: charter_status

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `banking_ecm`.`_metrics`.`account_fee`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Fee assessment and waiver metrics"
  source: "`banking_ecm`.`account`.`account_fee`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "assessment_date"
      expr: assessment_date
      comment: "Date the fee was assessed"
    - name: "assessment_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', assessment_date)
      comment: "Month of fee assessment"
    - name: "fee_description"
      expr: fee_description
      comment: "Description of the fee"
    - name: "product_code"
      expr: product_code
      comment: "Product code associated with the fee"
    - name: "billing_cycle"
      expr: billing_cycle
      comment: "Billing cycle for the fee"
  measures:
    - name: "total_fee_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net fee amount assessed"
    - name: "total_waived_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(waived_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount of fees waived"
    - name: "fee_record_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of fee records"
    - name: "average_fee_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net fee amount per record"
$$
metric_views.description: Fee assessment and waiver metrics
